{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":4,"lineType":1,"content":"粵昔帝堯，命羲和敬授人時，厥民知析因夷隩之節。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313861139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":4,"lineType":1,"content":"後","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313877523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"聖有作，推而彌廣，至於外事用剛日，内事用柔日，此皆","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313877523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"載之經典，百王不易者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313877523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"厥後濫觴，日以訛謬，術士以","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313893907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶禍福之說，震驚朕師，不可方物。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313893907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"如褚少孫補史記","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313910291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"所稱彼家云吉，此家云凶，彼家云小吉，此家云大凶，茫","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313910291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"乎不知其畔岸。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313910291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"漢武以來，已如聚訟，而荀悅、王充輩斥","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313926675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194129932324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"為理之所無，弃而勿論者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313926675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，天以日月行四時，人","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313943059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"奉天而時若，嚮明而治，嚮晦而息，后王君公所以奉若","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313943059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"天道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313943059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"日出而作，日入而息，羣黎百姓所以奉若天道","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313959443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313959443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"否則不能晨夜，不夙則暮，詩人譏焉，人人所知也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313975827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313992211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"則舉大事，動大衆，協乎五紀，辨乎五方，以順天地之性，","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313992211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"豈無寸分節解，以推極其至精至微之理者歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678953174313992211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"其支離","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314008595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"䝉昧，拘牽謬悠之說，乃術士之過，而非可因噎而廢食","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314008595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314008595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"欽天監舊有選擇通書，刻於康熙二十二年。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314024979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"其書","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314041363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194129948708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"成於星官之手，因訛襲謬，見之施行，往往舉矛刺盾。","logicSentenceId":"7678953174314041363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"皇祖聖祖仁皇帝知其荒率，不可以訓，曾纂為星厯考原一","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969614399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"書，刋刻頒行，而未將監本改正，葢以待夫後人。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969614399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人之心，慎而又慎如此也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969630783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"以諭監臣，監臣曰：通書之謬，允","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969647167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"宜改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969647167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"朕因其請，謂及今猶有莊親王等數人，曾經","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969663551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"38","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"皇祖指授，稍明此理。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969679935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"使此時不加訂正，恐後此益復無可任","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969696319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"使。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969696319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"爰命編輯成書，頒布天下，較之舊本，謬說少除。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969712703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"然俗","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969729087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"所久沿，則亦不能盡去，便民用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969729087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"命名曰協紀辨方書。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969745471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194129965092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"夫協紀辨方者，敬天之紀，敬地之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969761855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"一作止，一語黙，","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969778239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"天地實式臨之，况其大乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969778239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"如曰如是則吉，如是則凶，如","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969794623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"是則福，如是則禍，則明者所弗道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953686969794623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，敬不敬之間，","logicSentenceId":"767895368 {"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"一，男女合婚，","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801342479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":240,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"進愛已經奏請刪去。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801342479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"至其嫁娶大","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801358863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"利月及周堂日，亦屬不經，皆術士之妄說也。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801358863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"查大","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801375247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"利月以女命為主，陽年本命前一月、隂年本命後","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801375247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353305316737024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"一月為大利。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801375247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"次月妨媒，次月妨翁姑，次月妨女父","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801391631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"母，次月妨夫，次月妨女本身。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801391631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"惟妨本身月為女之","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801408015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"本命，與其對衝，然選擇亦無專取本命年支一字","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801408015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"之例，餘更無義可推。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801408015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"至于周堂，載在時憲書，以乾","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801424399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"為翁，坎為第，艮為竈，震為婦，巽為㕑，離為夫，坤為","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801424399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"姑，兌為堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801424399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"大月從夫順數，小月從婦逆數，遇第堂","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801440783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"㕑竈為吉，遇翁姑夫婦則妨其人，並不論本命與","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801440783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"日干支，尤屬無理。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801440783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"細按其圖，合於儀禮，成婚之次","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801457167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353305316753408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"日，新婦盥饋，而舅姑饗婦之位次，其所為翁姑夫","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801457167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"婦者，各人所立之方向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801457167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"宅與堂者，宅為坎宅，堂","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801473551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"為坐西朝東之堂，行禮之所，古人堂室如是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801473551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"有","logicSentenceId":"7678941574801489935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"l {"lines":[{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194130931748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"啓䝉附論曰：圖之一六為水，即後天之坎位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395956969499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"三八為","logicSentenceId":"7678946395956985883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"木，即後天震巽之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395956985883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"二七為火，即後天之離位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957002267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957018651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"九為金，即後天兌乾之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957018651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"五十為土，即後天之坤艮，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957035035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"周流四季，而偏旺於丑未之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957035035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"葢所以象五氣之順","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957051419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"布也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957051419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194130948132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4ickm/1-SK1619_figure_00009.webp~tplv- {"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194130964516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"啓䝉附論曰：洛書九數，虚中五以配八卦，陽上隂下，故","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957067803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"九為乾，一為坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957067803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"因自九而逆數之，震八、坎七、艮六，乾生","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957084187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"三陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957084187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"又自一而順數之，巽二、離三、兌四，坤生三隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957100571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"以八數與八卦相配，而先天之位合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957116955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"133","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"按，術家以乾配九，坤配一，離配三，坎配七，其數奇，故為","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957133339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957133339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"兌配四，震配八，巽配二，艮配六，其數偶，故為隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957149723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194130980900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4ip7q/1-SK1619_figure_00010.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zqN51pI5FAQCuZTBfblcvbKqZ3A%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4ip7q/1-SK1619_figure_00010.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=857BoogXbCYwIhniU6aHEcaWFak%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4ip7q/1-SK1619_figure_00010.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194130997284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"啓䝉附論曰：火上水下，故九為離，一為坎。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957166107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"火生燥土，故","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957182491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"八次九，而為艮。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957182491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"燥土生金，故七六次八，而為兌。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957198875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"乾水生","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957215259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"濕土，故二次一，而為坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957215259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"濕土生木，故三四次二，而為震","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957231643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"巽。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957231643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"以八數與八卦相配，而後天之位合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957248027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"按，邵子以文王八卦為入用之位，後天之學。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957264411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子以洛","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957280795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"書為數之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957280795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"術家飛宫弔替，俱用後天配洛書。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957297179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957313563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"坎一、坤二、震三、巽四、中五、乾六、兌七、艮八、離九為序。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957313563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"劉","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957329947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"歆曰：八卦九章，相為表裏。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957329947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"張衡曰：聖人重之以卜筮，雜","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957346331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131013668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"之以九宫，則所從來遠矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957346331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"160","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"周禮：十日之號，十有二辰之號，十有二月之號，十有二","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957379099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"歳之號，二十有八星之號。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957379099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭𤣥注曰：日，謂從甲至癸，辰","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957395483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"謂從子至亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957395483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"月謂從娵至荼。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957411867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"歳，謂從攝提格至赤奮若，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957428251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"星謂從角至軫。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957428251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"○爾雅月陽：月在甲，曰畢；在乙曰橘；在","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957444635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，曰修；在丁曰圉；在戊曰厲；在已曰則；在庚曰窒；在辛","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957444635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"曰塞；在𡈼，曰終，在癸，曰極。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957444635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"月名：正月為娵，二月為如，三","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957461019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131030052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"月為寎，四月為余，五月為臯，六月為且，七月為相，八月","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957461019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"為壯，九月為元，十月為陽，十一月為辜，十二月為涂。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957461019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"歳","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957477403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"陽：太歳在甲，曰閼逢；在乙，曰旃䝉；在丙，曰柔兆；在丁，曰","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957477403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"强圉；在戊，曰著雍；在已曰屠維，在庚曰上章，在辛曰重","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957477403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"光，在𡈼曰𤣥黓，在癸曰昭陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957477403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"歳名太歳在寅曰攝提格，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957493787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"在卯曰單閼，在辰曰執徐，在已曰大荒落，在午曰敦牂，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957493787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"在未曰協洽，在申曰涒灘，在酉曰作噩，在戌曰閹茂，在","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957493787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"亥曰大淵獻，在子曰困敦，在丑曰赤奮若。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957493787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡邕獨斷云：干，幹也，其名有十，甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957526555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"癸是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957526555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"支，枝也，其名一十有二，子、丑、寅、卯、辰、巳、午、未、申、","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957542939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、戌、亥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957542939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"○禮記月令：春月，其日甲乙，夏月，其日丙","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957559323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，中央土，其日戊巳，秋月，其日庚辛，冬月，其日𡈼癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957559323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957575707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"史記律書曰：七正二十八舍律歴，天所以通五行八正","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957575707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣，天所以成熟萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957575707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"舎者，日月所舎。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957592091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"舎者，舒氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957608475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"不周風居西北，主殺生。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957624859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"東壁居不周風東，主辟生氣而","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957641243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131062820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"東之。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957641243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"至於營室。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957657627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"營室者，主營胎陽氣而産之。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957674011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"東至於危，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957690395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"危，垝也，言陽氣之危垝，故曰危。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957690395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"十月也，律中應鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957706779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"應鐘","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957723163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"者，陽氣之應，不用事也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957723163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957739547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"亥者，該也，言","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957755931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣藏於下，故該也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957755931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"廣莫風居北方。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957772315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"廣莫者，言陽氣在","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957788699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"下，隂莫陽廣大也，故曰廣莫。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957788699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"東至於虚，虚者，能實能虚，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957805083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"言陽氣冬則宛藏於虚，日冬至則一隂下藏，一陽上舒，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957805083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰虚。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957805083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"東至於須女，言萬物變動其所，隂陽氣未相離，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957821467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"尚相如胥也，故曰須女。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957821467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月也，律中黄鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957837851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"黄鐘者，陽","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957854235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131079204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"氣踵黄泉而出也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957854235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為子。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957870619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，滋也；滋者，言","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957887003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物滋於下也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957887003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十母為𡈼癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957903387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼之為言任也，言陽","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957919771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"氣任養萬物於下也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957919771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"癸之為言揆也，言萬物可揆度，故","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957936155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"曰癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957936155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"東至牽牛。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957952539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"牽牛者，言陽氣牽引萬物出之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957968923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"牛者，","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957985307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"冒也，言地雖凍，能冒而生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395957985307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"牛者，耕植種萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958001691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"東至","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958018075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"於建星。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958018075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"建星者，建諸生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958034459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月，律中大吕。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958050843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"大吕者，其","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958067227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"於十二子為丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678946395958067227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"丑者，紐也，言陽氣在上未降，萬物厄紐","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686470153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"未敢出。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686470153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"條風居東北，主出萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686486537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"條之言條治萬物而出","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686502921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131095588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"之，故曰條風。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686502921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於箕，箕者，言萬物根棋，故曰箕。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686519305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"正月","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686535689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"也，律中泰簇。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686535689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"泰簇者，言萬物簇生也，故曰泰簇。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686552073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686568457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"二子為寅，寅，言萬物始生螾然也，故曰寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686568457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於尾，言","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686584841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物始生如尾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686584841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於心，言萬物始生有華心也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686601225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"南","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686617609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"至於房，房者，言萬物門户也，至於門則出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686617609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"明庶風居","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686633993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"東方。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686633993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"明庶者，明衆物盡出也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686650377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"二月也，律中夾鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686666761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"夾鐘者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686683145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"言隂陽相夾厠也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686683145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為卯，卯之為言茂也，言","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686699529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物茂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686699529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十母為甲乙，甲者，言萬物剖符甲而出","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686715913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131111972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"也；乙者，言萬物生軋軋也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686715913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於氐，氐者，言萬物皆至","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686732297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686732297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於亢，亢者，言萬物亢見也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686748681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"南至於角，角者，言萬","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686765065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"物皆有枝格如角也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686765065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"三月也，律中姑洗。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686781449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"姑洗者，言萬物","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686797833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"洗生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686797833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為辰，辰者，言萬物之蜄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686814217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"清明風居","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686830601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"東南維，主風吹萬物而西之軫。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686830601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"軫者，言萬物益大而軫","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686846985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"軫然。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686846985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"西至於翼，翼者，言萬物皆有羽翼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686863369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"四月也，律中","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686879753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"仲吕。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686879753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"仲吕者，言萬物盡旅而西行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686896137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為己","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686912521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"巳者，言陽氣之已盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686912521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"西至於七星，七星者，陽數成於","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686928905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131128356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"七，故曰七星。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686928905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"西至於張，張者，言萬物皆張也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686945289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"西至於注，","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686961673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"注者，言萬物之始衰，陽氣下注，故曰注。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686961673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"五月也，律中蕤","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686978057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"賓。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686978057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"蕤賓者，言隂氣幼少，故曰蕤；痿陽不用事，故曰賓。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502686994441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"景","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687010825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"風居南方，景者，言陽氣道竟，故曰景風。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687010825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687027209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"午，午者，隂陽交，故曰午。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687027209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十母為丙丁，丙者，言陽道","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687043593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"著明，故曰丙；丁者，言萬物之丁壯也，故曰丁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687043593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"西至于弧，","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687059977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"弧者，言萬物之吳落且就死也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687059977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"西至于狼，狼者，言萬物","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687076361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"可度量斷萬物，故曰狼。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687076361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"涼風居西南維，主地。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687092745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"地者，沈奪","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687109129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131144740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687109129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"六月也，律中林鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687125513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"林鐘者，言萬物就死，氣林","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687141897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"林然。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687141897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為未，未者，言萬物皆成，有滋味也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687158281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"北","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687174665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"至於罰，罰者，言萬物氣奪可伐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687174665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"北至於參，參言萬物","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687191049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"可參也，故曰參。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687191049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"七月也，律中夷則。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687207433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"夷則，言隂氣之賊萬","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687223817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"物也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687223817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為申，申者，言隂用事，申賊萬物，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687240201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687240201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"北至於濁，濁者，觸也，言萬物皆觸死也，故曰濁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687256585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"北至","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687272969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"於留，留者，言陽氣之稽留也，故曰留。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687272969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"八月也，律中南吕。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687289353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"南吕者，言陽氣之旅入藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687305737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687322121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，萬","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687338505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353194131161124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"物之老也，故曰酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687338505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"閶闔風居西方。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687354889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"閶者，倡也；闔者，藏也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687371273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"言陽氣道萬物，闔黄泉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687371273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十母為庚辛。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687387657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"庚者，言隂","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687404041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"氣庚萬物，故曰庚；辛者，言萬物之辛生，故曰辛。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687404041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"北至於","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687420425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"胃，胃者，言陽氣就藏，皆胃胃也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687420425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"北至於婁，婁者，呼萬物","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687436809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"且内之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687436809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"北至於奎，奎者，主毒螫殺萬物也，奎而藏之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687453193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"九月也，律中無射。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687469577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"無射者，隂氣盛用事，陽氣無餘也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687485961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"曰無射。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687485961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"其於十二子為戌，戌者，言萬物盡滅，故曰戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678947502687502345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：按史記天官書曰：用昏建者，杓；夜半建者，衡；平","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039103026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"旦建者，魁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039103026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"又春秋運斗極云：第一天樞，第二璇，第三璣，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039119410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"第四權，第五衡，第六開陽，第七搖光。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039119410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"第一至第四為魁，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039135794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"第五至第七為杓，合而為斗。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039135794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月初昏，則用斗杓指","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039152178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313939963940"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，夜半，則用斗衡指寅，平旦，則用斗魁指寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039152178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"其日月","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039168562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"所㑹之宫，謂之月將。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039168562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"娵訾，亥也；降婁，戌也，大梁，酉也，實","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039184946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"沈，申也，鶉首，未也，鶉火，午也；鶉尾，已也；壽星，辰也，大火，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039184946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"卯也，析木，寅也，星紀，丑也，𤣥枵，子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039184946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"子曰神后，丑曰大","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039201330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，寅曰功曹，卯曰太衝，辰曰天罡，已曰太乙，午曰勝光，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039201330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"未曰小吉，申曰傳送，酉曰從魁，戌曰河魁，亥曰登明。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039201330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039217714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"建運天道而左旋，為天關，月將稟地道而右轉，為地軸。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039217714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313939980324"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313939996708"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jehy/1-SK1619_figure_00012.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Vi5gDu2%2FY9SIWuuYnmH5w6G8xmQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jehy/1-SK1619_figure_00012.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=O9ohZMqudCcUpUsBh%2FyGqkrAKtY%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jehy/1-SK1619_figure_00012.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940013092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"蠡海集曰：十二肖屬，子為隂極，幽潛隠晦，以鼠配之，鼠","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"藏迹；午為陽極，顯易剛健，以馬配之，馬快行；丑為隂，俯","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"而慈愛，以牛配之，牛䑛犢；未為陽，仰而秉禮，以羊配之，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"羊跪乳；寅為三陽，陽勝則暴，以虎配之，虎性暴；申為三","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，隂勝則黠，以猴配之，猴性黠；卯酉為日月之門，二肖","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"皆一竅，兔䑛雄毛則孕，感而不交也；雞合踏而無形，交","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"而不感也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039234098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳陽起而變化，龍為盛，蛇次之，故龍、蛇配","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039250482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳，龍、蛇者變化之物也；戌亥隂斂而持守，狗為盛，猪","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039250482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940029476"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"次之，故狗、猪配戌亥，狗、猪者鎮靜之物也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039250482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"或云皆取不","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039266866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"全之物配肖屬者，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039266866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"庶物萬類，豈特十二哉！","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039283250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"况無義","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039299634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"理，不足信也明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039299634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：十二辰禽象，子鼠、丑牛、寅虎、卯兔、辰龍、巳蛇、午","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039316018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"馬、未羊、申猴、酉雞、戌狗、亥猪，其說相沿已久，莫知其所","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039316018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"自來。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039316018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"雖於經典無見，然以傳記子史考之，則不獨宋以","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039332402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"後也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039332402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"如韓愈毛穎傳謂食於卯地，祭張員外文謂虎取","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039348786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"而去，來寅其徵，則唐時有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039348786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"管輅傳推東方朔龍蛇","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039365170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940045860"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"之占，以為變化相推，㑹於辰巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039365170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"又譙周謂司馬為典午，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039381554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"則漢晉時有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039381554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"遡而上之，陳敬仲筮者言當昌於姜","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039397938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"姓之國，而釋春秋謂觀之六四，納得辛未，辛為巽長女，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039397938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"未為羊，羊加女為姜，則是周時又已有之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039397938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"至於二十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039414322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"八宿禽象，則近代方有之，意者因十二辰所取而附㑹","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039414322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"其說耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039414322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"何則？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039430706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰以子、午、卯、酉為四中宫，故一宫各","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039447090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"筦三象。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039447090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"子宫女、虚、危，虚星居中，故為鼠之本象；女為蝠，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039463474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"危為燕，則取其似鼠者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039463474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫氐、房、心，房星居","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039479858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940062244"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"中，故為兔之本象；氐為貉，心為狐，則取其似兔者以配","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039479858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039479858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"午宫柳星、張星居中，故為馬之本象；柳為獐，張為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039496242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"鹿，則取其似馬者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039496242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"酉宫胃、昴、畢，昴星居中，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039512626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"為雞之本象；胃為雉，畢為烏，則取其似雞者以配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039512626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘寅、申、己、亥、辰、戌、丑、未八宫，則各筦兩象，而以近中","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039529010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"宫者為主。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039529010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫，亢近中宫，故為龍之本象，角居其旁，則","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039545394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"取蛟為龍之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039545394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"寅宫，尾近中宫，故為虎之本象，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039561778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"箕居其旁，則取豹為虎之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039561778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"丑宫，牛近中宫，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039578162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940078628"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"為牛之本象，斗居其旁，則取獬為牛之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039578162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"亥宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039594546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"室近中宫，故為猪之本象，壁居其旁，則取㺄為猪之類","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039594546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039594546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"戌宫婁近中宫，故為狗之本象，奎居其旁，則取","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039610930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"狼為狗之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039610930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"申宫，觜近中宫，故為猴之本象，參","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039627314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"居其旁，則取猿為猴之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039627314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"未宫，鬼近中宫，故為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039643698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"羊之本象，井居其旁，則取犴為羊之類以配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039643698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"已宫，翼","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039660082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"近中宫，故為蛇之本象，軫居其旁，則取蚓為蛇之類以","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039660082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"配之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039660082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"517","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"考原云：日有六十，宿有二十八，四百二十日而一週。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039692850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039709234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"百二十者，以六十與二十八俱可以度盡也，故有七元","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039709234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039709234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"一元甲子日起虚，以子象鼠，而虚為日鼠也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039725618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"二元","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039742002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子起奎，三元甲子起畢，四元甲子起鬼，五元甲子起","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039742002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"翼，六元甲子起氐，七元甲子起箕，至七元盡而甲子又","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039742002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"起虚，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039742002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"但一元起於何年月日，則不可得而考","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039758386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039758386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"今按日月五星運行二十八舎，遲速不齊，躔次各别，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039774770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940111396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"交錯參差，遲留伏逆，縱使推之歴始，必有甲子年月日","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039774770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"時日在虚，月在危，五星以次居室、壁、奎、婁、胃者，然少選","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039774770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"月即過其度矣，且安得又從昴至鬼，復順次而列之哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039774770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"以不齊之天行，按一定之星舎，乃萬無之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039791154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"七政安","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039807538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"得與二十八宿相配耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039807538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"徧閱羣書，莫可考究，及見西域","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039823922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶時日善惡宿曜經，乃得其說。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039823922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"葢彼國不知十干十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039840306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"二支之名，而用二十八宿以紀日，其七政加二十八宿，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039840306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"猶干之加於支，非謂七政之果躔于此宿也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039840306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"又其術以","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039856690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940127780"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"人之生日所逢何曜何宿為本命，謂之命宿。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039856690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"而以加於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039873074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"行事所逢曜宿，參伍攷之，以命凶吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039873074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"又以宿曜性情，合","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039889458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"所為之事之剛柔健順，以定從違，亦有似於中國之建","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039889458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"除星命家言者。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039889458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"其宿曜之名，虚、昴、星、房屬日，危、畢、張、心","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039905842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"屬月，室、觜、翼、尾屬火，壁、參、軫、箕屬水，奎、井、角、斗屬木，婁、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039905842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼、亢、牛屬金，胃、柳、氐、女屬土，則各從其國語。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039905842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"假如日曜","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039922226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽，在回鶻則曰蜜，在波斯則曰曜森勿，在天竺則曰","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039922226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"阿你底耶，重譯之，即中國之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039922226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"其他皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039938610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"七元周","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039954994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940144164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"而復始，恰與此相符。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039954994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"其書又謂中國、西天諸國，此法並","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039971378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"所通行。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039971378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"今按厯家每歳鋪注于六十甲子，載在時憲書，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039987762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"而無所用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503039987762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞中惟伏斷、暗金二者，從此起例，其他並","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040004146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"不關渉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040004146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"然外域既以此紀年，則厯家存此，可使絶域殊","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040020530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"方同曉某日是何甲子，甚為有益，良不可廢也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040020530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"六經論五行者，始見於尚書洪範，曰：一五行：一曰水，二","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040053298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"曰火，三曰木，四曰金，五曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040053298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"大禹謨曰：水、火、金、木、土、穀","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040069682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940160548"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"惟修。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040069682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"其源起於河圖、洛書之數。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040086066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"葢圖、書之一、六，水也；二、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040102450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"七，火也；三、八，木也；四、九，金也；五、十，土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040102450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"在圖則左旋而","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040118834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"相生，在書則右轉而相克也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040118834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"然土於圖、書為五、十中宫","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040135218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"之數，無定位，無專體者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040135218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"惟吕氏春秋則以土直季夏","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040151602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，以順相生之序。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040151602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎通又以土直辰、戌、丑、未之四","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040167986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"季，而分旺於四時。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040167986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"文王後天圖象，坤、艮二土，獨居夏秋","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040184370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"冬春之交，則以火必得土而後能成金，水必得土而後","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040184370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"能生木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040184370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"今按行也者，言其行於地者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040200754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"質行於地，而","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040217138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940176932"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"氣通於天，數之有五焉，故曰五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040217138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"地者，土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040233522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"以其對","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040249906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"天言之，則曰地；以其質言之，固土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040249906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"土之為四行君也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040266290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"固也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040266290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"君則不專其司，不居其部，是故以火之克金，而秋","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040282674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"乃承夏令也，則謂既有四方，必有中央，而中央固土也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040282674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"可以嗣火之老而生金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040282674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"以春秋冬夏之遞嬗，四行轉","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040299058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"多而土轉少也，則謂季月必辰戌丑未，而辰戌丑未固","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040299058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"土也，減十二日以與本令，餘十八日為土王用事，則各","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040299058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"七十二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040299058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮二土居四氣之交，為土之真體，則後","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040315442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940193316"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"天圖象明之；乾巽二方，據魁罡之户，示土之神用，則素","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040315442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"問運氣詳之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040315442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"土之君乎四行也審矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040331826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"然此猶皆為有象","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040348210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"可示者也，若其無象可示者，則寅申己亥、子午卯酉，實","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040348210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"無一之離乎土焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040348210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"何也？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040364594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"非土則水火金木不能以行，其","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040380978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"能以行者皆土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040380978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940209700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940226084"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jr52/1-SK1619_figure_00013.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gp2teQtwlo5du50iwHaWb3H7y9U%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jr52/1-SK1619_figure_00013.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uekbumKH4a%2F1q%2FZwesdkEQ0mtM4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4jr52/1-SK1619_figure_00013.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false
