{"lines":[{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940242468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：五行旺各有時，惟土居無所定，乃於四立之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040397362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"前各旺一十八日。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040397362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：立春木，立夏火，立秋金，立","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040413746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"冬水，各旺七十二日，土於四立之前各旺一十八日，合","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040413746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"之亦為七十二日，總三百有六十而歳成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503040413746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940258852"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4k3s6/1-SK1619_figure_00014.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lyJhX2fY58T6P5R5kAewS5JwYeQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4k3s6/1-SK1619_figure_00014.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mcc17Wijd9SagvtW6YlHcb8Hkf8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4k3s6/1-SK1619_figure_00014.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940275236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：木長生於亥，火長生於寅，金長生於己，水長生","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391113242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"於申，土亦長生於申，寄生於寅，各由長生、沐浴、冠帶、臨","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391113242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"官、帝、旺、衰、病、死、墓、絶、胎、養，順歴十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391113242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天道循𤨔，生","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391129626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"生不已，故木方旺而火已生，火方旺而金已生，金方旺","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391129626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"而水已生，水方旺而木已生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391129626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"由長生而順推，穉則必壯，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391146010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"盛則必衰，終而復始，迭運不窮，此四時之所以錯行，五","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391146010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之所以順布也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391146010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"至於土生於申，而寄生於寅，則後天","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391162394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮之位，故易於坤曰萬物皆致養焉，於艮曰萬物之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391162394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940291620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"所成終而所成始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391162394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"639","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"按五行長生之義，考原之說甚明，而土之生於寅申，則","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391178778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"引而未發。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391178778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"由今考之，水土之同生於申也，申為坤，坤為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391195162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"地，水土所以凝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391195162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"土之寄生於寅也，寅為孟春，孟春之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391211546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"月，天氣下降，地氣上騰，天地所以和同，草木所以萌動","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391211546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391211546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"是故洪範家獨以土生於申為五行之體，隂陽選擇","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391227930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"諸家皆以土生於寅為五行之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391227930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"葢長生在寅，則臨官","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391244314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"在已，乃為土旺金生，與木、火、水同為一例。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391244314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"然則以土為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391260698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940308004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"生於寅者，所以順五行相生之序，固與月令土旺於夏","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391260698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"秋之交，以順四時相生之序者，同出於理之自然，而非","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391260698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"為臆說也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391260698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"外此又有陽死隂生、陽順隂逆之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391277082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"甲木死","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391293466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"於午，則乙木生焉；丙戊死於酉，則丁巳生焉；庚金死於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391293466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"子，則辛金生焉；𡈼水死於卯，則癸水生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391293466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"由長生而沐","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391309850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"浴，十二位皆逆轉，陽死則隂生，隂死則陽生，此二氣之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391309850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391309850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"陽臨官則隂帝旺，隂臨官則陽帝旺，此四時之㑹","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391326234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391326234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"順逆分合，俱極妙理。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391342618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"論十干則分隂陽，論五行則陽","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391359002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940324388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"統隂，尤天地自然之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391359002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"故凡言數者皆祖之此吉凶神","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391375386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"煞所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391375386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940406308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"天干則甲乙屬木，丙丁屬火，戊己屬土，庚辛屬金，𡈼癸","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391391770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391391770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"地支則寅卯辰屬木，配東方也；己午未屬火，配南","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391408154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"方也；申酉戌屬金，配西方也；亥子丑屬水，配北方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391408154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391424538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"土寄旺於辰、戌、丑、未之間，配四季也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391424538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"五星家又以寅亥","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391440922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"屬木，卯戌屬火，辰酉屬金，子丑屬土，而午則為日，未則","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391440922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"為月者，則以子丑在下，故為土，午未在上，故為日、為月。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391440922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、卯、辰、巳、申、酉、戌、亥分布左右，則如四時之流行於天","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391457306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"地之間，故以其左右之合宫而别為木、火、金、水之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391457306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940422692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"右皆考原所載，今具録之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391473690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"其言五星五行，則引而未發。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391490074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋天者，日也、月也；星者，日月之餘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391506458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"午未者，離；子丑者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391522842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"坎。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391522842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"離為日，坎為月。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391539226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"午之為日，是己子之不為月者何？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391555610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391571994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"者，水之精，懸乎上而受日之光者，非北方子之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391571994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391588378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"丑之氣衝乎上而與日並，其方，固必在未也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391588378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"地者，水也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391604762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"土也，子水丑土，丑又比水之土，其為地之體無可疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391604762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"地，土也，故子丑為土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391621146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"天位乎上，地位乎下，行乎兩間","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391637530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"者必木火金水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391637530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"子丑為水土，水土之際，木必生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391653914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391670298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940439076"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥寅為木，一長生一禄位也，木成而火已出矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391670298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"寅火","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391686682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"長生也；卯，木旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391686682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"旺則必嬗，嬗則必歸其根，故卯戌為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391703066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391703066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"卯戌為火，則戌為黅天之氣，戊之所居。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391719450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"黅天之氣","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391735834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"始於辰，辰亦戊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391735834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"土旺必生金，故辰酉為金。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391752218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，金之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391768602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"帝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391768602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"酉居金旺之極，於其未至於極而水已生於申，對","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391784986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"宫為己巳，金之母也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391784986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"水必以申巳者，申巳逼於午未，最","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391801370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"髙之地無水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391801370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"舉母則子歸水，不得舎土而自立。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391817754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"其麗","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391834138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"於土者，即子丑之位，土之所攝，命為土而不命為水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391834138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391850522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940455460"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"其離土而言水，必納於母氣，故申巳為水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391850522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"水為生物","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391866906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"之源，是以麗乎日月，其次則金，其次則火，其次則木，其","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391866906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"次則土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391866906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"五緯之序，水最近日，金次之，火又次之，木又次","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391883290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"之，土又次之，此麗乎天者之自然之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391883290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"水土所生者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391899674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"木上生而為火，土又上生而為金，又上生而為水，如畫","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391899674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之由下而上也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391899674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"此行乎地者之自然之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391916058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"然則五","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391932442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"星五行，具有實理，而非人所能强為也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391932442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940471844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940488228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu {"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940504612"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰合水局，亥卯未合木局，寅午戌合火局，己酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391948826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"合金局。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391948826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：三合者，取生旺墓三者以合局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391965210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391981594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"生於申，旺於子，墓於辰，故申子辰合水局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391981594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"木生於亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391997978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"旺於卯，墓於未，故亥卯未合木局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503391997978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"火生於寅，旺於午，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392014362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"墓於戌，故寅午戌合火局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392014362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"金生於巳，旺於酉，墓於丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392030746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"故己酉丑合金局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392030746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"756","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"今按淮南子云：木生於亥，壯於卯，死於未，三辰皆木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392047130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"火生於寅，壯於午，死於戌，三辰皆火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392063514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"土生於午，壯於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392079898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940520996"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，死於寅，三辰皆土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392079898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"金生於己，旺於酉，死於丑，三辰","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392096282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"皆金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392096282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"水生於申，壯於子，死於辰，三辰皆水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392112666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"故五勝","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392129050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"生一，壯五終九，五九四十五，故神四十五日而一徙，以","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392129050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"三應五，故八徙而歳終。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392129050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"由今考之，隂陽家言三合者，唯","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392145434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"水火木金而已，不及於土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392145434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"然言隂陽之書，淮南子亦","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392161818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"可為古矣，所為三合之說，未必不始於是書，而土之三","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392161818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"合，則不傳於世者，何歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392161818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"且世所言土之長生等十二位，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392178202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"與火無異，而淮南子則謂生午、壯戌、死寅，亦他書所無","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392178202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940537380"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"有也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392178202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"今附載於此，以備一義。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392194586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940553764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4luzq/1-SK1619_figure_00019.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8sN7t7h99lEFvGY1AA30fSplSII%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4luzq/1-SK1619_figure_00019.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dlQqKQugVBsgNIQ1VvBdKAw%2Bbik%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4luzq/1-SK1619_figure_00019.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940570148"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"子與丑合，寅與亥合，卯與戌合，辰與酉合，巳與申合，午","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392210970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"與未合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392210970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"○蠡海集曰：隂陽家地支六合者，日月㑹於子，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392227354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"則斗建丑，日月㑹於丑則斗建子，故子與丑合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392227354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"日月㑹","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392243738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅，則斗建亥，日月㑹於亥，則斗建寅，故寅與亥合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392243738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392260122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"月㑹於卯，則斗建戌，日月㑹於戌，則斗建卯，故卯與戌","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392260122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"合；日月㑹於辰，則斗建酉，日月㑹於酉，則斗建辰，故辰","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392260122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"與酉合；日月㑹於己，則斗建申，日月㑹於申，則斗建巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392260122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"故巳與申合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392260122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"日月㑹於午，則斗建未，日月㑹於未，則斗","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392276506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940586532"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"建午，故午與未合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392276506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：六合者，以月建與月將為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392292890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392292890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月建寅，月將在亥，故寅與亥合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392309274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建卯，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392325658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"月將在戌，故卯與戌合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392325658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"月建左旋，月將右轉，順逆相","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392342042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"值，故為六合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392342042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"801","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"按月將即是日。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392358426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"月無光，受日之光，月行與日合而成歳","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392374810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"紀，則是日者，月之將也，故曰月將。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392374810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"非别有神從日而右","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392391194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"轉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392391194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"其躔次，亥曰娵訾，戌曰降婁，酉曰大梁，申曰實","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392407578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"沈，未曰鶉首，午曰鶉火，巳曰鶉尾，辰曰壽星，卯曰大火，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392407578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940602916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"寅曰析木，丑曰星紀，子曰𤣥枵。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392407578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋左氏傳已有其說，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392423962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"至今用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392423962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"其躔度過宫，具載公規。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392440346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940619300"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4m7mu/1-SK1619_figure_00020.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=KrZZN2K4vL3a5Q1u%2Fmmb145c5yk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4m7mu/1-SK1619_figure_00020.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=L5IGMCSY%2BH76OgITFm1O7kroP8k%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4m7mu/1-SK1619_figure_00020.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940701220"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"甲與己合，乙與庚合，丙與辛合，丁與𡈼合，戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503392735258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642771502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"己化土，乙庚化金，丙辛化水，丁𡈼化木，戊癸化火。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642771502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"○考","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642787886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"原曰：五合者，即五位相得而各有合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642787886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖一與六，二","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642804270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"與七，三與八，四與九，五與十，皆各有合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642804270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"以十干之次言","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642820654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"之，一為甲，六為己，故甲與己合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642820654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"二為乙，七為庚，故乙與","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642837038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"庚合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642837038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"三為丙，八為辛，故丙與辛合；四為丁，九為𡈼，故丁","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642853422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"與𡈼合；五為戊，十為癸，故戊與癸合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642853422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"又年起月，日起時，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642869806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"越五則花甲，周而復始，而月時同干，亦即五合之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642869806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940717604"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"按化氣之理，沈括據黄帝素問論之最明。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642886190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"素問有五運","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642902574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"六氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642902574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂五運者，甲己為土運，乙庚為金運，丙辛為水","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642918958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"運，丁𡈼為木運，戊癸為火運也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642918958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"黄帝問岐伯五運之所","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642935342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"始，岐伯引太始天元冊文曰：始于戊巳之分。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642935342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642951726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"分者，奎壁、角軫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642951726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"奎壁、角軫，天地之門户也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642968110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"王冰注引","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642984494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲：六戊為天門，六已為地户。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503642984494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"天門在戌亥之間，奎壁","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643000878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"之分；地户在辰巳之間，角軫之分。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643000878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽皆始于辰，五運","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643017262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"起于角軫者，亦始于辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643017262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳之歳，戊巳，黅天之氣經","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643033646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940733988"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"于角軫，角屬辰，軫屬己，其歳得戊辰、己巳，干皆土，故為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643033646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"土運。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643033646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚之歳庚辛，素天之氣經于角軫，其歳得庚辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643050030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳，干皆金，故為金運。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643050030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之歳𡈼癸，元天之氣經于","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643066414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"角軫，其歳得𡈼辰、癸巳，干皆水，故為水運。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643066414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼之歳甲","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643082798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，蒼天之氣經于角軫，其歳得甲辰、乙巳，干皆木，故為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643082798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"木運。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643082798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸之歳丙丁，丹天之氣經于角軫，其歳得丙辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643099182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳，干皆火，故為火運。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643099182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"運臨角軫，則氣在奎壁，氣與運","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643115566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"常司天地之門户。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643115566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳在角軫，則甲乙在奎壁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643131950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己歳","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643148334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940750372"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"必甲戌、乙亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643148334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"故素問曰：土位之下，風氣承之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643164718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛在","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643181102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"角軫，則丙丁在奎壁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643181102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚歳必丙戌、丁亥也，故曰金位","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643197486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"之下，火氣承之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643197486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼癸在角軫，則戊巳在奎壁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643213870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛歳必","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643230254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌、己亥也，故曰水位之下，土氣承之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643230254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"甲乙在角軫，則","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643246638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛在奎壁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643246638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼歳必庚戌、辛亥也，故曰風位之下，金","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643263022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"氣承之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643263022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁在角軫，則𡈼癸在奎壁，戊癸歳必𡈼戌、癸","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643279406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"亥也，故曰相火之下，水氣承之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643279406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"五行家以戊寄於己，巳","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643295790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"寄於午。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643295790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"六𡈼家以戊寄於己，巳寄於未。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643312174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"惟素問以戊寄","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643328558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940766756"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"於戌，巳寄於辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643328558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲以六戊為天門，六己為地户，與素","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643344942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"問同。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643344942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"水土相隨。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643361326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"水，金子也，陽土，故居金行之末，以為亥","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643377710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"始。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643377710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"水，木母也，已，金祖也，隂土，故居水行之墓，以為巳始。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643394094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰天地之門户，而萬物所從出。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643410478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"星家有逢龍則化之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643426862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"說，亦本於此。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643426862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"此十干化氣之源也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643443246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"930","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"沈括曰：六十甲子有納音，鮮原其意。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643476014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋六十律旋相為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643492398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"宫法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643492398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"一律含五音，十二律納六十音也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643508782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"凡氣始於東","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643525166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940783140"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"方而右行，音起於西方而左行，隂陽相錯而生變化。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643525166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643541550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"謂氣始於東方者，四時始於木，右行傳於火，火傳於土，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643541550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"土傳於金，金傳於水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643541550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂音始於西方者，五音始於金，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643557934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"左旋傳于火，火傳于木，木傳于水，水傳於土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643557934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":596,"lineType":2,"content":"納音與易納甲同法，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":597,"lineType":2,"content":"乾納甲而坤納癸，始于乾而終于坤。納音始于金，金，乾也；終于土，土，坤也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"納音之法，同類娶","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643574318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，隔八生子，此律吕相生之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643574318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"五行先仲而後孟，孟","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643590702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"而後季，此遁甲三元之紀也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643590702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子，金之仲；","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":599,"lineType":2,"content":"黄鐘之商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"同位娶","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":600,"lineType":2,"content":"大吕之商。同位謂甲與乙、丙與丁之類。下皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"隔八下生𡈼申，金之孟；","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940799524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":602,"lineType":2,"content":"夷則之商。隔八謂大吕下生夷則也。下皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申同位娶癸酉，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":602,"lineType":2,"content":"南吕之商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"隔八上","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"生庚辰金之季。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643607086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":603,"lineType":2,"content":"姑洗之商。此金三元終。若只以陽辰言之，則依遁甲順傳仲孟季。若兼妻言之，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":604,"lineType":2,"content":"則逆傳孟仲季也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰同位娶辛巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643623470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":604,"lineType":2,"content":"仲吕之商。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"隔八下生戊子火之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643623470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643623470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"黄鐘之徵。金三元終，則左行傳南方火也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子娶己丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643639854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":605,"lineType":2,"content":"大吕之徵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"生丙申火之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643639854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643639854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":606,"lineType":2,"content":"夷則之徵。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"conten List":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":611,"lineType":2,"content":"太簇之類。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"子至於巳為陽，故自黄鐘至於仲吕皆下生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643721774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"自午","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643738158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"至於亥為隂，故自林鐘至於應鐘皆上生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643738158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"991","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"蠡海集曰：萬物之所為以生者，必由氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643754542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"氣者何？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643770926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643787310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643803694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"受氣順行，則為五行之體，逆行則為五行之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643803694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"順行為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643820078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之體者，金生水，水生木，木生火，火生土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643820078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至起歴","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643836462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"之元，自冬而春，春而夏，夏而長夏，長夏而歸於秋，返本","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643836462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"歸原而收斂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643836462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"逆行為五行之用者，金出鑛而從革於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643852846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"火以成材，成材則為有生之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643852846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"然火非木不生，必循木","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643869230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940832292"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"以繼之，木必依水以滋榮，水必托土以止畜，故木而水，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643869230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"水而土，是則四行之類，土以定位，故大撓作甲子，分配","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643869230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"五行為納音，蓋金能受聲而宣氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643869230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"法曰：甲娶乙妻，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643885614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"隔八生子，子生孫，而後行繼代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643885614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"初一曰金，金為氣","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643901998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"居先，甲子為受氣之始。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643901998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"甲娶乙妻，隔八𡈼申，是為子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643918382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼娶癸妻，隔八庚辰，是為孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643934766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"庚娶辛妻，隔八戊子，火","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643951150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643951150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"次二曰火，戊繼其後。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643967534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"戊娶己妻，隔八丙申，是為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643983918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503643983918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"丙娶丁妻，隔八甲辰，是為孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644000302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"甲娶乙妻，隔八𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644016686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940848676"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"子，木代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644016686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"次三曰木，𡈼繼其後。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644033070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼娶癸妻，隔八庚申，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644049454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"是為子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644049454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"庚娶辛妻，隔八戊辰，是為孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644065838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"戊娶己妻，隔","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644082222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"八丙子，水代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644082222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"次四曰水，丙繼其後。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644098606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"丙娶丁妻，隔八","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644114990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申，是為子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644114990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"甲娶乙妻，隔八𡈼辰，是為孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644131374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼娶癸","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644147758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，隔八庚子，土代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644147758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"次五曰土，庚娶辛妻，隔八戊申，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644164142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"是為子矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644164142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"戊娶己妻，隔八丙辰，是為孫矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644180526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"丙娶丁妻，隔","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644196910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"八甲子，金復代其位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644196910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午乙未起如前法。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644213294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"是故有五子","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644229678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"歸庚之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644229678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"道家者流，取其義，用配五方之位，自子干頭","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644246062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940865060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"數至庚字，則為其數。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644246062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子金，自甲數至七，逢庚則西方","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644262446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"金，得七氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644262446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子火，自戊數至三，逢庚則南方火，得三氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644278830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子木，自𡈼數至九，逢庚則東方木，得九氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644295214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子水，自","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644311598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"丙數至五，逢庚則北方水，得五氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644311598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子土，則自得一，為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644327982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"中方一氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644327982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"是為五子歸庚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644344366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"乃知金者受氣之先，順行","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"則為五行之體，逆行則為五行之用，故六十甲子納音","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以充萬物之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644360750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：五行以氣始形終為次，則洪範之水火木金土","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644377134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940881444"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644377134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"以播於四時相生為次，則月令之木火土金水是","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644393518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503644393518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"以飭庀五材相尅為次，則禹謨之水火金木土是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961538570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"納音五行，始金，次火，次木，次水，次土，既非本其始終，又","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961554954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"無取於生尅，故說者莫知其所自來。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961554954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"詳考其義，蓋亦祖","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961571338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"述易象之意，即先後天卦之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961571338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"各為圖以明之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961587722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940897828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940914212"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4n9k6/1-SK1619_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0CzKYU1SLlr%2F8Li9qDUAqTSJSD4%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4n9k6/1-SK1619_figure_00023.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=W5agXHlznFxfh7bj1VVxWnIMCtU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4n9k6/1-SK1619_figure_00023.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940930596"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"先天之圖，乾兌居首屬金，次以離屬火，又次震、巽屬木，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961604106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"又次以坎屬水，終於艮、坤屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961604106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"故始於金、終於土者，乾","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961620490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"始坤成之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961620490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"金取於天之剛，土取於地之柔，火附於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961636874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"天，水附於地，而木以生氣居中，此納音所本於先天之","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961636874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961636874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940946980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4nm7a/1-SK1619_figure_00024.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UXCvnC0n1KlCmPFl1f%2F5Z%2F4GJn0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4nm7a/1-SK1619_figure_00024.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664
