{"lines":[{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940963364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"後天之圖亦以乾居首而逆轉，自乾、兌之金旺於西方，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961653258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"次轉而為離，火旺於南方，次又轉而為震、巽之木旺於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961653258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"東方，次又轉而為坎，水旺於北方，而土旺於四季，故退","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961653258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"艮坤以居終焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961653258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"此納音所本於後天之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961669642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940979748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4nyue/1-SK1619_figure_00025.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GTmBC%2FWwED2Dd1f54EBf7XAb3F4%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4nyue/1-SK1619_figure_00025.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=K%2BnQZ5vFq%2BlldehUs3TeKIVNE94%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4nyue/1-SK1619_figure_00025.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313940996132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"右圖以甲子、乙丑為金上元，𡈼申、癸酉為金中元，庚辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961686026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"辛巳為金下元。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961686026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"三元俱周，則傳於戊子、己丑為火上元，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961702410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、丁酉為火中元，甲辰、乙巳為火下元。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961702410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"自此以後，皆","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961718794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"依前圖金、火、木、水、土之次，而用樂律同位娶妻、隔八生","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961718794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"子之法，以終於丁巳，而納音小成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961718794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"又自甲午、乙未為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961735178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"金上元，起如前法，以終於丁亥，而納音大成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961735178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"按十干、十二支相錯為六十，五音、十二律相乗亦為六","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961751562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"十。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961751562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子金而乙丑亦為金者，同位娶妻也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961767946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丑金而𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961784330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941012516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"申又為金者，隔八生子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961784330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"一行各三元，而後傳於次行，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961800714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"猶春有孟、仲、季三月，而後傳於夏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961800714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲子至丁巳，而","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961817098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之三元一周，猶易之三畫為小成也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961817098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"自甲午至丁","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961833482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，而五行之三元又一周，猶易之六畫為大成也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961833482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"其立","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961849866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"法皆與律吕相應。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961849866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳子午，九；乙庚丑未，八。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961882634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛寅申，七。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961899018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼卯酉，六。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961915402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961931786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"癸辰戌，五。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961931786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥屬四數。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961948170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941028900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"蠡海集云：或問曰：先天之數，何縁而起？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961964554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"余答曰：數極於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961980938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"九，自九逆退取之，故甲己子午，九；乙庚丑未，八；丙辛寅","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961980938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"申，七；丁𡈼卯酉，六；戊癸辰戌，五。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961980938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"天干己盡，而地支獨遺","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961997322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，是以己亥得四終焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503961997322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"况夫亥為天門，己為地户，純","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962013706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之位，為開闔之樞，所以關鍵五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962013706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"瑞桂堂暇録曰：六十甲子之納音，以金、木、水、火、土之音","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962030090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"而明之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962030090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"一、六為水，二、七為火，三、八為木，四、九為金，五、","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962046474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"十為土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962046474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"然五行之中，惟金、木有自然之音，水、火、土必相","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962062858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941045284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"假而後成音。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962062858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋水假土，火假水，土假火。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962079242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"故金音四、九，木","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962095626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"音三、八，水音五、十，火音一、六，土音二、七。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962095626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"此不易之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962112010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962128394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳子午，九也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962144778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚丑未，八也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962161162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛寅申，七","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962177546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962177546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼、卯酉，六也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962193930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸辰戌，五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962210314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥，四也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962226698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子、乙丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962243082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"其數三十有四。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962243082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"四者，金之音也，故曰金。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962259466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰己巳，其數","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962275850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"二十有三。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962275850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"三者，木之音也，故曰木。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962292234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未，其數三十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962308618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"有二。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962308618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"二者，火也，土以火為音，故曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962325002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉，其數三","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962341386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"十。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962341386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"十者，土也，水以土為音，故曰水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962357770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子己丑，其數三十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962374154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941061668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"有一。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962374154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"一者，水也，火以水為音，故曰火。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962390538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"凡六十甲子，莫不","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962406922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"皆然，此納音之所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962406922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：此揚子雲太𤣥論聲律所紀數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962423306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"凡兩干兩支","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962439690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"之合，其餘數得四、九者，為金。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962439690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"得一、六者，為火，得三、八者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962456074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"為木，得五、十者，為水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962456074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"得二、七者，為土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962472458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子皆九，得數","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962488842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"十八，乙丑皆八，得數十六，合之三十有四，故為金。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962488842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼六","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962505226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"申七，得數十三，癸五酉六，得數十一，合之二十有四，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962505226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"亦為金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962505226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘按數推之，莫不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962521610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"但所配一、六、二七","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962537994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941078052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"等數，與河圖之數不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962537994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，大衍之數五十，其用四十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962554378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"有九，以兩干兩支之合數，於四十九内減之，餘數滿十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962554378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"去之，餘一、六為水，二七為火，三八為木，四九為金，五十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962554378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"為土，各取所生之五行以為納音。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962554378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"如是則與河圖相同。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962570762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"又揲蓍之法，用餘策以定奇偶，此用餘數以定五行，其","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962587146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"理正相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962587146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲九子九、乙八、丑八，其合數三十四，於","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962603530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"四十九内減之，餘十五，十不用，餘五，屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962603530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"土生金，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962619914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"金。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962619914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅、丁卯共合數二十六，於四十九内減之，餘二十","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962636298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941094436"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"三，十不用，餘三，屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962636298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"木生火，故曰火。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962652682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳共合數","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962669066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"二十三，於四十九内減之，餘二十六，十不用，餘六，屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962669066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"水生木，故曰木。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962685450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未共合數三十二，於四十九内","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962701834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"減之，餘十七，十不用，餘七，屬火，火生土，故曰土。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962701834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962718218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"按：揚雄太𤣥經曰：子午之數九，丑未八，寅申七，卯酉六，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962734602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌五，己亥四，故律四十二，吕三十六，并律吕之數，或","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962734602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"還或否，凡七十有八，黄鐘之數立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962734602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"其以為度也，皆生","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962750986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"黄鐘。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962750986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：甲已之數九，乙庚八，丙辛七，丁𡈼六，戊癸五。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962767370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941110820"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"聲生於日，律生於辰，聲以情質，律以和聲，聲律相協而","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962783754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"八音生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962783754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"歴代以來宗之，謂之先天之數。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962800138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"顧其甲巳子午","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962816522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"之何以九，乙庚丑未之何以八，則罕有確論焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962816522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"今按子","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962832906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"午者，乾震之所納也；丑未者，坤巽之所納也；寅申者，坎","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962832906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"所納也；卯酉者，離所納也；辰戌者，艮所納也；己亥者，兌","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962832906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"所納也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962832906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"陽數極於九，隂數極於八，故乾坤得之震巽長","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962849290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"而統於父母，其餘以次而降，兩大六子、男女長少之序，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962849290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"秩然不紊，實非人之能强為也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962849290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫十日之序，則又各","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962865674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941127204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"隨化氣壽夭之數，而亦無一毫造作於其間。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962865674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"甲已，土也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962882058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"土終古不毁，即析為微塵，蕩為鄰虚，而其質固在也，為","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962882058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"最壽，故數九。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962882058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"其次則金，雖火鑠之，亦有質灰氣散之時，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962898442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"而堅固為萬物王也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962898442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚，金也，故次甲己也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962914826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"又次則水，","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962931210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"日炙風銷而火煎烹之，亦有乾盡之時，而無自然銷滅","logicSentenceId":"7678947503962931210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233", :null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"大成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255549467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生於子，自甲子以至癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255565851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生於午，自甲午","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255582235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"以至癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255582235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"故三十而復從宫起。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255598619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"宫君、商臣、角民，皆人道","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255615003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故皆可以為首。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255615003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"徵事、羽物，皆人所用也，故不可以為","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255631387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"首。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255631387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"是以三甲終而復始於宫，干為天，支為地，音為人，三","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255647771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"才之五行備矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255647771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"陶宗儀曰：甲子乙丑海中金者，子屬水，又為湖，又為水","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255664155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之地，兼金死於子，墓於丑，水旺而金死墓，故曰海中","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255664155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255664155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅丁卯鑪中火者，寅為三陽，卯為四陽，火既得","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255680539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941241892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"地，又得寅卯之木以生之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255680539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"此時天地開鑪，萬物始生，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255696923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"曰鑪中火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255696923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰己巳大林木者，辰為原野，已為六陽，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255713307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"木至六陽，則枝榮葉茂。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255713307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"以茂盛之木而在原野之間，故","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255729691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"曰大林木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255729691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未路傍土者，未中之木而生午位","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255746075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"之旺火，火旺則土焦，未能育物，猶路傍土若也，故曰路","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255746075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"傍土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255746075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼申、癸酉劍鋒金者，申酉金之正位，兼臨官申，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"帝旺酉，金既生旺，則成剛矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255762459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"剛則無踰於劍鋒，故曰劍","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255778843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"鋒金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255778843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌、乙亥山頭火者，戌亥為天門，火照天門，其","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255795227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941258276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"光至髙，故曰山頭火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255795227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、丁丑澗下水者，水旺於子，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255811611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"衰於丑，旺而反衰，則不能為江河，故曰澗下水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255811611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"戊寅、","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"己卯城頭土者，天干戊巳屬土，寅為艮山，土積而為山，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰城頭土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255827995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辰、辛巳白鑞金者，金養於辰，生於巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255844379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"形質初成，未能堅利，故曰白鑞金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255844379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼午、癸未楊柳木","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255860763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"者，木死於午，墓於未，木既死墓，雖得天干𡈼癸之水以","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255860763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"生之，終是柔弱，故曰楊柳木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255860763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申、乙酉井泉水者，金","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255877147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官申，帝旺酉，金既生旺，則水由以生，然方生之際，力","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255877147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941274660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"量未洪，故曰井泉水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255877147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌、丁亥，屋上土者，丙丁屬火，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255893531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥為天門，火既炎上，則土非在下而生，故曰屋上土","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255893531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255893531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子、己丑，霹靂火者，丑屬土，子屬水，水居正位，而納","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255909915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"音乃火，水中之火，非神龍則無，故曰霹靂火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255909915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"庚寅、辛","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255926299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"卯，松栢木者，木臨官寅，帝旺卯，木既生旺，則非柔弱之","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255926299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"比，故曰松栢木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255926299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼辰、癸巳，長流水者，辰為水庫，巳為","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255942683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"金長生之地，金生則水性已存，以庫水而逢生金，則泉","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255942683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"源終不竭，故曰長流水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255942683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、乙未，砂石金者，午為火","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255959067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941291044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之地，火旺則金敗，未為火衰之地，火衰則金冠帶敗，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255959067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"而方冠帶未能盛滿，故曰砂石金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255959067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"丙申、丁酉山下火","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255975451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"者，申為地户，酉為日入之門，日至此時而藏光，故曰山","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255975451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"下火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255975451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌、己亥，平地木者，戌為原野，亥為木生之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255991835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"夫木生於原野，則非一根一株之比，故曰平地木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504255991835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256008219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"子、辛丑壁上土者，丑雖土家正位，而子則水旺之地，土","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256008219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"見水多，則為泥也，故曰壁上土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256008219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼寅癸卯金箔金者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256024603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯為木旺之地，木旺則金羸，又金絶於寅，胎於卯，金","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256024603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941307428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"既無力，故曰金箔金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256024603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳覆燈火者，辰為食時，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256040987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"已為禺中，日之將中，豔陽之勢，光於天下，故曰覆燈火","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256040987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256040987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午丁未天河水者，丙丁屬火，午為火旺之地，而納","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256057371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"音乃水，水自火出，非銀漢不能有也，故曰天河水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256057371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"戊","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256073755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"申己酉大驛土者，申為坤，坤為地，酉為兌，兌為澤，戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256073755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"之土加於坤澤之上，非其他浮薄之土也，故曰大驛土","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256073755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256073755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌辛亥釵釧金者，金至戌而衰，至亥而病，金既衰","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256090139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"病，則誠柔矣，故曰釵釧金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256090139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子癸丑桑柘木者，子屬","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256106523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941323812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"水，丑屬金，水方生木，金則伐之，猶桑柘木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256106523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅乙卯","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256122907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"大溪水者，寅為東北維，卯為正東，水流正東，則其性順，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256122907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"而川澗池沼俱合而歸，故曰大溪水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256122907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳沙中","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256139291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，土庫辰絶已，而天干丙丁之火至辰，冠帶已臨，官","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256139291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"土既庫絶，旺火復與生之，故曰沙中土也；戊午己未天","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256139291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"上火者，午為火旺之地，未中之木又復生之，火性炎上，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256139291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"又逢生地，故曰天上火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256139291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申辛酉石榴木者，申為七","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256155675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"月，酉為八月，此時木則絶矣，惟石榴之木反結實，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256155675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941340196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"石榴木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256155675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼戌癸亥大海水者，水冠帶戌，臨官亥，水臨","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256172059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"官冠帶，則力厚矣，兼亥為江，非他水之比，故曰大海水","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256172059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256172059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"蠡海集云：納甲之說，自甲為一，至𡈼為九，陽數之始終","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256204827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故歸乾，易順數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256204827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"乙為二，至癸為十，隂數之始終也，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256221211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"故歸坤，易逆數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256221211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"乾一索而得男為震，坤一索而得女","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256237595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"為巽，故庚入震，辛入巽。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256237595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"乾再索而得男為坎，坤再索而","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256253979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941356580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"得女為離，故戊趨坎，巳趨離。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256253979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"乾三索而得男為艮，坤三","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256270363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"索而得女為兌，故丙從艮，丁從兌。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256270363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生於北，而成於南，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256286747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1438","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾始甲子而終以𡈼午。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256286747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1439","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生於南而成於北，故坤始","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256303131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1440","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未而終以癸丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256303131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1441","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽一索也，故庚辛始於子丑；坎離","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256319515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1442","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"再索也，故戊巳始於寅卯；艮兌三索也，故丙丁始於辰","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256319515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1443","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256319515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1444","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"又一說乾坤者，二氣之正位也，坎離者，二氣之交","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256335899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1445","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"互也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256335899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1446","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"正位則始終全備，故甲𡈼歸乾，乙癸歸坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256352283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1447","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"交互則","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256368667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1448","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"往來處中，故戊歸坎，已歸離。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256368667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1449","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽乃受氣之始，故庚辛","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256385051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1450","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941372964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1451","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256385051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1452","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"艮兌乃生化之終，故丙丁歸焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256401435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1453","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤位隂陽之極，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256417819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1454","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"故子午丑未配於甲𡈼乙癸，父母總攝内外之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256417819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1455","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256434203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1456","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"長男長女為初索，是以子丑配庚辛；坎離中男中女為","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256434203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1457","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"再索，是以寅卯配戊巳；艮兌少男少女為三索，是以辰","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256434203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1458","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"巳配丙丁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256434203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1459","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"納之為言受也，容受六甲於八卦中也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256450587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1460","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"易者，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256466971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1461","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"逆也，數皆以逆而推之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256466971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941389348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941405732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1464","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4obhi/1-SK1619_figure_00026.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=fDyetGejxLh%2Fm3H%2Fa7U6%2BFVsATE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4obhi/1-SK1619_figure_00026.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lP925X47ja%2BYHGzqU345pj8LhdI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4obhi/1-SK1619_figure_00026.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1465","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941422116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1466","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：乾納甲𡈼，坤納乙癸，乾坤包括始終之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256483355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1467","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256499739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1468","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"餘六卦則自下而上，法畫卦者之自下而上也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256499739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1469","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"震巽隂","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256516123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1470","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"陽起於下，故震納庚，巽納辛。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256516123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1471","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離隂陽交於中，故坎納","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256532507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1472","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"戊，離納己。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256532507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1473","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"艮兌隂陽極於上，故艮納丙，兌納丁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256548891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1474","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、丙、戊、","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256565275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1475","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、𡈼為陽干，皆納陽卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256565275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1476","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"乙、丁、巳、辛癸為隂干，皆納隂卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256581659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1477","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941438500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1478","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4oo4m/1-SK1619_figure_00027.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YEbG20n6LvxDlMclswXAcVWv01w%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4oo4m/1-SK1619_figure_00027.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3hTj0r25iK4yALcMNpcYiWQRjsE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4oo4m/1-SK1619_figure_00027.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941454884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1480","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰，此以六卦應月候，而坎離為日月之本體，居中","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256598043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1481","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256598043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1482","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"震直生明者，一陽始生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256614427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1483","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"又生明之時，以初昏候之，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256630811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1484","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"月見庚方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256630811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1485","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"兌直上弦者，二陽浸盛。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256647195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1486","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"又上弦之時，以初","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256663579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1487","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"昏候之，月見丁方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256663579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1488","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"乾直望者，三陽盛滿。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256679963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1489","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"又望時以初","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256696347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1490","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"昏候之，月見甲方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256696347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1491","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"巽直生魄，則一隂始生。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256712731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1492","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"又生魄之","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256729115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1493","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"時，以平明候之，月見辛方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256729115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1494","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"艮直下弦，則二隂浸盛。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256745499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1495","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256761883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1496","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"下弦之時，以平明候之，月見丙方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504256761883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1497","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"坤直晦，則三隂盛","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502603814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1498","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"滿。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502603814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1499","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"又晦時以平明候之，月見乙方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502620198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1500","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"皆與納甲相應。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502636582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1501","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941471268"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1502","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4p0rq/1-SK1619_figure_00028.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=IuTczuMdEh1ESw0R8BZNvWp12Vw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4p0rq/1-SK1619_figure_00028.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=swkGlfUD8112VPt3%2FiEMBHI6RE4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4p0rq/1-SK1619_figure_00028.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941487652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1504","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰，此以八卦之六畫，分納六辰之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502652966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1505","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"凡乾在内","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502669350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1506","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"卦則為甲，而納子寅辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502669350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1507","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"如初九為甲子，九二為甲寅，九","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502685734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1508","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"三為甲辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502685734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1509","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"在外卦則為𡈼，而納午、申、戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502702118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1510","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"如九四為𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502718502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1511","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"午，九五為𡈼申，上九為𡈼戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502718502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1512","lineNum":917,"lineType":1,"content":"凡坤在内卦則為乙，而","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502734886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1513","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"納未、己、卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502734886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1514","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"如初六為乙未，六二為乙巳，六三為乙卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502751270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1515","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"在外卦則為癸，而納丑、亥、酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502767654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1516","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"如六四為癸丑，六五為癸","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502784038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1517","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，上六為癸酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502784038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1518","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"因乾坤各納兩干，故别為内外二卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502800422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1519","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"若震止納庚，則初九為庚子，六二為庚寅，六三為庚辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502816806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941504036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1521","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"九四為庚午，六五為庚申，上六為庚戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502816806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1522","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"巽止納辛，則初","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502833190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1523","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"六為辛丑，九二為辛亥，九三為辛酉，六四為辛未，九五","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502833190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1524","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"為辛巳，上九為辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502833190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1525","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、離、艮、兌四卦，依震巽例推之。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502849574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1526","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502865958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1527","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：納甲之法，不知其所自起。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502865958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1528","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"其以六卦直月，候明魄死","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502882342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1529","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"生，隂陽消息，與先天圖有相似。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502882342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1530","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"如魏伯陽參同契中所","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502898726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1531","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"陳，即其說也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502898726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1532","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"參同契曰：三日出為爽，震庚受西方。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502915110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1533","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"八日","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502931494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1534","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"兌受丁，上弦平如繩。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502931494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1535","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"十五乾體就，盛滿甲東方。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502947878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1536","lineNum":929,"lineType":1,"content":"七八道","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502964262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1537","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"已訖，屈折低下降。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502964262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1538","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"十六轉就統，巽辛見平明。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502980646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1539","lineNum":930,"lineType":1,"content":"艮直于丙","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502997030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941520420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1541","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"南，下弦二十三。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504502997030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1542","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"坤乙三十日，東北喪其朋。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503013414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1543","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"節盡相禪與，","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503029798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1544","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"繼體復生龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503029798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1545","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼癸配甲乙，乾坤括始終。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503046182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1546","lineNum":933,"lineType":1,"content":"朱子以為即先","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503062566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1547","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"天之傳，孔子之後，諸儒失之，而方外之流密相付授，以","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503062566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1548","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"為丹竈之術耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503062566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1549","lineNum":935,"lineType":1,"content":"今按先天之圖，八卦俱備，而納甲除去","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503078950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1550","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離以為二用，則其法亦不盡合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503078950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1551","lineNum":936,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：說卦言天地定","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503095334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1552","lineNum":937,"lineType":1,"content":"位，山澤通氣，雷風相薄，乃以三陽三隂至一陽一隂為","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503095334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1553","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"序，而其後方言水火不相射，蓋以六卦寓消息，而以水","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503095334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1554","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"火為用，或者古有此說也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503095334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1555","lineNum":939,"lineType":1,"content":"至其參錯六辰之法，則陽皆","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503111718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941536804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1557","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"順行，隂皆逆轉，隂陽之老長中少，每差一位。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503111718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1558","lineNum":941,"lineType":1,"content":"惟震與乾","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503128102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1559","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"同者，長子繼父體也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503128102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1560","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"坤不起於丑而起於未，尤與洛書","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503144486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1561","lineNum":943,"lineType":1,"content":"耦數起未位，後天圖坤居西南，樂律林鐘為地統，而應","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503144486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1562","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"未月之氣者相合。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503144486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1563","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"故諸術之中，惟納甲為近理。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503160870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1564","lineNum":944,"lineType":1,"content":"今火珠","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503177254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1565","lineNum":945,"lineType":1,"content":"林卜卦，即其法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503177254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1566","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353313941553188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1567","lineNum":947,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷一","logicSentenceId":"7678947504503193638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391115976745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"卦四，天干八，地支十二，共為二十四方位。","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647862784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽家名二","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647879168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"十四山，言山則向在其中，如子山則必午向，午山則必","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647879168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"子向，𡈼山則必丙向，丙山則必𡈼向之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647879168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦惟","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647895552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"用四隅，而不用四正者，以四正卦正當地支子、午、卯、酉","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647895552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"之位，故不用卦而用支，用支即用卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647895552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦既定四正，","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647911936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"則以八干輔之，甲乙夾震，丙丁夾離，庚辛夾兌，𡈼癸夾","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647911936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"坎。","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647911936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"四隅則以八支輔之，戌亥夾乾，丑寅夾艮，辰巳夾巽，","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647928320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"未申夾坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678954711647928320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"合四維八 {"lines":[{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116107817"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"圖外層所列為正針，内層所列為縫針。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392057896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"其子位在正針","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392074280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"子癸二位之間，比正針後半位。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392074280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"其雙取三合者，為三合","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392090664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，與雙山同，特比中針正差一位耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392090664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"地理家用以消","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392107048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"砂納水，蓋砂水為去路，故用後至者收之，乃無遺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392107048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"按：雙山五行，即三合五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392123432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"地支十二，取生旺墓三者","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392139816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"為三合局，而四卦八干，各在支前一位。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392139816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"今以支前一位","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392156200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"之卦干與支雙並，而同取地支三合之五行，故曰雙山","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392156200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"五行。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392156200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"坤申𡈼子乙辰，合水局，六山皆屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392172584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"乾亥甲卯丁","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392188968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116124201"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"未，合木局，六山皆屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392188968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"艮寅丙午辛戌，合火局，六山皆","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392205352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392205352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"巽巳庚酉癸丑，合金局，六山皆屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392221736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"地理書曰：正","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392238120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，乃五行之質，雙山五行，乃五行之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392238120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"故推龍氣之","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392254504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺，用雙山而不用正五行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392254504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"又地理家有三針，一曰","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392270888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"正針，乃二十四山之正位，定向用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392270888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰中針，其子位","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392287272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"在正針𡈼子二位之中，格龍用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392287272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰縫針，其子位在","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392303656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"子癸二位之縫，消砂納水用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392303656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"故中針與縫針差一位，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392320040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"在中針則曰雙山五行，在縫針則曰三合五行，其實皆","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392320040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116140585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"雙山法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392320040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116156969"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4qrza/1-SK1619_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=egIH5%2BK4vangHmmNDqte6JkdgvY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4qrza/1-SK1619_figure_00033.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BLOkwVVaFY1UGuJELQmj9qi6oSE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4qrza/1-SK1
