{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116173353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、寅、辰、巽、戌坎辛申八山屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392336424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"離、𡈼、丙乙四山屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392352808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392369192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"艮已三山屬木。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392369192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、亥兌丁四山屬金，丑癸坤庚未五山","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392385576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392385576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"地理大成曰：洪範者，即正五行而進推其本初之氣者","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392401960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392401960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉，五行之正位，故無變。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392418344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為木，木必藉水，故","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"甲變水；酉屬金，金必藉土，故庚變土；午為火，火不必木","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"生而生于日之光，故丙為太陽之火；子為水，水不必藉","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"金生而反根于火，水不得火則寒凍而冰死，故𡈼為水","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116189737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"中之火；卯為木，木旺則喜生火，故乙為火；酉為金，金旺","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"則喜生水，故辛為水；午為火，火旺則喜鎔金，故丁為金；","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"子為水，水旺無土則散，故癸為土。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392434728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"此十二位皆以八干","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392451112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"輔成四正之氣，其中水火異于金木者，金木以形用，其","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392451112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"理易直；水火以神用，其妙奥曲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392451112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"四生者，四正之始氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392467496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"水之始本于金，故亥是金；木之始本于水，故寅是水；火","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392483880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"之始本于木，故已是木；金之始本于土，而申不變土而","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392483880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"變水者，燥土不生金，土必得水而生金，水實金之始氣，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392483880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116206121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"道家所以水中求金，故申是水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392483880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓者，四正之歸氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392500264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物生則向上，歸則向下。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392516648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"在下之物，水土是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392533032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"火歸于","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392549416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"土而灰，水歸于土而涸，故丑未為土。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392549416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"金出于土，不復能","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392565800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"歸于土；木出于土，亦不能歸于土，故同歸于水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392565800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"金入水","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392582184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"則沈，木入水則朽，故辰戌為水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392582184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"四維者，四方之交也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392598568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"乾本生北水之金，坤本生西金之土，二老也，故不變。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392614952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"艮","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392631336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"居水木之交，受水以生木，而土不能生木，故從而變木。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392631336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"巽居木火之交，木固能生火，而火實根于水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392647720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋坎中之","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392664104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116222505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"陽為火根，離中之隂為水根，水火互為其根，故巽變水","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392664104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"以為火根也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392664104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例曰：晉趙載註郭氏元經山家五行篇，不用正","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392680488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，而用洪範，可見其傳已久。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392680488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂始于唐時一行禪","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392696872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"師者，妄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392696872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"惜郭、趙諸公用之，而未嘗解釋其義。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392713256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"逮元季","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392729640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"無著大士始有紫白原本連山洪範論，以洛書方位生","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392729640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"成奇耦之數，定五行而分吉凶，又皆引而不發，人不能","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392729640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"解。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392729640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"後見楚江萬民英所註三命通㑹，論河圖及洪範五","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392746024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116238889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"行，頗有發明。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392746024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"其言曰：古者庖羲氏之王天下也，則河圖","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392762408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"以作八卦，故序乾、坤、坎、離、震、巽、艮、兌之名，設天、地、日、月、","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392762408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"風、雷、山、澤之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392762408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"繫辭曰：天地定位，山澤通氣，雷風相薄，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392778792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"水火不相射，八卦相錯，八卦成列，而二十四位同行乎","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392778792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"其中。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392778792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"迨夫以隂陽消息驗之，八卦之變，甲本屬木，納卦","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392795176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"于乾，乾與坤對，以坤三之上下二爻換乾三之上下二","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392795176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，化成坎三象，甲隨坎化，故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392795176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"乙本屬木，納卦于","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392811560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"坤，坤與乾對，以乾三之上下二爻換坤三之上下二爻，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392811560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116255273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"化成離三象，乙受離化，故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392811560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"丙本屬火，納卦于艮，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392827944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"艮與兌對，以兌三之下爻換艮三之下爻，化成離三象，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392827944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"丙受離化，故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392827944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"丁本屬火，納卦于兌，兌與艮對，以","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392844328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"艮三之上爻，換兌三之上爻，化成乾三象，丁受乾化，故","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392844328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392844328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"庚本屬金，納卦于震，震與巽對，以巽三之下爻，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392860712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"換震三之下爻，化成坤三象，庚受坤化，故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392860712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"辛本","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392877096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金，納卦于巽，巽與震對，以震三之上爻，換巽三之上","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392877096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，化成坎三象，辛受坎化，故屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392877096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼本屬水，納卦于","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392893480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116271657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"離，離與坎對，以坎三之中爻，換離三之中爻，化成乾三","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392893480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"象，𡈼受乾化，本當屬金，納于離火，火焰金銷，不能退立，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392893480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"而自附于離，火立焉，故屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392893480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"癸本屬水，納卦于坎，坎","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392909864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"與離對，以離三之中爻，換坎三之中爻，化成坤三象，癸","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392909864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"受坤化，故屬土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392909864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"此八干納卦之變，其爻之交換雖有","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392926248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"不同，而要各有取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392926248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾坤上下二爻交者，取象于否","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392942632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"泰之義，故曰天地定位。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392942632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"震艮以上爻交于巽兌，巽兌以","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392959016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"下爻交于震艮者，取象于咸恒損益之義，故曰雷風相","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392959016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116288041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"薄，山澤通氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392959016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離以中爻交于乾坤，乾坤以中爻交于","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392975400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"坎離，取象于既濟未濟，故曰水火不相射是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392975400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"至八卦","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392991784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"所屬之五行，變不變雖有不同，而亦各有取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102392991784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤本","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393008168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"乎金土而不變者，乃隂陽之祖宗，衆卦之父母也，退身","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393008168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"于休息之地，老亢而不變也；坎離震兌位乎四正，金木","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393008168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"水火而不變者，以子午卯酉隂位各専四旺之地，宣布","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393008168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之令，而氣化行焉，故不變也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393008168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽用變者，艮土易","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"位于坎震東北之界，處身于衰丑病寅之間，思于更相","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116304425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"代立，自然成山而化木也；巽木易位于震離東南之界，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"立身于衰辰病已之間，不能自立，反歸于水，辰為墓地，","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"故巽辰皆水也；亥本屬水，因金以生，乘代金立，故亥屬","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"金也；寅本屬木，因水以生，乘代水立，故寅屬水也；巳本","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火，因木以生，乘震之衰，代震而立，故巳屬木也；申本","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金，水能生申，金助水勢，故申屬水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393024552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未，五方","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393040936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"五土之神，分為四季，作造化甄陶之主，為厚載之質，本","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393040936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"不可變。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393040936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"因土以生木，木附于土，奪土一半為水，水動土","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393057320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116320809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"靜。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393057320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌，陽之動也，故屬水；丑未，隂之靜也，故屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393073704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"化氣","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393090088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"五行所取之由，大率類此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393090088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":n ,"content":"兌卦納甲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"土坤","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393614376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"本宫正卦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393614376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":191,"lineType":2,"content":"辛丑土。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393630760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"庚子土，癸屬子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393647144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":192,"lineType":2,"content":"戊申土，庚屬申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"木受坤化，終於己之隂土；","logicSentenceId":"7678955102393647144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"313","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"乾用𡈼申而生水，坤乙生火而癸生木，各主八位，乾坤","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974825487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"用足。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974825487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"繼以長男長女，庚辛運化，金土攸定，五氣迭布，造","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974841871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"化之功備矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974841871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"本以卦畫象數，參之六十甲子，始得窺其","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974858255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"立法之端倪，不悖經㫖，允合象數。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974858255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"後有明者，不易吾言","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974874639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974874639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"○大五行出於乾坤者十二位，出於六子者亦十二","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974891023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"位，合六子足以當乾坤之數。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974891023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋乾坤之策三百六十，合","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974907407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"六子之策亦三百六十，足以當乾坤之策也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974907407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"但郭景純","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974923791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116402729"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"所載，未本屬木，而金土木各得四位，故山家五行篇曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974923791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑坤庚名稼穯，艮震己未曲直應。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974923791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"今皆以未屬土，殆","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974940175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"必有所據，其理亦通，木三、金四、土五是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974940175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"然一為數之","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974956559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"元，總攝八位可也，火何以不二不七而四耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974956559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"二說未知","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974972943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"孰是，將以質諸専門之學、造理之士云。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974972943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"山家五行，郭景","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974989327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"純既以名篇，又於葬元一篇論坎坤水土之山，則曰：崇","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974989327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"土益申，長生位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740974989327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"及論艮山，則曰：崇土益亥，非木之長","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975005711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"生乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975005711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"論巽山，則曰：崇土益申，水長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975022095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"此又景純筆之","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975038479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116419113"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"書，而用大五行之明證也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975038479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"○醫書有左癱右瘓之證，人","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975054863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"身一氣脈也，一息往來，骨節毛竅，何往不達？","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975054863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"及其感疾，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975071247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"左癱者病不及右，右瘓者病不及左，五臟六腑，一而已","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975071247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"矣，豈有界限，使左之病不得右，而右之病不得左耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975071247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975087631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"五臟皆一，而腎獨有二，左為腎而藏精，右為命而藏氣，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975087631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"神依氣立，故曰神門配𡈼子之水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975087631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"是以人之精敗者，必","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975104015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"左癱；氣敗者必右瘓。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975104015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"兩腎各有所主，故其病亦各有所","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975120399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"歸。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975120399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子一位也，子屬水而𡈼屬火，左腎配子，右腎配𡈼，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975136783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116435497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"子水為精，𡈼火為神，五臟猶五行也，六腑猶六神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975136783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975153167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"乙配青龍，丙丁配朱雀，庚辛配白虎，𡈼癸配元武，戊乃","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975153167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"配勾陳，巳乃配螣蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975153167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋坎水納戊，離火納己，故五行而","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975169551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"有六神，猶五臟而有六腑。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975169551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼火子水之說，近取諸身，理","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975185935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"尤明甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975185935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"今按地理大成之論，世所共宗，顧牽强支離，不足以厭","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975202319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"人之心。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975202319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例所載八干位，以卦變而從化，似為合","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975218703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975218703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"至于𡈼不從金，則又不可通，於是自改其例，且所為","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975235087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116451881"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"換爻者，亦人之換之，以凑合其說，非理氣自然不得不","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975235087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"換者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975235087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"至其他遷就處，亦不異于地理大成。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975251471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"至于儲泳","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975267855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"袪疑說，以納甲納音得之，實超出兩家之上，言有本末，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975267855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"但癸化木一語，究無著落。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975267855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"今按葬藏于土，而土氣之生","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975284239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"死在水，故論正五行，止有水土二行。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975284239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"其金山、火山、木山","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975300623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"云者，皆言其形似而非真也，所以不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975300623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"而此洪範五行","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975317007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"之說，水居八而土居五，為獨多也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975317007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"坎水離火，兌金震木，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975333391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"乾金坤土，神煞起例謂其不變是己。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975333391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"顧其餘者，亦各從","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975349775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116468265"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"方位實有之五行，而抉其幽元之義，要亦不得謂之變","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975349775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975349775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"艮統丑寅，其方為木之始氣，故為木。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975366159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"巽統辰巳，其方","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975382543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"為水之尾閭，故為水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975382543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"然艮方本土也，巽方本木也，故丑","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975398927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"為土而巳為木。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975398927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"震統甲乙，兌統庚辛，木金之全局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975415311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"震","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975431695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"為木，木之為行也，其滋膏皆水，而生氣皆火也，是故始","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975431695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"於水而終于火。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975431695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"其始必由雨露之澤焉，其終往往出火","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975448079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"以自焚，故甲水而乙火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975448079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"水者，震之所以為龍也；火者，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975464463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"震之所以為雷也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975464463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"兌為金，金之為行也，水土之所際，由","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975480847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116484649"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"水土相比，久而成石，石乃生金，金生而泉發，是故始于","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975480847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"土而終于水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975480847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"其始必土，其終必水，故庚為土而辛為水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975497231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"其土也，兌之所以為剛鹵也；其水也，兌之所以為澤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975513615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"坎統𡈼癸，離統丙丁，水火之全局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975529999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"坎為水，四獸北方","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975546383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩龜為水，而蛇為火，是以𡈼納于離水，又比于土，地","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975546383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"中之水，離地即失其性。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975546383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，地中之水也，故𡈼為火而癸","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975562767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"為土。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975562767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"離為火，火能成金，無火則金終埋于土，是以丁為","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975579151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"庚夫，而兌納丁。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975579151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"丙者，日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975595535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"八干之中，唯丙當與乾坤同","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975611919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116501033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"例，故丙為火而丁為金。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975611919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"日月與乾坤同，而専言日者，辛","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975628303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"為月，月為水，辛固水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975628303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫寅之為水，則以地不滿東","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975644687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"南，自析木之津以達于巽之地户，皆積水之區，所為尾","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975644687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"閭，洩之不知何時已者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975644687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"故寅甲辰巽皆水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975661071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫亥","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975677455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"之為金也，則以天不滿西北，自少昊之墟以至于亥之","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975677455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"天門，皆積山之區。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975677455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"山者石，而石者金，故兌乾亥皆金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975693839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"金積于西北，而水盛于東南。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975710223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"海為百川之朝宗，而河為","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975726607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"之源焉，祭川所以先河後海也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975726607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"河源出于崑崙，戌位也，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975742991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116517417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"故戌為水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975742991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"史記天官書曰：漢者，其本曰水。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975759375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"河圖括地","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975775759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"象曰：河精為天漢。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975775759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"唐書天文志曰：北斗自乾攜巽為天","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975792143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"綱，雲漢自坤抵艮為地紀。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975792143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"然則寅申者，水之終始也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975808527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為水而申亦水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975808527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"要而論之，皆幽元之義，實有之理，","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975824911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"而非或變或不變，任人造作者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955740975824911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116533801"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116550185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4r4me/1-SK1619_figure_00034.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ONhRzBuFG34prxobzvbIlrBGffw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4r4me/1-SK1619_figure_00034.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ULHLAomNJsmwojJntCzVZe%2FE00M%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4r4me/1-SK1619_figure_00034.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"按墓龍者，本山龍，洪範五行之墓庫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088055330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"變運者，本墓庫之","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088071714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"納音，隨歳運而變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088071714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"用五子元遁者，與七政自冬至","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088088098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"起算同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088088098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"上年冬至已屬今年，今年冬至即屬明年，天","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088104482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"地之運皆自子始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088104482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"然五子元遁始子終亥，而一歳統","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088120866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"四時，冬至後丑月，歳君未更，而墓運已改。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088120866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為金墓，故","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088137250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"金山之墓運，冬至後又重變也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088137250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲山正運屬水，水墓","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088153634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116648489"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088153634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己年五子元遁，自甲子順數得戊辰，納音屬木，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088170018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"即為木運。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088170018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"乾山屬金，金墓在丑，甲巳年五子元遁，自甲","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088186402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"子順數得乙丑，納音屬金，即為金運。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088186402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至後屬乙庚年，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088202786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"用乙庚年五子元遁，自丙子順數得丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088202786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"或用甲巳年","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088219170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"五子元遁，自甲子順數至乙亥，又進而順數至丑，亦得","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088219170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑，納音屬水，即為水運。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088219170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088235554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116664873"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116681257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientli {"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116697641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"通書大全曰：本年二十四山墓龍變運，某山運為年月","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088251938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"納音所尅，即為年月尅某山。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088251938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"惟新建宅舎、新立墳塋論","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088268322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"之，其拆修豎造不動地基，及舊塋附葬者，皆不論。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088268322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子年納音屬金，本年水土山墓運，戊辰屬木，受年","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088284706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"納音之尅，即為本年尅。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088284706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、辰、巽、戌、坎、辛、申八水山，丑、","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088301090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"癸、坤、庚、未五土山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088301090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子年丙寅、丁卯、甲戌、乙亥月，納","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088317474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"音屬火，本年金山墓運，乙丑屬金，受月納音之尅，即為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088317474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"正、二、九、十月尅乾亥兌丁四金山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088317474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"戊辰、己巳月，納音","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088333858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116714025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"屬木，本年木山墓運，辛未屬土，受月納音之尅，即為三、","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088333858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"四月尅震艮巳三木山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088333858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午、辛未月，納音屬土，本年","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088350242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山，無水運，即其月無尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088350242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼申、癸酉月，納音屬","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088366626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"金，與本年納音同，故亦尅水土山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088366626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"丙子、丁丑月，納音","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088383010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水，本年火山墓運，甲戌屬火，受月納音之尅，即為十","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088383010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"一、十二月尅離𡈼丙乙四火山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088383010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"又如𡈼申年，納音屬","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088399394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"金，本年二十四山無木運，惟冬至後金山墓運，癸丑屬","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088399394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"木，受年納音之尅，即為本年二十四山，並無尅，冬至後","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088399394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116730409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"尅乾亥兌丁四金山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088399394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"日時尅山家，俱倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088415778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"凡自年月","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088432162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"起山家之法，用本年五子元遁，歴數丑辰未戌四墓納","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088432162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"音，為年月納音所尅者，其墓為某山之墓，即為年月尅","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088432162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"某山。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088432162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋墓龍變運，從山起而忌年月，此從年月起而尅","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088448546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"山家。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088448546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"參互相推，其理一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088464930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116746793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4rtwm/1-SK1619_figure_00036.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VP2mNbj5guhZ%2BLnjGqPYq0j967Y%3D","pictureHeight":1498," {"lines":[{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353391116763177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"立春艮，雨水寅，驚蟄甲，春分震，清明乙，穀雨辰，立夏巽，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088481314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿巳，芒種丙，夏至離，小暑丁，大暑未，立秋坤，處暑申，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088481314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"白露庚，秋分兌，寒露辛，霜降戌，立冬乾，小雪亥，大雪𡈼，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088481314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至坎，小寒癸，大寒丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088481314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"四立、二分、二至，正應八卦，是為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088497698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"八節。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088497698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"奇門九局，皆起于此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088514082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436259883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4s6jq/1-SK1619_figure_00037.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oWMWs6FaK%2BH9Afg84kirnzjOsDA%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4s6jq/1-SK1619_figure_00037.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expir {"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436276267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"乾納甲，坎納癸、申、辰，艮納丙，震納庚、亥、未，巽納辛，離納","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088530466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼、寅、戌，坤納乙，兌納丁、己、丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088530466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、離不納戊、巳者，二十四","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088546850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"山無戊巳，故離納乾之𡈼，坎納坤之癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088546850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"其法不知所自","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088563234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"來。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088563234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，啓䝉附論曰：火之體，隂也，其用則陽，而天用之，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088579618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾中畫與坤交，而變為離。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088579618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"水之體，陽也，其用則隂，而","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088596002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"地用之，故坤中畫與乾交，而變為坎。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088596002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"然則坎、離納戊、巳","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088612386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"者，固先天之傳；而離納𡈼，坎納癸，則後天之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088612386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"其四","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088628770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"正卦，兼納八支，取與本卦支為三合局。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088628770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"地理家之坐山","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088645154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436292651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"九星，淨隂淨陽，皆起于此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088645154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"小遊年變卦，青囊經謂之九曜，亦名翻卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088677922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"從乾卦翻者，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088694306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"為天父卦；從坤卦翻者，為地母卦，皆由天定卦翻變而","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088694306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"出。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088694306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"地理家之淨隂淨陽、三吉、六秀、八貴、十二吉龍，皆本","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088710690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"于此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088710690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"後世借以為男女生命合婚之用，故名遊年。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088727074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"因陽","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088743458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"宅又有遊年變卦之法，故此為小遊年。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088743458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以貪狼、巨","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088759842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"門、禄存、文曲、廉貞、武曲、破軍、左輔、右弼為序。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088759842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"以八卦而","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088776226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436309035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"論，則右弼與左輔同宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088776226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"以九宫而論，則貪狼為一白，屬","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088792610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"水；巨門為二黑，屬土；禄存為三碧；文曲為四緑，屬木；廉","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088792610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"貞為五黄，屬土；武曲為六白；破軍為七赤，屬金；左輔為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088792610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"八白，屬土；右弼為九紫，屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088792610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"又以五星而論，則貪狼為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088808994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣，屬木；巨門為天醫；禄存為絶體，屬土；文曲為遊魂，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088808994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"屬水；廉貞為五鬼，屬火；武曲為福徳；破軍為絶命，屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088808994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼從本宫無耑，屬地理家，從龍上起，以貪狼、巨門、武","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088825378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"曲、廉貞為吉，禄存、文曲、破軍、輔弼為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088825378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家從向上","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088841762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436325419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"起，以貪狼、巨門、武曲、文曲為吉，禄存、廉貞、破軍、輔弼為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088841762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088841762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"其取義各自不同，卦例具詳於後","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088858146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436341803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436358187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4sj6u/1-SK1619_figure_00038.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=O6VuR4UiYqUEgD5sakNgT%2BUYt30%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4sj6u/1-SK1619_figure_00038.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bVhYyzr%2BMuZJWwBWPcA1nrAu68Q%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4sj6u/1-SK1619_figure_00038.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436374571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"天定卦例，以乾、艮、坎、震，後天四陽卦横列于下，離、巽、坤、","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088874530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"兌，後天四隂卦横列于上。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088874530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"而按先天生卦之序，乾與兌","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088890914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"對，離與震對，巽與坎對，艮與坤對。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088890914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"自本宫對卦，一上一","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088907298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"下，次第翻之，中起中止，傍起傍止，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088907298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"按天定卦例，止取本卦之上爻變者為對卦，所以便于","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088923682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"翻轉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088923682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"究之乾震居中，艮坎居傍，陽卦居上，隂卦居下，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088940066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"無不可者。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088940066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"地理大成另易有三式，然則非果有一定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088956450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436390955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4svty/1-SK1619_figure_00039.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nfDx1K%2BDNEGseIGiiyGRWX7%2BxNU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4svty/1-SK1619_figure_00039.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=j4bHaOSsbDX3QXC%2FrPfqXEf%2BYoE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4svty/1-SK1619_figure_00039.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436407339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"天父卦從乾翻起，自上而中，而下，而復中，而復上，以次","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088972834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"遞變。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088972834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"乾上爻變為兌，為貪狼；兌中爻變為震，為巨門；震","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088989218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"下爻變為坤，為禄存；坤中爻變為坎，為文曲；坎上爻變","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088989218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"為巽，為廉貞；巽中爻變為艮，為武曲，艮下爻變為離，為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088989218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍；離中爻變復為乾，為輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741088989218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"是為傍起傍止。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089005602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436423723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4t8h2/1-SK1619_figure_00040.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=episBuAMjzL0rNfTbwyniWArYOk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4t8h2/1-SK1619_figure_00040.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires {"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"按青囊經太元終易圖以坤為本宫，說云：坤為地母，諸","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089120290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"山所托，三吉六秀，勢定於此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089120290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"卦例訣曰：經云三吉只求","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089136674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"來勢好，但以地母卦為主，求其艮丙、巽辛、兌丁、巳丑、震","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089136674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436456491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、亥未十二隂龍諸山所托之故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089136674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"邱公頌曰：三般大","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089153058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"卦如何起，元女當年親口傳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089153058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"三吉只求來勢好，向家須","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089169442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"變鬼爻看。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089169442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"註曰：坤為地母，諸山所托，察龍坤卦，索求三","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089185826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，後世因此遂有地理貴隂之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089185826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"今按青囊卦例，八宫","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089202210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"皆稱地母三吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089202210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"註曰：三吉來山，陽山隂落，隂山陽落，上","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089218594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089218594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"陽山陽落而隂水朝，隂山隂落而陽水朝，次吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089234978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"然則","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089251362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"山不皆隂，苐以與水相配為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089251362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂地母卦者，特舉坤","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089267746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"以見例耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089267746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"如坤為本龍，艮為貪狼，巽為巨門，兌為武曲，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089284130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436472875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"故以艮巽兌為三吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089284130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"艮納丙，巽納辛，兌納丁，故以丙辛","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089300514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"丁並三吉為六秀。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089300514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"又艮巽震兌四卦，抽去中爻，餘上下","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089316898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"二爻皆隂陽得配，謂之九六衝和。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089316898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"震卦廉貞雖凶，而以","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089333282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"得配為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089333282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"震納庚，故以震庚並三吉六秀為八貴。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089349666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"又兌","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089366050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"之三合為己丑，震之三合為亥未，故以己丑亥未并八","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089366050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"貴為十二吉山，皆由地母卦而定。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089366050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"然八宫皆有九曜，天","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089382434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"父卦得天定卦之乾兌相對，巽坎相對，地母卦得天定","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089382434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之離震相對，艮坤相對，而六子之用備具。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089382434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"故翻卦之","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089398818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436489259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"法，舉天父地母以見例，十二吉山又専舉地母以見例。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089398818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":45
