{"lines":[{"lineId":"740","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"變為絶體禄存。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089546274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻俱不變，為伏位輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089562658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋取上一","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089579042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"爻變，上二爻變，或下一爻變，下二爻變者，則乾坤坎離","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089579042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"四陽卦，必變為震艮兌巽之四隂，而四隂卦必變為四","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089579042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，故為三吉，以取坐山之用。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089579042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"地理家所謂陽龍坐隂，山","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089595426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"立陽向；隂龍坐陽，山立隂向是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089595426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"山與向既有隂陽之","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089611810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"不同，故論向者，又自本宫五鬼方之對位起貪狼，而以","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089611810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"本宫與五鬼互易，謂之五鬼卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089611810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾為本宫，巽為五鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089628194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"乃轉以巽為本宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089628194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"自巽對宫坎上起貪狼，坤為巨門，震","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089644578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436735019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"為禄存，兌為文曲，乾為五鬼，離為武曲，艮為破軍，巽為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089644578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089644578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"然後乾巽互易，仍以乾為本宫，巽為五鬼，則所得","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089660962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"坎、坤、離之三吉，又皆與乾本宫成淨陽，而其卦變遂一","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089660962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"上一下，以輔、武、破、廉、貪、巨、禄、文為序。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089660962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"然則變卦之吉凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089677346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以所分之隂陽為定耳，未必有深義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741089677346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂按諸卦","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549428776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"例，亦有合焉者。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549428776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"其說曰：先天八卦，上一爻變者，本象所","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549445160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"生，隂陽相配，相生相比，是猶同氣而相得者也，故為生","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549445160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549445160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"上二爻變者，本儀所生，奇偶相配，相制而不相害，是","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549461544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436751403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"猶補偏而救弊者也，故曰天醫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549461544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"下一爻變者，陽往交隂，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549477928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"隂往交陽，往為屈，屈為鬼，而卦序皆相隔五位，故曰五","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549477928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549477928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"下二爻變者，老少同情，隂陽交易，志相得，氣相生，故","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549494312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"為福徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549494312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"上下二爻變者，陽儀隔位而交于隂，隂儀隔位","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549510696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"而交于陽，隂陽奇偶俱不相配，故曰遊魂。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549510696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"中一爻變者，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549527080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"陽儀隔位而還于陽，隂儀隔位而還于隂，其氣反歸而","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549527080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"交尅，故曰絶命。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549527080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻俱變，則卦位對衝，全非本體，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549543464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"絶體。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549543464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"三爻俱不變，則自得本宫，故曰伏位，猶云伏吟者","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549559848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436767787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549559848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"在八宫卦象，則上爻持世卦為本宫伏位，初世卦為","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549576232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"五鬼，二世卦為福徳，三世卦為絶體，四世卦為天醫，五","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549576232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"世卦為生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549576232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"遊魂卦為遊魂，歸魂卦為絶命。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549592616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾遇乾，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549609000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"則成重乾，為上爻持世卦，是為伏吟。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549609000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、巽相遇，則成姤、","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549625384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"小畜，皆初世卦，為五鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549625384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、艮相遇，則成遯、大畜，皆二世","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549641768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"卦，為福徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549641768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坤相遇，則成泰、否，皆三世卦，為絶體。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549658152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、震","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549674536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"相遇，則成无妄、大壯，皆四世卦，為天醫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549674536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、兌相遇，則成","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549690920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"履、夬，皆五世卦，為生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549690920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、坎相遇，則成需、訟，皆遊魂卦，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549707304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436784171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"為遊魂。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549707304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、離相遇，則成同人、大有，皆歸魂卦，為絶命。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549723688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"餘","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549740072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549740072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，先天之說甚巧，其八宫卦象，則唯絶體、遊","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549756456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"魂、絶命，與卦變義合，餘無所取，蓋特以此為記耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549756456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"圖列","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549772840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"於後：","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549772840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"811","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"大遊年變卦，相宅家用之選擇，有以宅長行年配合修","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549805608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"造之說，故名遊年。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549805608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"因地理亦有遊年變卦之法，故此名","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549821992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"大遊年，小隂而大陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549821992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"其法亦由天定卦翻變而出，而","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549838376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436800555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"以貪狼、廉貞、武曲、文曲、禄存、巨門、破軍、輔弼為序。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549838376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549854760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"為本宫，乾上爻變為兌，為貪狼；兌中爻變為震，為五鬼；","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549854760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"震下爻變為坤，為武曲；坤中爻變為坎，為文曲；坎上爻","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549854760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"變為巽，為禄存；巽中爻變為艮，為巨門；艮下爻變為離，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549854760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"為破軍；離中爻變復為乾，為輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549854760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼與小遊同，亦曰","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549871144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549871144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞即小遊之巨門，亦曰五鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549887528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲即小遊之絶","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549903912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"體，又曰延年；文曲與小遊同，又曰六煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549903912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存即小遊之","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549920296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"五鬼，又曰禍害。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549920296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門即小遊之福徳，亦曰天醫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549936680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍、輔","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549953064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436816939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"弼與小遊同。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549953064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽宅之法，以乾、兌為老陽，艮、坤為老隂；","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549969448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"離、震為少隂，巽、坎為少陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549969448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"二老相配為西四宅，二少相","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549985832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"配為東四宅，東西各自相配為吉，交錯相配為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741549985832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"故變","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550002216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"卦之吉凶，與小遊年有同異耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550002216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"翻卦之法，皆以上一爻","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550018600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"變為生氣、貪狼，下二爻變為天醫、巨門，三爻俱變為延","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550018600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"年、武曲，三爻俱不變為伏位輔弼。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550018600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋上一爻變者，則乾、","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550034984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"兌互變，艮、坤互變，離、震互變，巽、坎互變；下二爻變者，則","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550034984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"乾、艮互變，兌、坤互變，離、巽互變，震、坎互變；三爻俱變者，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550034984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436833323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"則乾、坤互變，兌、艮互變，離、坎互變，震、巽互變；三爻俱不","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550034984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"變者，則自得本宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550034984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"皆老少各自相配，故為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550051368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"外此則","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550067752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"老少交錯相配，故為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550067752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"在八宫卦象，則上爻持世卦","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550084136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"為伏位，初世卦為禍害，二世卦為天醫，三世卦為延年，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550084136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"四世卦為五鬼，五世卦為生氣，遊魂卦為六煞，歸魂卦","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550084136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"為絶命。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550084136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"與小遊年例亦有異同，圖並列後。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550100520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436849707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4w1ly/1-SK1619_figure_00048.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AXn5ZGLwXZWY7UZ%2FyGmYQ%2FYFSDc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4w1ly/1-SK1619_figure_00048.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=welXrMQkOYag47BSo%2FMCdWkRedM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur4w1ly/1-SK1619_figure_00048.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353490436866091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"乾上一爻變為兌，兌上一爻變為乾。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550116904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"離上一爻變為震，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550133288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"震上一爻變為離。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550133288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"巽上一爻變為坎，坎上一爻變為巽，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550149672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"艮上一爻變為坤，坤上一爻變為艮。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550149672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"乾兌老陽所生；離","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550166056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"震少隂所生；巽坎少陽所生；艮坤老隂所生，乃先天生","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550166056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"卦自然之序。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550166056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"乾兌兩金相比，震離木火相生，坎巽水木","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550182440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"相生，艮坤兩土相比。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550182440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"而後天乾陽兌隂，震陽離隂，坎陽","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550198824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"巽隂，艮陽坤隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550198824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤、坎 少男，兌少女。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550739496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"相宅家以隂陽正配為吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550755880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"故大遊年取皆應之義，為延年。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550755880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"一吉一凶，各隨其用爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678955741550772264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇神煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441446921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"古有建除、堪輿、叢辰諸家，顧其義不盡傳，起","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441463305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"例尤多襲誤。","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441463305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"今頗為蒐輯，擇其近理而雅馴者，加之解","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441479689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"釋，正其舛誤，庶吉凶之義，因例可尋，而不惑於世俗術","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441479689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"數之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441479689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"作義例","logicSentenceId":"7678949563441496073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"舉事無細大，必擇其日辰，義歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475808283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：敬天也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475824667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"記曰：易抱龜","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475841051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"南面，天子卷冕北面，雖有明智之心，必進斷其知焉，示","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475841051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"不敢專，以尊天也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475841051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"夫古之君子，居則觀其象而玩其辭，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475857435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"一事之至，其合於何卦何爻，應有何變何應，早已謀諸","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475857435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"乃心而灼然，況又謀及卿士大夫至於庶民，夫亦何患","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475857435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"其不審，乃又必動則觀其變而玩其占耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475857435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"凡以血氣心","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475873819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"知之性，必合諸虛靈不昧之天，而後天下之理得。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475873819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"使足","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475890203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878614070"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"已而不問，則未事而先失也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475890203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇之義，亦猶夫是。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475906587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"天地","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475922971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"神祗之所向則順之，所忌則避之，既奉若於宫廷，以彰","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475922971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"昭事之忱，又申布於閭左，以協休嘉之氣，凡以敬天云","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475922971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475922971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"如曰若是則福，不若是則禍，則術士之曲説，而非其","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475939355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"本原也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475939355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"王充論衡闢之不遺餘力，則又儒士拘迂而未","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475955739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"見大義。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475955739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"善夫荀悦申鑒曰：或問時羣忌，曰：此天地之數","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475972123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"也，非吉凶所從生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475972123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"夫知其為天地之數，則固修身者","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475988507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"所當順也；知其非吉凶所從生，則一切拘牽謬悠之説","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475988507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878630454"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"具廢，而所為順之避之者，亦必有道矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035475988507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878646838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878663222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ic6e/1-SK1619_figure_00058.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=n8aVHBJMGHD1MsCVd6f%2BDxKvmDs%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ic6e/1-SK1619_figure_00058.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=B3y%2Fqdo2XnsT%2BG%2BkMNexkaac6bU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ic6e/1-SK1619_figure_00058.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878679606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經曰：歲德者，歲中德神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476004891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"十幹之中，五為陽，五為","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476021275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476021275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者，君道也；隂者，臣道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476037659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"君德自處，臣德從君也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476054043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476070427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"理之地，萬福咸集，衆殃自避，應有修營，並獲福祐。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476070427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476086811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"聖厯曰：甲德在甲，乙德在庚，丙德在丙，丁德在𡈼，戊德","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476086811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"在戊，己德在甲，庚德在庚，辛德在丙，𡈼德在𡈼，癸德在","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476086811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"戊。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476086811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：律吕六陽當位自得，六隂則居其衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476103195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476119579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"則五陽干當位自得，五隂干則取其合。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476119579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽以自得為","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476135963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"德，而隂以從陽為德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476135963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878695990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"按甲、丙、戊、庚、𡈼五陽，即以甲、丙、戊、庚、𡈼為德，不同于乙、","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476152347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"丁、己、辛、癸以所合之干為德者。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476152347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經謂君德自處，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476168731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"文不足以暢厥㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476168731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋易之道，陽一隂二，陽為德，隂為刑。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476185115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，善也，隂惡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476201499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"是故陽之為德也，在不化乎隂；而隂之","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476217883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"為德也，在棄其本位而從乎陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476217883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：西南得朋。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476234267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"西南，陽","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476250651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"也，得朋，隂從乎陽之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476250651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"東北喪朋。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476267035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"東北，隂也，喪朋，棄","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476283419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"其本位之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476283419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"隂能化陽，亦能從陽，陽為隂化，隂斯慝","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476299803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476299803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"能從乎陽，斯為德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476316187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"然則陽惟一，而隂有二矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476332571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"是故","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476348955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878712374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"甲德在甲，甲，陽也，故甲即甲之德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476348955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"乙德在庚，乙，隂也，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476365339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"庚能制乙者也，在乙而從庚，是即乙之徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476365339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁以下","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476381723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476381723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878728758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ioti/1-SK1619_figure_00059.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=opxBvxNY5f3px%2BtGSsPLP%2FF%2FVKk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ioti/1-SK1619_figure_00059.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UaGMmNSdlh17JfnmX%2FUG2m7a8XY%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ioti/1-SK1619_figure_00059.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878745142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：歲德合者，歲德五合之干是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476398107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"甲年在己，乙年","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476414491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"在乙，丙年在辛，丁年在丁，戊年在癸，巳年在己，庚年在","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476414491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，辛年在辛，壬年在丁，癸年在癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476414491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"故歲德屬陽，歲德合","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476430875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"屬隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476430875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"143","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"按，歲德與歲德合，並屬上吉，有宜無忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476447259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"然細推其義，有","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476463643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"剛柔之别焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476463643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德，無問隂年陽年，皆剛辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476480027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"歲德合，無","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476496411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"問隂年陽年，皆柔辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476496411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"外事以剛，内事以柔，古之志也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476512795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家雖未論及此，用者可以意通也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476529179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878761526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6j1gm/1-SK1619_figure_00060.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MiPMy1FDKv%2Bxwfwy9rQMM70L%2F%2BQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6j1gm/1-SK1619_figure_00060.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tCzixHop%2F5mkhy76cnf%2F {"lines":[{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878777910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱經曰：歲幹合者，天地隂陽配合也，主除滅災咎，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476545563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"興福祐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476545563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，可以修營起土，上官嫁娶，逺行叅","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476561947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"謁。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476561947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：甲年在己，乙年在庚，丙年在辛，丁年在𡈼，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476578331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"戊年在癸，取其與歲干相合者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476578331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：今厯日","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476594715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"歲轉吉神無此條。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476594715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"按：歲幹合為歲中大神，而保章氏不著于簡者何也？","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476611099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476627483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丁己辛癸之年，則所為甲丙戊庚𡈼者，即歲德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476627483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476643867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊庚𡈼之年，則所為乙丁己辛癸者，即歲德合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476643867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"既","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476660251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878794294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"有歲德，歲徳合，則不必復著歲幹合之名也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476660251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，要各","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476676635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"有義焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476676635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽同職不同性，故如五鬼之又為厭對，又為","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476693019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"六儀之類，必兩著之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476693019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"歲幹合仍當存其目，不得因彼而","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476709403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"廢此也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476709403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878810678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878827062"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6je3q/1-SK1619_figure_00061.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vbynz1YrmtyCc0BH7VX%2B2fYh%2FEk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6je3q/1-SK1619_figure_00061.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=UHfdY0J5SL3Fcqn4Uq4JF9fhr3o%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6je3q/1-SK1619_figure_00061.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878843446"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：歲枝德者，歲中德神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476725787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"德者，得也，得福之謂","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476742171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476742171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"主救危而濟弱，所理之方，利以興造舉動衆務。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476758555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"○李","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476774939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"鼎祚曰：常居歲前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476774939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：枝德者，從太歲向","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476791323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"前五合之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476791323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"假令歲在甲子，向前見己巳，甲與己合，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476807707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"即己為枝德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476807707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"又如歲在丙子，向前見辛己，丙與辛合，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476824091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"即已為枝德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476824091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476840475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯日歲轉吉神無此條。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476856859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"按：歲枝德者，謂甲既在子，則巳上必已。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476873243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"已，甲之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476889627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476906011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"所合之神，所居之枝，則亦必吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476906011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"地必從天，枝必從幹，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476922395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878859830"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"幹既吉位，枝必無凶，其義然也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476922395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"其辰又為死符，又為小","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476938779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476938779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"厯家既重死符、小耗，則不用此條。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476955163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"然美惡不嫌同位，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476971547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶不嫌同名。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476971547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"死符為營塚等事所忌，小耗為市易造","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476987931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"作等事所忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035476987931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"茍所舉之事非此屬也，則仍為吉神矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477004315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"即","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477020699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"同一興造，如為營居室歟，則當以小耗論。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477020699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"如為治橋梁、","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477037083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"築堤岸，損己之財以利衆之事歟，則雖屬小耗，而實為","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477037083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"枝德，乃大吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477037083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"此條固不可廢。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477053467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878876214"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878892598"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6jqqu/1-SK1619_figure_00062.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=psFg7Exm21ZFryGiv9JhANANzdw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026, {"lines":[{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878908982"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：太歲，人君之象，率領諸神，統正方位，斡運時","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477069851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"序，總成歲功。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477069851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"以上元閼逢困敦之歲，起建於子，歲徙一","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477086235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"位，十二年一週。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477086235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"若國家巡狩省方，出師畧地，營造宫闕，","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477102619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"開拓封疆，不可向之黎庶修營宅舍，築壘墻垣，並須逥","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477102619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"避。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477102619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"○黄帝經曰：太歲所在之辰，必不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477119003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477135387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲者，歲星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477135387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"故木星十二年行一周天，一年行一次","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477151771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477151771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"按周禮馮相氏掌十有二歲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477168155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭康成註曰：歲謂太歲，歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477184539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878925366"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"星與日同次之月，斗所建之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477184539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"樂説謂歲星與日常應","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477200923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲月建以見，然則今厯太歲非此也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477200923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"賈公彦疏曰：太","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477217307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在地，與天上歲星相應而行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477217307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星為陽，右行於天，一","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477233691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"歲移一辰，又分前辰為一百三十四分而侵一分，則一","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477233691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"百四十四年跳一辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477233691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰帀，則總有千七百二十八","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477250075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"年，十二跳辰帀。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477250075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"以此而計之，十二歲一小周，謂一年移","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477266459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"一辰故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477266459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"千七百二十八年一大周，十二跳帀故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950035477282843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"太","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921096201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"歲左行於地，一與歲星跳辰年數同。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921096201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"其云歲星與日同","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921112585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878941750"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"次之月，斗所建之辰者，以歲星為陽，人之所見，太歲為","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921112585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，人所不覩。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921112585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星與太歲雖右行左行不同，要之行度","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921128969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"不異，故舉歲星以表太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921128969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星與日同次之月，一年之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921145353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"中，惟于一辰之上為法。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921145353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"若上元甲子朔旦冬至，日月五","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921161737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"星同在牽牛之初，是歲星與日同次之月也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921161737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月斗","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921178121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"建子，子有太歲，至下年歲星移向子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921178121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月日月會於","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921194505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"元枵，十二月斗建丑，丑有太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921194505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"自此以後皆然也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921210889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"故引","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921227273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"樂説以證太歲在月建之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921227273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯太歲無跳辰之義，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921243657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878958134"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"故云非此經太歲也云云。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921243657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，歲星右行於天，太歲左","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921260041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"行於地。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921260041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"歲星歲移一辰，十二年一周，故曰歲星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921276425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"則厯之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921292809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲，即是保章氏所云十有二歲，並非别有太歲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921292809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"顧太","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921309193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"歲者，歲之神；歲星者，歲之星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921309193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"舉太歲以表歲星則可，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921325577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲即歲星則不可。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921325577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭之説非也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921341961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲為百神之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921358345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"統，俗謂之年中天子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921358345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經謂國家巡狩省方、出師畧","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921374729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"地、營造宫闕、開拓封疆，不可向之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921374729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"向之云者，與太歲對，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921391113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"則身居歲破之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921391113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：若黎庶修造，則並須迴避者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921407497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878974518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲君象，其方固上吉之方，而非下民之所敢用。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921407497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"猶月","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921423881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"忌日為中宫五黄，民間須避是日，同一義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921423881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"故又謂之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921440265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"堆黄煞，古人謂之歲下，對方則亦曰歲破。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921440265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"漢王充論衡","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921456649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"載移徙法曰：徙抵太歲凶，負太歲亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921456649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"抵太歲名曰歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921473033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"下，負太歲名曰歲破，是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921473033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425878990902"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6k3dy/1-SK1619_figure_00063.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4xlH5KPxP3SXlxrVl1pwylxNvp8%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6k3dy/1-SK1619_figure_00063.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Vy2Iw6AsqDrSby1x4dovPzGpm6s%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6k3dy/1-SK1619_figure_00063.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425879007286"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：歲破者，太歲所衝之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921489417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"其地不可興造、移","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921505801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"徙、嫁娶、逺行，犯者主損財物，及害家長，惟戰伐向之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921505801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總要曰：歲破者，子年在午，順行十二辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921522185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"按歲破為最凶之神，而廣聖厯云：戰伐向之吉者，蓋向","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921538569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"歲破即坐太歲，而敵人乃居歲破之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921538569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"然則仍是用","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921554953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲，非用歲破也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921554953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"308","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：大耗者，歲中虛耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921587721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可營造","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921604105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425879023670"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"倉庫，納財物，犯之當有冦賊驚恐之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921604105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總要曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921620489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"常居歲衝之地。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921620489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大耗者，太歲擊衝破散之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921636873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921636873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"物擊則破，衝則散，破散則耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921653257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425879072822"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：大將軍者，歲之大將也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921718793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"統御威武，總領戰伐。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921735177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"若國家命將出師，攻城戰陣，則宜背之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921751561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"凡興造皆不可","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921767945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921767945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：孟歲，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"寅申己亥，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"以勝光","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"午；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"仲歲，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":224,"lineType":2,"content":"子午夘酉，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"以小吉","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"未；","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"季歲，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"以傳送","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"申，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"加歲枝上，逢天罡","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":225,"lineType":2,"content":"辰，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"為大將軍。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921784329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年為仲年，即以未加歲枝子上，順數至酉，得辰，即","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921800713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為大將軍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921800713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921817097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大將軍，其德忠直，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921833481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"常居四正，三年一遷，所理之地，可以命將帥，選威勇，以","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921833481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"伐不義。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921833481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：大將軍者，統御武臣之職，有䕶衞虎","logicSentenceId":"7678950584921849865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353425879089206"},
