{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447061011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：蠶室者，歲之凶神也，主絲繭綿帛之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922308617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"所理","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922325001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可修動，犯之，蠶絲不收。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922325001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：蠶室者，常","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922341385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"與力士對衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922341385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"按太歲之四維：一奏書，二博士，三力士，四蠶室。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922357769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書在","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922374153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲之後，維天子古與稽，今與居，左圖右史所鑑之以","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922374153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"出治者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922374153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"故於太歲為最親而近，為神之貴而吉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922390537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"博士，文臣也，出納王命，行政施惠，故與奏書衝，而在太","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922406921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"歲之前，亦吉神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922406921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"力士，武臣也，在太歲之前隅，若羽林","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922423305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447077395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"千牛旗纛旄麾之屬，專掌殺伐，故其方之軍旅，可命以","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922423305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"討有罪也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922423305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"與力士對衝，而在太歲之後隅者，後宫之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922439689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"后妃之屬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922439689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"後宫之事，莫大於親蠶，以供郊廟祭祀之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922456073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"服，故以蠶室名之，而亦不可抵向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922456073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447093779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447110163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6m78m/1-SK1619_figure_00069.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qyAT13jdW5iQ4pu9W5xWr09kQLI%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6m78m/1-SK1619_figure_00069.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kObi3EnYbkpDXZPGjjXzYO8KkR0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6m78m/1-SK1619_figure_00069.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447126547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：蠶官者，歲中掌絲之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922472457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，忌營構宫","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922488841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"室，犯之，蠶母多病，絲繭不收。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922488841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"○黎幹曰：歲在東方居戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922505225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"在南方居丑，在西方居辰，在北方居未。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922505225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：蠶官","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922521609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"者，蠶室之官，使蠶得養也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922521609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"如歲在東方，屬木，木養於戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922537993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"故在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922537993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在南方，屬火，火養於丑，故在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922554377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在西方，屬","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922570761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"金，金養於辰，故在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922570761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在北方，屬水，水養於未，故在未","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922587145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922587145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447142931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mjvq/1-SK1619_figure_00070.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Nrrs96PAE%2Fs7kbdOLwh7y1H8Ghc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mjvq/1-SK1619_figure_00070.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8zhrdmGcTzozCZ3uWpooDY2HYx0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mjvq/1-SK1619_figure_00070.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447159315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：蠶命者，掌蠶之命神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922603529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可舉動百","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922619913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"事，犯之者主傷蠶，絲繭不收。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922619913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"○黎幹曰：歲在北方，居申，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922636297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在東方，居亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922636297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在南方，居寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922652681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在西方，居巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922669065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922685449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：蠶命者，蠶之所係以生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922685449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"如歲在北方，屬水，水生於","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922701833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"申，故在申。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922701833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在東方，屬木，木生於亥，故在亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584922718217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在南方，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975622171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火，火生於寅，故在寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975622171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在西方，屬金，金生於已，故在","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975638555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975638555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"今之蠶命，子年未，丑年午，寅年亥，夘年戌，辰年己，巳","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975654939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"年丑，午年寅，未年申，申年夘，酉年辰，戌年子，亥年酉，此","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975654939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447175699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"恐有悞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975654939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"又按萬全廣濟云：亥子丑年未坤申，寅夘辰年","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975671323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"戌乾，亥巳午未年丑艮，寅申酉戌年辰巽己。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975671323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"假如亥子","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975687707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年，蠶官在未，蠶室在坤，蠶命在申是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975687707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975704091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"人之生也，食穀而衣絲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975736859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"殖穀者在野，無一方而不宜也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975753243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"養蠶者在室，則營構必有宜忌焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975769627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲為本年之主，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975786011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"是年之蠶，即太歲之所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975786011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"所生之庫地，即蠶之官府","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975802395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故有蠶官方位。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975802395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在東方，東方木，木生火，火庫戌，故","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975818779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447192083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"戌蠶官也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975818779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶以是年生，則是年方位之所受生，即蠶所","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975835163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"受命也，故有蠶命方位。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975835163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"歲在東方，東方木，木長生在亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975851547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"故亥蠶命也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975851547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975867931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447208467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mwiu/1-SK1619_figure_00071.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=swV%2FqK6qQrc8mLFTfhfQ%2FVwA8nU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mwiu/1-SK1619_figure_00071.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6b8zP1BvJstoBAhLXSPa8Ktrk10%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6mwiu/1-SK1619_figure_00071.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447224851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"紀歲厯曰：喪門者，歲之凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975884315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"主死喪哭泣之事，常居","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975900699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"歲前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975900699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可興舉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975917083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之者，主盜賊、遺亡、死","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975933467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"喪之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975933467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛書曰：子年在寅，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975949851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975966235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：喪門者，太歲之轅門也，故常居歲前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975966235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂喪門","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975982619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"與白虎對衝，白虎主喪服之事，衝之故凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975982619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447241235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6n95y/1-SK1619_figure_00072.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=i%2B%2BViQ9KNkoya0sI9UyRmHjofbs%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6n95y/1-SK1619_figure_00072.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=way6EACsaicNgU2s%2FBNZ1f2zsaI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6n95y/1-SK1619_figure_00072.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447257619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：太隂者，歲后也，常居歲後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584975999003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976015387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"可興修。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976015387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：后妃所居者，后宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976031771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"后宫之星，在","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976048155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"帝後二星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976048155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":343,"lineType":2,"content":"紫微垣北極五星，第二為帝星，第四為后宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"故太隂常居太歲後","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976064539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976064539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"子年起戌，順行十二辰，如子年則在戌，丑年則在","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976080923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，寅年則在子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976080923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"按史記白圭傳曰：太隂在夘，穰；明歲衰惡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976097307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"至午，旱；明歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976113691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"美。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976113691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"至酉，穰；明歲衰惡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976130075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"至子，大旱；明歲美，有水。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976146459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"至夘，積貯","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976162843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"率數倍。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976162843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"張守節正義曰：歲後二辰為太隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976179227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"又吳越春","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976195611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447274003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"秋載計倪曰：太隂所居之歲，畱息三年，貴賤見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976195611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"又越","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976211995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"絶載計倪曰：從寅至未，陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976211995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂在陽，歲德在隂，歲美","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976228379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"在是。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976228379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人動而應之，制其收發。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976244763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"然則太隂之神，為年穀","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976261147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"豐歉水旱之占也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976261147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"今厯家謂修造等事，不宜抵向，其説","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976277531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"不符於古。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976277531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"然或别有所自來，未可遽以為非。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976293915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"顧從太隂","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976310299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"例之，則所謂蠶室、蠶官、蠶命者，其方位所在，必有每歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976310299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶絲豐歉之占，而今不可考矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976310299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"又按四利三元，以太歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976326683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"前三位為太隂，與此同名不同位，蓋各為一家之言，不","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976326683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447290387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"嫌並存也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976326683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"紀歲厯曰：弔客者，歲之凶神也，主疾病哀泣之事，常居","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976359451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"歲後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976359451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，不可興造及問病尋醫，弔孝送喪。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976375835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛書曰：子年在戌，順行十二辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976392219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"其位常與官","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976408603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"符對衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976408603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447306771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6nlt2/1-SK1619_figure_00073.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BgdginzBmw1rQ2N08dR0W36LkjE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6nlt2/1-SK1619_figure_00073.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wYK%2BWHbrCJJPi46omC7DRq5wrMo%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6nlt2/1-SK1619_figure_00073.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447323155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"蓬瀛書曰：歲在四孟，太隂與大將軍合于四仲，名曰羣","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976424987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976424987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯神原始曰：天地凶殃，必在羣醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976441371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"按天文志：中宫天極星，其一明者，太一常居也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976474139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"旁三星","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976490523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"三公，或曰子屬。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976490523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"後勾四星，末大星后妃，餘三星，後宫之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976506907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"屬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976506907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"禮記曰：天子掌陽教，后掌隂教。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976523291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"故以歲後二辰象","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976539675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"之，而名之太隂焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976539675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"夫太隂之職，將以助陽出治也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976556059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"大將","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976572443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"軍之職，雖主殺伐，然殺伐者，凡以鋤邪凶而扶正直，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976572443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447339539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"所以佐陽出治也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976572443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"若其年太隂與大將軍同位，則是窮","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976588827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"隂沍寒，奸慝暴亂，而絶無生養之意矣，故曰羣醜，為方","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976588827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"位之最凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976588827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"然太隂之方又為弔客者，何歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976605211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋歲後二","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976621595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"位與歲前二位必屬三合，如太歲在午，則後二辰，前二","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976621595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"申，申與辰必暗拱子，以尅太歲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976621595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲在丑，則後二亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976637979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"前二夘，夘與亥必暗拱未，以衝太歲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976637979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"為太歲所衝尅，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976654363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"與衝尅太歲者，皆死地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976654363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"然則扶助之者，非喪門弔客","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976670747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"之象歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976670747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"門必在前，故前為喪門；客者，自他方至者也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976687131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447355923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"後為弔客。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976687131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之義，美惡不嫌同位，各從其所用耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976703515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"喪","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976719899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"門之位又為朱雀，則以前朱雀，後𤣥武，而以太歲前二","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976719899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"位為朱雀耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976719899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"今曹震圭以喪門為太歲之轅門，則泥於","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976736283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"門字之名，而不知太歲之門不必喪也，亦可嗤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976736283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447372307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6nyg6/1-SK1619_figure_00074.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Pqo5afITVMFmwnQ4sTTTyZUEpHA%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6nyg6/1-SK1619_figure_00074.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eyPCkfM2Y4TcybU {"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447388691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：官符者，歲之凶神也，主官府詞訟之事，所理之","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976752667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"方不可興土工，犯之者當有獄訟之事，常居歲前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976752667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：歲中掌符信之官，文權之職也，常居三合","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976769051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"前辰，故前辰為文官，後辰為武職。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976769051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"假令歲在寅，寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976785435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"為三合，則午有官符，文權也；戌有白虎，武職也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976785435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976801819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖厯曰：畜官者，歲中牧養之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976818203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"主養育羣畜之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976834587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，忌造牛欄馬櫪及放牧，犯之者，損六畜，傷財。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976850971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：居歲前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976867355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：畜者，養也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976883739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"是養畜","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976900123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447405075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"之官，以待百官之乘驛者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976900123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"居三合前辰，與官符同位。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976916507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書年表神煞方位，以三合五行臨官之位為天官","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976932891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"符，故此又名地官符以别之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976932891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"地之云者，以其隨地支逐","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976949275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"歲而移也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976949275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽家最重山向，並論三方地官符，三方弔","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976965659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"照太歲，故忌興造。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976965659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447421459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447437843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ob3a/1-SK1619_figure_00 {"lines":[{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447454227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"人元祕樞經曰：白虎者，歲中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976982043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"常居歲後四辰所","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976998427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"居之地，犯之，主有喪服之災，切宜愼之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584976998427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：居","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977014811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"三合後辰，解見官符節。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977014811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"按：官符，白虎，歲三合也，太歲之引從也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977031195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"引為文，曰官符；","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977047579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"從為武，曰白虎。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977047579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"前陽而後隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977063963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"畜官同官符者，猶先馬","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977080347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977080347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"因以為六畜之占。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977096731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447470611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6onqe/1-SK1619_figure_00076.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6aEaR5lmM2RqttQYyLO5vP0O5vM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6onqe/1-SK1619_figure_00076.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GPsSiIsLFLJzG8Pt3MUjQITmYWM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6onqe/1-SK1619_figure_00076.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447486995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寶典曰：黄幡者，旌旗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977113115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"常居三合墓辰，所理之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977129499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"不可開門、取土、嫁娶、納財、市買及有造作。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977129499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之者，主有","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977145883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"損亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977145883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：黄幡者，寅午戌歲在戌，申子辰歲在","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977162267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，亥夘未歲在未，巳酉丑歲在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977162267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：黄幡者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977178651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"歲君安居之位，華蓋也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977178651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"故取三合五行墓辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977195035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"墓者，土也，","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977211419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"故言其黄。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977211419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經曰：將出乎中軍，蓋張於庫上。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977227803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977244187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950584977244187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447503379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6p0di/1-SK1619_figure_00077.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=c71zTxLOE2tmQPfaLEVJzikFR2s%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6p0di/1-SK1619_figure_00077.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=y8h7HmmDR928i9wC3RKAUD6RYYo%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6p0di/1-SK1619_figure_00077.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447519763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寶典曰：豹尾者，亦旌旗之象，常居黄幡對衝，其所","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147588659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"在之方，不可嫁娶、納奴婢、進六畜及興造。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147588659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"犯之者，破財","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147605043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"物，損小口。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147605043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：豹尾者，虎賁之象，先鋒之將也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147621427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"故常與黄幡相對，是置於華蓋之前也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147637811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"678","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"黄幡者，三合之季，象華蓋也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147670579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"與黄幡相對者，為豹尾，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147686963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"喜忌亦相同。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147686963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋皆歲君之鹵簿大駕，以見不可犯之意","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147703347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147703347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申、巳、亥年，豹尾在前，黄幡在後。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147719731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"子、午、夘、酉年，豹尾","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147736115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447536147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"在後，黄幡在前。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147736115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭以豹尾為先鋒之將，而置于華","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147752499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋之前，則非也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147752499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"又按子、午、夘、酉年，黄幡即是官符，豹尾","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147768883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"即是弔客；寅、申、己、亥年，黄幡即是白虎，豹尾即是喪門；","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147768883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、丑、未年，黄幡即是太歲，豹尾即是歲破。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147768883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"然則黄幡、","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147785267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"豹尾二神固虛設也，以其無甚悖理，仍存其舊名。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147785267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447552531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447568915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6pd0m/1-SK1619_figure_00078.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ue1D4NHd9TdoLkMzIQIc8jRZrzk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6pd0m/1-SK1619_figure_00078.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hroVDnzdY%2BOlayn8Z3wPN2qTWYk%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6pd0m/1-SK1619_figure_00078.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447585299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寶典曰：病符主災病，常居歲後一辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147801651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147818035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"居歲後一辰，是言舊歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147818035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"新歲將旺，舊歲必衰，衰則病","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147834419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147834419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447601683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ppnq/1-SK1619_figure_00079.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=llXQmeZJZpmNo7G7exMasbcUv7Q%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ppnq/1-SK1619_figure_00079.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FEU5FJgd5fg301w1P4b98cRUNOI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ppnq/1-SK1619_figure_00079.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447618067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：死符者，歲之凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147850803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不可營塚墓，置死","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147867187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"喪，及有穿鑿，犯之者，主有死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147867187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"常居歲前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147883571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147899955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：死符者，是太歲自絶之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147899955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"假令太歲在子，是當","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147916339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"旺也，則丑為衰，寅為病，夘為死，辰為墓，已為絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147916339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147932723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147932723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"716","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：小耗者，歲中虛耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147949107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不宜運動、出","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147965491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"入、興販、經營，及有造作，犯之者，當有遺亡虛驚之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147965491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147981875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"明時總要曰：常居歲前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147981875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：小耗者，小損","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147998259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447634451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"也，乃太歲氣絶之辰，故曰小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585147998259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅年寅旺、夘衰、辰","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148014643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"病、巳死、午墓、未絶也，與死符同位，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148014643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：小","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148031027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"耗常居大耗後一辰，未至於大耗，故曰小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148031027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"729","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"病符，舊太歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148063795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"病符所衝，則死符也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148080179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"病之所究極，非死","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148096563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"而何？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148096563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"何以不名本年太歲所衝為死符耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148112947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲為一歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148129331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"之君，德刑並施，其所衝禍且不止於死，而福亦未可料","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148129331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148129331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"故六𡈼類神以歲破為貴相，謂得坐而論道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148145715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"若舊","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148162099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447650835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲休廢之氣所衝，則必死矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148162099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"又為小耗者，則以次於","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148178483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"大耗而言，太歲所衝為大耗，則舊太歲所衝為小耗云","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148178483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148178483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲所破，其為亡耗大矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148194867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"迨易歲之後，而元氣未復，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148211251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"有小耗之象焉，故舊歲破為小耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148211251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"又易曰：天數五，地","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148227635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"數五，數至五而極，歲前五辰，數居其極，故為死符，是亦","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148227635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"一説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148227635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭以歲前五辰為太歲絶氣，蓋亦數窮之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148244019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"意，然其説似是而非。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148244019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"夫長生沐浴以至絶胎養，皆從五","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148260403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"行旺相休囚死而言，謂之五勝。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148260403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"又從五勝細區之，而為","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148276787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447667219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"是十二位云耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148276787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行歴乎四季，加以中央土，則五勝","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148293171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"起焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148293171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"五行歴乎十二辰，而各有寖昌寖微之漸，則十二","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148309555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"位立焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148309555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"又同為一行，陽順而隂逆，陽死則隂生，隂死則","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148325939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生，于以成五行之氣之無終絶，其㫖深也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148325939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"今太歲者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148342323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"歲隂也，雖行乎五行之中，而不定其為何行，安得指其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148342323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"本位為帝旺，而以其前五為絶位哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148342323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"如以前五為絶位，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148358707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"則將以舊太歲為新太歲臨官之位乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148358707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"不可通矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148375091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"且陽","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148391475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"順則前五為絶矣，隂逆則又當以後五為絶，隂年太歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148391475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447683603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"豈又將以後五為死符耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148391475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447699987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6q2au/1-SK1619_figure_00080.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Hkxyda8JgKVlja3YsZ82rNwnUvE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6q2au/1-SK1619_figure_00080.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r1JHKbAhNJT1Zf1h787douueT6o%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6q2au/1-SK1619_figure_00080.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447749139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：災煞者，五行隂氣之位也，常居劫煞前一辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148457011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"主災病疾厄之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148457011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，不可抵向營造，犯之者，當","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148473395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"有疾患。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148473395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：災煞者，三合五行胎神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148489779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148506163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：劫煞起於絶，災煞起於尅。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148506163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"假令申子辰年合水局，水","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148522547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"絶於已，故劫煞在巳，胎於午。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148522547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"又水與午火相尅，故災煞","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148538931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"在午也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148538931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑年合金局，金絶於寅，故劫煞在寅，胎於","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148555315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"夘。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148555315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"又金與夘木相尅，故災煞在夘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148571699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148588083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447765523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6qrl2/1-SK1619_figure_00082.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VaKXXW3IKWI0BymJuBHcxMVYrSo%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6qrl2/1-SK1619_figure_00082.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ApVTvS%2Bashl7QRxo3JJmzraw4WU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6qrl2/1-SK1619_figure_00082.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447781907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：歲煞者，隂氣尤毒，謂之煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148604467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"常居四季，謂四","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148620851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"季之隂氣能遊天上。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148620851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：寅午戌煞在丑，巳酉","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148637235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"丑煞在辰；申子辰煞在未，亥夘未煞在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148637235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148653619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"歲煞之地，不可穿鑿、修營移徙，犯之者，傷子孫六畜。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148653619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148670003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭曰：月煞者，三合五行成形之位，所謂養是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148670003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148686387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"抵物之成形，母必有傷，故曰煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148686387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：劫煞、災煞、歲","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148702771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，是為三煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148702771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"如曹氏説，則三合五行絶胎養之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148719155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"絶","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148735539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養者，墓庫以後，長生以前，神樞經所謂隂氣是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148735539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"或","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148751923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447798291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"謂三煞者，三合五行當旺之衝，故有宜向不宜坐之説。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148751923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰合水局，水旺於北方，南方其衝也，故三煞在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148768307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"南方巳午未，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148768307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447814675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447831059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6r486/1-SK1619_figure_00083.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yGk7cizcqg2fRqCPIPcEmkbkheM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidt
