{"lines":[{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447847443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：伏兵大禍者，歲之五兵也，主兵革刑殺，所理之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148784691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"方，忌出兵行師及修造，犯之主有兵傷刑戮之咎。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148784691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"○黎","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148801075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"幹曰：寅午戌歲，伏兵在𡈼，大禍在癸；亥夘未歲，伏兵在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148801075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，大禍在辛；申子辰歲，伏兵在丙，大禍在丁；巳酉丑歲，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148801075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"伏兵在甲，大禍在乙是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148801075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：伏兵大禍者，以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148817459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"三合五行相尅之陽干為伏兵，隂干為大禍，伏兵災甚，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148817459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"大禍災輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148817459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：伏兵大禍，夾處於三煞之間，如申","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148833843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰年，三煞在巳午未，伏兵大禍則在丙丁是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148833843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148850227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447863827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148850227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447880211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447896595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rgva/1-SK1619_figure_00084.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vX1%2BUQZJ%2FmJHVUv42cHDiLmuzDc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rgva/1-SK1619_figure_00084.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xumtNOQc4QNldrTGVcmeJzYiG1c%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rgva/1-SK1619_figure_00084.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447912979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"按天以一而圓，地以兩而方，人以三而角。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148866611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"天地無心，人","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148882995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"者天地之心也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148882995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"是故一生二，二生三，至於三而萬物旅","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148899379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"生矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148899379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"圓而方之，三角出焉，至於角而一微畢見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148915763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"是故","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148932147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"本天下之至簡，以極天下之至賾，推天下之至隠，成天","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148932147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"下之至顯者，必於三角得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148932147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"然則三角者，天地之心，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148948531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之端，鬼神之會，五行之秀氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148948531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"是故三合者，神煞之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148964915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"所最重，三合必三角也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148964915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲者，為而不宰，其性情畢見","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148981299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"於三合，故太歲之下，神之大者，以三煞為首焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148981299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148997683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447929363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"與太歲為敵為對者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585148997683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"假如太歲在寅、午、戌三合方，自","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149014067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"寅至午，中為夘辰、巳，東南春夏之交，非類也；自午至戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149014067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"中為未申、酉，南西夏秋之交，亦非類也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149014067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"若自戌至寅，中","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149030451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"為正北亥、子丑，則三冬月令𡈼癸水之位，與寅午戌火","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149030451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"局為敵為對矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149030451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"是故以丑為歲煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149046835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"歲煞者，三合為火，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149063219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為首，丑居寅上，是據其顛頂而厭之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149063219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"猶夫月厭","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149079603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"之在太陽前一位也，必為歲所煞，故曰歲煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149079603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為劫","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149095987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，劫者，三合為火，而戌居終，亥居戌下，是睥睨其間，以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149095987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447945747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"代其位者也，有盜之象焉，故曰劫煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149095987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"三合為火，而午","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149112371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"居中，午者，火德盛滿之會也，有其衝之，必有災也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149112371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"子者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149128755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"正位之衝也，故曰災煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149128755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"夫地支固如是矣，而地支之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149145139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"位必有天干之寄居者焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149145139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑之間，𡈼癸居之，陽𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149161523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"為伏兵，隂癸為大禍，則以其方位亦與三煞同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149161523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"不用","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149177907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己者，戊己中宫之氣，既以三合論，則不用戊己，猶夫","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149177907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"三合成局，則不得有土局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149177907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149194291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫曹震圭絶","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149210675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"胎養之説，則無當於理矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585149210675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"考原所謂宜向不宜坐之説，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239863346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447962131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"最為得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239863346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋三煞之方，皆太歲之所惡而不可居，非以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239879730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"其能敵太歲而畏之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239879730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447978515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546447994899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rtie/1-SK1619_figure_00085.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AoYeos5uuSJgSu5Hh33v8FfFCVw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rtie/1-SK1619_figure_00085.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=aVIcWgo3n0AgM6Ht4m9jHQLbOz4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6rtie/1-SK1619_figure_00085.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448011283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"翼氏風角曰：金剛火强，各守其方，木落歸根，水流趨末。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239896114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"○曾門經曰：巳酉丑，金之位，刑在西方，言金恃其剛，物","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239912498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"莫與對。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239912498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火之位，刑在南方，言火恃其强，物莫與","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239928882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"對。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239928882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未，木之位，刑在北方，言木恃榮華，故隂氣刑之，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239945266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"使其彫落。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239945266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水之位，刑在東方，言水恃隂邪，故陽","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239961650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"氣刑之，使不復歸。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239961650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"所以子刑夘，丑刑戌，寅刑己，夘刑子，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239978034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"巳刑申，未刑丑，申刑寅，戌刑未，辰午酉亥為自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239978034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239994418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"儲泳袪疑説曰：三刑是極數，子夘一刑也；寅巳申，二刑","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239994418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448027667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"也，丑戌未三刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585239994418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"自夘順至子，自子逆至夘，極十數。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240010802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240027186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"寅逆至巳，自巳逆至申，極十數。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240027186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"丑順至戌，戌順至未，極","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240043570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"十數。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240043570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"皇極中天，以十為殺數，積數至十，則悉空其數。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240059954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240076338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"道惡盈，滿則覆也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240076338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"此三刑之法所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240092722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240109106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"歲刑之地，攻城戰陣，不可犯之；動土興工，亦須迴避，犯","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240109106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"之多鬭爭。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240109106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：相刑之説，翼氏最明。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240125490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋以巳酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240141874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"刑申酉戌，則巳刑申，酉自刑，丑刑戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240141874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅午戌刑巳","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240158258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"午未，則寅刑巳，午自刑，戌刑未也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240158258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"以申子辰刑寅夘辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240174642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448044051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"則申刑寅，子刑夘，辰自刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240174642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥夘未刑亥子丑，則亥","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240191026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"自刑，夘刑子，未刑丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240191026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"939","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"按翼氏風角四語，曾門經與考原申其㫖，亦明顯矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240207410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"顧","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240223794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂木恃榮華，故隂氣刑之；水恃隂邪，故陽氣刑之，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240223794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"説猶不無矯强，而辰午酉亥自刑之理，亦未有論及之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240223794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240223794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"儲泳天道惡盈，數極于十之説，亦有妙義，要亦不","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240240178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"出翼奉四語。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240240178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"今繹其㫖，而得自刑之説焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240256562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"金火剛强，水","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240272946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"木柔弱，故金刑金方，火刑火方，剛强者必自戕也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240272946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"而金","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240289330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448060435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"莫剛於酉，火莫强於午，則并不特自戕其本方，而己且","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240289330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"自戕其體焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240289330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"若水木之柔弱，則必被戕於生我者與所","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240305714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"生者。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240305714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"水生木而刑木，木生於水而刑水，生我之門，死我","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240322098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"之户。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240322098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"孟子所為死於安樂者，其斯之謂歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240338482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥夘未刑","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240354866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑，而亥轉自刑，亥，木根也，所為木落歸根也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240354866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"以申","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240371250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰刑寅夘辰，而辰轉自刑，辰，水庫也，所為水流趨末","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240371250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240371250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448076819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448093203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6s65i/1-SK1619_figure_00086.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oritBgB8BBmk0fkhPEheHSwWJbI%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6s65i/1-SK1619_figure_00086.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9BwJVS86kOr9k7EycIVViDlJ1CU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6s65i/1-SK1619_figure_00086.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448109587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：大煞者，歲中刺史也，主刑傷鬭殺之事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240387634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240404018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"地，出軍不可向之，併忌修造，犯者主有刑殺。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240404018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"○明時總","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240420402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"要曰：子年起子，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240420402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大煞者，是歲三","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240436786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"合五行建旺之辰，將星之位，名曰刺史。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240436786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：大煞，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240453170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"子年在子，丑年在酉，寅年在午，夘年在夘，辰年又在子，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240453170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"如是逆行四正。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240453170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋申子辰三合為水，水旺於子也；巳酉","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240469554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"丑三合為金，金旺於酉也；寅午戌三合為火，火旺於午","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240469554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"也；亥夘未三合為木，木旺於夘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240469554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448125971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"按子午夘酉，水火木金之正位也，天地之交，而日月之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240485938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240485938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"故太歲在四正，則太歲自當之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240502322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"名太歲，則大煞不","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240518706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"足云矣，猶天子自理其畿内也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240518706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"若太歲在孟季，則正位","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240535090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"亦成大煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240535090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞云者，亞於太歲，而重於官符白虎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240551474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240567858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例有刺史之稱，蓋古刺史得生殺一方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240567858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448142355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448158739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6sism/1-SK1619_figure_00087.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WkfGN9o2ga6oUWf1pZ8QlEe5TMM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6sism/1-SK1619_figure_00087.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=S3UDxe4Um7FW6RwF6cbRBy6Ni6Q%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6sism/1-SK1619_figure_00087.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448175123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：飛廉者，歲之廉察，使君之象，亦名大煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240584242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"所理","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240600626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可興工、動土、移徙、嫁娶，犯之，主官府口舌、疾病、","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240600626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"遺亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240600626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖厯曰：子年在申，丑年在酉，寅年在戌，夘年","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240617010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳，辰年在午，巳年在未，午年在寅，未年在夘，申年在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240617010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，酉年在亥，戌年在子，亥年在丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240617010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"按飛廉者，力士也，事紂以善走名。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240633394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"古之力士多矣，而取","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240649778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"象於飛廉者，喻惡煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240649778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"三合之序，由生而旺，由旺而墓，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240666162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"由墓而生。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240666162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"四時之序，由木而火，由火而金，由金而水，由","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240682546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448191507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"水而木。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240682546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"此一元所以迭運而不窮，五氣所以順布而成","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240698930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"歲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240698930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"飛廉子年起申，子為水旺，申為水生，是以旺而逆","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240715314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"厯於生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240715314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"由是夘年在巳，午年在寅，酉年在亥，以子夘","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240731698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"午酉四旺之序，而逆厯於申巳寅亥四生之方，則并其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240731698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"生而亦逆矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240731698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年起酉，丑為金墓，酉為金旺，是以墓而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240748082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"逆厯於旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240748082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"由是辰年在午，未年在夘，戌年在子，以丑","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240764466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"辰未戌四墓之序，而逆厯於酉午夘子四旺之方，則并","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240764466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"其旺而亦逆矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240764466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年起戌，寅為火生，戌為火墓，是以生","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240780850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448207891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"而逆厯於墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240780850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"由是巳年在未，申年在辰，亥年在丑，以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240797234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳申亥四生之序，而逆厯於戌未辰丑四墓之方，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240797234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"幷其墓而亦逆矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240797234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"夫順天者以德，逆天者以力，此豈非","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240813618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"恃力悖德之象乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240813618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"故以飛廉喻之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240830002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"又名大煞者，在歲名","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240846386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"飛廉，在月名大煞，變其名使不紊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240846386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"又按子、丑、寅、午、未、","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240862770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"申年，飛廉即是白虎；夘、辰、巳、酉、戌、亥年，飛廉即是喪門。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240862770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"然則飛廉之神，亦與黄幡、豹尾同，可有可無者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240879154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448224275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6svfq/1-SK1619_figure_00088.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=BQei1yYCmbM%2Fg3KY9geWGhKX9yM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6svfq/1-SK1619_figure_00088.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0TzgQzz4zRd6wUplNKIQJIaJ6HI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6svfq/1-SK1619_figure_00088.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448240659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範篇曰：金神者，太白之精，白獸之神，主兵戈、喪亂，水","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240895538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"旱、瘟疫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240895538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，忌築城池，建宫室，豎樓閣，廣園林，興","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240911922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"工上梁，出軍征伐，移徙嫁娶，逺行赴任。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240911922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯干神者，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240928306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"忌尤甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240928306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿經曰：甲己之年在午、未、申、酉，乙庚之年","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240944690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"在辰、巳，丙辛之年在子、丑、寅、夘、午、未，丁𡈼之年在寅、夘、","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240944690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥，戊癸之年在申酉子丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240944690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：金神者，以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240961074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"年幹五虎元厯之逢庚辛及納音金之位者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240961074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240977458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳之年起丙寅，順行得庚午辛未，又𡈼申癸酉，納音","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240977458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448257043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"為劍鋒金，故甲巳年午未申酉為金神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240977458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585240993842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"按選擇宗鏡以五虎遁得庚辛之方為天金神，旬内納","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241010226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"音屬金者為地金神，以天金神為重，即洪範篇所謂若","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241010226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"犯干神，其忌尤甚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241010226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：天金神一名遊天暗曜，犯之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241026610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"患眼最凖。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241026610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"其説為近似。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241042994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"若洪範篇所云，未必若是之甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241059378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"兵戈喪亂，水旱瘟疫，豈係一家之犯金神煞所致耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241075762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448273427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448289811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6t82u/1-SK1619_figure_00089.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=T6zz7T8qxAFlsw7kgBaXNXK3NKs%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6t82u/1-SK1619_figure_00089.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=V%2FK1NPND7FqNwH2SarvOq1%2Fyo%2Bg%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6t82u/1-SK1619_figure_00089.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448306195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：子年在辰，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241092146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：辰與子，水","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241108530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"之精；丑與夘，木之精；未與酉，金之精；午與戌，火之精；寅","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241108530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"申巳亥，土之精。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241108530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"謂土能生育萬物，四孟為五行長生之","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241124914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241124914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"故子年在辰逆行，自然相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241141298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：曹氏五","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241157682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"行之説未確，以理求之，殆以歲序起子而順行，二十八","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241157682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"宿起辰而逆行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241157682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"順者為陽為人，逆者為隂為鬼，各以其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241174066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"數之起處，轉而相應也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241174066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"按五緯皆起於辰而逆行，五鬼亦起於辰而逆行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241190450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"然則","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241206834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448322579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"五鬼者，五緯之魄氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241206834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"五緯不皆十二歲一周，而五鬼","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241223218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"則十二歲一周，以歲星為五緯之長，故從歲星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241223218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼也","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241239602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"者，氣返而歸者也，象其幽隂，故名之曰鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241239602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼必五者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241255986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼五星，其中一星曰質，曶曶不明，為積尸，氣明則所臨","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241255986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"之下有積尸，故取鬼宿第五星以象之，而名之曰五鬼，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241255986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"非真自一至五而鬼有五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241255986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"子午年與官符同位，丑未","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241272370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"年與喪門同位，寅申年與太歲同位，夘酉年與大隂同","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241272370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"位，辰戌年與白虎同位，己亥年與歲破同位。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241272370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"各隨其所","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241288754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448338963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"同位之神，以類相應。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241288754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448355347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6tkpy/1-SK1619_figure_00090.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=KTqyZft6cdU2QUGDmBrx4aEaTY4%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6tkpy/1-SK1619_figure_00090.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=CxtLq%2BgeDMMnA6ymDdgQegZy3qQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6tkpy/1-SK1619_figure_00090.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448371731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寶典曰：五鬼者，五行之精氣也，主虛耗之事，所理","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241305138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不可興舉，犯之主財物耗散。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241305138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：甲𡈼年在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241321522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"巽，乙癸年在艮，丙年在坤，丁年在震，戊年在離，己年在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241321522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"坎，庚年在兑，辛年在乾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241321522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：按納甲法，乾納甲","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241337906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼，其衝在巽，故甲𡈼之年在巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241337906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"坤納乙癸，其衝在艮，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241354290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙癸之年在艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241354290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"艮納丙，其衝在坤，故丙年在坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241370674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"兑納丁，其衝在震，故丁年在震也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241387058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"坎納戊，其衝在離，故","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241403442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"戊年在離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241403442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"離納己，其衝在坎，故己年在坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241419826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"震納庚，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241436210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448388115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"其衝在兑，故庚年在兑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241436210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"巽納辛，其衝在乾，故辛年在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241452594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241452594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"按破敗五鬼云者，以其方衝破歲幹所納之卦位，故以","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241468978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"破敗為名，而亦係之以五鬼者，言其幽隂之象云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241468978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241485362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"從歲破之例例之，而及於卦位者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585241485362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"然後天卦位則然，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478938674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"而先天卦位則又不爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478938674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"且後天卦位所為出震齊巽云","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478955058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"云者，是從東以至東北為一歲天行之序也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478955058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"古聖並未","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478971442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"嘗以方位衝射言之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478971442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫先天八卦，天地定位，山澤通","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478987826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448404499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，雷風相薄，水火不相射，轉以對待為義，不嫌衝射也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585478987826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"然則强取易卦以就建除之例，謂巽能破敗乾宫之氣，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479004210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"艮能破敗坤宫之氣者，於理不可通也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479004210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"今以舊厯所用，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479020594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"姑存之，實則無所關係。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479020594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448420883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6txd2/1-SK1619_figure_00091.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Jwmm6bNi7YIat%2FNYpY47it2%2BZaM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6txd2/1-SK1619_figure_00091.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OwH%2BdYrOnqCAPcRcfJ5E4UhFMpU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6txd2/1-SK1619_figure_00091.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448437267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰，太歲出遊日者，甲子日東遊，己巳日還位；丙子","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479036978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"日南遊，辛巳日還位；戊子日遊中宫；癸巳日還位；庚子","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479036978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"日西遊，乙巳日還位；𡈼子日北遊，丁巳日還位。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479036978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"共出遊","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479053362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479053362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：太歲諸神者，隂氣之化，地祗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479069746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋子至巳，乃陽氣健旺之辰，隂氣受制於陽神，不敢用","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479086130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"事，故假言其出遊耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479086130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰，出遊日，各以五子日幹","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479102514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"為所徃之方。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479102514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為東方、木，故甲子日東遊；丙為南方、火，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479118898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"故丙子日南遊；庚為西方、金，故庚子日西遊；𡈼為北方、","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479118898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448453651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"水，故𡈼子日北遊；戊為中央、土，故戊子日遊中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479118898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"五者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479135282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"生數之極，故各出遊五日，共五五二十五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479135282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"按太歲者，地祗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479151666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"地祗從支，故以五子為斷。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479168050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，木也，東","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479184434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故甲子至己巳在東。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479184434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，火也，南也，故丙子至辛巳在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479200818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"南。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479200818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"餘三子倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479217202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日東遊，則西南北可併工修造也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479233586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"東則雖本屬空方，猶當有所忌，若本不空，則無論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479249970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479266354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"曰太歲己下神煞者，諸神煞皆從太歲而有，太歲既不","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479266354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"居本位，則諸神煞皆無矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479266354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"若謂出遊之日，四方皆空，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479282738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448470035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"但當舉此二十五日為悉無禁忌可也，何必分東西南","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479282738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"北乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479282738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"其以五日為斷者，天數五，地數五，五者數之終也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479299122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448486419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ua06/1-SK1619_figure_00092.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GcCIXB%2BQjvhnJ1M4bbPwMC0IY5w%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ua06/1-SK1619_figure_00092.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sd69aMMpkqN4cvgesYBJplw23lE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6ua06/1-SK1619_figure_00092.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448502803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：癸巳至丁酉日在房内北，戊戌、己亥日在房内","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479315506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"中。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479315506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子、辛丑、𡈼寅日在房内南，癸夘日在房内西。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479331890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479348274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"至丁未日在房内東，戊申日又在中。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479348274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉日出遊四十","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479364658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"四日，遊神所在之方，不宜安産室，掃舍宇，設牀帳，其義","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479364658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"未明。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479364658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"今按：日遊神載於時憲書，明代承元授時厯即有之，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479381042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"前則莫可考矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479381042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：其義未明，自來未有為之説者。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479397426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"然俗所遵信，南方民俗又有所謂鶴神方者，出行忌扺","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479413810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448519187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"向之甲子乙丑日，在東南方之己丙寅，轉丙午丁方，五","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479413810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"日而轉未坤申方，六日而轉庚酉辛方，五日而轉戌乾","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479413810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"亥方，六日而轉𡈼子癸方，盡五日則為𡈼辰矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479413810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳日","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479430194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"起，至戊申日止，此十六日謂之鶴神上天。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479430194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"至己酉日又","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479446578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"出，至丑艮寅方，六日而轉甲夘乙方，五日而轉辰巽巳","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479446578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"方，凡四日為癸亥矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479446578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"辰二日，巽二日，而甲子乙丑又從","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479462962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"巳起，凡居四維則六日而去，居四正則五日而去。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479462962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"載於","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479479346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"婁元禮所作田家五行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479479346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"其説云：鶴神己酉日下地東北","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479495730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448535571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"方，乙夘轉正東，庚申轉東南，丙寅轉正南，辛未轉西南，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479495730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"丁丑轉正西，𡈼午轉西北，戊子轉正北，癸巳上天，在天","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479495730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"上之北。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479495730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"戊戌日轉天上之南，甲辰轉天上之東，己酉復","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479512114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"下地，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479512114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"括云：纔逢癸巳上天堂，已酉還居東北","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479528498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"方。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479528498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"上天下地之日，晴主久晴，雨主久雨，轉方稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479544882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"若大","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479561266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"旱年，雖轉方天，並不作變。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479561266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"諺云：荒年無六親，旱年無鶴","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479577650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"神。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479577650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"今紬繹之，暗與日遊神相應。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479594034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋日遊神以癸巳日在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479610418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"室，共十六日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479610418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"至己酉日而出遊四方，共四十四日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479626802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"鶴神","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479643186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448551955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"以癸巳日上天，亦共十六日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479643186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"至己酉而下地，巡歴四方，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479659570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"亦共四十四日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479659570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"此以為在室，則彼以為在天，其在四方，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479675954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"則同此四十四日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479675954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"夷考其意，確有至理，蓋即天罡煞","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479692338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之遊行耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479692338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陽必有隂，猶手之有掌背也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479708722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"陽以生而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479725106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"隂以殺，道並行而不相悖。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479725106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽所到處，即隂所到處，其","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479741490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"所托始，必於陽氣極盛之時，故甲子乙丑日起巳方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479741490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"其居四正則少一日，居四維則多一日者，正為陽而維","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479757874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂，陽竒而隂偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479757874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑者，日光之所不照也，積隂","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479774258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448568339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"之區，乃其家也，故居之特為最久。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479774258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"西北維、正北方、東北","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479790642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"維既十七日矣，又有上天十六日，合為三十三日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479790642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"統而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479807026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"計之，其在他方則為二十七日，二十七者，三三也；其在","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479807026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"本方則為三十三日，三十三者，亦三三也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479807026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"癸方遇癸，尤","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479823410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"為重隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479823410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"巳者，隂生隂盡之㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479839794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"故既起於巳方，而上天","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479856178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"又必以癸巳日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479856178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"癸巳至戊申十六日，乃遇己酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479872562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"己者，革","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479888946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"位也；酉者，金之正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479888946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"以己酉日出於丑方，合上天而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479905330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"計之，則又己酉丑金全局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479905330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"於是又歴東北以至東南，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479921714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448584723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"而𡈼戌癸亥，干支數盡焉，恰又交於己矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479921714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陽盡午中，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479938098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"隂盡子中，已則當莧陸夬夬之爻，為金煞之所由起，易","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479938098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"之大義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479938098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"室中者，與四方為對者也，故為中宫之象，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479954482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"以上天之十六日當之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479954482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"夫上天云者，言其不偏於一方","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479970866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"耳，夫豈真有上天者哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479970866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"故室中之象似之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585479987250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"而細區其方，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480003634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"仍始自北，由北而南，而西而東，即日遊神所在之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480003634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"安産室安牀，則不宜抵向日遊神，出行則不宜犯鶴神，","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480020018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"總以其為隂煞之氣，故忌之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480020018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"轉方則天有風雨，隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480036402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448601107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣交也，其義曉然可見。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480036402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"唯鶴神之名，則從俗之稱，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480052786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"莫可解。","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480052786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"意者鶴為噩字之訛，酉曰作噩，噩神猶金神歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950585480069170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353546448617491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6umna/1-SK1619_figure_00093.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Nl7zdsfsJ1CkhV {"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557256723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"厯書曰：厯家以建、除、滿、平、定、執、破、危、成、收、開、閉，凡十二","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174732815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"日，周而復始，觀所值以定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174732815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"每月交節，則疊兩值日。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174749199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"其法從月建上起建，與斗杓所指相應，如正月建寅，則","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174765583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"寅日起建，順行十二辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174765583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"○淮南子曰：正月建寅，則","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174781967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為建，夘為除，辰為滿，已為平，主生；午為定，未為執，主","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174781967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"陷；申為破，主衡；酉為危，主杓；戌為成，主小德；亥為收，主","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174781967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"大德；子為開，主太陽；丑為閉，主太隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174781967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：建","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174798351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"為歲君，為元神，為吉凶衆神之主帥，可坐不可向。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174798351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"其在","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174814735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","li
