eId":"79","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，又為飛廉，又為四利白虎小凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174945807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"收為四利福德小吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174962191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"又為八座小凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174962191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"開為青龍太隂，為生氣華蓋，上吉，又為","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174978575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"四利、弔客，小凶；閉為病符，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174978575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"平、成、開、危最吉，定、除次吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174994959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557289491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"破大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537174994959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：按月建十二神，除、危、定、執、成、開為吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175011343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"建、破、平、收、滿、閉為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175011343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"歴書所謂建、滿、平、收黑，除、危、定、執","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175027727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"黄，成、開皆可用，閉破不相當者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175027727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡以四利三","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175044111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"元諸神相配，吉凶亦未盡合。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175044111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"如以建為太歲，除為太陽，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175060495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"滿為喪門，破為歲破，危為龍德，此相合者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175060495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"至以平為","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175076879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂，定為官符，執為死符，成為白虎，收為福徳，開為弔","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175076879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"客，此不相合者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175076879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵凡日吉神多則吉，凶神多則凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175093263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"又各視其神之宜忌以為趨避，亦未可以執一而論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175093263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557305875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"按建者一月之主，故從建起義，而叅伍於十二辰，古之","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175109647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂建除家言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175109647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"建次為除，除舊布新，月之相氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175126031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"一","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175142415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"生二，二生三，三者數之極，故曰滿，滿則必溢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175142415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：坎","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175158799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"不盈，祇既平。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175158799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"概滿則平，繼滿故必以平也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175175183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"平則定，建前","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175191567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"四位則三合，合亦定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175191567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"定則可執矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175207951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"故繼之以執。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175224335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"執者，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175240719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"守其成也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175240719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"物無成而不毁，故繼之以破，對七為衝，衝則","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175257103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"破也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175257103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"救破以危，在易已日乃革之。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175273487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"已，十干之第六。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175289871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"破，十","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175306255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"二辰之第七，其義同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175306255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"是故救破以危，既破而心知危。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175322639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557322259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"孟子曰：危故逹。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175339023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"夫心能危者，事乃成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175355407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"不必待其成而","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175371791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"後知為逹也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175371791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子云：前三後五，百事可舉。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175388175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"平，前三也，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175404559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"危，後五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175404559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"繼危者成，何以成？","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175420943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"建三合備也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175437327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"既成必收，自","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175453711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"建至此而十。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175453711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"十極數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175470095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"數無終極之理，開之。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175486479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"開之云者，","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175502863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"十即一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175502863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"一生二，二生三，由此一而三之，則復為建矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175519247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"建固生於開者也，故開為生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175535631","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"氣始萌芽不閉，則所","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175552015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"謂發天地之房，而物不能以生，故受之以閉終焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175552015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"唯其","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175568399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"能閉，故復能建，與易同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175568399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：自建至閉十二神，其辰","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175584783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557338643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"皆由建改而遞更。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175584783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"古今論説紛紜，吉凶不一。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175601167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"夫止以建","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175617551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"除論吉凶，未甚彰顯著明也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175617551","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"此建則彼除，十二辰自然","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175633935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"輪轉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175633935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"迨夫叅以萬事，錯以二氣五行，然後吉凶生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175650319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"特其吉凶之大小劑量，則生於建除。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175666703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"雲駛月運，舟行岸","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175683087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"移，明者黙契其微，神而明之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175683087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"今具列各條之下，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175699471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"陽之變化無窮，夫亦舉一隅云耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175699471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：建除之説，見於","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175715855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"古者，自淮南子外，又有太公六韜云：開牙門當背建向","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175715855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"破。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175715855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"越絶云：黄帝之元，執辰破已，伯王之氣，見於地户。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175732239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"王","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175748623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557355027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"莽傳云：以戊辰直定，御王冠，即真天子位。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175748623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"師古曰：於建","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175765007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"除之次，其日當定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175765007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"知所由來久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175781391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋其説與諸家同","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175797775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"起戰國時，而並託之黄帝云。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175797775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557371411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6vbxi/1-SK1619_figure_00095.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pxRLIIb738LLk%2BnniwDVNU3W6ow%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6vbxi/1-SK1619_figure_00095.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?l {"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557387795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"古有建除家、叢辰家，時師已莫識其統系，總名選擇，而","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175814159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"咸統於天官。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175814159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"今按建除之義，以年統時，以時統月，以月","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175830543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"統日，雖原本於五行，而以建為重。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175830543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫叢辰云者，猶言","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175846927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"衆辰吉凶，各以義起者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175846927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"如兵福小時之即建，吉期兵","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175863311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"寶之即除之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175863311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"或建除家之異名見義，或叢辰家之殊","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175879695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"途同歸，己莫可考。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175879695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"但散而無紀，殽而無序，此云吉而彼","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175896079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"云凶，方稱宜而旋稱忌，莫之適從。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175896079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"今為類聚之，而悉統","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175912463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"於建除，取其必須異名而後義見者，或此吉彼凶，不妨","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175912463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557404179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"一辰兩義者，著於篇。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175912463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557420563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557436947"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6vokm/1-SK1619_figure_00096.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1uaYKJ%2FA3YFobhkERRhP5N%2Bjez0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6vokm/1-SK1619_figure_00096.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4vPfg8YfhbDx1bRoO4%2Bp5tEsebM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6vokm/1-SK1619_figure_00096.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557453331"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：兵福者，與月建同行。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175928847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"○太白經曰：五帝所在，不","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175945231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"可出軍，向之必敗。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175945231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"春東方，夏南方，秋，西方，冬，北方。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175961615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175977999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"春不東行，是謂伐生，百事不成；夏不南行，是謂伐强，兵","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175977999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"卒多殃；秋不西行，是謂伐熟，兵將不復；冬不北行，是謂","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175977999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"伐藏，士卒多傷。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175977999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"故月建所在，為王相之方，我用而我利","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175994383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537175994383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子曰：小時者，月建也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176010767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"○神樞經曰：小時者，郎將之","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176027151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"象也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176027151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌結姻親，開倉庫。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176043535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"○總要厯曰：四時之氣，隨","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176059919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557469715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"斗杓所指而建立，雖非四時之大時，亦一月之小時也。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176059919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：建破、平、收，俗之所忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678965537176076303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"惟破日最凶，建日","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845498420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"吉多可用，平日甚吉，收日吉多無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845498420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：小時","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845514804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"者，是當時之旺辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845514804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"忌結姻親者，因陽氣獨持旺氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845531188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"忌開倉庫者，是旺氣發而不收也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845547572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"○邵泰衢曰：建為土","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845563956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"府者，猶言中府也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845563956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"月建當月令，而為主於中府也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845580340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"按厯書建日不利行師，而於兵福，則又曰利行師。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845596724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"兵福","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845613108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"即建也，而矛盾如是。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845613108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋月建所在，我用則我利，用之則","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845629492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557486099"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"為兵福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845629492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"若敵在建方，則不利行師以伐之，以彼據王","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845645876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"氣故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845645876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"然禮記孟春月令云：兵戎不起，不可從我始。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845662260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845678644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"則建雖兵福，要須視此建為何月之建。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845678644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"如孟春建寅，則","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845695028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不利行師也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845695028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"月建大義詳後厭建篇，此專以明建之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845711412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"同位異名者。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845711412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"又按，建日忌結姻親者，男為日，女為月。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845727796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845744180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"建者，月也，女壯之象，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845744180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫忌開倉庫，猶夫甲不","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845760564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"開倉之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845760564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"建為十二辰之首，亦有朔旦之象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845776948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"惡其月","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845793332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"建初轉之月，即有所費，民俗所忌耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845793332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"至今元旦俗忌用","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845809716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557502483"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"財，謂一歲不能積蓄，皆此類也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845809716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557518867"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557535251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6w17q/1-SK1619_figure_00097.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=rltw%2FuEliwS6cGJIoUwxsf4wUsE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6w17q/1-SK1619_figure_00097.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ze23evkWuPFlZrhoVo8gAu9O%2BdE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6w17q/1-SK1619_figure_00097.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557551635"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：吉期者，吉慶之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845826100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜出軍行師，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845842484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"攻城寨，興弔伐，㑹親姻。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845842484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845858868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：吉期者，是月建腹心同契之侍臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845875252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋常","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845891636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"居建前一辰，可與要約吉事，故因名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845891636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"258","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"按，兵寶之義與兵福同，説已見前。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845924404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"假如寅為兵福，則夘","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845940788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"為兵寶，皆四時當王之氣云耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845940788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557568019"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wduu/1-SK1619_figure_00098.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=i8z1wUc0PhZDejYufIf1ksjtcxA%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wduu/1-SK1619_figure_00098.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=gUSK0UD4VJ7YbpbHxfEPKlH%2B9h0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wduu/1-SK1619_figure_00098.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557584403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：福德者，月中福德之神也，其日宜祀神祗求","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845957172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"福，願修宫室，獻封章。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845957172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：福德常居月建前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845973556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：建前二辰者，是月所生之子，以其當相氣","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845989940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"在前為引與我能為福為德之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852845989940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"故易卦以子孫爻","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846006324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"為福徳，其義一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846006324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵子能制乎鬼，使不害已，故為福","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846022708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"德。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846022708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月寅以火生辰土為子，其土能制水鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846039092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846055476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"月夘木生巳火為子，火能制金鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846055476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"三月辰之衰木能","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846071860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"生午火為子去制金鬼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846071860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846088244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：十二地支","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846104628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557600787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"各有所藏，若以前二辰為月建所生者，亦無不合，則生","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846104628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"氣之在月建前二辰，亦當取此義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846104628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"283","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天巫者，月中善神也，所值之日，宜合藥請醫，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846121012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"祀鬼神，求福願。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846121012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846137396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846153780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天巫者，月中善神，能克除鬼煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846153780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"義與福德同。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846170164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：天狗者，月中凶神也，其日忌禱祀鬼神，祈求","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846186548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"福願。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846186548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天狗者，常居月建前二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846202932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846219316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗者，月中禦衞之犬也，祛除私邪之神，無使敢侵，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846219316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557617171"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"居建前二辰，是禦於門首也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846219316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"自子建之月起於寅，寅者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846235700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"艮之陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846235700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：艮為夫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846252084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"祈福願，祠鬼神，皆為正","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846268468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"道，故並忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846268468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"按滿為福德，總要厯謂其日宜祭神祇，祈福願，又謂之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846284852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"天巫，亦謂宜祀鬼神，求福願。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846284852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天巫云者，巫能通幽明，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846301236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"以見日吉辰良，其誠意可逹於鬼神，故比之天巫云耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846301236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"豈真是日有神號天巫者下行世間哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846317620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"顧同一滿日也，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846334004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"忽又謂之天狗；同一樞要歴也，又云忌禱祀鬼神，祈求","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846334004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557633555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"福願，誠不可解矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846334004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"詳考其義，蓋天狗者，戌日值滿也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846350388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846366772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"官家謂太白餘氣散為天狗，滿既是戌，建必在申，滿之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846366772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"為滿也，以三為數之極也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846366772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"天之刑神，當令之時，而又居","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846383156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"盛滿之極，則其與他滿日不可同例論明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846383156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"故又謂之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846399540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗，而謂不宜禱祀，非謂凡為滿日皆天狗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846399540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"夫滿日","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846415924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"所以為福德而宜祭祀者，以月建為本日之生氣，有鬼","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846415924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"神降福之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846415924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"若滿在戌日，則從申至酉，悉屬金行，其","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846432308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"為神也，乃蓐收司刑之神，而非降福之神矣，故忌之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846432308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557649939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"乃曹震圭以天狗為祛除私邪之神。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846448692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天狗本妖星，如","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846465076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"彗孛之類，從未有被以嘉稱者，其説不類。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846465076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂建前二","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846481460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為禦於門首之象，犬之守宅，亦不必其在門也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846481460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"又以","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846497844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為艮，艮為犬，而謂建子則滿寅有犬之象焉，未識建","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846497844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"丑滿夘，則又何説也？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846497844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂祈福願祀鬼神，皆為正道，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846514228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"並忌之，然則為邪道，則不須忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846514228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"無論隂陽之道，本不","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846530612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"為小人謀，且前既以天狗為祛除私邪之神矣，此又謂","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846530612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"忌用正道，倐命之為正，倐命之為邪，何其無特見也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846530612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846546996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557666323"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天狗為申建之戌，止一位，故不入圖。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846546996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557682707"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557699091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wqhy/1-SK1619_figure_00099.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JlgLDyUwY1wTXwmObg27kLkNEno%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wqhy/1-SK1619_figure_00099.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kgZ50vrWqsO51WTVFD%2BoYQrYSQU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6wqhy/1-SK1619_figure_00099.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557715475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"桑道茂曰：天罡河魁者，月内凶神也，所值之日，百事宜","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846563380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"避。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846563380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰，陽建之月，前三辰為天罡，後三辰為河魁；","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846579764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建之月，反是。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846579764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：魁罡者，乃月建四煞之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846596148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"平收之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846596148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"○洞源經曰，對七為衝，隔三為破。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846612532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846628916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂辰破丑，而丑衝未；亥破寅，而寅衝申；午破夘，而夘","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846628916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"衝酉；酉破子，而子衝午；申破巳，而巳衝亥；戌破未，而未","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846628916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"衝丑是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846628916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰，死神者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846645300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌請醫服藥，出師","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846661684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557731859"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"征討，種植樹木，進人納畜。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846661684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：常居月建前三","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846678068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846678068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：死神者，以月建為旺辰，前逢死位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846694452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846710836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"抵死氣之前，必有死神，其義同前。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846710836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天罡者，辰也；河魁者，戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846727220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"平收二日，輪轉十二支，何","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846743604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"與辰戌事，而亦命為天罡、河魁耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846743604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經曰：對七為衝，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846759988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"隔三為破。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846759988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"説者曰：辰破丑而丑衝未，亥破寅而寅衝申。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846776372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"謂辰至丑上，則破其所居之丑，而丑又衝我對宫之未","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846792756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846792756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"然辰何以破丑耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846809140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"其義未詳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846825524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，辰戌之所以為","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846841908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557748243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡者，以其為二氣之樞紐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846841908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"陽從辰而左，至於戌，而","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846858292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"成剥蔑之象；隂從戌而右，至於辰，而成夬決之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846858292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846874676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"消息之大會也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846874676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"是故歲從辰始，而至巳辰，陽善之通也；","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846891060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"厭從戌始，而至亥戌，隂慝之作也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846891060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"二者必不能比而和，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846907444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"且辰戌互相衝擊，故畏忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846907444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"今建除家以平收為魁罡","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846923828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"者，乃比擬於魁罡，以見宜畏忌之意，非真以此為魁罡","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846923828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846923828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"由是言之，則洞源經所謂隔三為破者，破即是罡。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846940212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"罡，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846956596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍也，本從此魁罡借義以及於破，而後人釋之，遂謂","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846956596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557764627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"辰破丑、亥破寅，失其㫖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846956596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"亥與寅合，安得有破義也？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846972980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"凡","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846989364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"數三而極，建前三而建後三，則前後之數皆極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852846989364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"而此","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847005748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"二位必自相衝擊。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847005748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"假如建在子，前三為平為夘，後三為","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847022132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"收為酉，夘酉衝也；建在丑，前三為平為辰，後三為收為","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847022132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，辰戌衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847022132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"推之十二辰，莫不皆然，有龍戰之象焉，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847038516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以魁罡名之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847038516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"其隂月、陽月兩相易位者，以此見其","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847054900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"非真魁罡也，若魁罡則有定位矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847054900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以一歲而論，陽生","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847071284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"於冬至，三於寅，五於辰；隂生於夏至，三於申，五於戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847071284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847087668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557781011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"者，春秋之首，隂陽各半也；五者，歲厭之首，隂陽之紐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847087668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰魁罡，取義於斗之第一、第七星，以其為運斗之樞","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847104052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847104052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"國語曰：王者必合三五。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852847120436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"以一建而論，陽生於開，半於","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958744611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"建，終於平，故平為死神，而開為生氣，為時陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958744611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"半於建","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958760995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"者，陽長至三而乃可建，與寅為歲首同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958760995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"隂生於定，半","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958777379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"於破，終於收，故定為時隂，為死氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958777379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"一建之内，亦有十二","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958793763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"月之象，故亦曰魁罡，取諸歲神之魁罡以見意也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958793763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"平之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958810147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"為死神也，平在定前，定為死氣，則其神已降於平矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958810147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"氣","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958826531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557797395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"在萌芽之前，而神又在氣之前也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958826531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"由此推之，開為生氣，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958842915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"收必為生神，而厯不言者，或係闕文，或以其微而不足","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958842915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"於吉，故不言，均未可定。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958842915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"然神煞起例，以收為月命座，則","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958859299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"亦生神之意云。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958859299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557813779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557830163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6x352/1-SK1619_figure_00100.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=TxHWwptBu1K3FFss4%2BsmKJx5O38%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6x352/1-SK1619_figure_00100.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hLH%2BZPTtG7l5KsP5Nr9U0QoNtdw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6x352/1-SK1619_figure_00100.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557846547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：時隂者，月中隂神也，所值之日，宜運謀算畫","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958875683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"計䇿，睦子孫，㑹親友。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958875683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958892067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958908451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：時隂者，月内隂氣之神，母婦之象，故隂神主事，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958908451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"機密不測，故其日宜運謀算畫計䇿，㑹親友，睦子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958908451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"起","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958924835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"例常以月建加功曹，子上所得之辰為時陽，午上所得","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958924835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰為時隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958924835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"謂子者一陽初生也，故時陽取焉；午者，一","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958941219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"隂初生也，故時隂取焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958941219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"寅者，艮方，成終成始之位，三陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958957603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"交泰之所，故以加之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958957603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙家常以計神加和德，其義一","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958973987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557862931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958973987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：官符者，其日忌拜官視事，上表章，陳詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852958990371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959006755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：官符者，正月起午，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959006755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：官","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959023139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"符者，是歲月中掌符信之官，文職也，常居三合前辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959023139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959039523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"抵歲辰月建，以其三合前辰為文官，後辰為武職，是左","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959039523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"文右武之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959039523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月建寅，則午上有官符，文官也；戌","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959055907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"上有白虎，武職也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959055907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"併見第二卷。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959072291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：死氣者，無氣之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959088675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌戰鬭征伐，療病","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959105059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557879315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"求醫，安置産室、經營栽植。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959105059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：死氣者，常居月","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959121443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"建前四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959121443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：死氣者，以月建為臨官前，臨死","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959137827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959137827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"假令二月建夘為臨官帝，旺在辰，衰在巳，病在午，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959154211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"死在未也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959154211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"或云生氣之衝辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959170595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"謂此愛其生，彼愛其死，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959186979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"我旺而彼死也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959186979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"故常與生氣相對。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959203363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"按，時隂死氣之義，具見前條。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959219747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"而曹震圭月建加功曹之","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959236131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"説，亦甚有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959236131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"至官符之義，已見歲官符條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959252515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"四利三元，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959268899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"成為白虎，定為官符，皆同歲神取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959268899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"官符為文，白虎為","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959285283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557895699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"武，今厯家不用白虎，而惟用官符，於義例不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959285283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋四利","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959301667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"三元，原從太歲起例，官符、白虎皆歲神方位，以其弔照","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959301667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲，故避之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959301667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"若其在日，則定成為月建三合，何凶之有？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959318051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"厯家特誤以年方配日辰耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959334435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"其以臨日為凶者，誤亦由","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959350819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959350819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"今既不用白虎，應亦不用官符也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959367203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557912083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557928467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xfs6/1-SK1619_figure_00101.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=iV2YEdc%2BQ87KByEgdqLSlN%2F84JQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xfs6/1-SK1619_figure_00101.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=A43aYLNpRDSlrj%2BdzcaFpZ7vlDY%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xfs6/1-SK1619_figure_00101.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557944851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：枝德者，地支帶德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959383587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜修造築垣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959399971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959416355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：枝德者，正月在未，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959416355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：亦月内之耗神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959432739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌經營、種蒔、納財、交","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959449123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"易、開市。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959449123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：小耗者，常居月建前五辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959465507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959481891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：小耗者，小損也，乃月建氣絶之辰，大耗之從神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959481891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"按，枝德乃歲神吉方，詳歲枝德條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959498275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽年歲幹即歲","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959514659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"德，隂年歲幹即歲德，合自太歲順數至前五辰，其幹必","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959514659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"與歲幹合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959514659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年則為歲德，合隂年則為歲德，方為枝，而","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959531043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557961235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"幹為德，故曰地枝帶徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959531043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"若其在月，則一丙寅月也，而","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959547427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"未日有五，其辛未日為月幹合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959547427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丁己癸四未日，初","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959563811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"與丙寅無涉也，何以概謂之枝德耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959563811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"即以辛未日而論，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959580195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"辛為月幹，五合六辛皆然，與枝無取，非若歲枝前五辰","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959580195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"之獨與歲幹合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959580195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"且月幹非月德，即與之合，亦第幹合","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959596579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"云爾，非若歲幹合之必為德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959596579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"是則枝德之名，曰枝曰","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959612963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"德，皆無取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959612963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"可見古人原由歲枝起例，後世誤用之於","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959629347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"月，而於歲反遺之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959629347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"今添入歲神月枝德，應刪去。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959645731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"月小","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959662115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557977619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"耗，義詳歲小耗條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959662115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"舊歲破為歲小耗，則舊月破為月","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959678499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"小耗，又為本月閉日之衝，應閉而衝之，是小耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959678499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560557994003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xsfa/1-SK1619_figure_00102.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uFqVxRuZd8BA154LnPAVupEzrWU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xsfa/1-SK1619_figure_00102.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=zQHg5XOTKVbEOT8A0Bnv2cgJW7o%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6xsfa/1-SK1619_figure_00102.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558043155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"按選擇宗鏡曰：危為極富星，為谷將星，為四利之龍德，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959776803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959776803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"顧其所以為極富，為谷將，則無其義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959793187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例，又名","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959809571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"之為地輅，皆今厯家所不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959809571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"龍德别詳四利三元條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959825955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558059539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yhpi/1-SK1619_figure_00104.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GY1JkkPtTui4TvPbcARzGJVB4ek%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yhpi/1-SK1619_figure_00104.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=prbFxgVhBvQyE1dMfsG9YMsu8R4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yhpi/1-SK1619_figure_00104.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}
