{"lines":[{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558075923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：天醫者，天之巫醫，其日宜請藥避病，尋巫禱","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959842339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"祀。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959842339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：天醫者，正月起戌，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959858723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959875107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天醫者，三合後辰，能使萬物死而復生，損而復益。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959875107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959891491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建寅，三合為寅午戌，而戌為寅之後辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959891491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959907875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959907875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：天喜者，正月戌，二月亥，三月子，四月丑，順","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959924259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"輪十二月，乃日支與月建三合，故曰天喜。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959924259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"○通書曰：春","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959940643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，夏丑，秋辰，冬未。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959940643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"今人不原其理，嘗於卦書中得其要","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959957027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558092307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"領，大抵取日辰與月建相合為天喜也，與成日同位。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959957027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"按月建後二辰，生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959973411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"又後二辰，即生氣之生氣也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959989795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"曰天醫。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852959989795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"又成日也，萬物莫不喜其有成，故曰天喜。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960006179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"厯書","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960022563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"以春戌、夏丑、秋辰、冬未為天喜日，而曹震圭謂母喜見","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960022563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"子，然亦有成就之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960022563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"如春之令屬木，木生火，火墓在戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960038947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"至於戌，則火之道成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960038947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"故春以戌為天喜。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960055331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"夏之令屬火","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960071715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"土，火土生金，金墓在丑，至於丑，則金之道成矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960071715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"故夏以","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960088099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為天喜。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960088099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"秋辰、冬未，可以類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960104483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"今通書與宗鏡皆以成","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960120867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558108691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"日為天喜，惟寅、申、巳、亥四孟月，與戌、丑、辰、未相合，或古","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960120867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩説，或一為後起，俱未可知。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960120867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"然成日之理為長，且通","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960137251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"書總論既取成日，而立成又用戌、丑、辰、未日，不宜自相","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960137251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"矛盾，故改從畫一，而並存其説，以備叅考。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960137251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558125075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yucm/1-SK1619_figure_00105.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=t7Gesc0zVJZ8WflUpE6bfvdCdy4%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yucm/1-SK1619_figure_00105.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4hbF3O55KQp93Q77WrtAd8iZ4xU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6yucm/1-SK1619_figure_00105.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558141459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"按陽月魁、隂月罡之義，己見平日條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960153635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558157843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6z6zq/1-SK1619_figure_00106.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=icQcuaelhRprCW%2B6pV1pmMMVxVs%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6z6zq/1-SK1619_figure_00106.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=8gpCwl6FYWuSoU2FJDQ2hzNjcQk%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6z6zq/1-SK1619_figure_00106.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558174227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"總要厯曰：時陽者，月中陽神也，所值之日，宜叙婚姻，行","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960170019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960170019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：常居月建後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960186403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：時陽者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960202787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"月内掌陽氣之神，父夫之象，故陽之主事，威儀正直，有","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960202787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"禮義儀容，故其日宜叙婚姻，行宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960202787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：生氣者，極福之神也，其日宜修築城壘，開道","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960219171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"溝渠，起土修營，養育羣畜種蒔，如出軍戰陣，則宜背之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960219171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：生氣者，常居月建後二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960235555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：生氣","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960251939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"者，萬物所生之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960251939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"生育萬物者土也，土之所居者，四","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960268323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558190611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"季也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960268323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"四季者，乃四時五行所衰之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960284707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"自衰然後可生","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960301091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"彼，故以四時前季辰為生物之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960301091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"假令冬水生春木，水","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960317475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"衰於丑，生木於前，木之長生在亥也；木衰於辰，生火於","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960317475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"前，火之長生在寅也；火衰於未，生金於前，金生於巳也；","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960317475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"金衰於戌，生水於前，水生於申也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960317475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"皆各居其後二辰，此","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960333859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960333859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：月建乃當王之氣，不可以衰言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960350243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"且","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960366627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣亦不耑在四維之位，亦不可耑以五行之長生言","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960366627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967852960366627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵月建者，當正王之位，而前二辰己有生氣，是未","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176848384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558206995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而將旺者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176848384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月為三陽之月，而子則一陽己生，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176864768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"是為生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176864768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"可與王日、官日叅看益明。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176881152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"按孫奭孟子疏曰：木旺，亥、子丑寅夘；火旺，寅夘辰巳午；","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176897536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"金旺，巳午未申酉；水旺，申酉戌亥子。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176897536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"土與水同，其言旺","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176913920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"也，始於長生之位，而終於正旺之鄉，此即生氣居建後","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176913920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"二辰之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176913920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"隂符經曰：天地之道浸，故隂陽勝，隂陽相","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176930304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"推而變化順矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176930304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"建為月中天子，其後二辰為極福之神，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176946688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽以漸浸而勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176946688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"必以二位者，從生氣至建而成三，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176963072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558223379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋一生二，二生三，而天地之道備也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176963072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"歲後二辰為太隂，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176979456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"建後二辰為生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176979456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂為后妃之象，天下之母也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853176995840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177012224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"之義，亦母道也，於建除為開日，無一之不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177012224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177028608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"强以衰論者，豈疑其與太隂同位歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177028608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"不知太隂固吉神","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177044992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"也，特不宜侵犯耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177044992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558239763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353560558256147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6zjmu/1-SK1619_figure_00107.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=K2w7nNVaqYAS1eeGAiLroNpsdPw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6zjmu/1-SK1619_figure_00107.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XF282Eom20LbuQEI73NybVpuQoQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur6zjmu/1-SK1619_figure_00107.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505624127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要經曰：血支，其日忌針刺出血。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177061376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：血支者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177077760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"氣血之支流也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177077760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"故起於旺建之後，生氣之前，如人生之","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177094144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"後，自有血脉暢於四肢，若其日針刺者，是去其血也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177094144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177094144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"按：月令仲冬以後，忌作土事，謂地氣阻洩，是謂發天地","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177110528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"之房，閉之為血忌，而不宜針刺者，亦此意。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177110528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"人身與天地","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177126912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"之氣相應，不宜於應閉之日而發洩之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177126912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"建之為建也，生","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177143296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"於開而養於閉，以成其建。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177143296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"閉在十二辰，猶小冬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177159680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"閉日","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177176064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505640511"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"針刺，猶冬日發房也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177176064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505869887"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月神之以十二辰起例者，雖莫考其為建除家言、叢","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177192448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"辰家言，今一以建除統之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177192448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅為建，則凡神煞之在正","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177208832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"月為寅者，皆與建同也；夘為建，則凡神煞之在二月為","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177208832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"夘者，皆與建同也；如寅為除，則凡神煞之在十二月為","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177208832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"寅者，皆與除同也；夘為除，則凡神煞之在正月為夘者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177208832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"皆與除同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177208832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177225216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"既使一日之内，吉凶神煞如指","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177241600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"諸掌，又可叅詳其吉凶之大小深淺，有制無制，可化不","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177241600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"可化，以為從違也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177241600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505886271"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505902655"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur743za/1-SK1619_figure_00120.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QhWPokyLgwRYYPA5ttNxmikpg%2F8%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur743za/1-SK1619_figure_00120.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=C3bWA%2F2tUVa8w8QOaOolYjJRN0w%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur743za/1-SK1619_figure_00120.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505919039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：月建者，陽建之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177257984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，戰鬭攻伐，宜","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177274368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"背之，不可抵向。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177274368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜封建視事，不宜興造土功，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177290752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"結親禮。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177290752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月建寅，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177307136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177323520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"月建所理之地，戰鬭攻伐，不宜向而宜背者，蓋使我乘","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177323520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣而攻彼休囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177323520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜封建視事者，建者健","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177339904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"也，是月内羣神之長，萬神無不咸服也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177339904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"不可興造土功","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177356288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"者，蓋彼當旺勢，不可犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177356288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"其不可結親禮者，是陽建獨","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177372672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，隂建氣消之辰，親禮之道，宜隂陽相和，若偏則不宜","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177372672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505935423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177372672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"按淮南子云：斗柄為小歲，正月建寅，月從左行十二辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177389056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"小歲東南則生，西北則殺，不可近也，而可背也；不可左","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177389056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"也，而可右也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177389056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"賈公彦疏周禮占夢曰：建謂斗柄所建，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177405440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"之陽建，故左旋於天。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177405440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"史記天官書曰：斗為帝車，運於中","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177421824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"央，臨制四鄉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177421824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"然則月建者，諸神之主帥也，俗謂之月中，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177438208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"天子從建而之焉，則有除滿以下十一神並建而十二，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177438208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"觀所值以定吉凶，古所為建除家者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177438208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"建之所在，日躔","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177454592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505951807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"其所合之辰，則太陽月將也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177454592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽前一位則為月厭，月","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177470976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"厭謂之隂建，右旋於天，厭建相值相離，則周禮所稱觀","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177470976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之㑹者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177470976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"其説各詳本條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177487360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505968191"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74gme/1-SK1619_figure_00121.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Z7HrguLTgX3hGIOqvDDfD9w0kCE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74gme/1-SK1619_figure_00121.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l4NxGQYZc5KVKfx7YQUsxZN9YRw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74gme/1-SK1619_figure_00121.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601505984575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：天老曰：正月陽建於寅，隂建在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177503744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"○春秋繁","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177520128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"露曰：天道大數，相反之物也，不得俱出，隂陽是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177520128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"春出","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177536512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"陽而入隂，秋出隂而入陽，夏右陽而左隂，冬右隂而左","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177536512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177536512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"隂出則陽入，陽入則隂出，隂右則陽左，隂左則陽右。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177552896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"是故春俱南，秋俱北，而不同道；夏交於前，冬交於後，而","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177569280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"不同理。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177569280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"並行而不相亂，澆滑而各持分，此之謂天之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177585664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"而何以從事？","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177602048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"天之道，初薄大冬，隂陽各從一方來，而移","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177618432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"於後，隂由東方來西，陽由西方來東，至於中冬之月，相","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177618432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506000959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"遇北方，合而為一，謂之曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177618432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"别而相去，隂適右，陽適左。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177634816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"適左者其道順，適右者其道逆。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177651200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"逆氣左上，順氣右下，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177667584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"下煖而上寒。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177667584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"以此見天之冬右隂而左陽也，上所右而","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177683968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"下所左也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177683968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"冬月盡而隂陽俱南還，陽南還出於寅，隂南","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177700352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"還入於戌，此隂陽所始出地入地之見處也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177700352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"至於中春","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177716736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，陽在正東，隂在正西，謂之春分。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177716736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"春分者，隂陽相半","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177733120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故晝夜均而寒暑平。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177733120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"隂日損而隨陽，陽日益而鴻，故","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177749504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"為燒熱。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177749504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"初得大夏之月，相遇南方，合而為一，謂之曰至。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177765888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506017343"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"别而相去，陽適右，隂適左。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177782272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"適右由下，適左由上。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177798656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"上暑而","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177815040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"下寒，以此見天之夏右陽而左隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177815040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"上其所右，下其所","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177831424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"左。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177831424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"夏月盡而隂陽俱北還，陽北還而入於申，隂北還而","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177847808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"入於辰，此隂陽之所始出地入地之見處也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177847808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"至於中秋","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177864192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，陽在正西，隂在正東，謂之秋分。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177864192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分，隂陽相半也，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177880576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"故晝夜均而寒暑平。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177880576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"陽日損而隨隂，隂日益而鴻，故至","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177896960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"於季秋而始霜，至於孟冬而始大寒。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177896960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"下雪而物咸成，大","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177913344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"寒而物畢藏，天地之功終矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177913344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"○淮南子曰：北斗之神有","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177929728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506033727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"雌雄，十一月始建於子，月徙一辰，雄左行，雌右行，五月","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177929728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"合午謀刑，十一月合子謀德。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177929728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建所居辰為厭日，厭日","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177946112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以舉百事。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177946112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿徐行，雄以意知雌，故為竒辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177962496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"數從","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177978880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子始，子母相求，所合之處為會十日十二辰周六十","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177978880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"日，凡八會。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177978880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"會於歲前則死亡，會於歲後則無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853177995264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"○天寶","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178011648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"厯曰：月厭者，隂建之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178011648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，可以禳災祈福避","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178028032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"病，所值之日，忌逺行、歸家、移徙、婚嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178028032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：月厭者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178044416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"正月在戌，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178044416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月厭者，厭魅之神","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178060800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506050111"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178060800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"其性暗昧，私邪不正，故各忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178077184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋十一月建子，隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178093568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"氣爭，冬至前隂氣極，冬至後陽氣生。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178093568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"故自建子之月，陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178109952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"建順厯丑寅夘一十二辰，隂建逆歴亥戌酉一十二辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178109952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"至五月夏至，二氣又同建而相爭也，亦名曰隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178109952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"按月建者，斗柄所建也，象見於天，仰而望之，而莫不見","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178126336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178126336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭者，二氣消息之原，運於太无，而出萬有者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178142720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"推建可以知厭，故淮南云：堪輿徐行，雄以意知雌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178159104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"曰","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178175488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿者，蓋此堪輿家言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178175488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰厭者，以其每處日躔之","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178191872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506066495"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"前，故謂之厭。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178191872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"厭，古壓字也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178208256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"月建左行，月厭右行，六十甲","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178224640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"子，相交相錯，而吉凶生焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178224640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"周禮所為觀天地之㑹者，鄭","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178241024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"康成以厭建當之，可以知古之日者，必宗乎此也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178241024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"若其","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178257408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"所以然，則董仲舒春秋繁露言之詳且明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178257408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子云：","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178273792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹於歲前則死亡，㑹於歲後則無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178273792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"然則八會之日，非","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178290176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"吉日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178290176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"建陽而厭隂，建吉而厭凶，其同位之日，隂陽叅","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178306560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"雜，斷可識矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178306560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"夫和㑹者，隂從乎陽之謂。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178322944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽為陽，月建","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178339328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂，如寅月之亥，夘月之戌，則當以隂陽和㑹論。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178339328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"若從","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178355712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506082879"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"月建而復生隂建，則所為隂中之隂，其所會之干支，安","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178355712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"得以吉論乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178355712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"又叅以太歲而消息之，如歲在甲寅，正月","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178372096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌大㑹，則歲前也，尤凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178372096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"若八月辛夘大㑹，則在歲後","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178388480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"矣，可無殃也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178388480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"漢時已有堪輿八會，見於經史，今厯家大","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178404864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹八，即其傳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178404864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"又有小㑹八，又有行狠、了戾、孤隂、單陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178421248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"等名，考原詳之，今並載於後。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178421248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"要之皆為不吉之日，而曹","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178437632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭以大小㑹為隂陽和會，則顯與淮南子不符，不可","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178437632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"從也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178437632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫天子用大小㑹日，謂之歲位，皇后、太子、諸侯","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178454016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506099263"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"用歲前，卿大夫用歲對，士庶人用歲後，其所為歲前、歲","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178454016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"後，亦與淮南子不同，而以歲前為可用，益悖於古，均無","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178454016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"取焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853178454016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：地火者，月中凶神也，其日忌修築園圃，栽植","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587890191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"種蒔。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587890191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：地火者，正月起戌，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587906575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"875","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"按厭建，堪輿家言也；地火，叢辰家言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587922959","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"然地火即是月","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587939343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"厭，故載於此。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587939343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506115647"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506132031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74t9i/1-SK1619_figure_00122.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=j8qyayFeTJipp4KIbeouLOQDAgc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74t9i/1-SK1619_figure_00122.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sIlwf2guDb6MGCMQZuvkQcCWfio%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur74t9i/1-SK1619_figure_00122.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506148415"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"天寶厯曰：厭對者，月厭所衝之辰也，其日忌嫁娶，又為","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587955727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"招搖，忌乘船渡水。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587955727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：厭對者，正月起辰，逆行十","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587972111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587972111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：六儀者，月中吉神也，所值之日，宜牧養生財，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587988495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"栽植樹木，結親納禮，視事臨官。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853587988495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：正月起辰，逆","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588004879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588004879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：六儀者，月中正禮儀之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588021263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"月","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588037647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"厭主暗昧，六儀與之敵衝，以威厲之，使不敢妄失儀容","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588037647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588037647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506164799"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"按厭對正月起辰，逆行十二辰，六儀亦正月起辰，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588054031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰，然則厭對之即為六儀也明甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588054031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"乃選擇之書於","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588070415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"厭對則曰忌嫁娶，於六儀則曰宜結親納禮，適相反也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588070415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋堪輿家言其大指，總以建為陽，厭為隂，必干支與厭","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588086799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"全不相涉者，始為吉日，故厭對雖衝破月厭，亦不以為","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588086799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588086799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"而叢辰家則以其能衝破月厭，而名之曰六儀，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588103183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭主曖昧隂私，則月厭之反必威儀正直之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588103183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588119567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"以兩相矛盾，而並見于厯書，莫之適從也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588119567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"今定為厭對","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588135951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506181183"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"忌嫁娶，六儀宜視事臨官，庶於義各當云。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588135951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"招搖見後。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853588152335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506197567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur755wm/1-SK1619_figure_00123.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7yK7aZ%2BU5ZoN%2B3FYnu%2FqHxRXRg0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur755wm/1-SK1619_figure_00123.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=C%2Bq0CIqRnX18MTtu4GXEJaHyGKY%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur755wm/1-SK1619_figure_00123.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：小㑹：二月己酉、三月戊辰、四月己巳、五月戊","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589020687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506345023"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"午、八月己夘、九月戊戌、十月己亥、十一月戊子，皆以中","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589020687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"宫戊巳配厭建為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589020687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"如二月陽建於夘，隂建於酉，隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589037071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"相衝，以乙配酉，以辛配夘，大㑹皆已有之，故以已配隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589037071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"建之酉，為隂陽小㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589037071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"三月陽建於辰，隂建於申，以庚","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589053455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"配辰，大㑹有之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589053455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"以乙配申，隂陽非耦，故以戊配辰，為三","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589069839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"月小會也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589069839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"四月純陽用事，隂勢盡消，故無大㑹，而以己","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589086223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為四月小㑹也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589086223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10 enceId":"7678967853589413903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"能配隂建之申；四月巳中之丙，不能配隂建之未是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589413903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"小會為隂㑹陽，故其日皆用陽建，惟二月、八月隂陽二","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589430287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"建對衝，故相易也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589430287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"其月無小會者，以其日大會巳有之，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589446671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"或他月小會巳有之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589446671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其所領日，逆至他月大小會日，","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589463055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506410559"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"則止可見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589463055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：三月陽建於辰，隂建於申，陽前不及於丙，隔","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589495823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"於巳也；後過於甲，隔於夘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589495823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"故以甲配申則不從，以丙","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589512207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"配申則不及，以戊庚𡈼配申則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967853589512207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"故甲申為行狠，丙","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242201652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"申為了戾，戊申、庚申、𡈼申為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242201652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"四月陽建於巳，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242218036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"建於未，陽前不及於丁，隔於午也；後過於乙，隔於辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242218036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"故以乙配未則不從，以丁配未則不及，以己辛癸配未","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242234420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506426943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242234420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙未為行狠，丁未為了戾，己未、辛未、癸未為","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242250804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242250804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"九月陽建於戌，隂建於寅，陽前不及𡈼，隔於亥","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242267188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"也；後過於庚，隔於酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242267188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"故以庚配寅則不從，以𡈼配寅","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242283572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"則不及，以甲丙戊配寅則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242283572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"故庚寅為行狠，𡈼寅為","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242299956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"了戾，甲寅、丙寅、戊寅為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242299956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"十月陽建於亥，隂建於","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242316340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，陽前不及癸，隔於子也；後過於辛，隔於戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242316340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"故以辛","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242332724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"配丑則不從，以癸配丑則不及，以乙丁己配丑則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242332724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"故辛丑為行狠，癸丑為了戾，乙丑、己丑、丁丑為孤辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242349108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506443327"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"○天寶厯曰：過為行狠，不及為了戾，不合為孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242365492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242381876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：月建者，陽也；月厭者，隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242381876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主干，隂主支。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242398260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"若得","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242414644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"陽建前後近干以配隂建者，大會也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242414644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"若以陽建後隔位","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242431028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"之干配隂建者，為行狠不從，乃陽氣不從也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242431028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"陽建前隔","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242447412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"位之干配隂建者，為了戾不及，是陽氣不及也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242447412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"以隂建","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242463796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"左右之干自配者，為孤辰，非正應隂自配也，故曰不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854242463796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"按大小會所領日考原依歴事明原所載堪輿經列之。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243643444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭既以大小會為上吉之日，比和之辰，則其所領，","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243659828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"必亦以為吉日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243659828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"今按，淮南之言，大小會既為凶日，則","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243676212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"所領日當亦非吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243676212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"然周禮漢鄭康成注有八會之目，而","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243692596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"唐賈公彦謂堪輿大會有八，小會亦有八。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243692596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"然則大小會","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243708980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506689087"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"之來舊矣，顧未言大小會所領日。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243708980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"今考其㫖，日辰參差","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243725364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"不齊，多寡不等，無義可尋，恐後人之附會歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243725364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"又以歲位、","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243741748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"歲對、歲前、歲後，屬之春夏秋冬，以季為歲，名實紊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243741748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243758132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"與淮南之言大相逕庭。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243758132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"復分屬天子、皇后、卿士、庶民，或","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243774516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"用歲位、歲對，或用歲前、歲後，其謬更甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243774516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"今將所分用日","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243790900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"四條刪去，仍其春秋冬夏、歲位歲對、歲前歲後之目。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243790900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"刪","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243807284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"者，以其不可為法也；存者，不没其迹，使後人可考也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243807284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243823668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"行狠了戾以下二十神，俱從厭建起義，合不將日觀之，","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243823668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506705471"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿家擇日之道備矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854243823668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經單隂、純隂、孤陽、純陽，以","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758100992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"時無大會，故以戊己配月建為之，而謂皆不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758100992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"然則堪","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758117376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"輿家本意以大會為凶日，益可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758117376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"特其書無傳，吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758133760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"之義不著。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758133760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"歴家不覩淮南等書，故曹震圭輩妄意以為","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758150144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"吉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758150144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：賈公彦疏周禮引堪輿經黄帝問天老云：四","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758166528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"月陽建於己，巳破於亥；隂建於未，未破於癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758166528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"是為陽破","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758182912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，隂破陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758182912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"故四月有癸亥，為隂陽交會。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758199296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"十月丁巳為隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758215680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"陽交會。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758215680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"言未破癸者，即是未與丑對而近癸也云云。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758232064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758248448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506721855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"即立成中隂陽交破之二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758248448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"今曰交破，古曰交會，然","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758264832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"則會之為義與破同，洵非吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758264832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"至大㑹等名義，考原所","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758281216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"載甚詳，而猶有未盡。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758281216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"今按隂陽二建，合于子午，分于夘","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758297600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758297600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"大會為陽會，隂由合而至分，故自十一月至二月，自","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758313984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"五月至八月，共八日，而三四九十月無大會。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758313984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"小會為隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758330368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"會，陽由分而至合，故自二月至五月，自八月至十一月，","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758330368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"共八日，而六七十二正月無小會。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758330368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"非以其月干支不能","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758346752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"相配而無大會，其日己有大會而無小會也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758346752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"陽會于隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758363136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506738239"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"者，干建支厭，甲即寅，乙即夘，非取近干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758363136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"隂會于陽者，","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758379520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"干厭支建，厭為隂，隂為地，故以戊己配月建為小會，非","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758379520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"近干已有大會而後取戊己也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758379520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"又小會皆建日衝皆破","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758395904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"日，明原以二月己酉、八月己夘為小會，二月己夘、八月","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758395904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉為隂道衝陽，當是互誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758395904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"三九月隂陽始侵，四十","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758412288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"月隂陽相逼，故行狠了戾，孤辰無虛日。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758412288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"單隂純陽，孤陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758428672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"純隂，乃從小會别取一義為名，非以其月無大會也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758428672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":887,"lineType":1,"content":"歲","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758445056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"薄隂陽將合而氣已先爭，逐陣隂陽始分而難猶未解，","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758445056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506754623"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"故以二建配子午日。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758445056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"丙𡈼即陽建，非取近干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758461440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"戊即隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758477824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"建，非以無大會而取戊己也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758477824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":891,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌為戊己之分，故以隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758494208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"建配辰戌日為隂位，非但以辰戌為陽建也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758494208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":892,"lineType":1,"content":"如第取陽","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758510592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"建而已，則逐月皆有之，何獨三、九月耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758510592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":893,"lineType":1,"content":"正七月厭破將","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758526976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":894,"lineType":1,"content":"併，而氣已先交，故正月辛酉、七月乙夘，皆取厭破間干","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758526976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"支自相配者為三隂日，與歲薄同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758526976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":895,"lineType":1,"content":"明原作正月辛夘、","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758543360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"七月乙酉，當亦是互誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758543360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":896,"lineType":1,"content":"陽建疊陽建為陽錯，隂建疊","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758559744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"隂建為隂錯。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758559744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":897,"lineType":1,"content":"五月、十一月隂陽同建，又疊同建之干為","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758576128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353601506771007"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽俱錯，亦非取近干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758576128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"又自隂位以下，皆取月宿。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758592512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":899,"lineType":1,"content":"孫","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758608896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"思邈房中經載月宿日，是否即此，亦不可考。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758608896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":900,"lineType":1,"content":"然其日之","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758625280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"不吉，義例甚明，不待值月宿而後定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758625280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":901,"lineType":1,"content":"今三隂己為改","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758641664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"正，小會改載立成卷中，此則仍舊，以備參考。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758641664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫絶隂","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758658048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"絶陽，乃從單隂孤陽更進一義。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758658048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋三月之單隂，至四月","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758674432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"而絶，九月之孤陽，至十月而絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758674432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"其所領日，亦後人附","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758690816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"會，故刪。","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758690816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷四","logicSentenceId":"7678967854758707200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
