{"lines":[{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035738665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：天道者，天之元陽，順理之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569151010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"其地宜興","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569167394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"舉衆務，向之上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569167394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖歴曰：天道正月九月在南方，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569183778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"二月在西南方，三月七月在北方，四月十二月在西方，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569183778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"五月在西北方，六月十月在東方，八月在東北方，十一","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569183778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"月在東南方也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569183778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：按天道者，天徳所在之方也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569200162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：天徳者，天之福徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569216546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，所值之日，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569232930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"可以興土功，營宮室。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569232930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"○堪輿經曰：天徳者，正月丁，二月","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569249314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"坤，三月𡈼，四月辛，五月乾，六月甲，七月癸，八月艮，九月","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569249314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035755049"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，十月乙，十一月巽，十二月庚。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569249314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四孟之月，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569265698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"以隂干為天徳者，是天道惠其未生也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569265698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"正月丙火生，而","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569282082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"丁火未生。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569282082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"四月庚金生，而辛金未生。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569298466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"七月𡈼水生，而癸","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569314850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"水未生。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569314850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"十月甲木生，而乙木未生。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569331234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"故以隂干為徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569347618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569364002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"季之月，以陽干為天徳者，是天道恵其自墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569364002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"三月𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569380386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"水墓，六月甲木墓，九月丙火墓，十二月庚金墓。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569380386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"故以陽","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569396770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"干為徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569396770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲之月，以四維之卦為徳者，是天道變化","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569413154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"成功也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569413154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"二月萬物將生，致役乎坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569429538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"五月隂氣將生，乾","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569445922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035771433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"道變化也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569445922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"八月萬物將收，成言乎艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569462306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月隂氣散，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569478690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣入，巽，入也，風以散之也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569478690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：天徳者，三合之","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569495074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569495074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"如正、五、九月，建寅、午戌，合火局，故以火為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569511458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"正月","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569527842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"丁，九月丙，五月乾，戌火墓在乾宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569527842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"二、六、十月建卯、未、","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569544226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，合木局，故以木為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569544226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"六月甲，十月乙，二月坤，未木墓","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569560610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"在坤宮也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569560610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"三、七、十一月建辰、申、子，合水局，故以水為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569576994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"三月𡈼，七月癸，十一月巽，辰水墓在巽宮也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569593378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"四、八、十二","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569609762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"月建巳、酉、丑，合金局，故以金為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569609762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"四月辛，十二月庚，八","logicSentenceId":"7675110213569626146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035787817"},"logicSenten 353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570363426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂報徳之維、常羊之維、背陽之維、蹏通之維者，即","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570379810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、巽、坤、乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570379810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、巽、坤、乾之維，斗柄各指十五日，不若震、","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570396194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"兌、坎、離之居卯、酉、子、午，統於十五日之中，不别立分位","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570396194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570396194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"故天徳方祗有艮、巽、坤、乾，而無震、兌、坎、離者以此。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570412578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570428962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"又按蠡海集曰：術家取天徳之法，至子、午、卯、酉月居於","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570428962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"四卦之上，每卦有二支，人懷疑。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570428962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵天徳不加於戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570445346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"者，天氣不親於土，其子、午、卯、酉之月，只用巳、亥、寅、申，不","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570445346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"用四墓矣。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570445346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"又一說，既不用四墓，則五行之中土氣遂絶，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570461730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035869737"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"土其可絶乎？","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570461730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋正用四墓爾。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570478114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"春二月木墓未，夏五月火","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570494498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"墓戌，秋八月金墓丑，冬十一月水墓辰。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570494498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"乃四行休墓，于","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570510882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"四季為徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570510882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"是以古今術家兼取用焉。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570527266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"况亥月用乙，未","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570543650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"月用甲，則卯月必用未，不用申，無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570543650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"寅月丁，戌月丙，","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570560034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"則午月在戌不在亥，無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570560034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋生月用隂，墓月用陽，旺","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570576418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"月用墓，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7675110213570576418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"由今觀之，蓋以天徳取用，以天干者八，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319082548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"以卦位者四，干卦不純，故論說紛紛如此爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319082548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"夫戊巳者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319098932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"中宮之位，本無方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319098932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"是故以其母家命之，則曰巳未。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319115316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319131700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035886121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"其祿旺命之，則曰巳午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319131700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"以其終萬物、始萬物之義命之，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319148084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"則曰罡魁。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319148084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"以其生萬物、成萬物之義命之，則曰坤艮。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319164468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"要","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319180852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"之，舉其一義，而未舉其全。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319180852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"如欲舉其全，莫若參同契以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319197236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳為坎離，虚中不用為得也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319197236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"夫不用者，乃無適而不","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319213620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319213620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"凡十二月之天徳，皆戊巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319230004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，四正方必尤著焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319246388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"是故寓之於四維，凡物之四維，必通於心，心立而後角","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319262772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"乃見，用角即所以用心。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319262772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"凡乾坤艮巽云者，即戊巳耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319279156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319295540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"夫長生墓庫云者，十二支乃有之，十干無也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319295540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"今天徳既","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319311924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035902505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"用十干，則不應雜以十二支之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319311924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"考原同王逵墓庫之","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319328308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"說，聊存以傳一解可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319328308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"○又按：天道即是天徳，專言其","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319344692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"方，則曰天道，兼日干與方向言之，則曰天徳，其實一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319344692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"又龍首經天道起例，陽月用丑，隂月用未，加月建，視天","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319361076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"上甲庚所臨為天道，與此不同，别詳辨譌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319361076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035918889"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur76x46/1-SK1619_figure_00128.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qbzIlu3RqH9WU9nSG%2Bxz6yuhKh0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur76x46/1-SK1619_figure_00128.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2Faq%2Fzx%2BOic160azcE2b%2FxPBLpRc%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur76x46/1-SK1619_figure_00128.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035935273"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：月徳者，月之徳神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319377460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"取土修營，宜向其方，宴","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319393844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"樂上官，利用其日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319393844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：月徳者，正五九月在丙，二","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319410228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"六十月在甲，三七十一月在𡈼，四八十二月在庚。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319410228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319426612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：月徳者，月中之陽徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319426612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"故幹為尊，枝為卑，是臣","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319442996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"求君徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319442996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合五行陽干為徳，假令寅午戌三合為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319459380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"火，以丙為徳，是各求自旺之幹為應助也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319459380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319475764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"按：月，隂也，隂無徳，以陽之徳為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319492148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"其一乎陽者，皆徳也；","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319508532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"其二乎陽者，皆慝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319508532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"是故正五九火則以丙為徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319524916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，天","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319541300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035951657"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"上之火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319541300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"天上之火，地火之所稟也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319557684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"故寅午戌火月，以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319574068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"丙為月徳，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319574068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"推甲丙庚𡈼皆陽也，陽者，徳也，是以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319590452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"不用乙丁辛癸也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319590452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"然則天徳何以有乙丁辛癸也？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319606836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：從","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319623220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"天而言之，天秉陽，故徳宜陽而陽，徳宜隂而隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319623220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"從月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319639604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"而言之，月秉隂，故專以陽為徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319639604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"然則何以無戊也？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319655988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319672372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"三合只四行也，土寄其中，無適而非土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319672372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"居中者用中，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319688756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"生殺並施，徳刑互濟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319688756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"今專以徳言之，則當旺之一行為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319705140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，自不得及乎土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319705140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，地也，無徳之徳，是謂大徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319721524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319737908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035968041"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"徳者，必不徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319737908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566035984425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur779ra/1-SK1619_figure_00129.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GABxHmsNUFTGPOY29Zho79ExVUE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur779ra/1-SK1619_figure_00129.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lnl%2FeRGb8%2F3fSGw2BVRPaiPqq%2F8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur779ra/1-SK1619_figure_00129.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566036000809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：天徳合者，合徳之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319754292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，宜營構宫","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319770676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"室，修築城垣；所値之日，宜覃恩肆赦，命將出師，禱禮山","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319770676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"川，祈請福願。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319770676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天徳合者，正月𡈼，三月丁，四月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319787060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"丙，六月巳，七月戊，九月辛，十月庚，十二月乙是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319787060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319803444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，天徳居四維，故無合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319803444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：天徳合者，即各","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319819828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"以其月天徳所合之干為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319819828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"按陽干為徳者，隂干為合；隂干為徳者，陽干為合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319836212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"四維","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319852596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"固無合矣，然舉坤乾艮巽之維以為徳，則其近維即為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319852596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353566036017193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319852596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"乾與艮合，寅亥合也，寅戌合也；坤與巽合，申巳合也，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319868980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"申辰合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319868980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"不言者，以四維無十干，則不得有其日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319885364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"然以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319901748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"方向論，則乾為天徳方，艮即為天徳合方；巽為天徳方，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319901748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"坤即為天徳合方，可以三隅反者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319901748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦可備一義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319918132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683059243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683075627"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77mee/1-SK1619_figure_00130.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nr21zek3jFwRBfAOSQ81yBHO2%2B0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77mee/1-SK1619_figure_00130.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0tVc1OiUDxkStLuxA8jlIxRWx8g%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77mee/1-SK1619_figure_00130.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683092011"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：月徳合者，五行之精，符會為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319934516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319950900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"衆惡皆消，所値之日，百福並集，利以出師命將，上冊受","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319950900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"封，祠祀星辰，營建宫室。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319950900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：月徳合者，正、五、九月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319967284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"在辛，二、六、十月在巳，三、七、十一月在丁，四、八、十二月在","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319967284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319967284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：月徳合者，即各以月徳所合之干為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240319983668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"按甲丙𡈼庚為月徳，則巳辛丁乙為月徳合矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320000052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳與","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320016436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳合無戊癸，戊在巳為金母，癸在丑為金墓，酉為金","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320016436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"之正位，庚辛所不臨，合之即巳酉丑全局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320016436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"夫金者刑","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320032820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683108395"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"也，徳之反也，巳酉丑謂之三煞，又謂之破碎，又謂之紅","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320032820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"沙，徳合之外，戊癸之方恰存金局，隂陽之自然而然者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320032820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"其妙如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320032820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683124779"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683141163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77z1i/1-SK1619_figure_00131.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=KhTTQ0bp3HV7pbvvDIzphji8YpU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77z1i/1-SK1619_figure_00131.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5564MMg11665Bhg60D8nuTukKtM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur77z1i/1-SK1619_figure_00131.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683157547"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"厯例曰：寅午戌月𡈼亥卯未月庚，申子辰月丙，巳酉丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320049204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"月甲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320049204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"○天寳厯曰：月中之陽辰也，所理之日，宜設籌謀，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320065588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"陳計䇿。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320065588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯神原始曰：月徳自南而東，丙甲𡈼庚，月空","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320081972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"自北而西，𡈼庚丙甲，乃天徳之衝神也，而曰宜設籌謀、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320081972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"陳計䇿者，貴人之對，名曰天空，宜上書陳言，故天空即","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320081972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320081972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"此對月徳之神，亦名之以空，而曰月空，故利於","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320098356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"343","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"按：月徳丙，則月空𡈼，則是凡為月空，皆與月徳為仇為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320131124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683173931"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"敵者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320131124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"何以名曰月空歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320147508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"孟子曰：仁者無敵。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320163892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月徳之","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320180276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"所在，莫敢與為對，而亦莫或與為敵，則是方之神，固有","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320180276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"而不有者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320180276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"故如十二神天空之例，而以為奏書之神","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320196660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320196660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683190315"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683206699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur78bom/1-S {"lines":[{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683223083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：天恩者，施徳寛下之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320213044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"天有四禁，常開一","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320229428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"門。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320229428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為陽徳，配巳成養育之功，故甲配子，巳配卯酉，各","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320245812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"五日而為恩也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320245812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物非土不生，故以巳土配甲成功，其","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320262196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"日可以施恩賞，布政事，恤孤惸，興宴樂。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320262196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：常以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320278580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子至戊辰，巳卯至癸未，巳酉至癸丑，凡一十五日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320278580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320294964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭曰：天有四禁，子午卯酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320294964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"子為元武門，午為明","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320311348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"堂門，卯為日門，酉為月門。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320311348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋聖人居明堂而治天下，故","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320327732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"常開此門。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320327732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"易所謂聖人南面聽天下，嚮明而治者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320344116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320360500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683239467"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"為乾之納甲，巳為離之納甲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320360500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"先天乾居正南，後天離居","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320376884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"正南，故以甲配子，巳配卯酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320376884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"然則不配午者，以甲、巳皆","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320393268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"南方卦之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320393268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"各進五辰而不及六者，謂五為君位，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320409652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"中央之数不可過也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320409652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"故各配五日，合之成一十有五，為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320426036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"天恩大吉日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320426036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"按：十母皆天也，十二子皆地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320442420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"然就十母而分之，則甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320458804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"乙丙丁戊又屬天，巳庚辛𡈼癸又屬地。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320458804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之心，無往","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320475188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"而非恩也，然必有所見端焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320475188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"其端維何？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320491572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天必以始，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320507956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683255851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"地必以中。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320507956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"元善，乾之所以統也；黄中，坤之所以大也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320524340","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320540724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"必以始，故自甲子以至戊辰，六十甲子之首五日為天","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320540724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"恩。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320540724","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"地必以中，故自巳卯至癸未，巳酉至癸丑，分六十而","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320557108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"半之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320557108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"此十日者，各居其中，亦為天恩。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320573492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"甲至戊，天也；巳至","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320589876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"癸，地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320589876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"天五而地十者，陽一而隂兩也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320606260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"不曰地恩，而皆","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320622644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"名天恩者，地統于天也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320622644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683272235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur78obq/1-SK1619_figure_00133.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Ye9G21ISc9BFQR8HqSdAQRcT3PQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur78obq/1-SK1619_figure_00133.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JT58d3aitVQtI84xEVxxcXZWhus%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur78obq/1-SK1619_figure_00133.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683288619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：天赦者，赦過宥罪之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320639028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"天之生育，甲與戊，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320655412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"地之成立子午寅申，故以甲戊配成天赦，其日可以緩","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320655412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"刑獄，雪寃枉，施恩惠，若與徳神會合，尤宜興造。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320655412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320671796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"曰，春戊寅，夏甲午，秋戊申，冬甲子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320671796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320688180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"赦者，乃天之赦過宥罪之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320688180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"生萬物者，土也，土之所","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320704564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"居者，四季也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240320704564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"助土而成功者，甲巳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478466088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"子午者，隂陽氣爭","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478482472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰，是其罪也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478482472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申者，隂陽否泰之辰，是其過也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478498856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"至此","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478515240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"四辰，天道憫其罪過，故以甲巳配合而助以赦之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478515240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478531624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683305003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"者陽土也，以甲配之，春起甲戌，秋起甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478531624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未者隂土","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478548008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"也，以己配之，夏起己丑，冬起己未，皆四時長生前一辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478548008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"順數至當旺之陽辰是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478548008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：天赦為赦過之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478564392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"則非以子午寅申為罪過也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478564392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋子午寅申者，乃四時當","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478580776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之陽辰，甲戊於十干中為最尊，所謂甲為諸神之首，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478580776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"戊以助甲成功也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478580776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"故以配其日，皆取干不克支，有上能","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478597160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"生下之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478597160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"如戊寅木非土不生也，甲午木生火也，戊申","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478613544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"土生金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478613544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子雖非相生，若戊子則以土克水，故以甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478629928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683321387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478629928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"且甲木生於亥，水亦生木也，故曰天赦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478646312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"按：歴神原始曰：天有五緯，歳星為仁，而甲應之，鎮星為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478662696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"徳，而戊應之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478662696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"仁徳之神，莫甲戊若也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478679080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"其說高於曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478695464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478695464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"史記天官書以木土為吉星，又道家以甲戊日為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478711848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"祈禳所宜，蓋其來乆矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478711848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"天赦與天恩義相似，從六十甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478728232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"子而論，則有天恩十五日，從四季而論，則有天赦四日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478728232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為十干之首，戊為十干之中，寅申為春秋之始，子午","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478744616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"為冬夏之中。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478744616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"不以巳為中者，巳則過中，又隂干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478761000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"故易","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478777384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683337771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：已日乃革之，言甲至戊則數窮而當變也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478777384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"不用卯酉","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478793768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"者，生物者，春始之，夏終之；成物者，秋始之，冬終之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478793768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"始之","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478810152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"者天也，終之者地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478810152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋屬天，故不用中而用始。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478826536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"且卯","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478842920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亦隂支也，用支之始，則以干之中配之，故春戊寅而","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478842920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"秋戊申；用支之中，則以干之首配之，故夏甲午而冬甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478842920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478842920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"是為天地合徳之辰，天地生心之所見端也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478859304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"之死而","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478875688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"忽生之，莫大於赦，故以天赦名也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478875688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"施恩赦罪，固宜用之，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478892072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"然謂必天恩之日乃可施恩，天赦之日乃可赦罪，則亦","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478892072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683354155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"拘論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478892072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"夫賞之不可行，罪之不可宥歟，則固不得以日","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478908456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"之為天恩天赦，而曲法以從事也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478908456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"其恩之宜施，罪之宜","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478924840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"宥歟，則如火之然，如泉之達，雖破敗休廢之日，何擇焉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478924840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"安得擇此十九日而用之，餘並屯其膏而不下耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478941224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683370539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur790yu/1-SK1619_figure_00134.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NOWS1zl9DOkVzpSnwCtTodLGgtg%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur790yu/1-SK1619_figure_00134.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SWhz3LWgPlyuH8yYxxAiJ0jLFWs%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur790yu/1-SK1619_figure_00134.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683386923"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：天願者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478957608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"所値之日，宜嫁娶納財，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478973992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"敦睦親族。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478973992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天願者，正月甲午，二月甲戌，三月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478990376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉，四月丙子，五月丁丑，六月戊午，七月甲寅！","logicSentenceId":"7678925240478990376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"八月丙","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479006760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"辰，九月辛卯，十月戊辰，十一月甲子，十二月癸未。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479006760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479023144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：天願者，乃月建枝徳合神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479023144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"陽前隂後，五辰各","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479039528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"以陽干配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479039528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"四季月以隂干配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479055912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇四孟及丑、未、子、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479072296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"午者，無合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479072296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋謂亥巳為隂陽終極之辰，寅申為隂陽否","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479088680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"泰之辰，丑未為隂陽絶蔑之辰，子午為陽消隂長之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479088680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683403307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"故不可為合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479088680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"十干巳為六賊，庚為白虎，𡈼為元武，故","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479105064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479105064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢忌用之辰，以前後近者用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479121448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479137832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"未為枝徳，今忌用，取近未者，午以王干甲配之，得甲午","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479137832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479137832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"二月甲戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479154216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"三月乙酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479170600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"四月丙子。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479186984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"五月忌亥，退合丑就","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479203368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"以丁配，故得丁丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479203368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"六月忌寅就午，六合以戊配，得戊午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479219752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"七月否建之辰，忌丑就寅，寅中有甲，從其泰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479236136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"八月忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479252520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"庚用丙，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479252520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":306,"lineType":2,"content":"謂金生於己，巳中有丙火也，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"配得丙辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479252520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"九月辛卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479268904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"十月忌𡈼，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479285288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"以戊之陽土能聚水潰土，易有比卦之義，故得戊辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479285288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"十","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479301672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683419691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"一月以其自建者，謂前後皆無所配，然建子之月，未可","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479301672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"假力於人，其忌𡈼用甲者，是待其子有所助也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479301672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479318056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"忌申，以就近申之未，故得癸未，其義如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479318056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"按曹震圭之論，支離難通，不待辨而明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479334440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"於東不可，則","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479350824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"轉而之西，于西不可，又轉而之南之北；陽干不可通則","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479350824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"借隂干用之，本位不可通，則借下位用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479350824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"然則神煞者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479367208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"乃聽人造作之物矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479367208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"古人造作以愚今人，今人解之，又","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479383592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"宛轉自道其造作之狀，而號於天下曰：當從我之造作","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479383592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683436075"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"以定吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479383592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"雖三尺童子亦知不信矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479399976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"考諸神煞起例，乃","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479416360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"知傳寫謬誤，二十四字中誤十三字焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479416360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭不知其","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479432744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"誤，而曲為解，展轉支離，如韓昌黎狀侯劉與軒轅彌明","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479432744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"聫句，所謂口吻鳴益悲者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479432744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"起例曰：正月乙亥，二月甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479449128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，三月乙酉，四月丙申，五月丁未，六月戊午，七月己巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479449128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"八月庚辰，九月辛卯，十月𡈼寅，十一月癸丑，十二月甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479449128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479449128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"十二辰皆太陽也，其十干皆令星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479465512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"唯十二月甲非","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479481896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"令星，而其為甲子，其義最大。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479481896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋丑寅為艮，終萬物，始萬","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479498280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683452459"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"物。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479498280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"丑月木巳甲於地中，而太陽又適始於子，故丑雖嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479514664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"終，而實始萬物，樞紐隂陽，尤令星之大者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479514664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽，日也，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479531048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"天之所以生物者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479531048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"令星，時也，天之所以成嵗者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479547432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"太","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479563816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"陽右旋，令星左旋，五氣順布，四時行焉，百物生焉，天之","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479563816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"願也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479563816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"天願之義大矣哉！","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479580200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683468843"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur79dly/1-SK1619_figure_00135.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JLs9OTnSxNLqKDcNC3zAQ%2BNOcew%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur79dly/1-SK1619_figure_00135.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signatur
