{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683485227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：母倉者，五行當王所生者為母倉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479596584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇土王","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479612968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"後，則以巳午為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479612968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜飬育羣畜，栽植種蒔。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479629352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479645736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：春亥子，夏寅、卯，秋辰戌、丑、未，冬申酉，土王後巳午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479645736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479662120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭曰：生我者為母，積藏者為倉，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479662120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"各以生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479678504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"當時五行之辰為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479678504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：春屬木，水生之，故以亥","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479694888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"子為母倉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479694888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479711272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"不用干而用支者，支為地，有母道","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479727656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479727656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物生於土，有藏道焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479744040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"按母倉者，種植、畜牧、納財等事之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479760424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"春木以亥子","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683501611"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"為母，木者，亥子之所生，水至木成則休矣，母老則待養","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"於子也，故以倉為名。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479776808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"又木生於水，木之所以能旺於春","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479793192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"者，由水生之，則木固由水而得養也，故以母為名。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479793192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"又我","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479809576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"尅者為財，而尅我之所由生者，亦財也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479809576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"以母倉之辰而","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"納財，一以見藏于生我之方，則其原不匱也；一以見生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"我之方之宜致養焉，以是為報本返始也；一以見財者","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"所以養人而多藏，則尅我之所由生，轉以為我害矣，非","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"所以為養也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479825960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"母倉之義大矣哉！","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479842344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683517995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683534379"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur79q92/1-SK1619_figure_00136.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=6OlwpF96S%2FRU0zcDkXQ83g2xZjE%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur79q92/1-SK1619_figure_00136.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FVpXih0tTKK5YmF2D6S4Y%2BkSph4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur79q92/1-SK1619_figure_00136.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683550763"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"五行論曰：月恩者，陽建所生之干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479858728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"子母相從，謂之月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479875112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"恩。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479875112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜營造、婚姻、移徙、祭祀、上官、納財。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479891496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479907880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"恩者，正月丙，二月丁，三月庚，四月巳，五月戊，六月辛，七","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479907880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"月𡈼，八月癸，九月庚，十月乙，十一月甲，十二月辛。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479907880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"震圭曰：月恩者，子母相從，是月建反生於彼，蓋母生我，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"我生子之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479924264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴神原始曰：寅木生丙火，卯木生丁火，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479940648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌土生庚金，丑未土生辛金，巳火生巳土，午火生戊","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479940648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"土，申金生𡈼水，酉金生癸水。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479940648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"子水生甲木，亥水生乙木，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479957032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683567147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"皆月建之所生，故曰月恩也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479957032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：正月寅陽木生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479973416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"丙陽火。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479973416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"二月卯隂木生丁隂火。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240479989800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"則各從其類也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480006184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480022568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"按：月恩者，母倉之對待也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480038952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"母倉為義爻，月恩為寳爻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480055336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480071720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"令神之神，母倉也，有恩於本令者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480071720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"月神所生之神，月","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480088104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"恩也，有恩於彼神者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240480088104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"母倉為本月之母，本月為月恩","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650432564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"之母。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650432564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"寅生丙，即甲生丙也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650448948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"卯生丁，即乙生丁也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650465332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650481716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，即戊生庚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650481716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"子平家謂之食神。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650498100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯辰，猶母也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650514484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650530868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，猶男子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650530868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"從地支以生天干，猶母之生子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650547252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"故結婚","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650563636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683583531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"姻，則宜子，營造上官，無所不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650563636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683599915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7a2w6/1-SK1619_figure_00137.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=r0uFryuQYaNXAdX9zY0xyoSBB20%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7a2w6/1-SK1619_figure_00137.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FdBtsc1vxSoE7NJNXHCU4B95u8Y%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7a2w6/1-SK1619_figure_00137.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683616299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：四相者，四時王相之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650580020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜修營起工，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650596404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"養育生財，栽植種蒔，移徙逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650596404","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：春丙丁，夏戊","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650612788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，秋𡈼癸，冬甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650612788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四相者，養育之道，母生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650629172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650629172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"春木王，生丙丁，夏火王，生戊巳；秋金王，生𡈼癸；冬","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650645556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"水王，生甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650645556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"惟庚辛者，金也，能殺萬物，故不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650661940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"按：四相無庚辛，此非人之所能為也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650678324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"木相本是火，火相","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650694708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"本是土，金相本是水，水相本是木，五行之自然而然者","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650694708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650694708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"相者，輔我者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650711092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"此以知天之道，任徳不任刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650727476","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"相者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650743860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683632683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"相君者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650743860","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"此以知臣之道，導以徳而不導以刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650760244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683649067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683665451"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7afja/1-SK1 {"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683681835"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：四時天徳者，四序中徳神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650776628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜慶賜宴","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650793012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"樂，拜官賞賀。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650793012","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：春午，夏辰，秋子，冬寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650809396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650825780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：子、寅、辰、午，乃東方生育之陽辰，故用事吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650825780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"申戌者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650842164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"西方之殺氣，故不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650842164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"各以四時所生之陽辰為之，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650858548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"是我生者為徳也，亦名時徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650858548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"按：時徳與四相同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650874932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"春木","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650891316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"生午火，夏火生辰土，秋金生子水，冬水生寅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650891316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"四相","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650907700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"取天干，時徳取地支。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650907700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"682","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"按：子、寅、辰、午、申、戌，為六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650924084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者，徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650940468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"時徳所以取陽","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650956852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683698219"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650956852","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"分而言之，春秋各二，冬夏各一，各以其時所生取","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650973236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650973236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"春木生火，取午；夏火生土，取辰、戌，辰先戌後，取辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240650989620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"秋","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651006004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"金生水，取子；冬水生木，取寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651006004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"六取四，而所餘者，適秋令","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651022388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"之二辰焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651022388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"亦猶十干為四相，而却餘庚辛二干不用，皆","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651038772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"自然而然，非人之所能為也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651038772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"天心之以徳不以刑，豈日","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651055156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"者強為說哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651055156","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683714603"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683730987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7as6e/1-SK1619_figure_00139.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=CyuaFNLHvlKEAMAJSnozffzcJuY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7as6e/1-SK1619_figure_00139.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wKIvGqs4xixyaGkl747PnhAwJio%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7as6e/1-SK1619_figure_00139.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683747371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"壇經曰：王官、相民、守日者，皆月内視事之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651071540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"所值","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651087924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"之日，宜命將登壇，襲爵受封，上官赴任，臨政親民。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651087924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651104308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：王日者，春寅、夏巳、秋申、冬亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651104308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":418,"lineType":2,"content":"今易為官日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"官日者，春卯、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651104308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"夏午、秋酉、冬子，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651104308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":419,"lineType":2,"content":"今易為王日。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"相日者，春巳、夏申、秋亥、冬寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651104308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"民","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651120692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"日者，春午、夏酉、秋子、冬卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651120692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"守日者，春酉、夏子、秋卯、冬午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651137076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：王日者，四時正王之辰，四正之位，帝王之","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651153460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"象，故得其政治也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651153460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"官日者，四時臨官之辰，諸侯之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651169844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"相","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651186228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"日者，四時官日所生也，相氣之辰，宰相之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651186228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"民日者，四","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651202612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683763755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"時死絶之辰，庶民之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651202612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"守日者，四時胎絶之辰，無氣能","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651218996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"自固守，以待將來，各取其義以為名也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651218996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"按此以春夏秋冬取令星王相以為吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651235380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"王日，天子","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651251764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"所用日；官日，臣下所用日；守日，封疆之臣所用日；相日，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651251764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"貴近之臣所用日；民日，百姓所用日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651251764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"五日之外，歴家又","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651268148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"以未、戌、丑、辰為四序獄日，申、亥、巳寅為四序𨽻日，酉、子、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651268148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、午為四序牢日，戌、丑、辰、未為四序死别日，亥、寅、巳、申","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651268148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"為四序伏罪日，子、卯、午酉為四序大敗日，又曰不舉日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651268148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683780139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、辰、未、戌為四序罪刑日，又曰刑獄日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651284532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋獄日為四序","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651300916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"之墓辰，餘並休囚死辰云耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651300916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"後人以王官、守相、民日有","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651317300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"吉無凶，而十二辰未遍也，于是一一區而别之，而命以","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651317300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"名，又勢必不能確切也，于是重出疊見，支離覆逆，而不","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651317300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"可信據矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651317300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"然神煞雖增七類，而别無所宜，不過一例忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651333684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"用，則止存原定五辰，而餘並勿用可耳，何必多其辭說","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651333684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"以惑世哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651333684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"今悉刪去。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651350068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"至王日向為寅巳申亥，官日向為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651366452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"卯午酉子，後人兩易其位，蓋以寅為春木之臨官，而卯","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651366452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683796523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"為春木之帝旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651366452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"然細繹其理，不如舊說為高。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651382836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋寅為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651399220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"陽木之臨官，卯為隂木之臨官，五行之性，臨官吉於帝","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651399220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，以其中也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651399220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"君用陽而臣用隂，又易之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651415604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"帝居帝位，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651431988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"官居官位，皆臨官也，不必帝用帝旺，官用臨官，然後為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651431988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"得，且使隂陽易位，轉為失也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651431988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"至於春辰、夏未、秋戌、冬丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651448372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"者，四序當王之土神也，故曰守日，守封疆之臣用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651448372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651464756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、夏申、秋亥、冬寅，四序之相氣，則自元子以下，王侯卿","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651464756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"相通用之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651464756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"夫春旺木而生火，則午為正令；夏旺","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651481140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683812907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"土而生金，則酉為正令。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651481140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"相宜以午酉子卯，而以午酉子","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651497524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為民日，而不曰相者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651497524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"巳陽火陽土也；申陽金也；","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651513908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"亥陽水也；寅陽木也，故為相也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651513908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"午隂火隂土也；酉隂金","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651530292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"也；子隂水也；卯隂木也，故為民也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651530292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"臣陽而民隂，猶王陽","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651546676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"而官隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651546676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"抑更有進焉，相之為相也，為王之所生固已","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651563060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"然已有金申、有水亥、有木寅、有火，不專一行，其吉凶未","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651563060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651563060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"書曰：惟吉凶不僣在人，惟天降災祥在徳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651579444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉凶","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651595828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"未定，正與富貴相似。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651595828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"用其日者，適順乎天之道，而致儆","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651612212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683829291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"於人之心也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651612212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫午、酉、子、卯，則專火、專金、專水、專木，為","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651628596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"四序當令之真子，吉莫大焉，故為民日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651628596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"民得全吉，則王","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651644980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"官相守，皆得全吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651644980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"而曹震圭以四時死絶之辰，為庶","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651661364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"民之象，最為無理。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651661364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人心之惡，雖桀紂、盜跖，未必欲庶","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651677748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"民之死絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651677748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"且衆庶馮生，故曰庶民。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651694132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"雖一晝一夜，萬生","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651710516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"萬死，而終古無死絶者，乃庶民也，安得有死絶之象耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651710516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"其荒謬至於如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651726900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"794","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"又按歴例，以春酉、夏子、秋卯、冬午為守日，以春辰、夏未、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651743284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683845675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"秋戌、冬丑為牢日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651743284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"邵泰衢作歴神原始，謂守與牢二字","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651759668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"相近而訛，易之則吉凶各以類聚，且與五勝義恰符，甚","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651759668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"為有理，今從之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651759668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683862059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7b4ti/1-SK1619_figure_00140.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HvV7InLRYULy5OqJvimM6lDSzDY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7b4ti/1-SK1619_figure_00140.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=at50b75QU%2Bm7B%2FqKoCNZa%2FAZh2M%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7b4ti/1-SK1619_figure_00140.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683878443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：四擊者，春戌、夏丑、秋辰、冬未，其日忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651776052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"軍事。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651792436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"○考","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651808820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"原曰：四擊者，四時所衝之墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651808820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"如春月建寅、卯、辰，辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651825204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"與戌衝，故戌為四擊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651825204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651841588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"按四季以土旺為守日，四擊其衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651857972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"春土旺於辰，而戌","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651874356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"擊之；夏土旺於未，而丑擊之；秋冬亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651874356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"故其日忌出軍、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651890740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"防邊等事。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651890740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683894827"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bhgm/1-SK1619_figure_00141.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dfTRalJJl%2FqVQRfHazQ%2FaljZD3g%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bhgm/1-SK1619_figure_00141.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=qchigpd8Eo4f8OzfeQ9wAr%2FQBVk%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bhgm/1-SK1619_figure_00141.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683911211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：九空者，月内殺神也，其日忌修造倉庫、出入","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651907124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"貨財。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651907124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：九空者，正月在辰，逆行四季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651923508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651939892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：九空者，墓庫破散之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651939892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"庫破則空，衝則散。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651956276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅、","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651972660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"午戌月，火庫在戌，辰能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651972660","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、卯未月，木墓在未，丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651989044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240651989044","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月，水墓在辰，戌能衝散也；巳酉丑月，","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652005428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"金墓在丑，未能衝散也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652005428","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"今歴家所傳，與九坎、九焦同行","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652021812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"者，非，蓋所傳有誤。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652021812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"紀嵗歴亦止是逆行四季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652038196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683927595"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bu3q/1-SK1619_figure_00142.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=conG4vZlL08OzbaJdEVR21shJok%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bu3q/1-SK1619_figure_00142.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HAPYFtajxly1k9%2BMZTKJxYI8jTo%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7bu3q/1-SK1619_figure_00142.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683943979"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：五墓者，四旺之墓辰也，其日忌營造、起土、嫁","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652054580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"娶、出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925240652054580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：五墓者，正二月，乙未，四五月，丙戌；七","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250218019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"八月，辛丑；十月十一月，𡈼辰；四季月，戊辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250218019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250234403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：五墓者，五行旺干自臨墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250234403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"十干者，身之象，若營","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250250787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"造起土，似臨於無氣之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250250787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"又以干為夫之象，若嫁娶，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250267171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"則夫自臨死氣之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250267171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"又以干為我，若出軍征伐，是自","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250283555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"臨死墓之地也，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250283555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正二月木旺，木墓於未，加","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250299939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"以乙未，是自臨墓辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250299939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250316323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683960363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7c6qu/1-SK1619_figure_00143.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VjeTmC3oJA4mLZSXilWLlg5z%2FW0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7c6qu/1-SK1619_figure_00143.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FFmEtk3JmqYTvF95MyqtLzIHZ5w%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7c6qu/1-SK1619_figure_00143.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683976747"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"總聖歴曰：四耗者，謂四時休干臨分至之辰也，其日忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250332707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹親姻、出師、開倉庫、施債負。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250332707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：春𡈼子，夏乙卯，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250349091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"秋戊午，冬辛酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250349091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：物之將分者，必散也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250365475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"至者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250381859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"盡也，是隂陽數盡而將分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250381859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"又得休干臨之，故曰耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250398243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250414627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：四耗日，固是休干，亦休支也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250414627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"春𡈼子，幹枝皆水；","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250431011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"夏乙卯，幹枝皆木；冬辛酉，幹枝皆金；秋戊午，幹土而枝","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250431011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"火。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250431011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經云：火不尅金，何旺？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250447395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"土生金，火亦生金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250463779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋春","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250480163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"木旺則水耗，夏火旺則木耗，秋金旺則火土耗，冬水旺","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250480163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660683993131"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"則金耗，故曰四耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250480163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：四廢者，四時衰謝之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250496547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌出軍、征伐、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250512931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"造舍、迎親、封建、拜官、納財、開市。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250512931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：春，庚申、辛酉；","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250529315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"夏，𡈼子、癸亥；秋，甲寅、乙卯；冬，丙午、丁巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250529315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"○蓬瀛經曰：四","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250545699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"廢者，是五行無氣，福徳不臨之辰，百事忌用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250545699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250562083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：四廢者，干支俱絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250562083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"假令庚申、辛酉絶於春寅卯辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250578467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250578467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250594851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"885","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例曰：四忌，春甲子，夏丙子，秋庚子，冬𡈼子，合四","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250611235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684009515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"窮日，即為八龍、七鳥、九虎、六蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250611235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：四窮者，謂亥為隂絶之辰，以四時旺干臨之，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250627619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰四窮。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250627619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，不可逺行征伐，出納財物。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250644003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250660387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：春乙亥，夏丁亥，秋辛亥，冬癸亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250660387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：亥者，地","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250676771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"支末辰，極隂之位，以四時隂干配之，故曰四窮。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250676771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：八龍、七鳥、九虎、六蛇，其日皆不可迎婚嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250693155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：春，甲子、乙亥，為八龍；夏，丙子、丁亥，為七鳥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250709539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"秋","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250725923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"庚子辛亥為九虎。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250725923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"冬𡈼子癸亥為六蛇。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250742307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：亥","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250758691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684025899"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"者，隂氣之極，子者陽氣初生，是隂陽氣絶脫謝之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250758691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"十干象夫，十二支象婦，今以四時旺干而配亥子，是夫","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250775075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"旺而婦絶，且我臨於絶地也，故用忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250775075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：甲乙","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250791459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"者，東方木也，為青龍，其成數八。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250791459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁者，南方火也，為朱","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250807843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"雀，其成數七。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250807843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛者，西方金也，為白虎，其成數九。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250824227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼癸","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250840611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"者，北方水也，為龜蛇，其成數六。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250840611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"故各因以為名也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250856995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"按：四耗日，干支皆休氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250873379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"四廢日，干支皆死氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250889763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"四忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250906147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"日，以本令陽干加於辰首也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250906147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"四窮日，以本令隂干加於","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250922531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684042283"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"辰尾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250922531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"夫休死固非吉辰矣，本令陽干加子，本令隂干","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250938915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"加亥，何以亦凶耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250938915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：易之道，天徳不可為首，今以陽干","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250955299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"而居辰首，是為首也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250955299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"地道無成，今以隂干而居辰尾，是","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250971683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"有成也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250971683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以其旺極而為凶，非衰謝之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241250988067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"其八龍、七","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251004451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥、九虎、六蛇，義亦本此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251004451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋春甲子乙亥合之，則是春之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251020835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"陽干據其首，春之隂干據其尾，全備而無遺矣，故曰八","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251020835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251020835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"八者，春之數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251037219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"龍者，春之獸也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251053603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"猶言全春之數盡在","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251069987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251069987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：積善之家，必有餘慶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251086371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"天地循𤨔不窮，萬化日","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251102755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684058667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"新，皆由氣盈朔虚而出，無餘者，非天道也，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251102755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684075051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684091435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7cjdy/1-SK1619_figure_00144.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5P3s5Q6fsebznKEo%2FPOB0zs72Xo%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7cjdy/1-SK1619_figure_00144.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=04v2z6x39eJW0ZEll1CsStQLx6Q%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7cjdy/1-SK1619_figure_00144.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684107819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：九坎者，月中殺神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251119139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌乘船渡水、修堤","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251135523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"防、築垣墻、苫蓋屋舍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251135523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：九坎者，正月在辰，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251151907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"四季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251151907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"五月在卯，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251168291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"九月在寅，逆行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251184675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251201059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：坎者，陷也，險也，不平也，義與九焦同。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251201059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"○廣聖歴曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251217443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"九焦者，月中殺神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251217443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌爐冶、鑄造、種植、修築園圃。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251233827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正月在辰，逆行四季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251250211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"五月在卯，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251266595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"九","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251282979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"月在寅，逆行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251282979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：九坎、九焦者，是月中之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251299363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"殺神，逆天地之道者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251299363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正、二、三、四為嵗首，東方之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251315747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684124203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"位，當用孟辰以生萬物，今則以季辰收殺萬物，是其逆","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251315747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251315747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"五、六七八為嵗中，今雖用仲辰，成熟萬物，然嵗首不","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251332131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"與其生，焉有成熟哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251332131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"九、十、十一、十二月為嵗之終，萬物","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251348515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"收藏之時，今方欲以孟辰生育萬物，豈能有生育哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251348515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251364899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"逆天地之道，萬物無能成就也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251364899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"按：寅午戌火月，逆行辰、夘寅，亥、夘未木月，逆行丑、子、亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251381283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"申、子辰水月，逆行戌、酉、申，巳、酉丑金月，逆行未、午、巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251381283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"火","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251397667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"逆於木，則火成燎原；木逆於水，則木多沉溺；水逆於金，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251397667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684140587"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"則水多搏激；金逆於火，則金多爍銷。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251397667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰九坎，曰九焦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251414051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"然從水火以命二名，故歴家止忌乘船、鼓鑄、栽種等事，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251430435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"義無大害，今從之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251430435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684156971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7cw12/1-SK1619_figure_00145.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uynFVYhKrmH7m9HdbcmqXMkp6hM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.by
