{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684173355"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要厯曰：五虚者，四時絶辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251446819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開倉庫，營種蒔，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251463203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"出財寳，施債負。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251463203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"○厯例曰：五虚者，春巳酉丑，夏申子辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251479587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"秋亥卯未，冬寅午戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251479587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：五虚者，四時逢絶","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251495971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251495971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"物絶則損朽，其中虚而無實也，故曰虚。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251512355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"如春木","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251528739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，巳酉丑，金絶也；夏火旺，申子辰，水絶也；秋金旺，亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251528739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"未，木絶也；冬水旺，寅午戌，火絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251528739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684189739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7d8o6/1-SK1619_figure_00146.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Jiwt9cVCfcKG8N%2BtKwbu5YMKz6w%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7d8o6/1-SK1619_figure_00146.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=J62Lhx6PhFAG%2BAButP1cNBEBqIo%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7d8o6/1-SK1619_figure_00146.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684206123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：咸池招揺，八風觸水龍，所值之日，忌乘船渡","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251545123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"水涉江河。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251545123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：八風者，春丁丑巳、酉，夏甲申、甲辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251561507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"秋辛未、丁未，冬甲戌、甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251561507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"觸水龍者，丙子、癸丑、癸未也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251577891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：八風者，是八節八卦之風也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251594275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"各以四立之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251610659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"建後一辰，為四立之風，以其三合前辰，為次節風。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251610659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"如立","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251627043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"夏建巳，以辰為立夏風，申為三合前辰，為夏至風是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251627043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"假令立春建寅，以建前丑為正風，以丁配之，取溫和之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251643427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"意也；以酉為傍風，配之以巳，取巳土長生之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251643427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"立夏","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251659811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684222507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"建巳，以辰為正風，申為傍風，皆以甲配之者，立夏之後，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251659811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"風勢極微，故配甲以生之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251659811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋建申，以未為正風，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251676195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"不取傍風者，謂秋氣好殺，而無養育之性，以辛配之，取","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251676195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"金風之象；又以丁配之，存其溫和之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251676195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬建亥，以","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251692579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"戌為正風，寅為傍風，皆以甲配之者，以風鳴冬，其勢極","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251692579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"大，配之以甲木以生風也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251692579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"共為八節，故曰八風。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251708963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"觸水龍","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251725347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"者，觸，犯也，龍，水物也，𡈼癸亥子，水也，能與水相勝者，火","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251725347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251725347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"火在上為丙，土居下為四季，辰乃龍之正位，𡈼水","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251741731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684238891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"所居戌亥為乾天之位，有龍象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251741731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"故惟餘丙子、癸未、癸","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251758115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"丑為觸水龍日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251758115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"按靈樞經曰：一者天，二者地，三者人，四者時，五者音，六","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251774499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"者律，七者星，八者風，九者野。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251774499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：冬至之日，太一立於","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251790883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"叶蟄之宫，風從南方來，為虚風，賊傷人者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251790883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"立春之日，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251807267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"風從西方來，萬民又皆中於虚風。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251807267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，八風之義，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251823651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"其本諸此乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251823651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"春：丁丑、丁巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241251840035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"夏：甲申、甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778700323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"秋：丁未、丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778716707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"冬：","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778733091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778733091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778749475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"己丑之於春也，即五虚巳、酉、丑而去其正位","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778765859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684255275"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"之酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778765859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"申辰之於夏也，即五虚申、子、辰而去其正位之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778782243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778782243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"秋冬可推，蓋正風猶可，而邪風更凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778798627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"其以丁甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778815011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"者，木為風，風又出於火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778815011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"觸水龍者，水之伐日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778831395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，水","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778847779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"族之長子為水宫，癸即子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778847779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"干為水而支伐之，與支為","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778864163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"水而干為支之所伐，皆猶觸水中之龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778864163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"招摇即六儀，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778880547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"六儀即天罡，隂建之衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778880547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池，五行沐浴之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778896931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"圖並","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778913315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"見前，故不著觸水龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778913315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"不論四時，皆忌此三日，故不圖涉","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778929699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"江並忌，故比而陳之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778929699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"而咸池、招揺不嫌重見者，别著一","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778946083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684271659"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"義故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778946083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684288043"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dlba/1-SK1619_figure_00147.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=RinKhJZfOhRbK24E8s0GMwta9LM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dlba/1-SK1619_figure_00147.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AUXJHA8YZ8p9vSvXfY0MgwJ5muQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dlba/1-SK1619_figure_00147.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684304427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子曰：子生母曰義，母生子曰寳，子母相得曰專，母","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778962467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"勝子曰制，子勝母曰困。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778962467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"以制擊殺，勝而無報，以專從事，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778978851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"而有功，以義行理，名立而不墮；以寳畜養，萬物蕃昌；以","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778978851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"困舉事，破滅死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778978851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"○遁甲經曰：寳日者，幹生枝也；義日","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778995235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"者，枝生幹也；制日者，幹克枝也，其日利行軍；伐日者，支","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778995235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"克干辰也，其日忌攻討征伐、出軍掠地；專日者，干支五","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778995235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"行相同也，其日忌出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241778995235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：寳日者，丁未、丁丑、丙","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779011619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、甲午、庚子、𡈼寅、癸卯、乙巳、戊申、己酉、辛亥、丙辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779011619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"義日","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779028003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684320811"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"者，甲子、丙寅、丁夘、己巳、辛未、𡈼申、癸酉、乙亥、庚辰、辛丑、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779028003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"庚戌、戊午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779028003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"制日者，乙丑、甲戌、𡈼午、戊子、庚寅、辛夘、癸巳、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779044387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"乙未、丙申、丁酉、己亥、甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779044387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"伐日者，庚午、辛巳、丙子、戊寅、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779060771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"己夘、癸未、癸丑、甲申、乙酉、丁亥、𡈼辰、𡈼戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779060771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"專日者，甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779077155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、乙夘、丁巳、丙午、庚申、辛酉、癸亥、𡈼子、戊辰、戊戌、己丑、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779077155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"己未。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779077155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：幹生枝者，得其天時也；枝生幹者，得","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779093539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"其地利也；幹克枝者，得其人和，我可制彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779093539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"故幹為天","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779109923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"為我，枝為地為彼也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779109923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"伐者，彼伐於我也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779126307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"干為尊為我，支","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779142691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684337195"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"為卑為彼，是卑伐於尊，彼尅於我，其義逆也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779142691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"今幹枝同","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779159075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"類，是彼我同徳，兩勢相敵，不分勝負，故忌出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779159075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779175459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：專日，亦名和日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779175459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"按淮南以專日為吉，謂以專從事則有功，而遁甲則以","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779191843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"專日為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779191843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"今按專日所忌，止在行軍，其他固當從淮南，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779208227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"並以吉日論。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779208227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684353579"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dxye/1-SK1619_figure_00148.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=V3UuxHVLPukrrZwVLGe28osEo5I%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dxye/1-SK1619_figure_00148.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SNtE8vbVWin1TNNCFTFj5JH3Ol0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7dxye/1-SK1619_figure_00148.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684369963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"曾門經曰：八專日，忌出軍、嫁娶，丁未、己未、庚申、甲寅、癸","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779224611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779224611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"按八專而止五日者，十干所寄，止於八支，不居子、午、夘、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779240995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，而此八支之中，六甲循𤨔，干支相見，則曰八專也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779240995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779257379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"出軍者，彼己同位，則交綏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779257379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"忌嫁娶者，隂陽同居，則無","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779273763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"别也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779273763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684386347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7eali/1-SK1619_figure_00149.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3VQzYwEbw4UROe5Z6F5WVCT9SPs%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7eali/1-SK1619_figure_00149.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BCLFKSS33XR1MFy%2FniLkbmMS2UI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7eali/1-SK1619_figure_00149.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684402731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"通書云：甲辰、乙巳、庚辰、辛巳、丙申、戊戌、丁亥、己丑、𡈼申、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779290147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥，此十日禄皆落空，故云無禄。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779290147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲禄在寅，乙禄在","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779306531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"夘，甲辰旬，寅卯空，故甲辰、乙巳為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779306531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"庚禄在申，辛","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779322915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"禄在酉，甲戌旬，申酉空，故庚辰、辛巳為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779322915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊禄","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779339299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳，甲午旬，巳空，故丙申、戊戌為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779339299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"丁巳禄在午，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779355683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申旬，午空，故丁亥、己丑為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779355683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼禄在亥，甲子旬，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779372067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"亥空，故𡈼申為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779372067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"癸禄在子，甲寅旬，子空，故癸亥","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779388451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"為無禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779388451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"此十日名曰無禄日，又曰十惡大敗日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779404835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"然惟","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779421219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684419115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"隨各年及本命避之，如庚戌年及庚戌生人，忌用甲辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779421219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779421219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"按無禄日，乃禄䧟旬空，故以為忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779437603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"然六𡈼火珠林之法，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779453987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"填實則不空，非不論年月而概以此十日為禄空也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779453987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779470371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰日，寅禄落空，若太嵗月建太陽在寅，則不為空，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779470371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"此年月之甲辰日，即不為無禄日矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779470371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"餘日倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779486755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"術士盲","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779503139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"於理，不問年月而概忌之，固拘滯不可通。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779503139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂惟對衝","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779519523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"之年及對衝本命人，忌用其日，則又曲為通融，而悖謬","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779519523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684435499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"不可解者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779519523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684451883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7en8m/1-SK1619_figure_00150.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OwqGHviKCVTLO5tV2lwq2EXtVhc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7en8m/1-SK1619_figure_00150.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vr2eKDlRKu06ZLxp5E9QIqkweMw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7en8m/1-SK1619_figure_00150.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684468267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：重日者，以隂陽混合於亥，陽起於甲子而順，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779535907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"隂起於甲戌而逆，至己亥而同，故曰重日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779535907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌為凶","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779552291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"事，利為吉事。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779552291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：重日者，己亥二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779568675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779585059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：亥為隂極之位，坤辟在焉；巳為陽極之位，乾辟在焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779585059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"是陽中陽而隂中隂也，故曰重。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779601443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌為凶事者，恐重","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779617827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"犯也；利為吉事者，宜再見也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779617827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：五合者，月内良日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779650595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜結婚姻，㑹親友，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779666979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684484651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"立劵交易。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779666979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：五合者，寅夘日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779683363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：十","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779699747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"干者，夫之象；十二支者，婦之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779699747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"今自子為始，以甲相配，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779716131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"至酉而止，不及戌亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779716131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"然戌能進五辰配寅中之甲，亥能","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779732515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"進前五辰配夘中之乙，而成夫婦㑹合之禮，故曰五合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779732515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"若其他，則進五無所配也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779748899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"雖有辰配申中之庚，巳配酉","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779765283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"中之辛，而申酉反為五離者，易曰：一隂一陽之謂道，雜","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779765283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"則相乖，合則暌離也，故曰五離。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779765283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"按歴例：五合者，寅夘日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779781667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"而曹震圭以戌亥為言，未詳","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779798051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684501035"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"其義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779798051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"今按漢書曰：甲寅無子，言甲寅旬中無子丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779814435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779830819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"則寅夘之為五合日者，以寅配甲，夘配乙，而六甲乃成，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779830819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"有貞下起元之義，則使五位相得而各有合者，寅夘也，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779830819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰五合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779830819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"反此則為申酉，六十甲子至戌亥而絶，則未","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779847203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"絶而離者，乃申酉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779847203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"若以四時言之，寅夘為春，和㑹之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779863587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也，故為五合。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779863587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉為秋，清肅之氣也，故宜解除","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779879971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：五離者，月中離神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779912739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌結婚姻，㑹親友，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779929123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684517419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"作交闗，立契劵。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779929123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：五離者，申酉日是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779945507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779961891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：五離者，是隂陽重㑹之辰，再合則離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779961891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779978275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書以申酉日為除神，與五合對衝之日也，宜沐浴","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779978275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"祓除災眚。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779978275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"按日神不從年月天干起義者，唯此三條，故并為一圖。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241779994659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684533803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684550187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7ezvq/1-SK1619_figure_00151.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=DNrssaoXNcN8B9hZqNoZ%2BBeiGio%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7ezvq/1-SK1619_figure_00151.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=EGrYtwP2uH1SZpv5rOYu5V%2BFaiY%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7ezvq/1-SK1619_figure_00151.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684566571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：解神者，月中善神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780011043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜上詞章，雪","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780027427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"寃枉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780027427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正二月，申，三、四月，戌，五、六月，子，七、八月，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780043811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，九、十月，辰，十一月、十二月，午也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780043811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：解神者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780060195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"月中奏對直諫之臣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780060195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"常居與月建相對之陽辰，與太","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780076579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗中奏書一義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780076579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋忠直之臣不處私隂之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780092963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"按，隂陽之性，非衝不解，而解神於六陽辰，即用衝神，於","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780109347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂辰則不用衝神，而即用陽辰之衝神者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780109347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"陽者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780125731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"徳也，衝之而即解，所為如日月之食者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780125731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"隂者，慝也，衝","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780142115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684582955"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"之即慝作矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780142115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"然而隂非無陽者也，必衝其陽，則慝亦解","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780158499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"動其固有之徳也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780158499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"雖然，不可徑衝其本位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780174883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"為臣者知","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780191267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"此，得進諌之方焉；為君者知此，得受諫之道焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780191267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"故曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780207651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"圭比之奏書也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780207651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684599339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684615723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7fciu/1-SK1619_figure_00152.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2rHCu3NDc2Vu1ABAcOOT1z98SpI%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7fciu/1-SK1619_figure_00152.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9CLm86smqJTkJn2NtvYvw%2BzCU5A%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur7fciu/1-SK1619_figure_00152.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684632107"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：復日者，為魁罡所繫之辰也，其日忌為凶事，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780224035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"利為吉事。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780224035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：復日者，正七月甲庚，二八月乙辛，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780240419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"四，十月丙𡈼，五，十一月丁癸，三九、六十二月戊巳日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780240419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：復者，重見也，為本建之辰，與所遇之干同","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780256803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780256803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月寅即甲也，而又見甲，是復也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780273187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"又如辰戌即","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780289571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"戊也，丑未即巳也，而又見戊巳，是復也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780289571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780305955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"地理新","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780322339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"書云：正月甲，七月庚，二月乙，八月辛，四月丙，十月𡈼，五","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780322339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"月丁，十一月癸，三月、九月戊，六月、十二月巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241780322339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353660684648491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"按建寅而得甲日，則是月與日同也，為凶事之所忌者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946472482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋猶忌月建之義，然干與支不可同日語矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946472482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"俗則以為","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946488866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"犯此則致重喪，益無是理。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946488866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡載古人葬課，多用","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946505250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"建日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946505250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：正月甲日，二月乙日，得令得禄，最吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946521634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"三月戊","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946538018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"日，雖不得禄，而實得令，次吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946538018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"然則復日之忌，固不可從，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946554402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"而世俗相傳已乆，今定為鳴吠遇復日則忌，徳赦六合","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946554402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"遇復日則不忌，庶存其名，不害於義云。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946554402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437878838"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"一行云：鳴吠者，五性安葬之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946570786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"用之者，得金雞鳴，玉","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946587170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"犬吠，上下相呼，亡靈安穩，子孫富昌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946587170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"○鳴吠日者，庚午、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946603554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"壬申、癸酉、𡈼午、甲申、乙酉、庚寅、丙申、丁酉、𡈼寅、丙午、己","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946603554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、庚申、辛酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946603554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴事明原曰：金雞者，兌也，兌宫酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946619938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"玉犬者，艮也，艮為犬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946636322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵外宅之要，在山澤地勢，是","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946652706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"坤艮兌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946652706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"故以坤兌徃來加艮，順布八卦，視艮所臨之","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946669090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為良也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946669090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"如兌加艮，則艮臨離，午也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946685474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"又以離加艮，則艮","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946701858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"臨兌，酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946701858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"又以坤加艮，則艮臨坤，未申也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946718242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"又以艮自加","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946734626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437895222"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"艮，丑寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946734626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未二辰，乃墓絶無氣之位，故不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946751010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"又十","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946767394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"干之中，戊為陽土，以配中宮明堂之位，不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946767394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946783778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅、丙寅者，乃自死自旺自生之日，故不用，止餘一十","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946783778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":792,"lineType":1,"content":"四日為鳴吠吉日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946783778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"一行經云：鳴吠對日者，用之破土斬草也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946800162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"○鳴吠對日","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946816546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"者，丙寅、丁夘、丙子、辛夘、甲午、庚子、癸夘、𡈼子、甲寅、乙夘","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946816546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946816546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：按鳴吠對者，乃與鳴吠對衝之日，其己丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946832930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"日無對衝，庚寅與甲申，𡈼寅與丙申，又互為對衝，故止","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946832930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437911606"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"餘九日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946832930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"今取十日者，蓋甲午日雖不用為鳴吠，然其對","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946849314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"衝庚子，可用為鳴吠對也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946849314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲寅之對庚申，丙寅之對","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946865698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼申，則鳴吠日中巳用之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946865698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"惟甲午疑應作甲子，蓋甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946882082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"子本與庚午對衝，且既用庚子，不宜并用甲午也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946882082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"恐傳","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946898466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"者有誤。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946898466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例曰：金雞鳴，玉犬吠。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946914850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"並鳴吠對日，相傳始於郭","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946931234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"公，而定於邵子，舉世用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946931234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"大葬日曰：金雞鳴，玉犬吠，小","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946947618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"葬日曰：鳴吠對。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946947618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"試問何為金雞玉犬？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946964002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"何為對？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946980386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"則莫知所","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946996770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437927990"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"由來矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241946996770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋生人之禮属於陽，葬者藏也，則屬於隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947013154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"夫人","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947029538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"身有生死，一世之隂陽也；四序有春秋，一嵗之隂陽也；","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947029538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"十二時有晝夜，一日之隂陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947029538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"陽取乎陽，隂取乎隂，各","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947045922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"從其類，道本自然耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947045922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"時日之隂陽，分於日之出沒，日出","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947062306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"東方為陽，生人之事也；日入西方為隂，送終之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947062306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"金","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947078690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"雞者酉，為日入之門；玉犬者戌為閉物之㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947078690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"然埋藏於","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947095074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"土而不敢犯土。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947095074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"凡支干屬土者，如戊巳名都天，辰戌丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947111458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"未名大墓，皆所不宜，故不用戌而用酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947111458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"溯酉而上，至午","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947127842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437944374"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"而止，午乃一隂之始，過午而巳，則六陽之卦矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947127842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"用五酉","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947144226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"以為主，巳隂土屬酉，故亦不忌，是謂金雞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947144226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"申去戊而","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947160610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"用四申，越未而午，亦去戊而用四午，共為大葬之十三","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947160610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"日，謂之鳴吠者以此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947160610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"次酉之對為夘，則去巳而用四夘，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947176994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"以别於酉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947176994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"申之對為寅，亦去戊而用四寅，午之對為","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947193378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"子，亦去戊子不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947193378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"至於甲乃十干之長，純陽也，故亦不","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947209762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"用，而用三子，共為小葬之十一日，謂之鳴吠對者，以此","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947209762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為巳之對，故亦不用云。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947209762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"又星命之術，數人生時遇夘","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947226146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728437960758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"安命，取東方出地之義，而中陽子葬埋克擇，則遇酉安","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947226146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"命，亦取西方入地之義，豈非用酉之一証耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947226146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘因金","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947242530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"雞而多張名目，則術家巧飾耳目之為，不足深究矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947242530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728438009910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書：安葬用庚寅、𡈼寅、丙午、庚午、𡈼午、甲申、丙申、庚","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947357218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"申、𡈼申、乙酉、丁酉、己酉、辛酉、癸酉十四日為鳴吠日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947357218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"啓","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947373602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"攢用丙子、庚子、壬子、甲寅、丙寅、乙夘、丁夘、辛夘、癸夘、甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947373602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"午十日為鳴吠對日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947373602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"相傳始自郭璞，謂之金雞鳴、玉犬","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947389986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"吠日，而不知其所由。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947389986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"明原曲為之解，而不能通。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947406370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"考原疑","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947422754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"其有誤而未之定。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947422754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"今按神煞起例之語，於理為安，庶幾","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947439138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"可信。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947439138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":846,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以甲、丙、庚、𡈼四干配午、申，得八日，避戊土不","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947455522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947455522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"以乙、丁、巳、辛、癸五干配酉，得五日，避未土不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947471906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":847,"lineType":1,"content":"共十","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947488290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728438026294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"三日為鳴吠日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947488290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"巳為隂土，生於酉，故配酉而不避也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947504674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947521058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙、庚、𡈼三干配子，得三日，避戊土不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947521058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"甲配子為純","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947537442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，亦避不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947537442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":851,"lineType":1,"content":"以甲、丙、庚、𡈼四干配寅，得四日，避戊不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947553826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"以乙、丁、辛、癸四干配卯，得四日，避巳不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947570210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"共十一日為","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947586594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"鳴吠對日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947586594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"通共二十四日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947602978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"通書誤以庚寅𡈼寅為鳴吠，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947619362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午為鳴吠對，遂不可解。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947619362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"今圖依起例改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947635746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"又按起例","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947652130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"以戌為土不用，而止用酉，則止有金雞鳴，而無玉犬吠","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947652130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947652130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"何以為鳴吠耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947668514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：一行之言，金雞鳴，玉犬吠，上下相","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947684898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353728438042678"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1424","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"呼，亡靈安穩。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947684898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1425","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"人之葬也，歸骨於土，戌為終萬物之地，至","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947701282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1426","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"亥則又為始矣，故亥曰登明。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947701282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1427","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"然則戌者指葬地，而非指","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947717666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1428","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"葬日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947717666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1429","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"言擇日必以酉為主，則是金雞鳴於上，而地下","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947734050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1430","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"之玉犬與之吠應，上下相呼，而亡靈安稳矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947734050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1431","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，辛也，然","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947750434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1432","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"辛不居酉而居戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947750434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1433","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，金也；玉，金之精也，故有金雞、玉犬","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947766818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1434","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"之號。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947766818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1435","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"人事行於地上，魂魄安於地下，正以地上之金雞，","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947783202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1436","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"呼地下之玉犬，而非並用雞日、犬日之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947783202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1437","lineNum":865,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷五","logicSentenceId":"7678925241947799586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397370915"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"曽門經曰：三合者，異位而同氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374661675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌，火之三合；巳","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374678059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"酉丑，金之三合；申子辰，水之三合；亥夘未，木之三合。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374678059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374694443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"日宜結㑹親姻，和合交易，修營，起土立木。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374694443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"上梁○歴例","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374710827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：正月在午戌，二月在未亥，三月在子申，四月在丑酉，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374710827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"五月在寅戌，六月在夘亥，七月在子辰，八月在丑巳，九","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374710827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"月在寅午，十月在夘未，十一月在辰申，十二月在丑巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374710827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：三合者，各與其月建㑹成三合局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374727211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"70","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"按：子午為衝，子未為害，衝重於害也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374743595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"寅夘為類，寅午戌","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374759979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397387299"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"為合，合必輕於類矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374759979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"而不然者，何也？","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374776363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"天之圓，積氣也；地","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374792747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，積形也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374792747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"人者，圓首方趾，上圓下方，而為三角，實天","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374809131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"地之心。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374809131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"是故方圓之数，必以三角為用，以明天為大圓，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374825515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"地為大方，必由人之三角而神以著。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374825515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"然則辰之三合，固","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374841899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"天地之道所由及於人之端歟！","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374841899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"三方既立，五行以之終，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374858283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"以之始，四序以之生，以之成。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374858283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"一生二，二生三，三生萬物，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374874667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"理之自然，至粗而至精，至近而至逺，至微而至鉅，至庸","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374874667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"而至神，其唯三合之義歟！","logicSentenceId":"7678337635374874667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397403683"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397420067"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur8zj7t/1-SK1619_figure_00156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=fAjU9jwq34EhgXcSEfG9zoLbtnA%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur8zj7t/1-SK1619_figure_00156.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=HjDmNx6Q1cFfG99Q6kMdnaBDfNI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur8zj7t/1-SK1619_figure_00156.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
