{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397501987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：驛馬者，驛騎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375120427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜封贈官爵，詔命公卿，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375136811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"逺行赴任，移徙遷居。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375136811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：驛馬者，正月起申逆","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375153195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"行。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375153195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"四孟○總要歴曰：天后者，月中福神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375169579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜求醫","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375185963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"療病，祈福禮神。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375185963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天后與驛馬同位。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375202347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"○儲泳祛","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375218731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"疑說曰：今世之所謂驛馬者，先天三合數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375218731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"先天寅七","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375235115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"午九而戌五，合數二十有一，故自子順至申，凡二十有","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375235115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"一，而為火局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375235115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未之數四六八，合為十八，故","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375251499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"自子順至巳，凡十八，而為木局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375251499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"木火陽局也，從","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375267883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397518371"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"子一陽順行；金水隂局也，從午一隂順行。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375267883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"故申子辰之","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375284267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"數七九五，合二十有一，自午順至寅，凡二十有一，而為","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375284267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"水局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375284267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑之數四六八，合為十八，自午順至","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375300651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，凡十有八，而為金局之驛馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375300651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"此驛馬之法所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375317035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：驛馬者，五行將病，得見妻子，似人値困，途","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375333419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"逢妻子者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375333419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"假令寅午戌，火也，病於申中有庚為妻，戊","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375349803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"為子，故以申為馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375349803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰，水也，病於寅，中有丙為妻，甲","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375366187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"為子。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375366187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未，木也，病於巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375382571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"中有戊為妻，丙為子。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375398955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375415339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397534755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"金也，病於亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375415339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"中有申為妻，𡈼為子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375431723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"洞源經曰：既病見","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375448107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"子，驛馬到來。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375448107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天后者，驛馬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375464491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"五行受病，得見妻子，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375480875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"反有救助。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375480875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"天后主生育萬物，為萬物之母，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375497259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"按：寅為功曹，申為傳送，亥為天門，巳為地户，皆道路之","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375513643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"象也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375513643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"三合在寅午戌，則對寅之申，有驛馬之象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375530027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"三合","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375546411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳酉丑，則對巳之亥，有驛馬之象焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375546411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"又驛馬者，不安","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375562795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"其居之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375562795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"數窮則變，寅午戌之數盡，而恰遇夫申，則","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375579179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"火將變而之乎水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375579179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"火生於木，木絶於申，而申又生水","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375595563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397551139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"以生木，是火以變而不窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375595563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑之數盡，而恰遇夫","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375611947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，則金將變而之乎木矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375611947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"金生於火土，火土絶於亥，而","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375628331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"亥又生木以生火，是金以變而不窮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375628331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"申、子、辰、亥、卯、未","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375644715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375644715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"易稱乘馬班，如用拯馬壯，皆以舍舊圖新，改過遷","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375661099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"善為義。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375661099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"故驛馬又曰天后，亦絶處逢生之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375677483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"若洞源","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375693867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"經所謂既病見子，驛馬到來者，則以申為火病，巳為木","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375693867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"病，以見驛馬即是三合病鄉，聊以識之耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375693867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"猶三煞為太","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375710251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗三合絶胎養之類，恰遇其方，即用以為記，而非於病","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375710251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397567523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"絶胎養有所取義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375710251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"於此穿鑿附㑹，則失之逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375726635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375743019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"圭以三煞為絶胎養，則絶胎養皆屬幽隂之地，猶若可","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375743019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"通。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375743019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"至以驛馬為五行將病，得見妻子，則妄謬已甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375759403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375775787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"按：驛馬有從年支取者，有從日支取者，其義例皆與月","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375775787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"同，故不重列。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375775787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397583907"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"li {"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353673397600291"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：刼煞者，刼害之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375792171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌臨官視事，納禮","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375808555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"成親，戰伐行軍，出入興販。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375808555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：正月起亥，逆行","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375824939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375824939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754568744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"按月災煞，義與嵗災煞同。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375857707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"又按神煞起例，亦有伏兵大","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375874091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"禍、五兵神煞，與嵗同例，而歴家不特無伏兵、大禍二神，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375874091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"并無災煞，其為闕遺，固不待言。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375874091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"但月主一月之事，不必","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375890475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"一一與嵗同例，其伏兵大禍，可以弗論。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375890475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"至於三煞，㫁難","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375906859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"闕一，自當依起例補足。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375906859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"又按天獄，正月起子，順行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375923243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭以為天獄即是災煞，應逆行四仲，而今順行者，","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375939627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"流傳之誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375939627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"其說是，今從之。","logicSentenceId":"7678337635375956011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754585128"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天獄者，月中禁神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768774186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌獻封章，興詞訟，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768790570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"赴任征討。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768790570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"231","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"玉帳經曰：天火者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768806954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌苫蓋，築壘垣牆，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768823338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"振旅興師，㑹親娶婦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768823338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天火者，正月在子，順行","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768839722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768839722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"按天獄與天火，向為正月起子，順行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768856106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭以為","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768872490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"天獄即是月災煞，以逆行四仲為是，而天火仍順行四","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768872490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768872490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"其說曰：寅午戌月在子，蓋子中藏陽氣之火，其勢最","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768888874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754601512"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"弱，待寅午戌月火勢興旺，以顯其光，故子中有霹靂火","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768888874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"也，是水中之火見之於天也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768888874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、夘、未月在夘，蓋夘中有","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768905258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"伏燄之火也，火氣既生於寅，至夘而木旺，反蔽其燄而","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768905258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"成炭，又待亥卯未月木再生之，故夘内有鑪中火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768905258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"申、","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768921642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"子、辰月在午，蓋午中有正旺之火，其勢最大，物莫敢侵，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768921642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"其光反闇，待申子、辰月水勢將興，反制其光，上下俱明，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768921642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"故午中有天上火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768921642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉、丑月在酉，謂酉中有長生丁","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768938026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"火，如硫黄、煤炭之類，故待巳酉、丑月金石之氣而再發","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768938026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754617896"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"旺也，故酉中有山下之火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768938026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"且子中之陽火、夘中之木","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768954410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"火、午中之旺火、酉中長生丁火，莫非天道自然，故以名","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768954410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768954410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"觀曹震圭之論，亦為近似。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768970794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"但古人立義命名，純一不","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768987178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"二，使其宛轉推移，兼收並舉，納甲不得入於納音，河洛","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768987178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"不得入於𡈼遁，則無徃而不可立說矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304768987178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午、戌火既取","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769003562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"子水，申子辰水既取午火，則亥夘未木必不取夘木而","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769003562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"取酉金，巳酉丑金必不取酉金而取夘木，可㫁也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769003562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"子水","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769019946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"何以有火？","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769019946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：子中之火乃真火。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769036330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"於人身驗之，命門為真","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769052714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754634280"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"火；於海驗之，無月之夜，一海皆火。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769052714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋坎中一畫，是為純","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769069098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，故寅午戌之火局根於子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769069098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"出乎震則為龍為雷，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769085482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"人乃見水中之火焉，不知其不見者，乃子水之天火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769085482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"知乎此，則申子辰水之以午為天火，一而非二，取左手","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769101866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"以例右手可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769101866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫木中有火，鑽燧得之，石為金母，擊","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769118250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"火出之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769118250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"金中有火，摩軋亦生，人所見也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769134634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"其不見者，則為","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769151018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"木之天火，云木老則腐，而火發焉，即鑽木出火，亦木敗","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769151018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"而出火以自焚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769151018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"木敗於金。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769167402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"然則金者，木之天火也，金","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769183786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754650664"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"老則生水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769183786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫金之火，金之少也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769200170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"石者，未成之金也，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769216554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"少於金則火居焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769216554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"土者，又未成之石也，又少於石，則火","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769232938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"更散布漫衍於其中，而草木生之，又為火之母焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769232938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"然則","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769249322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"木者，金之天火無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769249322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"水火之中，冬夏至也，短長各極，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769265706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"而天火轉為一體。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769265706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"金木之中，春秋分也，短長齊等，而天","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769282090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"火轉居兩端。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769282090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"此以見天地之道，其相反者，實一而神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769298474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"其相似者，實兩而化也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769314858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"是故天火亦應逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769331242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"又，天","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769347626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"獄即災煞，今用災煞天獄，應刪。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769347626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754667048"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754683432"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur90xs9/1-SK1619_figure_00160.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=TxGQRic4ej%2FIvVlCSjeCRTyzc04%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur90xs9/1-SK1619_figure_00160.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=OFFwRqbKk38dOELHj%2B%2FH346jKPQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur90xs9/1-SK1619_figure_00160.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754699816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：月殺者，月内之殺神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769364010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌停賓客，興穿","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769380394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"掘，營種植，納羣畜。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769380394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：月煞者，正月起丑，逆行四","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769396778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769396778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：月虚者，月内虚耗之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769413162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開倉庫，出","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769429546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"財物，結婚出行。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769429546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：月虚者，正月起丑，逆行四季。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769445930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"按，在嵗為嵗煞，在月為月煞，無二義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769462314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"圖說巳見嵗神，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769478698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"唯又謂月虚者，蓋亦以月建三合旺氣之對，則必虚耗，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769478698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"猶破日之又名大耗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769478698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754716200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91afd/1-SK1619_figure_00161.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5S3Pq5vKaEr6RksWA%2BZblvROUrQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91afd/1-SK1619_figure_00161.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=SLuzlw7HsRQ {"lines":[{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754732584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"按，月刑之義，與嵗刑同，詳見嵗刑條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769495082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754748968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91n2h/1-SK1619_figure_00162.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vreKvR6aS6a2RJ4aKgwijmaObD8%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91n2h/1-SK1619_figure_00162.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=h0Zj%2B3RLEFAZf3pPJmYVOHBKkDc%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91n2h/1-SK1619_figure_00162.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754765352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：月害者，陽建所害之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769511466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"所値之日，忌攻城","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769527850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"野戰，牧養羣畜，結㑹親姻，請醫巫，納奴婢。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769527850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769544234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"月起巳，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769544234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：月害者，月中六害也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769560618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"假令夘辰相害者，夘以乙旺之木，害辰墓之土，辰以墓","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769577002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"土却害夘中癸水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769577002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳相害者，謂寅以旺甲害巳中","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769593386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"戊土，而巳以生庚害寅中旺甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769593386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午相害者，丑以癸","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769609770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"水害午中丁火，午以巳土害丑中癸水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769609770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"子未相害者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769626154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"子以所生之辛金害未中墓木，未以旺土害子中旺水","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769626154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754781736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769626154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"申亥相害者，亥以生木害申中生土，申以旺金害亥","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769642538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"中生木，又以生土害亥中旺水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769642538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"酉戌相害者，戌以墓","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769658922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"火害酉之旺金，酉以所生丁火害戌中辛金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769658922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：六害者，不和也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769675306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"凡事莫不喜合而忌衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769691690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769708074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，與亥合，而巳衝之，故寅與巳害；二月建卯，與戌合，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769708074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"辰衝之，故卯與辰害。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769708074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋月建者，衆神之首，衝其所合，是","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769724458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"以害也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769724458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"354","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"按六害之義，考原得之震圭，非也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769740842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"年日六害，皆同月害","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769757226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754798120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"取義，故不重列。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769757226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754814504"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91zpl/1-SK1619_figure_00163.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=dOdMRSfszHPsxerTdyX5PmbF4pM%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91zpl/1-SK1619_figure_00163.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2BgtHvUUQ%2BUN4raLWVJdDVX4dKd4%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur91zpl/1-SK1619_figure_00163.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754830888"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子曰：斗柄為小嵗，月從左行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769773610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"咸池為大嵗，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769789994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"正月建夘，月從右行四仲，終而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769789994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"大嵗，迎者辱，背者","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769806378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"強，左者衰，右者昌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769806378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"小嵗，東南則生，西北則殺，不可迎也，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769822762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"而可背也；不可左也，而可右也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769822762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"大時者，咸池也；小時者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769839146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"月建也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769839146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"○神樞經曰：大時者，將軍之象也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769855530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769871914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"出軍、攻戰、築室、㑹親。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769871914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：大時者，正月起夘，逆","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769888298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769888298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大時者，乃月建三合五行沐浴之","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769904682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769904682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋五行至此則敗絶，是㝡凶之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769921066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰大凶之","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769937450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754847272"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"時。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769937450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"按：咸池大時，神樞經有忌無宜，曹震圭以為大凶之時。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769953834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"今考淮南本義，則其義與嵗神大將軍相似。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769970218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754863656"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754880040"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur92ccp/1-SK1619_figure_00164.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=eIrCNA5U6IAkxtNAXUfbgJePwdU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur92ccp/1-SK1619_figure_00164.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kb7H2GtBDOnlctmhUgTZ1Z8IQGM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur92ccp/1-SK1619_figure_00164.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754896424"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：遊禍者，月中惡神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304769986602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌服藥、請醫、祝神、","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770002986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"致祭。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770002986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：遊禍者，正月起巳，逆行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770019370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770035754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：遊禍者，三合五行臨官之神，是對衝刼煞之位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770035754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：遊禍神者，以其流行於四隅，故曰遊；以其過","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770052138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，故曰禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770052138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天干以臨官為禄，而地支以臨官為禍，其義不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770068522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"干，","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770084906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"陽也，支，隂也，陽善而隂惡，故陽以方旺為吉，而隂以方","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770084906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"旺為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770084906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗方不忌陽刃，而忌大煞，義亦類此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770101290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫成","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770117674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754912808"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"定之吉，則取日月三合，不可與是同語矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770117674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754929192"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754945576"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur92ozt/1-SK1619_figure_00165.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4oi0xDyhTT%2BX3%2FmDv8PdzTO5B5M%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0 {"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754961960"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：天吏者，月中凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770134058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌臨官赴任，逺行","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770150442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"詞訟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770150442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天吏者，正月起酉，逆行四仲。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770166826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770183210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天吏者，三合五行死氣之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770183210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"五行至此，死而無氣，乃","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770199594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"天之凶吏，全無生意也，其忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770199594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天吏者，三合之死氣也，故又為致死。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770215978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"司馬遷曰：削木","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770232362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"為吏，義不對。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770232362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"漢酷吏尹賞且死，戒子曰：丈夫為吏，正坐殘","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770248746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"賊免，追思其功効，則復進用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770248746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"一坐軟弱不勝任免，終","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770265130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"身廢棄，無有赦時。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770265130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋吏之心，誠利人之死也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770281514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"為此名","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770297898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754978344"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"者，其為三代以下無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770297898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"如果天吏，則必曰求其生而","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770314282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"不得，則死者與吾兩無憾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770314282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"奈何以致死辱天吏哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770330666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765754994728"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755011112"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur931mx/1-SK1619_figure_00166.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uVZfFS7bvTc0R2kOXCjDTUX8Q%2BQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur931mx/1-SK1619_figure_00166.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kh2H2Ifk9NpqV%2B29KoJiqU7S5YQ%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur931mx/1-SK1619_figure_00166.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755027496"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：六合者，日月合宿之辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770347050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜㑹賓客，結","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770363434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"婚姻，立契劵，合交易。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770363434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：正月在亥，逆行十二","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770379818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925304770379818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：六合者，月建與月將相合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028804662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"○天寳歴曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028821046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"無翹者，翹猶尾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028821046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"陽烏所主，隂則無之，常居厭後，故曰","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028837430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"無翹。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028837430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028853814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：翹猶首翹，婦人之飾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028870198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"無翹者，是無其飾也，故忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028886582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"按：六合、月將、太陽過宫，並見本原及公規卷内。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028902966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"惟是日","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028919350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"乂名無翹，天寳歴以為烏尾，曹震圭以為首飾，其義亦","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028919350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755043880"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"不足取矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028919350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋堪輿家最忌月厭，故以厭前一辰為章光，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028935734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"厭後一辰為無翹，其日皆忌嫁娶，猶嵗神之以嵗前為","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028935734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"羅㬋，嵗後為病符也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028935734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"夫月厭僅值一日，非若方位之相","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028952118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"比連，㫁無因忌一日而并忌前後兩日之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028952118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"且六合天","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028968502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"願，皆宜嫁娶吉日，又以為無翹而忌之，母乃欺世而滋","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028968502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"惑乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028968502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"俗士又名飛翹，更屬譌繆，應刪。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305028984886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755060264"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755076648"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur93ea1/1-SK1619_figure_00167.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0jnz1gyg7yZC5Hfxp%2FqToSY8ATk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur93ea1/1-SK1619_figure_00167.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uTIVVkn0%2Brk9Cepa%2BhEhC5AlUD8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur93ea1/1-SK1619_figure_00167.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755093032"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：兵吉者，月内用兵之吉辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029001270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜出師命","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029017654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"將，攻伐畧地。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029017654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：兵吉者，正月、子、丑、寅、卯；二月、亥、","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029034038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑、寅；三月、戌、亥、子、丑；四月、酉、戌、亥、子；五月、申、酉、戌、亥；","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029034038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"六月、未、申、酉、戌；七月、午、未、申、酉；八月、巳、午、未、申；九月、辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029034038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"巳、午、未；十月、夘、辰、巳、午；十一月、寅、夘、辰、巳；十二月。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029034038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、寅、","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029050422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"夘、辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029050422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：兵吉，逐月漸退一辰者，是兵家無有","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029066806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"妄進，無有躁動之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029066806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"故云：兵者，不祥之器，不得已而用","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029083190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029083190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"又易卦師之六四曰：師左次，旡咎。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029099574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"言左次則為退","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029115958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755109416"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"舍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029115958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"故見可而進，知難而退，師之常也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029132342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"又太白隂經曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029148726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"未見而戰，雖衆必潰；見利而戰，雖寡必勝。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029148726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"是兵家不可","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029165110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"以妄舉輕進，此隂陽之戒也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029165110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755158568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：五富者，富盛之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029247030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜興舉運動估市。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029263414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"經求○歴例曰：正月起亥，順行四孟。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029279798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：五富","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029296182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"者，月中餘盛之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029296182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋寅午戌月火王，喜亥中甲木而","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029312566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"生。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029312566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰月水王，愛巳中庚金而生。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029328950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"亥夘未月木王，求","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029345334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"寅木相助；巳酉丑月金王，求申中庚金相益，故曰餘盛，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029345334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"此其義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029345334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"507","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"按：五富者，三合長生之六合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029361718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌火，火長生於寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029378102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"亥者，寅之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029378102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未木，木長生於亥，寅者，亥之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029394486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755174952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰水，水長生於申，巳者，申之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029410870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑金，金長","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029427254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"生於巳，申者，巳之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029427254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"生我之神，居得合地，則其益我","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029443638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"者必多，故曰五富也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029443638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"或曰：當逆行四孟，其說謂三合，父","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029460022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"母之長生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029460022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌火，以木為父母，木長生於亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029476406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029492790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"未木，以水為父母，水長生於申。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029492790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰水，以金為父母，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029509174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"金長生於巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029509174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"巳酉丑金，以土為父母，土長生於寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029525558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"生我","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029541942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，既得長生，則吉慶莫有大焉者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029541942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"故以五富名之，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029558326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"言無不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029558326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"九五福，二曰富，富固五福之一，五福而皆","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029574710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755191336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"富有，則洵乎其無不足也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029574710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"其說亦通，故附存之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029591094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755207720"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin": {"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755224104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：天倉者，天庫之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029607478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"其日可以修倉庫，受賞","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029623862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"賜，納財牧養。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029623862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：天倉者，正月起寅，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029640246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：倉者，藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029656630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"月建，私藏之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029673014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋建寅之月，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029689398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"天地交泰，隂陽各半而氣同，故共藏於本建。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029689398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"至二月，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029705782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣離，則建事於前，私藏於後，故歴丑逆行至七月，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029705782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"陽否，其氣又同，隂陽各半，亦同藏於申也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029705782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"按太陽在亥，則天倉在寅；太陽在戌，則天倉在丑，每居","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029722166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽後四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029722166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"然則天倉者，太陽之收日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029738550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"建後四辰為","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029754934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755240488"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"收日，神煞起例，以收為天倉，方可互觀而自得也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029754934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"收必","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029771318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"有倉，倉於何所？","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029771318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"必於其六合之地矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029787702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"天倉在寅，則亥為","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029804086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"收日；天倉在丑，則子為收日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029804086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"然則天倉者，又收之六合","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029820470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029820470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫曹震圭建事於前，收藏於後之說，亦太支且遁","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029836854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029836854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755256872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755273256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94g7d/1-SK1619_figure_00170.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=pEir10k1bllfco80r36TpOkyidQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94g7d/1-SK1619_figure_00170.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=h2B43US31cHm4qQYuPZM6cTGjPs%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94g7d/1-SK1619_figure_00170.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755289640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天賊者，月中盜神也，其日忌逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029853238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029869622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天賊者，正月在丑，逆行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029869622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天賊者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029886006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"盜神也，常居天倉後辰，蓋倉庫之後，必有盜也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029886006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"按天賊","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029902390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"者，月厭之收日也，常居厭後四辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029902390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭逆行，天賊亦逆","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029918774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"行，故建之平，乃厭之收。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029918774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"建所為前，乃厭所為後也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029935158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029951542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"主隂私。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029951542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"國語曰：天事恒象厭，所收必天賊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305029967926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755306024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94suh/1-SK1619_figure_00171.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ngUumyjkSqzm%2FNzEEpsBc6ci31E%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94suh/1-SK1619_figure_00171.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NL535VZ%2B%2BT4p8kdZIzJ43S3CzyM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur94suh/1-SK1619_figure_00171.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
