{"lines":[{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755519016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：聖心者，月中福神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876217897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜上表章，行恩澤，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876234281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"營百事。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876234281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：聖心者，正月亥，二月巳，三月子，四月","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876250665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"午，五月丑，六月未，七月寅，八月申，九月夘，十月酉，十一","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876250665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"月辰，十二月戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876250665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：勞而不敢安者，聖人之心","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876267049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876267049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋陽辰之月，順理陽卦之位；隂辰之月，順理隂卦之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876283433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"位。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876283433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"初寅之月，起於乾宫亥者，是順天之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876299817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876316201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"正、三、五、七、九、十一為陽建之月，故從亥至辰，配乾、坎、艮、","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876316201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"震四陽卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876316201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"二、四、六、八、十、十二為隂建之月，故從巳至戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876332585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755535400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"配巽、離、坤、兌四隂卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876332585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755551784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755568168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur979c9/1-SK1619_figure_00178.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=5zNC%2B9GFRHNsaRDXL%2BeRKIGrwxw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur979c9/1-SK1619_figure_00178.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZQEqp%2BU7xxZxWnIGMlQCdDoQfHg%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur979c9/1-SK1619_figure_00178.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755584552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：益後者，月中福神也，所值之日宜造宅舍，築","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876348969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"垣墻，行嫁娶，安産室。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876348969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正月子，二月午，三月丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876365353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"四月未，五月寅，六月申，七月夘，八月酉，九月辰，十月戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876365353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月巳，十二月亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876365353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：益後者，於子嗣有補","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876381737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"益之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876381737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"子、丑、寅、夘、辰、巳為陽氣之位，以陽建之月配","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876398121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876398121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"午、未、申、酉、戌、亥為隂氣之位，以隂建之月配之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876414505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876430889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹和，既生男女，當夫訓其男，婦教其女，使男從夫道，女","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876430889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"從婦道，各從其道，當有益於將來，故云益後。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876430889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755600936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97lzd/1-SK1619_figure_00179.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MpcTcZDlJcVX3DASx2YlsfNBSwk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97lzd/1-SK1619_figure_00179.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3eOTZnGKujT2Ud57yrJlxUkj85k%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97lzd/1-SK1619_figure_00179.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755617320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"樞要歴曰：續世者，月中善神也，所值之日宜結婚姻，睦","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876447273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"親族，祀神祗，求嗣續。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876447273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：續世者，正月丑，二月未，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876463657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"三月寅，四月申，五月夘，六月酉，七月辰，八月戌，九月巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876463657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"十月亥，十一月午，十二月子是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876463657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：按續世者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876480041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"月中繼續之神也，常在益後後一辰，蓋亦與玉宇金堂","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876480041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"之相連者同意。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876480041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"○又按：自要安至續世凡九神，其起例","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876496425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"皆以六隂月與六陽月對衝，如正月寅，則二月申，正月","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876496425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"夘，則二月酉是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876496425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876512809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"725","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"右要安以下九神，皆以對衝兩兩相比，或陽月陽，隂月","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876545577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，或陽月隂，隂月陽，從寅月寅起，至寅月丑止，取其九","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876545577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"位，而去其寅月巳、午、戌三位不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876545577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"或又以寅月從巳、午、","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876561961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"戌起，如例歴十二辰者，為龍虎，為罪至，為受死，皆為凶","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876561961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"神，而以此九位為吉神，雖有其例，而莫名其物，衆說紛","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876561961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"然，皆不明確。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876561961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"夫神之有凶吉也，皆本年月日神所喜所","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876578345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之隂陽五行以為㫁，或以三合、五合言，或以六合、六","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876578345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755650088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"冲言，或以納音、納甲言，或以卦位方位言，或以旺相休","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876578345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"囚言，千變萬化，要皆不離乎此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876578345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"而此以寅申夘、酉兩兩","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876594729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"相比，以命十二辰，則皆不可得而符合也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876594729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"史記：漢武帝","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876611113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"時，有五行家、堪輿家、建除家、叢辰家、歴家、天人家、太一","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876611113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"家，聚訟不決，各守其師傳而不相下。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876611113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"彼時術家之多如","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876627497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"此，今則統歸於歴家。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876627497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"其說之傳者，皆㫁爛蒙昧，莫尋其","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876643881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"端緒。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876643881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿、建除、五行、歴家，猶可意揣而命之，若叢辰等","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876660265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"家之言，則更莫可考也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876660265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"今此九神與堪輿、建除、五行、歴","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876676649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755666472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"家之旨，俱不符合，意者其叢辰等家之遺緒歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876676649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"而傳之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876693033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"最乆，歴代相沿不廢，用於禱祠鬼神，而亦為建造等事","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876693033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"之吉日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876693033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"唯歴神原始則曰此九神專為祈禳而設。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876709417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"今觀","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876725801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"其命名之義，且參之禮記柔日、剛日之旨，其說殆近是","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876725801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876725801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"存之以為祭祀擇日之占，而樞要歴所言上表章修","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876742185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"造諸事者，並不復用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876742185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫龍虎、罪至、受死三辰，並仍舊","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876758569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"歴從刪。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876758569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"夫既以九神為吉，則餘三不用可知，不必重立","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876774953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"名目也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876774953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"又按神煞起例，以龍虎、罪至為天地爭雄日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876791337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"由","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876807721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755682856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"此觀之，九神為禱祀鬼神而設益騐。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876807721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋己午者，隂陽之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876824105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"交也，故有天地争雄之目，而又南方正位也，故與幽則","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876824105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"有鬼神之義相反。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876824105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"其戌之為受死者，亥為陽氣剥盡之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876840489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，而乾之純陽居之，以首萬物，此隂陽之妙義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876840489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"六𡈼之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876856873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"以𡈼名，而不曰六甲者，此也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876856873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"亥既為首，則戌必居終，故","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876873257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"以戌為受死也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876873257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"然此特以六陽六隂十二辰，從寅輪轉","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876889641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"而命之云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876889641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"若自寅而夘，以至于丑，逐月論之，則義並","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876906025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"不可通。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876906025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"夫唯鬼神之道，有其始之即要其終，不若人事","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876922409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755699240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"之顯著，事各一理，而不可稍有差忒也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876922409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰宜祭祀之","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876938793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"吉辰，庶幾近之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876938793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"○要安，言徼福於鬼神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876955177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"金堂玉宇，神","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876971561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"所居也，修祠立廟之類用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876971561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"内神以金堂，而外神以玉","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876987945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"宇也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305876987945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"敬安，安神位之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877004329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"普䕶，福生，聖心泛禱之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877020713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"益後續世，祠高禖之日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877037097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755715624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755732008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97ymh/1-SK1619_figure_00180.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=09oq8wuoknsi3WVLNA5a6J6cHIQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97ymh/1-SK1619_figure_00180.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=VfJA7%2B%2F9GnQwrHP7J4syOwdD2V8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur97ymh/1-SK1619_figure_00180.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755748392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：陽徳者，月中徳神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877053481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜交易開市","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877069865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"結親姻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877069865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正月起戌，順行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877086249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877102633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳者，乾陽之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877102633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"陽道不可以盡剥，故正月起戌，應","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877119017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"乾之上九。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877119017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"戌者，乾之世爻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877135401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"又五月一隂生，即配於午，順","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877151785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"歴乾之六爻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877151785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"六陽月居於寅午戌，火炎上，為尊為夫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877168169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"六隂月臨於申子辰，水潤下，為卑為婦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877184553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"故所值之日，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877200937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"長幼有序，夫婦有别，是嘉㑹合禮之辰，故宜如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877200937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755764776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur98b9l/1-SK1619_figure_00181.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Rm%2FkkKY5UUmSHFNx1AJKeDC8Nvg%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur98b9l/1-SK1619_figure_00181.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NmapT%2BYju2akScbtzlnrvOjUUzw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur98b9l/1-SK1619_figure_00181.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755781160"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：隂徳者，月内隂徳之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877217321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，宜施隂","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877233705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"隲，行恵愛，雪寃枉，舉正直。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877233705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：正月起酉，逆行六","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877250089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"隂辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877250089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：隂徳者，是月中坤隂之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877266473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877282857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"於酉，應坤之上六。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877282857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，坤之世爻，故從酉逆歴坤之六","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877299241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"爻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877299241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"坤者，厚徳載物也，含𢎞光大，萬物資生，故宜如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877315625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"按：陽徳，乾六爻之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877332009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"隂徳，坤六爻之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877348393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":557,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877364777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"者，日月也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877364777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"各從夘酉起初爻，以歴十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877381161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳夘月乾","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877397545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"初子，隂徳夘月坤初未，陽徳辰月乾二寅，隂徳辰月，坤","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877397545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755797544"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"二巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877397545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳巳月，乾三辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877413929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"隂徳巳月，坤三卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877430313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳午月，乾","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877446697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"四午。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877446697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"隂徳午月，坤四丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877463081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"陽徳未月，乾五申。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877479465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"c {"lines":[{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755846696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：天馬者，天之驛騎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877659689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜拜公卿，擇賢良，","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877676073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"宣布政事，逺行出征。","logicSentenceId":"7678925305877676073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：天馬者，正月起午，順","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161266731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161266731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天馬者，是乾體六陽用事之神","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161283115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161283115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"易曰：乾為馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161299499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755879464"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：兵禁者，用兵凶辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161397803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌出師振旅，閱武","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161414187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"教戰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161414187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：兵禁者，正月起寅，逆行六陽辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161430571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161446955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"圭曰：兵家所利者，隂道也，所忌者，陽道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161446955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"故兵禁正月","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161463339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"起寅，逆行六陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161463339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"又月令曰：孟春之月，不可稱兵，稱","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161479723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"兵必天殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161479723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"兵戎不起，不可從我始。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161496107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"故正月以寅為禁辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161512491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925 tenceId":"7678925306161676331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月，辰，四煞天罡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161692715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161709099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161709099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"911","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"按易曰：地中有水，師。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161725483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"說者謂伏至險于大順之中，王者","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161741867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"之師所以有征無戰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161741867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"兵禁則與卦義相反。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161758251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"夫坎之六","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161774635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"爻，納甲寅辰午申戌子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161774635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"今自坎之初爻翻轉至上，倒","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161791019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"行而逆施之，是以其至險顯然，横行于天下矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161791019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"若由乾","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161807403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"坤以日月為用之義推之，則卯月起坎，上爻逆行而下，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161807403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非坎之所為上六失道，凶三嵗者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161807403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"從上而至初，係","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161823787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755912232"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"用徽纆，而入于坎窞，豈非兵 {"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755961384"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：地囊者，正月庚子、庚午，二月癸未、癸丑，三月甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161840171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"子、甲寅，四月己夘、己丑，五月戊辰、戊午，六月癸未、癸巳，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161840171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"七月丙寅、丙申，八月丁夘、丁巳，九月戊辰、戊子，十月庚","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161840171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、庚子，十一月辛未、辛酉，十二月乙酉、乙未。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161840171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161856555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：月令云：孟春之月，天氣下降，地氣上騰，天地和，草木","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161856555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"萌動。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161856555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋草木者，震也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161872939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"故易云動萬物者，莫疾乎雷。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161889323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"故正","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161905707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"月震納甲為地囊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161905707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"仲春之月，雷乃發聲，蟄蟲咸動，啟","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161922091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"户始出，當養生者，徳莫比坤，故二月用坤之納甲，為地","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161922091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755977768"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"囊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161922091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"季春之月，時雨將降，下水上騰，覆育萬物，莫大於","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161938475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"天，故用乾之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161938475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"孟夏之月，農乃登麥，聚畜百藥，靡","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161954859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"草死，蠶事畢，能烜燥萬物者，莫熯乎火，故四月用離之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161954859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161954859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"仲夏之月，隂陽争，死生分，雩祀山川百源，設坎","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161971243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"壇，無用火南方，故使萬物潤澤者，莫潤乎坎，故五月地","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161971243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"囊用坎之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161971243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"季夏之月，不可以興土功，土潤溽暑，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161987627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"大雨時行，燒薙行水，利以殺草，如以熱湯，可以糞田疇，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161987627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"可以美土疆，以配中央之位，故用坤之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306161987627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"孟秋之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162004011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765755994152"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"月，農乃登穀，萬物有成，用始行戮，故易曰：萬物之所以","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162004011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"成終而所以成始也，莫盛乎艮，故用艮之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162004011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"仲秋","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162020395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，務蓄菜，勸種麥，雷乃收聲，蟄蟲坏户，隂浸盛，陽日","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162020395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"衰，莫說乎澤，故用兌之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162020395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"季秋之月，蟄蟲咸俯在","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162036779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"内，皆墐其户，霜始降，草木黄落，農事備收，五穀之實，藏","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162036779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"帝藉之收于神倉，是萬物之所收蔵也，莫勞乎坎，故用坎之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162036779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162036779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"孟冬之月，天氣上騰，地氣下降，閉塞而成冬。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162053163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"水","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162069547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"始氷，地始凍，雉入大水為蜃，虹藏不見，反動於下也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162069547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162085931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765756010536"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"用震之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162085931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"仲冬之月，氷益堅，地始坼，芸始生，茘挺","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162102315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"出，蚯蚓結，土事無作，隂陽争，諸生蕩，萬物潔齊。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162102315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"故用巽","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162118699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162118699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"季冬之月，數已終，歳更始，水澤腹堅。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162135083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"修耒耜，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162151467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"耦耕，具田器，出土牛，以送寒氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162151467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"其徳厚載而致役者，莫","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162167851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"大乎坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162167851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"故用坤之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162184235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765756108840"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"總要歴曰：土符，土神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162659371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌破土、穿井、開渠、築墻。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162675755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162692139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：土符者，正月丑，二月巳，三月酉，四月寅，五月午，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162692139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"六月戌，七月夘，八月未，九月亥，十月辰，十一月申，十二","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162692139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"月子。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162692139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：土符者，乃土地握符信之神，使掌五","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162708523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162708523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"假令春木旺，土受其尅，故托子金以制之，是春三","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162724907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"月歴巳酉丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162724907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"夏火旺土休，頼火為母以飬之，故夏三","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162741291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"月歴寅午戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162741291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":679,"li {"lines":[{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"按：曹震圭以土符為符信之義，似也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162790443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"而以夏為土休，秋","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162806827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"為土相，則于五勝之義舛焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162806827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天之生物，皆地生之者","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162823211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故十二辰無非土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162823211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物生於東，旺於南，收于西，藏","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162839595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"于北。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162839595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"而由北而東，則土之所以終萬物、始萬物者也；由","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162855979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"南而西則土之所以盛美昌熾夫萬物者也；由西而北","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162855979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"則土之所以伏藏保固夫萬物者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162855979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"寅巳申亥，長生之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162872363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"位，則以丑寅卯辰為其長生之符；子卯午酉，帝旺之位，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162872363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765756141608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"則以巳午未申為其帝旺之符；辰未戌丑，收藏之位，則","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162872363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"以酉戌亥子為其收藏之符，故曰土符也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162872363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"其有所忌者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162888747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"亦猶月建之為土府，尊之，故不敢犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306162888747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765756157992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9af49/1-SK1619_figure_00187.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YWIiRsJvFRaQ6yWb3YHKHqAWInY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9af49/1-SK1619_figure_00187.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wt6eCnYA0Z12DSqG7RwI0UApqHI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9af49/1-SK1619_figure_00187.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋謂陽氣將出，萬物將生，故巡察西方，無以妄殺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878574635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"夘、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878591019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353765756190760"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":707,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、巳月歴南方巳午未者，謂萬物生長之時，故巡察南","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878591019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"方，使有成熟也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878591019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"午、未、申月歴東方寅、卯、辰者，謂萬物成","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878607403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"熟，宜在養育也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878607403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、戌、亥月歴北方亥、子、丑者，謂萬物收","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878623787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"成，使有斂藏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878623787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426767394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴曰：歸忌者，月内凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878672939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌逺行、歸家、移徙、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878689323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"娶婦。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878689323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：孟月丑，仲月寅，季月子。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878705707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：子","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878722091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":719,"lineType":1,"content":"者一陽，丑乃二陽，寅乃三陽，蓋此三辰陽氣始盛，主動","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878722091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"於外，不可反歸於内也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878722091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：孟月忌丑，仲月忌寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878738475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"季月忌子者，皆忌退後一辰，所謂歸忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878738475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"如子為仲，丑","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878754859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"為季，寅為孟，故孟月忌退歸於季，仲月忌退歸於孟，季","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878754859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":723,"lineType":1,"content":"月忌退歸於仲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878754859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"後漢書郭鎮傳曰：陳伯敬行必矩步，坐必端膝，還觸歸","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878771243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426783778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，則止寄鄉亭。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878771243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"注曰：隂陽書歴法曰，歸忌日，四孟在丑，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878787627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1117","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲在寅，四季在子，其日不可逺行、歸家及徙也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878787627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1118","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"然則","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878804011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1119","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"歸忌之說，其來舊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878804011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1120","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭與考原所云俱有理，而其","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878820395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1121","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"旨未暢。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878820395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1122","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋子一陽也，丑二陽也，寅三陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878836779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1123","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"陽主進，隂主","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878853163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1124","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"退，今丑退於子，寅退於丑，卯退於寅，是逆陽之道也，故","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878853163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1125","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"為歸忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878853163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1126","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"餘月倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878869547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1127","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：歸忌與飛廉同義，子丑寅為支","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878885931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1128","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"辰之始。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878885931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1129","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"子旺之始也，丑墓之始也，寅生之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878902315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1130","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申、巳、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878918699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"亥四生之月，歸忌在丑，是忌生之退歸於墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878918699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、午、酉、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878935083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426800162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1134","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"子四旺之月，歸忌在寅，是忌旺之退歸於生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878935083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1135","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、未、戌、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878951467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1136","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"丑四墓之月，歸忌在子，是忌墓之退歸於旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878951467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1137","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"故其日","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878967851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1138","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"忌逺逥移徙。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878967851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1139","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"廣聖歴謂并忌嫁娶者，蓋以婦人謂嫁曰","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878984235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1140","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"歸，而忌之夫謂嫁曰歸，明從夫之義云耳，非逺行之歸","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878984235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1141","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306878984235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1142","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"易漸卦彖辭曰：女歸吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879000619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1143","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"漸，進也，非退也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879017003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1144","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：女子有","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879033387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1145","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"行，行亦進也，非退也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879033387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1146","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"漢書注及他通書亦無忌嫁娶之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879049771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1147","lineNum":741,"lineType":1,"content":"說，應止忌般移逺逥，不忌嫁娶。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879049771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1148","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426816546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1149","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9b4eh/1-SK1619_figure_00189.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=XvpjpSq%2FsT5Nl%2BRCXZ5jJZHXx%2Bw%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9b4eh/1-SK1619_figure_00189.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=uxbMZtOR0u4p5BtjJCacXnwP12Y%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9b4eh/1-SK1619_figure_00189.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1150","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426832930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1151","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：往者，去也，亡者，無也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879066155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1152","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌拜官上任，逺行","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879082539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1153","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"歸家，出軍征討，嫁娶尋醫。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879082539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1154","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：徃亡者，正月在寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879098923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1155","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"二月在巳，三月在申，四月在亥，五月在夘，六月在午，七","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879098923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1156","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"月在酉，八月在子，九月在辰，十月在未，十一月在戌，十","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879098923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1157","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"二月在丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879098923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1158","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：往亡者，往而不反之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879115307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1159","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"孟者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879131691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1160","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"初也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879131691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1161","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"仲者，中也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879148075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1162","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"季者，末也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879164459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1163","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋嵗之始、中、終之意也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879180843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1164","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"正、二、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879197227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1165","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"三、四月，乃歳之初，皆以四孟辰為之，乃五行初生之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879197227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1166","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"是生氣之道往而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879197227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"五、六、七、八月，乃嵗之中，皆以四","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879213611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426849314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"仲辰為之，蓋四仲者，五行當旺之辰，是旺氣之道往而","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879213611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879213611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"九、十、十一、十二月，乃嵗之終，皆以四季辰為之，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879229995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"四季者，乃五行終墓之地，是萬物皆歸往而亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879229995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書曰：宋武帝以往亡起兵，軍吏以為不可。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879246379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"帝曰：我","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879262763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"往則彼亡，果克之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879262763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"由此言之，可廢明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879279147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"今按隂陽之義，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879295531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"無非慎微謹始，以昭欽若之忱，不必以一事之無驗，而","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879295531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"遽謂其可廢也，亦思其理之當否而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879295531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"往亡者，寅午戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879311915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"火月順行寅卯辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879311915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、未亥，木月順行巳、午、未，辰、申、子，水","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879328299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426865698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"月順行申、酉、戌，巳、酉、丑，金月順行亥、子、丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879328299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"火性遂於木，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879344683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"木性遂於火；水性遂於金，金性遂於水。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879344683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"木生火而火焚","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879361067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"木，金生水而水沉金。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879361067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋無尅則生不生，無制則化不化，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879377451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"無貞則元不能以起也，故曰往亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879377451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"微乎深哉！","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879393835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426882082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9bh1l/1-SK1619_figure_00190.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FyL%2BRTDHHqnp%2F%2FpOjMUbCuZDLSY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9bh1l/1-SK1619_figure_00190.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=bZJA9JVWSyxCbH0Ekos4ZGU3NHs%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9bh1l/1-SK1619_figure_00190.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426898466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：氣往亡者，立春後七日，驚蟄後十四日，清明後","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879410219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"二十一日，立夏後八日，芒種後十六日，小暑後二十四","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879410219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"日，立秋後九日，白露後十八日，寒露後二十七日，立冬","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879410219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"後十日，大雪後二十日，小寒後三十日，皆自交節日數","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879410219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879410219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：氣往亡者，以四立月徃亡日，三合化象","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879426603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"之成數為之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879426603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"假令正月立春，寅為往亡，寅午戌合火局，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879442987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"火之成數七也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879442987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"四月立夏，夘為往亡，亥夘未合木局，木","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879459371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"之成數八也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879459371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"七月立秋，酉為往亡，巳酉丑合金局，金之","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879475755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426914850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"成數九也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879475755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"十月立冬，未為往亡，土無化象，便以本行土","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879492139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"為之，其成數十也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879492139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"各倍之，為次月往亡日，三之，為下月","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879508523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"往亡日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879508523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"獨水數不用者，蓋四立之月往亡無申、子、辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879524907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879524907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"然一嵗之内，四季之月以辰為首，辰月以申為往","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879541291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，申合水局，水之成數六也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879541291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"故三月中氣後六日，九月","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879557675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"中氣後十二日，六月土旺後十二日，十二月土旺後十","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879557675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"八日，各得往亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879557675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"或節氣早晚間有差一日者，然其理大","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879574059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"槩如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879574059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806426996770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：上朔日，忌宴㑹、嫁娶、逺行、上官。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879819819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：陽","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879836203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"年以年干加寅，順數至亥；隂年以年干加丑，順數至巳","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879836203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879836203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：丑寅者，艮卦之方也，萬物始終之所也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879852587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"巳者，陽極之辰；亥者，隂極之辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879868971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"故陽有生發萬物之功","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879885355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"者，寅也；隂有成終萬物之道者，丑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879885355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"以陽而來㑹於極","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879901739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，以隂而往㑹於極陽，則非其相㑹之道也，其忌可知。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879901739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"按上朔日為不吉者，惡其隂陽與徳俱盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879918123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"陽盡於亥，","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879934507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"隂盡於巳，干盡於十。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879934507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲年以甲為徳，甲至癸而十，甲","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879950891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427013154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"年之癸而又臨於亥，則癸為徳盡，亥為陽盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879950891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"乙年以","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879967275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"庚為徳，庚至巳而十，乙年之巳而又臨於巳，則巳為徳","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879967275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"盡，巳為隂盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879967275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306879983659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"其以上朔名者，朔有始義，又","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880000043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"有盡義。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880000043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"尚書：平在朔易。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880016427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"正義曰：朔，盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880032811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427029538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"75273538
