{"lines":[{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427062306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"後漢書王符傳曰：公車以反支日不受章奏。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880049195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"注曰：反支","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880065579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"日，用月朔為正。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880065579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥朔一日反支，申、酉朔二日反支，午、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880081963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"未朔三日反支；辰、巳朔四日反支；寅、夘朔五日反支；子、","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880081963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"丑朔六日反支。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880081963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"見隂陽書也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880098347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"○歴例曰：其日忌上表章。","logicSentenceId":"7678925306880114731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"按：反支之義，惡其將盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885125674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、亥朔，本日即支，將盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885142058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"申、","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885158442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"酉朔，則在二日，午、未朔，則在三日。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885158442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"胥同此例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885174826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"推此而","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885191210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"言，則結㛰姻、納財等事，亦必有應忌者。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885191210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"而歴例止言忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885207594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"上表章，蓋古之隂陽書，傳者蓋少，而今歴例則轉據後","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885207594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427078690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"漢書公車不受奏章而言忌上表章也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885207594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門經曰：離者，隂陽分至前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885240362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"謂建夘之月，陽氣","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885256746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"出，隂氣入；建子之月，隂氣降，陽氣升；建酉之月，隂氣出，","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885256746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"陽氣入；建午之月，陽氣降，隂氣升。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885256746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"故先一日為四離辰","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885273130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885273130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：此日忌出行征伐。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885289514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：四離者，","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885305898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至前一日，水離；夏至前一日，火離；春分前一日，陽體","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885305898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"分，而木亦離也；秋分前一日，隂體分，而金亦離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885305898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"故名","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885322282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"曰四離。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885322282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427127842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"玉門經曰：四絶者，四立前一辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885338666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：此日忌","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885355050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"出軍逺行。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885355050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":849,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：立春木旺水絶；立夏火旺木絶；","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885371434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋金旺土絶，立冬水旺金絶，故先一日為絶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885371434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：月忌日，止註祭祀、宴㑹、沐浴、整容、剃頭、整手足","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885404202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":853,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、求醫療病、補垣、掃舍宇、修飾垣墻、平治道塗、破屋壞","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885404202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"垣，餘事不註。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885404202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"○齊東野語曰：俗以每月初五、十四、二十","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885420586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"三日為月忌，凡事必避之。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885420586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"其說不經。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885436970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":855,"lineType":1,"content":"後見衛道夫云：聞","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885453354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427144226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"前輩云，此三日即河圖之中宫，五宫五數耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885453354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":857,"lineType":1,"content":"五為君象，","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885469738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"故民庶不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885469738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"此說頗有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885486122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"○通書曰：俗忌初五、十四、","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885502506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"二十三，以五黄值日，配廉貞火，生起中宫之土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885502506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":859,"lineType":1,"content":"其法","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885518890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"每月初一日起一白水入中宫，與貪狼木相配，水木相","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885518890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885518890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"初二日，二黑土與巨門土相配，比和也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885535274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":861,"lineType":1,"content":"初三日，三","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885551658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"碧木能制禄存土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885551658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"初四日，四緑木與文曲水相生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885568042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":863,"lineType":1,"content":"初五日，五黄土配廉貞火，火加中宫之土，火生土旺，火","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885584426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"晦土湮而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885584426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":864,"lineType":1,"content":"初十、十九又起一白貪狼，至十四、二十三","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885600810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427160610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"又值五黄廉貞。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885600810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"前輩云：此俗忌之日，有吉星可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885617194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"○考","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885633578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"原曰：九宫之次，自一白至九紫。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885633578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":867,"lineType":1,"content":"九星之次，一貪狼，二巨","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885649962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"門，三禄存，四文曲，五、廉貞，六武曲，七破軍，八左輔，九右","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885649962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"弼，故其相配如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885649962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"又以其日為九五之數，自初一至初","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885666346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"五，五數也；自初五至十四，自十四至二十三，皆距九日，","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885666346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"世不敢用，故忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885666346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"按：月忌之義，中宫五黄之說皆為得之，而廉貞生土之","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885682730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"說，則不可信。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885682730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"今宫殿衙署有穿堂坐向用正子午，家居","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885699114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427176994"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"則不敢用。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885699114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"又以太嵗為堆黄煞，皆避尊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885715498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":875,"lineType":1,"content":"以卑犯尊則","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885731882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，非以其為廉貞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885731882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"月忌之義，亦猶夫是。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885748266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"國家亦不用","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885764650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"是日者，國有事必及臣民，故亦不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885764650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353806427193378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":879,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷六","logicSentenceId":"7678925307885781034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816298546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"神樞經曰：青龍、明堂、金匱、天德、玉堂、司命，皆月内天黄","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398326811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"道之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398326811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"所值之日，皆宜興衆務，不避太嵗、將軍、月刑，","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398343195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"一切凶惡自然避之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398343195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"天刑、朱雀、白虎、天牢、元武、勾陳者，","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398359579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"月中黑道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939002398359579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"所理之方，所值之日，皆不可興土功，營屋","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142945326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"舍、移徙、逺行，嫁娶、出軍。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142945326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"○李鼎祚曰：青龍正月起子，金","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142961710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"匱正月起辰，司命正月起戌，皆順行六陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142961710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂正","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142978094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"月起丑，天德正月起巳，玉堂正月起未，皆順行六隂辰","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142978094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142978094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"天刑者，正月起寅，白虎者，正月起午，天牢者，正月起","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142994478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816314930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"申，皆順行六陽辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754142994478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"朱雀者，正月起卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143010862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"元武者，正月起","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143027246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143027246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳者，正月起亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143043630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"皆順行六隂辰也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143060014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：此","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143076398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"天黄道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143076398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天者，萬物之主。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143092782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"黄者，中央之色。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143109166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"道者，乃天","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143125550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"皇居九重之内，出入所履之道也，故名曰天黄道。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143125550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"其神","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143141934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"逐年月日各有所主。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143141934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"易傳云：乾為天，為君，為父，是天皇","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143158318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"之正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143158318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"主御羣靈，司萬物生死，故曰司命。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143174702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"亦能掌握","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143191086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"萬物，故又名曰天符，今皆作天府。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143191086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"此乾卦之主也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143207470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"初行","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143223854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"其道起於戌，是乾之世爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143223854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"其對衝巽宫，為明堂，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143240238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816331314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"是天皇治事之宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143240238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"聖人南面而聽天下，故以巽為明","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143256622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143256622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"又名曰執儲，是天皇所操執，以除暴虐也，故曰齊乎","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143273006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"巽。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143273006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於丑，是巽之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143289390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"其明堂之左","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143305774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"有青龍，宰相之象，是震宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143305774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"震為雷，為龍，故曰青龍，又","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143322158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰雷公。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143322158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於子，是震之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143338542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"其明","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143354926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"堂之前有朱雀，是離宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143354926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰飛流，故離為火，朱雀飛","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143371310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"流之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143371310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於卯，是離卦初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143387694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"其明堂","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143404078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"之右有白虎，將軍之象。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143404078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天棒是天皇之先驅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143420462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143436846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816347698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天馬是天皇之所乘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143436846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於午，是震卦外","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143453230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"體之納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143453230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"謂震為大臣之象，向外則為將軍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143469614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"其天","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143485998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"皇之右有玉堂，是天皇寢安之宫，天后之位，是坤宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143485998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天玉是天皇寵愛之所。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143502382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於未，是坤之","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143518766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143518766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇之左有金匱，是寳蔵之府庫，艮之位","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143535150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143535150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天寳初行其道起於辰，是艮卦初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143551534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143567918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"皇右旁有天德，兑也，是天皇施仁布德喜樂之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143567918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143584302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"天對是天皇納諫聽政論道經邦之所。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143584302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143600686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816364082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"巳，是兑之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143600686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇左旁有天刑，坎也，勞卦也，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143617070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"是掌刑罰之所。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143617070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：蚩尤，蚩尤者，虐民之神。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143633454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143649838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"起於寅，坎之初爻納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143649838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎天棒之後有天牢。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143666222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143682606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"天獄是囚禁之所也，配之朱雀明堂之間，葢使刑禁明","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143682606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"而無私也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143682606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於申，是坎之外體納甲也，故云","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143698990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"勞乎坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143698990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇、天牢之間有元武。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143715374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：隂私是邪妄之","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143731758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"臣，故論正道必有讒言，舉正直則邪妄亦進。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143731758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"易卦爻辭","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143748142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"半君子半小人，則天下之道然也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143748142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"初行其道起於酉，是","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143764526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816380466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"離卦外體納甲也，故離為朱雀、飛流，皆小人之輩也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143764526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"中","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143780910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"宫之位有勾陳，是天皇嬪妃之位，天帝之所居也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143780910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"初行","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143797294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"其道起於亥，是乾宫之隂辰，兑宫之外體納甲也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143797294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"葢兑","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143813678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"者，説也，是天皇喜悦之宫也，故用配焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143813678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：青龍即雷","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143830062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"公，明堂即執儲，金匱即天寳，天德即天對，玉堂即天玉，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143830062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"司命即天府，天刑即蚩尤，朱雀即飛流，白虎即天棒，天","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143830062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"牢即天岳，元武即隂私，土勃即勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143830062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"○邵泰衢曰：黄道","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143846446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"明星十二神，異，其名為二十四龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143846446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"雷一也，而一吉一凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143862830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816396850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"天獄，凶也，而字誤為嶽。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143879214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"不知即建、除、滿、平、定、執、破、危、成、","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143895598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"收、開、閉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143895598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"今人以除、危、定、執、成、開為黄道，建、破、平、収、滿、","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143911982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"閉為黒道。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143911982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"除即明堂黄道，破即白虎黑道，皆相合。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143928366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"獨青","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143944750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"龍之建而以為黒道者，雷公之凶誤之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143944750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"以天獄之黑","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143961134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"道曰黄道者，天岳之吉誤之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143961134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"不知此即長生、沐浴、冠","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143977518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"帶、臨官、帝、旺、衰、病、死、墓、絶、胎、養也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143977518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"建危即生死也，在時","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143993902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"曰建危，在人曰墓，在物曰成，所謂葢棺而論定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754143993902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"建危","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144010286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"以時候言，生死以蠢動言也，黄道、明堂則其神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144010286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"人之","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144026670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816413234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"初生，時之建立，猶龍雷之出震也；人之入墓，時之巳成，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144026670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"如天獄之囚牢也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144026670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"人物之胎，有開之先也，而曰司命，命","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144043054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"根之由立也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144043054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"閉固則養之之道，而勾陳之土所以藏之","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144059438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144059438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"總不出王、相、休、囚之四者，分之為王官、守建、除、滿、長","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144075822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"生、沐浴、冠帶、青龍、明堂、天刑、雷公、執儲、蚩尤，名雖異而","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144075822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"其理固不異也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144075822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"干支之生死，以長生、沐浴言之，四時十","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144092206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"二月之建立，以建除言之，日時之吉凶，以青龍、雷公言","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144092206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"之，更以王相卜之，未常非合一之旨也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144092206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"擇日之家，不能","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144108590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816429618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"類觀兼察，泥執神煞之名以立異，而并不察其誤，各自","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144108590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"異説，欲自名家，幾何不為識者之所棄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144108590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"建除等皆次","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144124974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"第行黄道，以六陽六隂行，故人不悟也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144124974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：黄黒","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144141358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"二道者，黄道六，黑道六，共十有二，以配十有二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144141358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"一青","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144157742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"龍，二明堂，三天刑，四朱雀，五金匱，六天德，七白虎，八玉","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144157742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"堂，九天牢，十元武，十一司命，十二勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144157742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"其法則寅申青","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144174126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"龍起子，卯酉起寅，辰戌起辰，巳亥起午，子午起申，丑未","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144174126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"起戌，順行十二辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144174126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"月起日，則建寅之月，子日為青龍，丑","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144190510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816446002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"日為明堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144190510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"日起時，則子日申時起青龍，酉時為明堂，依","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144206894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"次順數。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144206894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"按神樞經載黄黑道十二神，厯來通書用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144223278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"顧此十二","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144239662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"神之何以吉，何以凶，則未言其故。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144239662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"通書又専用之以選","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144256046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"時，相沿日久，終身由之而不知其道。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144256046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭作明原，則","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144272430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"以為納甲，而斥坎離為小人，荒唐不經已甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144272430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"邵泰衢作","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144288814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"原始，以為與建除相配，而不顧六陽六隂十二神各得","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144288814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"一半，萬不能與建除相合，徒多遁詞。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144288814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"此考原所以疑之，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144305198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816462386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"而存而弗論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144305198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"今按司命即是子，勾陳即是丑，青龍即","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144321582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"是寅，明堂即是卯，天刑即是辰，朱雀即是巳，金匱即是","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144321582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"午，天德即是未，白虎即是申，玉堂即是酉，天牢即是戌，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144321582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"元武即是亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144321582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以天罡加於建上，視各神所臨之辰，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144337966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"神吉則吉，神凶則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144337966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡者，厭對也，招摇也，六儀也，隨","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144354350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"所取義而異其名，其實一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144354350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"所以用天罡加建者，天罡","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144370734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"為北斗，臨制四方之柄，故以加建。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144370734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"擇日則加月建，擇時","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144387118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"則加日建，此神道之樞機也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144387118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"罡既加於陽建，則破必指","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144403502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816478770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"於隂建矣，此隂陽之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144403502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"罡指陽建，則陽明用事；破","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144419886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"指隂建，則隂慝伏藏。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144419886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"於是視其日其時所履之神，以定","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144436270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144436270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅月日罡為辰，加陽建，破為申，指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144452654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"申月","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144469038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"日，罡為戌，加陽建，破為寅，指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144469038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"則寅、天刑，卯、朱雀，辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144485422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱，巳、天德；午、白虎。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144485422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"未、玉堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144501806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"申、天牢，酉、元武，戌、司命，亥、","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144518190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳，子、青龍，丑、明堂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144518190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"卯月日，罡為卯，加陽建，破為酉，","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144534574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144534574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"酉月日，罡為酉，加陽建，破為卯，指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144550958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"是為伏","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144567342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"吟。","logicSentenceId":"7678942754144567342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"則卯、明堂，辰、天刑，巳、朱雀。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091202610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"午、金匱，未、天德，申、白虎。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091218994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091235378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816495154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"玉堂，戌、天牢，亥、元武，子、司命，丑、勾陳，寅、青龍矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091235378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"午月日，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091251762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"罡為子，加陽建，破為午，指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091251762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"子月日，罡為午，加陽建，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091268146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"破為子，指隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091268146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"是為反吟。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091284530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"則午、司命，未、勾陳，申、青龍，酉、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091300914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"明堂；戌、天刑，亥、朱雀；子、金匱，丑、天德，寅、白虎。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091300914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"卯、玉堂，辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091317298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"天牢，巳、元武矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091317298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"餘月日倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091333682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"竒門所謂月月常加戌，時","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091350066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"時建破軍，亦即此義。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091350066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"葢用建則月月常加戌矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091366450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"言昏時","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091382834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"斗柄所指之方，當以天罡加之，便得起例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091382834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"又此司命","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091399218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"以下十二神，向以黄道、黑道命之，今按，黄道為日行躔","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091399218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816511538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"度，無只以子、午、卯、酉、寅、未為黄道之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091399218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"若黑道之説，葢","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091415602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"不見經傳，即黄、赤二道亦厯家識於儀象以紀天度，後","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091415602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"世相沿以為名稱，豈天真有此黄、赤異色耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091415602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"然則此所","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091431986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"為黄黑道云者，亦即吉凶之别名，而非有深義決矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091431986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"子","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091448370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：司命子位正當天極，斗衡所枕，為斗之中央，故曰司","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091448370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"命也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091448370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋文耀鈎曰：北宫黑帝，其精元武。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091464754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為天門，故","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091481138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"以為北帝之坐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091481138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為北方之始，寅為東方之始，巳為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091497522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"南方之始，申為西方之始，四神之名各於其始，重始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091497522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816527922"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"丑者，建星之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091513906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"建星者，旗也，故為勾陳，猶鹵簿也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091530290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"東方","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091546674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"蒼龍寅為攝提格，日月始子，則斗始寅，嵗且更始焉，故","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091546674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"寅為青龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091546674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"春秋說題辭曰：房心為明堂，天王布政之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091563058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"房心，卯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091579442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"房南衆星，左角，理；右角，將，當辰之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091595826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"理者，法","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091612210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"官。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091612210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"故辰為天刑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091628594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"辰者，天罡。" 5,"lineType":1,"content":"者，實在於庚伏之㑹，中央土之正位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091776050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"坤作成物，其致","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091792434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"役者未而非申，至於申則役休矣，故以未為天德。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091792434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"天德","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091808818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"云者，乾知大始而不為首，成之者皆坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091808818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"能使坤之克","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091825202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"有成，則天德也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091825202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"西宫白虎，參為白虎，在申，故以白虎名","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091841586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"申。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091841586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"酉者，月也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091857970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"卯為明堂，故以酉為玉堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091874354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"帝主日而后主","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091890738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"月，玉堂猶言後宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091890738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"史記律書曰：戌者，言萬物盡滅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091907122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"漢書志曰：畢入於戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091923506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"金者殺氣，戌又金行之終，故河魁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091939890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816560690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"為天獄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091939890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"合而觀之，子、午、卯、酉，天之四正，洗心退藏，基","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091956274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"命宥宻，必於子，則古昔法先王，嚮明而出治，復有以垂","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091956274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"百世之法，則，必於午。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091956274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"出乎震，說乎兑，如日月東西相從","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091972658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"而不巳，以先天而不違，後天而奉天時，必於卯酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091972658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"無成","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091989042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"而有終，終則有始，觀天地之生物，必於寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150091989042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"服中色而處","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092005426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"下飾，順承天德，觀天地之成物，必於未。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092005426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"餘辰莫有可與","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092021810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"比盛者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092021810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"故以六辰為黄道，餘則曰黑道也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092038194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"又按，三合","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092054578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"旺氣曰天德，此黄道亦名天德，以無别為嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092054578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"查天德黄","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092070962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816577074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"道，又名天對明星，又名寳光天對，名不雅馴，故取名寳","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092070962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"光，以别於天德云。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092070962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816593458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816609842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9dkw9/1-SK1619_figure_00196.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=R1Js6frIF4F3k%2BfI9aMPp%2BCwBk8%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pi {"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816626226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"蠡海集曰：天乙貴人，當有陽貴隂貴之分。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092087346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"葢陽貴起於","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092103730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"子而順，隂貴起於申而逆。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092103730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"此神實得隂陽配合之和，故","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092120114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"能為吉慶，可解凶厄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092120114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"且如陽貴以甲加子，甲與巳合，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092136498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"所以巳用子為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092136498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"以乙加丑，乙與庚合，所以庚用丑","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092152882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092152882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"以丙加寅，丙與辛合，所以辛用寅為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092169266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"以丁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092185650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"加卯，丁與𡈼合，所以𡈼用卯為貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092185650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"辰為天罡貴人不","logicSen },{"lineId":"375","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092365874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"乃隂貴逆取也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092365874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"古云丑未為天乙貴人出入之門，縁陽","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092382258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"貴以甲起子，循丑順行，至癸復歸於丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092382258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"隂貴以甲起申，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092398642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"由未逆行，至癸復歸於未。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092398642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"豈非丑未為貴人出入之門","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092415026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816675378"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092415026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：天乙者，乃紫微垣左樞傍之一星，萬神","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092431410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"之主掌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092431410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"一日二者，隂陽分治内外之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092447794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌為魁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092464178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"罡之位，故貴人不臨。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150092 {"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"考原曰：曹氏與通書二說各有意義，但曹氏則以陽為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141845542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，以隂為陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141845542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"夫陽順隂逆，陽前隂後，自然之理也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141861926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"當以","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141878310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"起未而順者為陽，起丑而逆者為隂方是。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141878310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"按，貴人云者，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141894694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"干德合方之神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141894694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"何以不用干德而用其合？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141911078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"干德，體也，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141927462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"合則其用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141927462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"合干之德，其所用必大吉矣，故以貴人名","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141943846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141943846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"合方之論，攷厯書所載審矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141960230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"而曹震圭隂陽順逆倒","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141976614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"置者，則世俗並如其說。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141976614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"攷其根原，則以元女經有旦大","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141992998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816773682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"吉、夕小吉之文故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150141992998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"然其理良不可通，則亦未得以元","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142009382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"女經有其文而可遽信也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142009382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"且大小二字易以淆譌，安知","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142025766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"非淺學之人轉以俗說改竄元女經，遂傳刻襲謬耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142025766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"至","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142042150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"其晝夜之分，則或以卯酉為限，或以日出入為限。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142042150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"今攷","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142058534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"其義，自當以日出入為定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142058534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816790066"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","li {"lines":[{"lineId":"530","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"按，酉中有辛，甲之官也，故甲日酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142091302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"申中有庚，乙之官也，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142107686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"故乙日申。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142107686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"子中有癸，丙之官也，故丙日子。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142124070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"亥中有𡈼，丁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142140454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"之官也，故丁日亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142140454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"卯中有乙，戊之官也，故戊日卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142156838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"寅中","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142173222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"有甲，巳之官也，故巳日寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142173222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"午中有丁，庚之官也，故庚日","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142189606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"午。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142189606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"巳中有丙，辛之官也，故辛日巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142205990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未中有己，𡈼之官","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142222374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"也，故𡈼日丑。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142222374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"未。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142238758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌中有戊，癸之官也，故癸日辰戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142255142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142271526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"取五䑕遁者，伏藏者，為貴為官。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142271526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"顯露者，為尅為伐也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142287910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816839218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ea6h/1-SK1619_figure_00198.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=X8ZrZLzDzMiLLtEWotePsjcqnag%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ea6h/1-SK1619_figure_00198.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ZTwziN%2F0X1gP009wjynnj2nuvJ8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ea6h/1-SK1619_figure_00198.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816855602"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例日干生時干，曰福星貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142304294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"553","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"按，淮南子：甲日寅時，必為丙寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142320678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日丑時、亥時，必為丁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142337062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、丁亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142337062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"丙日子時、戌時，必為戊子、戊戌。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142353446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"丁日酉時，必為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142369830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142369830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"戊日申時，必為庚申。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142386214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"己日未時，必為辛未。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142402598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"庚日午","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142418982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"時，必為𡈼午。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142418982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日巳時，必為癸巳。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142435366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼日辰時，必為甲辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142451750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"癸日卯時，必為乙卯。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142468134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"皆本日日干之食神子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142484518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"子孫為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142500902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"寳爻，故曰福星貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142500902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816871986"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9emtl/1-SK1619_figure_00199.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=A5DK1hudTLCTkor%2FdmRWzw9Pb4g%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9emtl/1-SK1619_figure_00199.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2FBygOPQHjbSrCp9hjWAKD1%2FQAdE%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9emtl/1-SK1619_figure_00199.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816888370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳日，艮方寅時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142517286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚日，乾方戌時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142533670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛日，坤方申時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142550054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼日，離方午時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142566438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸日，巽方辰時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142582822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：大抵","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142599206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"物之所喜者，母見子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142599206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲巳化土生金為子，金之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142615590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"所居者，丑也，丑近於艮。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142615590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛化水生木為子，木之所居","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142631974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"者，未也，未近於坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142631974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸化火生土為子，土居於辰，近於","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142648358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142648358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金生水為子，水居於辰，辰既有土，故居於","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142664742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"乾，乾為亥子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142664742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼化木生火為子，火旺於午離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142681126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142697510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"攷原曰：物以相見為喜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142697510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"易傳曰：相見乎離。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142713894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"離者，南方之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142730278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816904754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"卦也，於五行為火，於十干為丙。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142730278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"喜神者，見丙也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142746662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"假令甲","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142763046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"巳之干用五虎，元起丙寅，寅為艮，故在艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142763046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚之干","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142779430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙戌，戌為乾，故在乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142779430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛之干得丙申，申為坤，故","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142795814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"在坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142795814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼之干得丙午，午為離，故在離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142812198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸之干","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142828582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"得丙辰，辰為巽，故在巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142828582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"按：喜神之義，攷原得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142844966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"其日之方與其時，並取利用，然","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142861350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"亦須與其他神煞叅論。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142861350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲巳之日得丙寅時，固為喜","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142877734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"神時矣，而在申日，則為日破，又不得以其為喜神而用","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142877734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816921138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142877734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142894118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816937522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ezgp/1-SK1619_figure_00200.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=26vWyJoDjrkeSbN%2FJ8ISaOBn64w%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ezgp/1-SK1619_figure_00200.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1w%2Fm6D93EkwSMgKQ5
