{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816953906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"按神煞起例有八禄時，本日之禄位也，定為吉時，詳年","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142910502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"神例。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142910502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816970290"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9fc3t/1-SK1619_figure_00201.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=GT7vvY9s4ZuerxdYv7aLmXhpm7k%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9fc3t/1-SK1619_figure_00201.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=NDxXb9nXw0cCTzUjn38GW%2BeAP60%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9fc3t/1-SK1619_figure_00201.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839816986674"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"以本日地支為主，而以時叅之，或為日之建，或為日之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142926886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"破，或為日之合，或為日之害，或為日之刑，建合則吉，而","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142926886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"破、刑、害則凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142926886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"其與年月相參，亦必有此五者，逺大之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142943270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"事，亦須參觀，近小之事，則勿論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142943270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817003058"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9foqx/1-SK1619_figure_00202.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=iGI5sKzmemWJ04iotd1ISGUOy%2F0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9foqx/1-SK1619_figure_00202.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=tu%2F%2BZcwkfnkorpLI6RuLEqes8HU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9foqx/1-SK1619_figure_00202.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817019442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：四大吉時，月將在四孟，用甲、丙、庚、𡈼時；月將在","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142959654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲，用癸、乙、丁、辛時；月將在四季，用艮、巽、坤、乾時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142959654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"○攷","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142976038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"原曰：四煞者，寅午戌火煞在丑，亥卯未木煞在戌，申子","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142976038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"辰水煞在未，巳酉丑金煞在辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142976038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"凡取四煞沒時者，以月","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142992422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"將加時，使四煞臨乾、坤、艮、巽之位，為四煞沒於四維。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150142992422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"正、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143008806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"四、七、十，四孟月，用甲、丙、庚𡈼時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143008806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"二、五、八、十一，四仲月，用","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143025190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"艮、巽、坤、乾時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143025190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"三、六、九、十二，四季月，用癸、乙、丁、辛時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143041574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"如正","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143057958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"月月將在亥，則以亥加甲，或加丙，或加庚，或加𡈼。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143057958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"依二","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143074342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817035826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"十四方位順推之，則辰戌丑未四煞皆臨四維卦位，是","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143074342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"為四煞沒時也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143074342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"以四煞既沒，故又曰四大吉時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143090726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"647","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"按，辰戌丑未謂之四煞者，以其為五行之氣所終盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143107110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨長生之位，則是生生不已，循𤨔無端，故謂之四煞","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143123494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"沒時，即𡈼課四墓覆生之說也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143123494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"其以八干四卦言者，則","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143139878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡謂時之上四刻，其說得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143139878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"葢選擇取時之通","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143156262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"例，而非此四煞沒時，獨與八干四卦相干涉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150143156262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"俗又以","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196060198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"此為神藏煞沒時，則因煞沒二字而至譌謬。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196060198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"葢惟貴登","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196076582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817052210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"天門，則餘十一將皆居其所，凶神受制，吉神得位，為名","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196076582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"之曰神藏煞沒。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196076582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"若四煞沒時，甫將十二支加於地盤，尚","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196092966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"未論及於神將，安得有神藏煞沒之理？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196092966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家不叅𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196109350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"遁之過也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196109350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817232434"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：經云：年之善，不如月之善；月之善，不如日之善；","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196125734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"日之善，不如時之善。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196125734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人登天門，乃時之最善者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196142118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"其","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196158502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"法以月將加用時，晝用陽貴，夜用隂貴，以天乙貴人為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196158502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"主，而螣蛇、朱雀、六合、勾陳、青龍、天空、白虎、太常、元武、太","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196158502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"隂、天后隨之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196158502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"故貴人臨乾亥登天門，則螣蛇臨𡈼子而","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196174886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"落水，朱雀臨癸丑而鎩羽，六合臨艮寅而乗軒，勾陳臨","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196174886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"甲卯而登陛，青龍臨乙辰而游海，天空臨巽已而投匭，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196174886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎臨丙午而燒身，太常臨丁未而登筵，元武臨坤申","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196174886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817248818"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"而折足，太隂臨庚酉而回宫，天后臨辛戌而入帷。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196174886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"六吉","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196191270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"將得地，而六凶將斂威，故曰神藏煞沒，又為六神悉伏，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196191270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"此擇時之妙用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196191270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"○又曰：貴人己丑土，六合乙卯木，青","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196207654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"龍甲寅木，太常己未土，太隂辛酉金，天后𡈼子水，為六","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196207654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"吉將。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196207654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇丁巳火，朱雀丙午火，勾陳戊辰土，天空戊戌","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196224038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"土，白虎庚申金，元武癸亥水，為六凶將。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196224038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"按貴登天門為選時第一義，其月將加時貴人隂陽順","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196240422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"逆，皆六𡈼法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196240422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"日家未知𡈼遁之法，故誤以四煞沒時","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196256806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817265202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"為神藏煞沒，而貴登天門之說錯襍於其間，觀者遂不","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196256806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"可曉。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196256806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"今為取而序之，則知神藏者，安於其居之義，郭璞","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196273190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂藏神合朔，宗鏡所謂歸垣入局是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196273190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"煞沒者，隠而","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196289574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"不現之義，通書所謂六凶斂威，六神悉伏是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196289574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"乾亥為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196305958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"天門，貴人居之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196305958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"六合木而臨艮寅，青龍木而臨乙辰，太","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196322342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"常土而臨丁未，太隂金而臨庚酉，天后水而臨辛戌，皆","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196322342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"各得其位，當旺受生，故曰神藏。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196322342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"螣蛇朱雀火而臨𡈼子、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196338726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"癸丑，勾陳天空土而臨甲卯、巽巳，白虎金而臨丙午，元","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196338726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817281586"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"武水而臨坤申，皆不得其位，受制潛伏，故曰煞沒。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196338726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"然皆","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196355110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"由貴登天門而得之，故貴登天門即神藏煞沒，而非有","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196355110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"二義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196355110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"一日只有一時，然貴分隂陽，又卯酉辰戌時兼","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196371494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"占晝夜，故一日有兩時者。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196371494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"其或晝不得陽，夜不得隂，則","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196387878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一日不得一時者。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196387878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"今既按日起例於前，而又於總","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196404262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"括七百二十課貴登天門時為表於左。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196404262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":12,"content":"","logicSentenceId":"0","table":{"head":"","rows":[{"cells":[{"paraList":[{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"春分戌將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"穀雨酉將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"小滿申將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至未將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"大暑午將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"處暑巳將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分辰將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false},{"lines":[{"lineId":"","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"霜降卯將。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}],"cellType":2,"rows":1,"cols":1}]}]},"marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"741","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"如雨水後甲日卯時，以月將亥加甲卯，則陽貴未加乾","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196453414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"亥，是陽貴登天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196453414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"又如雨水後甲日酉時，以月將亥","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196469798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"加庚酉，則隂貴丑加乾亥，是隂貴登天門也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196469798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以日","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196486182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"干為主，以貴人加乾亥上，視某月將加某時，即某時貴","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196486182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"登天門。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196486182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日陽貴在未，加乾亥上，看旦時雨水亥將","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196502566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817330738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"加甲卯，即雨水後甲日卯時陽貴登天門；大寒子將加","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196502566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"乙辰，即大寒後甲日辰時陽貴登天門。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196502566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"又如甲日隂貴","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196518950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"在丑，加乾亥上，看夕時雨水亥將加庚酉，即雨水後甲","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196518950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"日酉時隂貴登天門；大寒子將加辛戌，即大寒後甲日","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196518950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"戌時隂貴登天門。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196518950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此例。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196535334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"至宗鏡以𡈼時為子時上","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196551718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"四刻，則與雙山法合，而取義尤切。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196551718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"如乾為天，貴登天門，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196568102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"取乾非取亥也；朱雀鎩羽，取癸非取丑也；天空投匭，取","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196568102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"巽非取巳也；元武折足，取坤非取申也；天后入帷，取辛","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196568102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817347122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"非取戌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196568102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"然雙山以干維與支同宫，故六𡈼用支，亦謂","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196584486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"神藏煞沒，則知二十四時之法，由來舊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196584486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"後世失其義，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196600870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"謂乾時為戌正二刻至亥初二刻，亥時為亥初二刻至","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196600870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"亥正二刻，𡈼時為亥正二刻至子初二刻，子時為子初","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196600870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"二刻至子正二刻。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196600870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"以十二支占十二時之中四刻，而以","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196617254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"前後各二刻分隸前後干維，似亦有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196617254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"然乾巽為天門","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196633638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"地戸，隂陽之界，貴人順逆所由分。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196633638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"若以乾為戌正二刻，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196650022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"則乾淪於隂，貴罹於網，而螣蛇以下諸神，皆當逆轉，又","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196650022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817363506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"烏覩所謂貴登天門，神藏煞沒者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196650022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817379890"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817396274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9k93d/1-SK1619_figure_00215.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=4xYRJPA%2Fhc0J6d4B9o579RT395Y%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9k93d/1-SK1619_figure_00215.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=0fMyzlf0lozvXufA7zwbz2c1bm8%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9k93d/1-SK1619_figure_00215.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817412658"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞起例，五不遇時，干尅日干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196666406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"按五不遇時，以五䑕遁得本時所臨之干，尅本日之干，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196682790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"則為凶時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196682790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"而遁甲隠公歌注則又以本時尅本日之支，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196699174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"亦為五不遇。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196699174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"今攷其義，不若神煞起例之善，亦列圖而","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196715558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"辨之如左。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196715558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817429042"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9klqh/1-SK1619_figure_00216.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=%2B%2FOPQjPjxdbwcmpcPIgl1b1YN%2FQ%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9klqh/1-SK1619_figure_00216.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3TI9CO44JiIKRSb1BtrwJlFW%2Fdw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9klqh/1-SK1619_figure_00216.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352839817445426"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲隠公歌：時尅干兮五不遇，此時名為辱損明。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196731942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"舉事","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196748326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"遥遥終不定，朝行暮敗損精兵。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196748326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"注曰：時干尅日干，時支","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196764710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"尅日支，名為損明，凡事不用，如甲乙日、庚辛時，亥子日、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196764710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌時，寅卯日、申酉時之類並是。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196764710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"798","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"按，天干五行氣純，地支五行氣雜，如寅中有火，則遇土","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196781094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"日，有相生之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196781094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之性，逢生即生，而見尅不尅，此天","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196797478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"地之性也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196797478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"故干尅干，斯純而不雜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196813862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"然尚須論其所臨之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196830246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"支，是否與日干、日支相生。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196830246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"如其相生，則又不為五不遇","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196846630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363508250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196846630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"焉得以土日寅卯時即為五不遇耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196863014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363622938"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱經曰：乙者，雷電始發之日；戊巳者，北辰下位之日；","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196879398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"辛者，萬物決斷之日；𡈼者，三光不照之日。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196879398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉，四","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196895782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"仲之辰，日月之門，隂陽之界。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196895782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"五干臨此四辰，其日不可","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196912166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"出軍、嫁娶、移徙、築室。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196912166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：卯酉為日月出入之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196928550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"門，子午為隂陽交争之界，乙為六合，辛為太隂，𡈼為元","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196928550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"武，己為六賊，戊為勾陳。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196928550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"故此五干加此四辰，名曰醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196944934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196961318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"以五干四辰，其共數九，故以名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196961318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"○指掌賦曰：乙戊己","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196977702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，𡈼同四仲，名曰九醜，天地歸殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196977702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"注：凡戊子、戊午、𡈼子、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196994086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363639322"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼午，乙卯、己卯、辛卯、乙酉、己酉、辛酉日而大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150196994086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"又臨日","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197010470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"辰子午、卯酉上者，為真九醜卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197010470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"葢乙是雷電始動之","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197026854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"日，震而不安。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197026854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"戊己是諸神下位之日。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197043238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"又戊己為坤，諸神","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197059622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"清虚之氣，合德于乾，轉入坤維，曰下位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197059622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼是三光","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197076006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"不照之位，𡈼禄在亥，六隂俱足，日月之光，至此損照。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197076006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"辛","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197092390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"是西方殺物之位，如何又居在四仲極隂位上？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197092390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉，是","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197108774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫神之主，為貴人之本家，所以為星紀，言諸星朝","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197108774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"會於斗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197108774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"今又臨四仲極隂之位，是為九醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197125158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"九，陽數，九","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197141542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363655706"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"醜，言陽之醜也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197141542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"按，辰戌為天羅地網，子午卯酉為四敗，丑為星紀。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197157926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"惟此","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197174310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"十日，支既為四敗，而星紀又落於支上，則干又必遭羅","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197174310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"網矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197174310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"否則其干本屬羅網，且羅網又必臨四敗，是以謂","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197190694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"之天地歸殃。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197190694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"若丑不臨支，則皆不然，自不得為九醜也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197207078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"乙戊己辛𡈼合子午卯酉為九，故曰九醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197223462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭之說","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197239846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197239846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"必大吉臨日辰，乃為九醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197256230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"指掌賦注得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197272614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"若其九","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197288998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"醜之義，則皆支離牽强，無足取也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197288998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"十二月將，每日各得","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197305382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363672090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"一時，合計七百二十日，内有一百二十時為九醜，餘並","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197305382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197305382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"如圖内一層為月將，外一層為所得之時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197321766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"假如内","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197338150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"一層為子，則是大寒、立春也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197338150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"戊子日，則丑時為九醜；戊","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197354534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"午日，則未時為九醜。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197354534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197370918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363688474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363704858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9mpl5/1-SK1619_figure_00222.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2c9hKQjGAacDq3OJnat3ykdB5S0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9mpl5/1-SK1619_figure_00222.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=sHfW2lWuqgeB8BPGDDUJXSe1GAM%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9mpl5/1-SK1619_figure_00222.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363721242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：旬中空亡者，甲子旬，戌、亥時；甲戌旬，申、酉時；甲","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197387302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"申旬，午、未時；甲午旬，辰、巳時；甲辰旬，寅、卯時；甲寅旬，子、","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197387302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197387302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原曰：十日為旬，以十干配十二支，自甲至癸","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197403686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"而止，餘二辰天干不及，故為空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197403686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子至癸酉，不及","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197420070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"戌亥，故甲子旬以戌亥為空，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197420070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"891","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"按劉歆七畧有風后孤虚二十卷，今其書亡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197436454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197452838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空為虚，其對為孤，如甲子旬中無戌亥，則戌亥為虚，","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197452838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"辰巳即為孤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197452838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"兵法曰：背孤擊虚，一女可敵十夫。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197469222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"又按","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197485606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363737626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中空亡云者，就一旬之内，十干不及之二支而言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197485606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡固不利矣，然猶有火空則發，金空則鳴之義，隨五","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197501990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"行之性與所遇之事以為斷，未可盡以為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197501990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"況又從空","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197518374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"亡而論日禄，如甲辰旬内寅卯之類，謂之禄陷空亡，而","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197518374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"又以甲辰、乙巳本日之寅、卯二時，謂之十惡大敗無禄","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197518374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"時，益屬無謂。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197518374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲辰日寅時，乙巳日卯時，即巳得本日","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197534758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"之禄矣，而以其為旬空也，而謂之無禄，豈非騎驢覔驢","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197534758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"之誚耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197534758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲辰本旬内寅、卯時，而本日為丙丁，則尤為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197551142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363754010"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"他人之無禄，何與於己？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197551142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"而亦謂為禄陷空亡而忌之，豈","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197567526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"不謬哉！","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197567526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363770394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9n289/1-SK1619_figure_00223.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Q2%2FQ5VEbJQoV%2FHuD%2BjQzh9yA%2Fe0%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9n289/1-S {"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363786778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：截路空亡者，甲巳日，申、酉時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197583910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚日，午、未時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197600294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197616678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"辛日，辰、巳時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197616678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼日，寅、卯時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197633062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸日，子、丑、戌、亥時。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197649446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"○攷","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197665830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"原曰：截路空亡，遇𡈼癸也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197665830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"行路而遇水，則不可行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150197682214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489661491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳日以五䑕遁起，甲子順歴之，得𡈼申癸酉，故甲巳","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489661491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"日以申酉為截路空亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489661491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150 {"lines":[{"lineId":"929","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"按：截路空亡之義，謂十干至此而極，其下二支即是旬","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489694259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"空，便如下臨無地，故曰截路空亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489694259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"其說載於神煞起","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489710643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"例，以五䑕遁取日干遁支，得甲乙則無吉無凶，得丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489710643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363803162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"則為喜神，得戊己則為五鬼，得庚辛則為金神，得𡈼癸","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489710643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"則為截路空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489710643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"通書惟取截路空亡一種，今推其義，葢","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489727027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"由竒門最重丙丁，故忌𡈼癸尅之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489727027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"若以行路遇水為","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489743411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"截，則方之舟之可矣，何截之有？","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489743411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353627363819546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷七","logicSentenceId":"7678944150489759795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textInd {"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"按：嵗禄者，嵗干臨官方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116093467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"五行之性，臨官吉於帝旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116109851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116126235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官則方盛，而帝旺則太過矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116126235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"故禄命家以臨官為禄，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116142619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"而帝旺為刃。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116142619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇家亦有嵗刃之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116159003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"天官非之語見附","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116175387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"錄。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116175387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"日禄，見本條。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116191771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"月神皆從支取，故獨無月禄例。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116208155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728099903"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：馬到山頭人富貴，禄到山頭旺子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116224539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢禄馬","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116240923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"一同到，千祥百福自駢臻。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116240923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：禄馬貴人，山","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116257307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"方皆吉，在本遁内者有力，遁外次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259116257307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：先以五虎遁，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823472678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"尋本年祿馬干支為真祿馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823472678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"次以月建入中宫，尋本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823489062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"真禄馬在何宫，即以吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823489062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728312895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：通天竅乃楊救貧真訣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823767590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"凡修造、塟埋、開山、立向、","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823783974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"修方，若遇吉星所值，不問太嵗、三煞、官符、大將軍諸凶","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823783974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，此星並能壓之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823783974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"其法只用八干四維，求年月日時吉","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823800358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"星所到之處，修之大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823800358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"其例則用雙山五行，各從本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823816742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"三合長生起，迎財、進寳、庫珠順行三位，其對衝三位為","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823816742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823816742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"進田、青龍，共為十二吉山，利用本年三合，及其對","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823833126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"衝月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823833126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書云：通天竅只用八干四維，而其例又用雙山兼","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823849510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728329279"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支，雖有異同，而於理無害。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823849510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"至其從嵗三合長生起，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823865894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"迎財、進寳、庫珠三星，并取對宫大吉、進田、青龍三星為","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823865894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"吉者，葢三合本方為大煞之位，對方為三煞之位，長生","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823865894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"前三位則為三合後方，其對宫則為三合前方，不犯大","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823865894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"煞、三煞諸凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823865894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰年，大煞在子，三煞在巳午未，從","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823882278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"三合長生起例，則迎財在坤申，進寳在庚酉，庫珠在辛","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823882278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，其對宫艮寅為大吉，甲卯為進田，乙辰為青龍，自不","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823882278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"犯大煞、三煞、坐煞、向煞諸凶是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823882278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"用本年三合月日時","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823898662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728345663"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"者，月日時皆不犯三煞、諸凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823898662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"然惟子、午、卯、酉年為然，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823915046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年不可概論。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823915046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"如申年太嵗在申，寧可以迎財為吉乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823931430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年太嵗在辰，寧可以青龍為吉乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823947814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"是其能壓太嵗之","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823964198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"說，既不可為典要，又自不犯三煞，則能壓三煞之說，更","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823964198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"屬有名無實。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823964198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"此宗鏡所以詆其不足為據也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823980582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"但與走馬、","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823996966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":136,"lineType":1,"content":"六𡈼並傳已久，世俗稱為竅馬，而亦不害於理，故存之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259823996966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"惟迎財、進寳諸名，殊不雅馴，今質名之曰三合前方、三","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824013350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"合後方，庶為例明義正。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824013350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"坊本又以三合本方為大州牢、","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824029734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728362047"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"小縣獄、小重喪，對方為小火血、大火血、大重喪，使十二","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824029734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"宫各有名色，尤為俗惡無理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824029734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"臺本不載，葢刪之也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824046118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"220","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"按三元之義未詳，而四利方則載於通書年表，八凶方","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824291878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"皆載於時憲書。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824291878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"今以各義例推之，太嵗、嵗破，不敢犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824308262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"喪門、弔客，則合拱嵗破以衝太嵗者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824324646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"官符、白虎，則三","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824341030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"方弔照太嵗者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824341030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"病符，舊太嵗也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824357414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"死符，舊嵗破也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824373798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"惟太","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824390182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728558655"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在太嵗之前，方興未艾。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824390182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"龍德在嵗破之前，安吉無虞。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824406566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂、福德，界乎太嵗、嵗破之間，不衝不照，其吉固宜。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824422950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824439334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃從太嵗起例，猶日之有建除，故宗鏡又有以四利","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824439334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"配建除之說。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824439334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"若以三合而論，則辰戌丑未年之太陽又","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824455718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"為劫煞，寅申己亥年之福德亦為劫煞，太隂又為天官","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824455718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"符，子午卯酉年之龍德又為嵗煞，不可以吉言矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824455718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"故須","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824472102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"兼㸔各神，未可執一而定也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824472102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728575039"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728591423"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ufpl/1-SK1619_figure_00244.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=1RQ7FAjp3z4kneAaelm%2B24oebFg%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbur9ufpl/1-SK1619_figure_00244.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-w {"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728607807"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"葢山黄道起於青囊九曜，以本年支對宫之卦為本宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824488486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"用小遊年變卦法，貪狼為黄羅，巨門為天皇，文曲為紫","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824488486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"檀，武曲為地皇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824488486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年屬坎，對宫為離，即以離為本宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824504870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼在震，巨門在兌，文曲在坤，武曲在巽。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824504870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"又依九曜納","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824521254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"甲三合之法，庚、亥、未並屬於震，丁、巳、丑並屬於兌，乙納","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824521254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"於坤，辛納於巽是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824521254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年倣此，","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824537638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":205,"lineType":2,"content":"法見本原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：其方開山","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824537638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"立向修營並吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935259824537638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"起例則止取八卦，不用納甲三合
