{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"攷原曰：甲子年正月中宫起八白，葢年前十一月甲子","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811822126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"起一白，十二月起九紫，故本年正月起八白也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811822126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"三年而","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811838510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"一週，葢三年三十有六月，以月數十二，與宫數九，俱可","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811838510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"以度盡也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811838510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"故以子、午、卯、酉年為上元，正月起八白；辰、戌、","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811854894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353826728788031"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、未年為中元，正月起五黄；寅、申、巳、亥年為下元，正月","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811854894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"起二黑。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811854894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"逐月逆轉，亦以其月所值星入中宫，順布九宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811871278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"與年九星同。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811871278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"按遯甲之法，冬至上元甲子起坎一，乙丑、坤二，丙寅、震","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811887662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"三，丁卯、巽四，戊辰、中五。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811887662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"己巳、乾六，庚午、兌七。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811904046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"辛未、艮八，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811920430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼申，離九。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811920430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉復坎一。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811936814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"以次順數，甲戌、坤二，甲申、震三，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811953198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午、巽四，甲辰、中五。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811953198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"甲寅，乾六。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811969582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"至中元甲子，則起兌七，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811985966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"下元甲子，則起巽四，歴六甲復為上元甲子，又起坎一，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811985966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321597482"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"此順行九宫者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906811985966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"九星之法：上元甲子一白入中宫，乙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812002350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"丑九紫，丙寅八白，丁卯七赤，戊辰六白，己巳五黄，庚午","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812002350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"四緑，辛未三碧，𡈼申二黑，癸酉復一白。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812002350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"以次逆數，甲戌","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812018734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"九紫，甲申八白，甲午七赤，甲辰六白，甲寅五黄。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812018734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"中元甲","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812035118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"子四緑，下元甲子七赤。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812035118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"歴六甲復為上元甲子，又一白","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812051502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"入中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812051502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"此逆行九宫者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812067886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"究之九星亦係順行，星順行","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812084270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"而前，則入中宫之星自逆轉而後。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812084270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"修造之法，以入中宫","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812100654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"之星為主，而順布於八宫，故自上元甲子起，一白逆行，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812100654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321613866"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"而得其年入中宫之星，其實九星皆順行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812100654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"攷原之說","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812117038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812117038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"至月九星，以子、午、卯、酉年為上元，辰、戌、丑、未年為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812133422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"中元，寅、申、巳、亥年為下元，則其例亦是，其法亦簡明，而","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812133422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"其義則不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812133422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"葢花甲一週，方為一元，三元既週，方復為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812149806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"上元。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812149806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"今上元甲子年嵗前十一月甲子，一白入中宫，十","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812166190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"二月乙丑，九紫入中宫，正月丙寅，八白入中宫，固已。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812166190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812182574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"至次年乙丑，又次年丙寅，則各歴十有二月，不得為一","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812182574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"元。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812182574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"再至次年丁卯，共歴三十有六月，其正月為𡈼寅，花","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812198958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321630250"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"甲未滿一週，尚不得為一元，更不得復為上元也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812198958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"今按","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812215342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子年正月丙寅，中宫八白，是為上元，以次逆數，乙丑","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812215342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"年正月戊寅，五黄；丙寅年正月庚寅，二黑；丁卯年正月","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812215342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼寅八白，戊辰年正月甲寅五黄；至己巳年正月復為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812215342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅，中宫乃得二黑，是為中元。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812215342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌年正月復為丙寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812231726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"中宫乃得五黄，是為下元；至己卯年正月丙寅，中宫又","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812231726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"得八白，復為上元。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812231726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"如此則與竒門甲巳為符頭，子午卯","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812248110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"酉為上元，寅申巳亥為中元，辰戌丑未為下元之義合，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812248110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321646634"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"而其例則不如三年一週之為便。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812248110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"故月九星入中宫之","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812264494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"法，仍用三年一週，第不用三元之名，而明其義如此，庶","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812264494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"義例兩得云。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812264494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321810474"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：天上三竒乙丙丁者，出於貴人之干德，遊行十","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812280878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"二支辰，以陽貴順行，則乙徳在丑，丙德在寅，丁德在卯，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812280878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"三干之德相聨而無間斷；以隂貴逆行，則乙德在未，丙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812280878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"德在午，丁德在巳，亦相聮而無間斷。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812280878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"又以其隨貴人在","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812297262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"天，故謂之天上三竒，能制煞發祥，中宫坐向得之，上官","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812297262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"嫁娶，入宅移居，修造營葬並吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812297262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"餘如戊己庚辛𡈼癸，隨","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812313646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人所涉，或間羅網，或間天空，皆不相聨也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812313646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812330030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"鏡曰：八節三竒，從八節本宫起甲子，陽遁順飛九宫，隂","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812330030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321826858"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"遁逆飛九宫，尋見本年太嵗泊何宫，便於其宫起本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812330030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"虎遁，依八節順逆飛，尋三竒分布取用。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812330030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚申年冬至","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812346414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"節用事，從坎一宫起甲子，順飛九宫，尋見太嵗庚申在","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812346414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"震三宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812346414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚年五虎遁得戊寅，便從震三宫起戊寅，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812362798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"順飛九宫，乙酉在坎一，丙戌在坤二，丁亥在震三。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812362798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"即庚","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812379182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"申年冬至節，乙竒在坎，丙竒在坤，丁竒在震也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812379182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"修作到","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812395566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"山到方，主進田産，生貴子，旺丁財。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812395566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"460","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"按，竒門以六甲為符使，最忌庚金，故用乙以合之，用丙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812411950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321843242"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"丁以制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812411950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇之用三竒，葢本諸此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812428334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至屬坎宫，用陽","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812444718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"遁一局，坎一起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812444718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"立春屬艮宫，用陽遁八局，艮八起","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812461102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子；春分屬震宫，用陽遁三局，震三起甲子；立夏屬巽","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812461102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，用陽遁四局，巽四起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812461102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"俱順飛九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812477486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至屬離宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812493870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"用隂遁九局，離九起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812493870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"立秋屬坤宫，用隂遁二局，坤","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812510254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"二起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812510254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分屬兌宫，用隂遁七局，兌七起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812526638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"立冬","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812543022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"屬乾宫，用隂遁六局，乾六起甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812543022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"俱逆飛九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812559406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"此即時","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812575790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"竒門法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812575790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"至以太嵗所泊之宫，起五虎遁，則與竒門順","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812592174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321859626"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"布六儀，逆布三竒之法不同，而亦自有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812592174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：三竒","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812608558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"當用竒門，用八節三竒亦可，則是古有此法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812608558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"又按，月","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812624942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"神以月建入中官，遇丙丁為火，此自嵗建起，虎遁遇丙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812624942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為竒，似乎兩相矛盾，然各有取義，而起例亦各不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812624942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"且丙丁獨火，本不為凶，第忌廉貞、打頭、月遊諸火星逢","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812641326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"之而火發，丙丁二竒又取照，蓋山向制尅金神，而非用","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812641326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"之以制火星，則其義固並行而不相背也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812641326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321892394"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"起例巡山羅㬋為太嵗前一位，子年在癸，丑年在艮，寅","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812657710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"年在甲，卯年在乙，辰年在巽，巳年在丙，午年在丁，未年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812657710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"在坤，申年在庚，酉年在辛，戌年在乾，亥年在𡈼。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812657710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812674094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：巡山羅㬋，止忌立向開山修方不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812690478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"○通書曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812706862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰羅㬋，乙巽辛，寅午戌丁癸艮宫出，巳酉丑丙𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812706862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"乾作首，亥卯未甲庚坤大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812706862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"註曰：申年辛，子年乙，辰年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812723246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"巽，寅年艮，午年丁，戌年癸，巳年丙，酉年乾，丑年𡈼，亥年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812723246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"庚，卯年甲，未年坤。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812723246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321908778"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"按：起例巡山羅㬋為嵗前最近之方，又為嵗君自本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812739630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"至次年所巡行必經之地，故立向避之，以其為嵗前一","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812739630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"位，猶前星為太子，次於嵗駕，不敢抵向，但又不敢斥言","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812739630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"前星，以為神煞名字，而以佛子之名羅㬋當之，故曰羅","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812739630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"㬋也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812739630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"通書既論三合年分，而其羅㬋所在之方，與三合","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812756014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"全無取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812756014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"起例則申子辰年在庚癸巽，寅午戌年在甲","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812772398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"丁乾，巳酉丑年在丙辛艮，亥卯未年在𡈼乙坤，皆成雙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812772398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"山三合五行，甚為有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812772398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"通書惟辰、巳、午、未年與起例合，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812788782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321925162"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"其為傳寫之誤無疑也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812788782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"今依起例改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812805166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321941546"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdyza2/1-SK1619_figure_00255.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=oUE%2Bryx9ttjzFnkE4cS1kmRFpJk%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdyza2/1-SK1619_figure_00255.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=YZ0p9ExbQiIIrVQNYvS4Z8qdGhk%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdyza2/1-SK1619_figure_00255.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321957930"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：絶胎之間為伏兵，胎養之間為大禍，二者又為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812821550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"夾三煞，坐向皆不宜。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812821550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"如申、子、辰年伏兵在丙，大禍在丁；","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812837934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、午、戌年伏兵在𡈼，大禍在癸。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812837934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"則申、子、辰年坐丙丁為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812854318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"坐煞，寅、午、戌年坐丙丁為向煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812854318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"葢坐丙則向𡈼，坐丁則","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812870702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"向癸也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812870702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812887086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"按選擇宗鏡曰：太嵗可坐不可向，三煞可向不可坐。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812903470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812919854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：三煞最凶，伏兵大禍次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812919854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"然則坐煞、向煞，特統同之","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812936238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812936238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"細分之，則坐與向當有輕重之不同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812952622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"見利用。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812969006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321974314"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdzbx6/1-SK1619_figure_00256.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=JvFhGrv6E%2FDrnyVUFte707mHuWU%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdzbx6/1-SK1619_figure_00256.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=ycZSIsXoPX4hhOe9CP3QFilFLW0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdzbx6/1-SK1619_figure_00256.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928321990698"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：申子辰年在卯，巳、酉丑年在子，寅、午、戌年在酉，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812985390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未年在午。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906812985390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：死方為六害，為灸退，此","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813001774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗不足之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813001774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"宜用三合局補之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813018158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"547","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"按：灸退者，三合死方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813034542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"其名義不可曉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813050926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"術家又為六害，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813067310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"又為飛天獨火，大抵兼獨火死氣而取義耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813067310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"夫六害獨","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813083694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"火與灸退同行異名，於義無取，今删去不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813083694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"而其為太","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813100078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗不足之氣，則出於三合自然之理，故獨存之，而名亦","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813100078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"仍其舊云。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813100078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322007082"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdzoka/1-SK1619_figure_00257.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=l6WPPi78lAM7O56e4kduVzQrxoc%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmburdzoka/1-SK16 {"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322023466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：獨火一名飛禍，又名六害，即葢山、黄道内朱雀、","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813116462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"廉貞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813116462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"修營動土，犯之主災，埋葬不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813132846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"按：獨火與葢山、黄道同一起例，如子年屬坎，對宫為離，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813149230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"即以離為本宫卦，下一爻變為艮，為廉貞，故子年以艮","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813149230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"為獨火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813149230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"丑寅年皆屬艮，對宫為坤，即以坤為本宫卦，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813165614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"下一爻變為震，故丑寅年皆以震為獨火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813165614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813181998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：葢山、黄道兼用納甲三合，獨火則止用本卦。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813198382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"通書","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813214766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：獨火方遇丙丁，飛弔其上，其火方發，無凶神併不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813214766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322039850"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"然則本宫且不必忌矣，納甲三合又為紆逺，其不用也","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813231150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"宜哉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813231150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322056234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322072618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure017e/1-SK1619_figure_00258.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=yDfmbzXNT45QAtmxuucLrkfA2ok%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure017e/1-SK1619_figure_00258.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=I3krmG2Wr1ON3mo0ydmRaBswySA%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure017e/1-SK1619_figure_00258.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322089002"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"起例曰：浮天空亡，甲年離壬，乙年坎癸，丙年巽辛，丁年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813247534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"震庚，戊年坤乙，巳年乾甲，庚年兌丁，辛年艮丙，𡈼年乾","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813247534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"甲，癸年坤乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813247534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"○通書曰：浮天空亡，其例出於變卦納甲，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813263918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"乃絶命破軍之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906813263918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳年在𡈼，乙戊年在癸，丙年在辛，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975547401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"丁年在庚，庚年在丁，辛年在丙，𡈼年在甲，癸年在乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975547401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"○","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975563785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975563785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：甲己辛年丙𡈼，乙庚戊年丁癸，丙癸年乙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975580169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"辛，丁𡈼年庚甲。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975580169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"山向並忌，止忌向而不忌山，非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975596553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"按絶命破軍，原係卦位，故以年干納甲之卦為本宫，取","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975612937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322105386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"中爻變之卦為破軍所在。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975612937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲為乾卦所納，則乾卦為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975629321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"甲年本宫中爻變為離卦，離納𡈼，故甲年以離𡈼為破","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975629321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"軍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975629321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975645705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":454,"lineType":2,"content":"法見本原。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"今通書止用干而遺卦，是取末而","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975662089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"舍本。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975662089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"又以己年同於甲，猶謂己與甲合，至以戊年同於","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975678473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"乙，則更自不可解矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975678473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"夫坎納戊，離納己，乃納甲。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975694857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"本義二","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975711241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"十四山無戊巳，故離納𡈼，坎納癸，以八卦分納八干耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975711241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"若年干戊己，未有不以坎離為本宫，而反統同於乾坤","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975727625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975727625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡並忌山向，甚為有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975744009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"而謂一年占兩方，則益","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975760393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322121770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"失本義，葢其襲誤久矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975760393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"今從起例改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975776777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322138154"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure0dui/1-SK1619_figure_00259.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=B%2FdxoYUKZMej8fsvlSrt1UxrUnY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure0dui/1-SK1619_figure_00259.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=lfZAA0SD {"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322154538"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"通書：年神立成隂府太嵗：甲己年，艮巽；乙庚年，兌乾；丙","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975793161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"辛年，坎坤；丁𡈼年，離；戊癸年，震。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975793161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：隂府太嵗，惟忌開","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975809545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"山，營造，修方不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975809545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"甲己年，月日時屬土，尅艮丙巽辛山。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975825929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚年，月日時屬金，尅乾甲兌丁巳丑山。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975842313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛年，月日","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975858697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"時屬水，尅坎癸坤乙申辰山。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975858697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼年，月日時屬木，尅離","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975875081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼寅戌山；戊癸年，月日時屬火，尅震庚亥未山。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975875081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"○起例","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975891465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：正隂府甲己年，艮巽；乙庚年，兌乾；丙辛年，坎坤；丁𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975891465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum" {"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"按：隂府太嵗，乃本年之化氣，尅山家之化氣，開山忌嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975940617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時尅坐山，故名之曰太嵗，示不可犯耳，非另有隂","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975940617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"府之太嵗在某山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975940617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲己年，月日時化氣屬土，土尅","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975957001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"水，而水乃丙辛合化之氣，艮納丙，巽納辛，故甲己年以","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975957001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽二山為正隂府，丙辛二山為傍隂府。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975957001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚年月日","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975973385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"時，化氣屬金，金尅木，而木乃丁𡈼合化之氣，兌納丁，乾","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975973385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322187306"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"納𡈼，故以兌乾為正隂府，丁𡈼為傍隂府。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975973385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906975989769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976006153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"則卦之所由取，皆從兩干合化而來。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976006153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"通書丁𡈼年有離","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976022537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"無乾，戊癸年有震無坤，無兩則不能化，其為遺漏無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976022537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"又納甲之法，乾納甲𡈼，坤納乙癸，坎納戊，離納己。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976038921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976055305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"家以二十四山無戊己，則以坎納癸，以離納𡈼，而乾坤","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976055305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"専納甲乙。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976055305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"子午卯酉四山，不用卦而用支，則以支之三","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976071689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"合幷納於一卦，此乃二十四山納甲之法。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976071689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"通書失隂府","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976088073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗之本義，而反即卦以配干。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976088073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":491,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚年月丁𡈼譌丁甲，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976104457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322203690"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"是因乾専納甲而誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976104457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辛年月戊癸譌乙癸，是因坎","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976120841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"納癸，坤専納乙而誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976120841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"丁𡈼年少甲而已譌𡈼，是因遺","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976137225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"乾而遺，又因離納𡈼而誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976137225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸年有庚無乙，是因遺","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976153609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"坤而遺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976153609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"可見古人原止用卦，後人以干附之，又失納","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976169993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"甲本義，乃致多誤。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976169993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"曰正曰傍，諸說不一。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976186377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"然卦從干來，用","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976202761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"干猶屬有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976202761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"至於納甲三合與兩干合化全無干涉，則","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976219145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"又附㑹支離之尤甚，而必不可從者。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976219145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"今圖訂正，庶曉然","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976235529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"於作者之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976235529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"又按，十干化氣本諸素問，逐年遞變。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976251913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"洪範","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976268297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322220074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"五行又推其意，以為墓龍變運，不取角軫，而取墓庫，不","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976268297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"取干氣而取納音，要亦逐年逐變者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976268297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府太嵗則不","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976284681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"論年而論山，甲山己山皆常屬土，乙山庚山皆常屬金，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976284681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"不待合而化，不隨年而變，此亦拘迂之甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976284681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"且以甲山","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976301065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"而論，正五行則屬木，洪範五行則屬水，隂府五行則屬","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976301065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"土，墓龍變運則又属火，或又屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976301065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"行止有五，而一山已","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976317449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"占其四，一年月日時，而干支納音化氣又占其四，求其","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976317449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"不尅，不亦難乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976317449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"今臺官用卦不用干，遵行已久，姑存其","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976333833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322236458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"舊。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976333833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"用干雖屬有理，然其義本非親切，故亦不取也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976350217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322252842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322269226"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure0qhm/1-SK1619_figure_00260.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=xIEnMBkieS%2BdvdfEyyvuzNx5sDY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure0qhm/1-SK1619_figure_00260.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=hnxZCphwUshJ7Pwro0RR%2FizDtlU%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure0qhm/1-SK1619_figure_00260.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322285610"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：天官符忌修方，申子辰年屬水，水臨官在亥，故","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976366601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"以亥為天官符；巳酉丑年屬金，金臨官在申，故以申為","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976366601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符；寅午戌年属火，火臨官在巳，故以巳為天官符；","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976366601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"亥卯未年屬木，木臨官在寅，故以寅為天官符。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976366601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"700","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"按：天官符為太嵗三合五行方旺之氣，故修造避之，與","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976382985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"月家遊禍同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976382985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰天官符者，五行質具於地，而氣行","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976399369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"於天，三合固氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976399369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322334762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：天官符忌修方，一年占一字○選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976415753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：申","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976432137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰年在亥，巳酉丑年在申，寅午戌年在巳，亥卯未年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976432137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976432137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"以月建入中宫，順飛九宫，遇本年天官符所占之","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976448521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"字，為本月天官符，每宫占三位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976448521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"715","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"按月家飛宫天官符，即本年天官符逐月飛弔之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976464905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976481289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"子年天官符在亥，正月修作，則以寅建入中宫，順數復","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976481289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"至中宫，遇亥字，即正月天官符在中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976481289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"若子年三月修","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976497673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"作，則以辰建入中宫，順數至震三，遇亥字，震宫統甲震","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976497673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322351146"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"乙三位，即三月天官符在甲震乙也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976497673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"又按二十四山四","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976514057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"正位不用卦而用支，飛宫又不用支而用卦者，以卦可","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976514057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"逐宫而數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976514057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976530441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322465834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：地官符忌修方，一年占一字。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976546825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":558,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：太","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976563209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗前五位為地官符，以月建入中宫，順飛九宫，遇本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976563209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"地官符，所占之字為本月地官符，每宫占三位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976563209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"744","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"按地官符義例，巳見年神，月家飛宫地官符，即本年地","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976579593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"官符逐月飛弔之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976579593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年地官符在辰，正月修作，則","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976595977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"以寅建入中宫，順數至兌七，遇辰字，兌宫統庚兌辛三","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976595977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"位，即正月地官符在庚兌辛也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976595977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"若子年二月修作，則以","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976612361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"卯建入中宫，順數至乾六，遇辰字，乾宫統戌乾亥三位，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976612361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322482218"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"即二月地官符在戌乾亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976612361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976628745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322531370"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：打頭火忌修方，寅午戌年在午，亥卯未年在卯，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976645129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"申子辰年在子，巳酉丑年在酉。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976645129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"葢子午卯酉是本宫旺","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976661513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"鄉，飛宫犯之則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976661513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：打頭火即三合旺方，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976677897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"又為金匱將星，主火燭。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976677897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"若叠太嵗尤凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976694281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"葢太旺則亢，亢","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976710665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"則屬火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976710665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以所用月建入中宫，順飛九宫，遇本年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976727049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"三合旺方，為本月打頭火，每宫占三位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976727049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"按，打頭火即本年大煞逐月飛弔之位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976743433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞義例，巳見","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976759817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"年神，其逐月飛弔，與天官符同法。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976759817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符為臨官，大煞","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976776201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322547754"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"為帝旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976776201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰火者，以其旺極為災，亦猶災煞之又名天","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976792585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"火耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976792585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"打頭火名不雅馴，又嫌多立名色，易致失實，故名","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976808969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"曰飛大煞，以存本義云。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976808969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322564138"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbure4lju/1-SK1619_figure_00271.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=FHCF6mbb7M4%2Bok7I7J {"lines":[{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322580522"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：小月建即小兒煞，忌修方。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976825353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"○選擇宗鏡曰：小月","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976841737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"建忌占方，然占山占向亦忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976841737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"子寅辰、午申戌為陽年，正","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976858121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"月起中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976858121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、卯、巳、未、酉亥為隂年，正月起離九，俱順飛","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976874505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976874505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽年正月起中宫，二月在乾六，三月在兌七。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976890889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"隂","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976907273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"年正月起離九，二月在坎一，三月在坤二是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976907273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"每宫亦","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976923657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"占三位。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976923657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"795","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"按小月建，即月建飛宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976940041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"修造最重太嵗，次則月建，故","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976956425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976956425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以月建為陽建，月厭為隂建。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976972809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年用正月陽","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976989193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322596906"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"建寅，加中宫順行，故正月在中五，二月在乾六，三月在","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976989193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"兌七，順飛九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906976989193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"隂年用正月隂建戌，加中宫順數至本","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977005577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"月陽建，故正月在離九，二月在坎一，三月在坤二，亦順","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977005577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"飛九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977005577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"厯家謂隂年起離九，順飛九宫，乃捷法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977021961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"又按","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977038345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"月神飛弔，皆以月建入中宫，此從月建起例，已是飛宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977038345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"故不又用飛弔。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977038345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"大月建倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977054729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322662442"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：大月建，忌修方、動土、○選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977071113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：大月建係","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977087497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"月家土煞，占山、占向、占方、占中宫，皆不宜動土。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977087497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"甲、丁、庚、","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977103881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"癸年正月起艮八，乙、戊、辛年正月起中五，丙、己、𡈼年正","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977103881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"月起坤二，逆行九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977103881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"823","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"按元經以上元甲子一白，中元甲子四緑，下元甲子七","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977120265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"赤，為太嵗一星。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977120265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"子、午、卯、酉年正月起八白，辰、戌、丑、未年","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977136649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"正月起五黄，寅、申、巳、亥年正月起二黑，為月建選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977136649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"宗","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977153033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"鏡載嵗月建之法，以太嵗尋月建，以月建尋太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977153033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"又載","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977169417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322678826"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"元經起例，下元甲子年七赤，為太嵗一星。","logicSentenceId":"7678935906977169417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"子年正月起","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239460874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"八白，為月建，如六月修離方，正月起八白，二月七赤，三","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239460874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"月六白，四月五黄，五月四緑，六月三碧，則三碧為六月","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239460874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"建，即以三碧入中宫順尋七赤到離九即月太嵗一星","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239460874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"在離，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239460874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"由此觀之，則太嵗即三元年九星入中宫之一","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239477258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"星，而月建即三元月九星入中宫之一星。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239477258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"葢九星順行，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239493642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲逆轉，其年其月到某宫，則其宫之星即入中宫而","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239493642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"用事，是其星乃太嵗月建之用神，而其宫即太嵗月建","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239493642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322695210"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"之所在也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239493642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"今通書不用飛太嵗，而用飛月建，豈以月建","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239510026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"較太嵗尤親切歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239510026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"然其例當三年三十有六月而一周，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239526410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"其義當十五年厯三元，周而復始選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239526410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡所載甲、丁、","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239542794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"庚、癸等年分，雖亦皆隔三年，但誤用天干起例，則惟甲","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239542794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"子至癸酉十年，與元經合，至甲戌年，則不與癸酉年相","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239542794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"輪，而又自甲起，不惟與太嵗相尋之例不合，且與其月","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239542794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"之九星俱相矛盾。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239542794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"是葢止據甲子至癸酉十年而撮其","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239559178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"例，遂致誤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239559178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"今依元經改正，子午卯酉年正月起艮八，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239575562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322711594"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌丑未年正月起中五，寅申巳亥年正月起坤二，逐","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239575562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"月逆轉，則其例與月九星及元經月建脗合，而其義亦","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239575562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"曉然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239575562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"又按小月建専用月支，故曰小；大月建兼用月","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239591946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"干，故曰大。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239591946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"月建為土府，故動土忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239608330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"然在山在方，自以","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239624714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"定位為重，飛宫為輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239624714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇最重太嵗，而未有用飛太嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239641098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"者，則月建之輕重，可以類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239641098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"術士不明其義，乃因其大","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239657482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"小之名，而謬為之說，謂犯小月建，則傷小兒，犯大月建","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239657482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"則傷宅長。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239657482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"又别名小月建曰小兒煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239673866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"舉世畏忌，而不知","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239690250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322727978"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"其由，惑世誣民，不已甚乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239690250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"884","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"按丙丁獨火，乃諸火星之總要，葢取天干丙丁之氣照","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239723018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"於其上，為火之所由發也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239723018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲巳年丙寅月修作，則以","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239739402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"丙寅入中宫，順數丙在中五，丁在乾六，即正月丙丁獨","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239739402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"火在中宫與乾宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239739402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"若丁卯月修作，則以丁卯入中宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239755786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"丁在中五，戊在乾六，以次順數，丙又在中五，即二月丙","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239755786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"丁獨火在中宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239755786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"然必與年獨火飛大煞併方忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239772170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"904","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"按月遊火，即來年太嵗，為進氣方旺之辰，於二十四山","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239804938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"則又在巡山羅㬋前一位，去太嵗尚逺，又為四利太陽，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239804938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"本不為凶，第以火未發先炎，故取太嵗前一辰曰火，月","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239804938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"移一位，故曰月遊。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239804938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"然必與打頭火、年獨火併，又得丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239821322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"同到，而後為忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239821322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年前一辰為丑，丑年前一辰為","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239837706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"寅，丑寅皆屬艮，故子丑年正月，月遊火同在艮八，二月","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239837706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353928322908202"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"在離九，三月在坎一，順行九宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239837706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年前一辰為卯，卯屬","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239854090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"震，故寅年正月，月遊火在震三，二月在巽四，三月在中","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239854090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"五，順行九宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239854090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239870474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"又按：月遊火逐月順飛九宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239886858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"不以月建入中宫，與大小月建同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239886858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷八","logicSentenceId":"7678935907239903242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
