{"lines":[{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"按月厭為隂建，是隂之自旺，而陽之對也，故合建破","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402328104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌而兼忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402328104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":903,"lineType":1,"content":"然隂不勝陽，故其義雖自為一家，而","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402344488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"其凶亦不若月破之不可解。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402344488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申月為三合，丑未月","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402360872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"為生氣，再與德神併，則吉勝矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402360872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":905,"lineType":1,"content":"故皆從德所宜，而不","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402377256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"從厭所忌，猶忌行幸等事者，惡隂盛也，不與德神併，","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402377256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉不抵凶，故如常例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402377256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":907,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌月雖亦為三合，然隂","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402393640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354019293020196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":909,"lineType":1,"content":"陽始侵，己亥月值滿日，又隂陽相逼，行狠了戾，孤辰","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402393640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":910,"lineType":1,"content":"殆無虛日，故與德神併，然後吉凶相抵，而不宜不忌，","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402393640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"否則如常例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402393640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":911,"lineType":1,"content":"子午月厭建㑹，則隂陽争，五月丙午，","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402410024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"十一月𡈼子，雖值月德，然為隂陽大㑹，丙𡈼只作建","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402410024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":913,"lineType":1,"content":"論，不作德論，惟天赦另有生意，故與天赦併，而後如","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402410024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"常例，否則諸事皆忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402410024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉月值災破，則顯然衝擊，","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402426408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"雖與德神併，亦應諸事不宜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402426408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":915,"lineType":1,"content":"又按舊厯止忌出行、","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402442792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"嫁娶、般移、逺廻，於義固為未協。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402442792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"淮南子厯事明原謂","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402459176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354019293036580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"厭日不可舉百事，則亦畧舉大義，而未之深辨。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402459176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":918,"lineType":1,"content":"今逐","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402475560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"月較量其輕重而區别之如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402475560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":919,"lineType":1,"content":"至大㑹小㑹隂位等","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402491944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"日，則皆從二建㑹合取義，故皆與子午月例同。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402491944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402508328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":921,"lineType":1,"content":"交破、隂陽擊衝、陽破隂衝、隂道衝陽等日，則皆從二","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402508328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"建對衝取義，故皆與卯酉月例同。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402508328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗薄逐陣，則取二","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402524712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":923,"lineType":1,"content":"建將合而先合，始分而未分為義，故與辰戌己亥月","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402524712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭例同。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402524712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"德作建論，不作德論，故又與子午月例同。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402541096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":925,"lineType":1,"content":"三陰取厭破將併而先併為義，故與卯酉月月厭例","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402557480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354019293052964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"同。","logicSentenceId":"7678970687402557480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":927,"lineType":1,"content":"陽建疊陽，建為陽錯，隂建疊隂，建為隂錯，故德作","logicSentenceId":"767 {"lines":[{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354015518408704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"日出入之早晚，晝夜永短所由分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044194825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"而早晚之故有二：","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044211209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"一由於日行之内外，一由於人居之南北。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044211209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋日行黄道","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044227593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"與赤道斜交，春秋分日行正當交㸃，與地平交於卯酉，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044227593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"地平上下之度相等，故晝夜適均，所謂日中宵中也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044227593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"春","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044243977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"分以後，日行赤道内，至夏至而極，其距等圈與地平交","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044243977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"於寅戌，地平上下之度上多下少，故晝長夜短，所謂日","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044243977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"永也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044243977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"秋分以後，日行赤道外，至冬至而極，其距等圈與","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044260361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"地平交於辰申，地平上下之度上少下多，故晝短夜長，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044260361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354015518425088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂日短也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044260361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"二分前後，距交不遠，黄道勢斜，則緯行疾，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044276745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"故數日而差一刻。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044276745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"二至前後，黄道勢平，則緯行遲，故半","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044293129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"月而差一刻。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044293129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"此永短由日行之内外而生者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044309513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"至於人","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044325897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"居有南北，則北極出地有高下，於是見日之出入早晚，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044325897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"隨地不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044325897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"中國在赤道北，北極出地上，南極入地下，故","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044342281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"夏晝長，冬晝短。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044342281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"自京而北，北極愈高，則永短之差愈多。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162044358665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"至於北極之下，則赤道當地平，夏則有晝而無夜，冬則","logicSente {"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117740642304"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"日出入方位者，乃各節氣日出入地平時距正東西之","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141925402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"度也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141925402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋日行黄道與赤道斜交，惟春秋分正當赤道，故","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141941786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"其出入地平也，正當卯酉，為正東正西。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141941786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"自春分至秋分，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141958170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"日行赤道北，其出入地平也，亦在卯酉北。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141958170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"自秋分至春","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141974554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"分，日行赤道南，其出入地平也，亦在卯酉南。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141974554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"而冬夏至","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141990938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"距赤道南北極遠，故其出入地平也，距正卯酉亦極遠。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162141990938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"冬至出辰入申，夏至出寅入戌，此方位之遠近由於天","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142007322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"行者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142007322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"而人居有南北，其度亦有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142023706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋愈北則北極","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142040090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117740658688"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"愈高，其距東西之度愈多。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142040090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"漸南則北極漸低，其距東西","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142056474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"之度漸少，皆以北極高度為準。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142056474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"今按京師北極高三十","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142072858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"九度五十五分，推得各節氣日出入方位如左。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162142072858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117740740608"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"朦影者，古所謂晨昏分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342105115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽未出之先，已入之後，距","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342121499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"地平下一十八度皆有光，故以十八度為朦影限。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342121499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"然十","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342137883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"八度同也，而時刻則隨時隨地不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342137883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"隨時不同者，天度","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342154267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"使然也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342154267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋十八度者，大圈之度也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342170651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"赤道亦為大圈，其度","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342187035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"濶；自赤道而南北，皆距等圈，其度狹。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342187035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"近二分者，以濶度","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342203419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"當濶度，故刻分少；近二至者，以狹度當濶度，故刻分多","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342203419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342203419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"隨地不同者，地南則赤道距天頂近，太陽正升正降，","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342219803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"其度徑；地北則赤道距天頂遠，太陽斜升斜降，其度紆。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342219803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117740756992"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"故愈北則朦影之刻分愈多，愈南則朦影之刻分愈少","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342236187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342236187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫北極出地四十八度半以上，則夏至之夜半猶","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342252571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"有光，愈北則愈不夜矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342252571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":459,"lineType":1,"content":"南至赤道下，則二分之刻分極","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342268955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"少，而二至之刻分相等。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342268955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"赤道以南反是。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342285339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"詳考成上編。","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342301723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342318107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"按京師北極出地三十九度五十五分，推得各節氣朦","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342318107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"影刻分如左：","logicSentenceId":"7678953162342318107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117741379584"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"星鳥星火，肇於虞書；昏中、旦中，詳於月令。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705849353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"中星之來尚","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705865737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705865737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"周禮司寤氏掌夜時，以星分夜。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705882121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"漢儀晝漏盡，夜漏起，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705898505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"省中黄門持五夜，又名五更，此更漏中星所由昉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705898505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705914889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"古今更㸃之制，亦微有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705914889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"元授時之法，於日入後、日","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705931273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"出前，減去晨昏分各二刻半，餘為夜時，分為五更，每更","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705931273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"又分為五㸃，於初更三㸃時起更，五更三㸃時攢㸃。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705931273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705947657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"臺官相傳之法，則於日入後八刻起更，日出前九刻攢","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705947657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"㸃，計起更至攢㸃，共若干時刻，五分之以為五更。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705947657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"日出","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705964041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117741395968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"前減朦影刻分為旦刻，日入後，加朦影刻分為昏刻。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705964041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705980425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"第一圖，舉春秋分為例，外大圜，地平經圈也；内半圜，地","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705980425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"平下赤道也；中直線，子午圈也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705980425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"二横線，上為地平緯圈，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705996809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"下則朦影限地平距等圈也，與赤道交於昏旦，自天頂","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705996809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"至昏旦作經圈，其地平下為十八度，與大圈朦影限度","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705996809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"等，自北極至昏旦作經圈，其所截昏旦距日出入之度，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705996809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"即朦影刻分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900705996809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"日入至日出，計四十八刻，減一更距日","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706013193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"入後八刻，攢㸃距日出前九刻，餘三十一刻，以五分之，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706013193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117741412352"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"得六刻三分，自一更遞加之，即得各更時刻也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706013193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"如以度","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"數而論，日入後八刻，起更在赤道為三十度，日出前九","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"刻，攢㸃在赤道為三十三度四十五分，於地平下赤道","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"半周一百八十度内減之，餘一百一十六度一十五分，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"以五分之，得二十三度一十五分，為每更相距赤道度，","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"每一度當時之四分，亦得六刻三分，為每更相距時刻","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706029577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"第二圖外層三百六十度，地平經度也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706045961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"次内十二時","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706062345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"九十六刻，地平刻分也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706062345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"時刻之在赤道，其度常均，而在","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706078729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117741428736"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"地平則闊狹不等。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706078729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"其法為半徑與時刻距午赤道度切","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706095113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"線之比，同於北極出地之正弦，與日影距午地平經度","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706095113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"切線之比，故子午卯酉四正之位不移，而子午前後則","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706095113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"狹，卯酉前後則闊也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706095113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"次内圓者為節氣線，曲者為節氣","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706111497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"時刻線。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706111497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋日出入昏旦更㸃時刻，各節不同，自中心對","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706127881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"各時刻，於各節圈上作㸃識之聯之，必成曲線也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706127881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"最内","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706144265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"一層為地平二十四方位，以明此圖即晷表之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706144265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"日在","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706160649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"南，則影在北，日在東，則影在西也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706160649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"夜無日影，以晝例夜","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706177033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354117741445120"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706177033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"今依其法，推得京師各節氣昏旦更㸃時刻中星著","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706193417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"於篇，星圖步天歌并附於後。","logicSentenceId":"7678935900706193417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"中宮北極紫微宮，北極五星在其中。","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163037230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"大帝之坐第二珠，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163053614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"第三之星庶子居，第一號曰為太子，四為后宮五天樞，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163053614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"左右四星是四輔，天一太一當門路，左樞右樞夾南門，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163053614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"兩面營衛一十五。","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163053614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"上宰少尉兩相對，少宰上輔次少輔，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163069998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"上衛少衛次上丞，後門東邊大贊府，門東喚作一少丞，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163069998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"以次却向前門數，隂徳門裏兩黄聚，尚書以次其位五。","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163069998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"女史柱史各一戸，御女四星五天柱。","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163086382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"大理兩黄隂徳邊，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163102766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527354181284593699"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"勾陳尾指北極顛，勾陳六星六甲前。","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163102766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇獨在勾陳裏，","logicSentenceId":"7678936928163119150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"line {"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇之道，有體有用。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531895846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"龍山方向之一定者，體也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531912230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":5,"lineType":1,"content":"年月日","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531928614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"時之無定者，用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531928614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"補龍扶山，制凶助吉，以無定而合有","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531944998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"定者，用之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531944998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":7,"lineType":1,"content":"弔替飛宫、合局相主，以無定而合無定","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531961382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"者，用之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531961382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"錯綜參伍，精義入神，庶足前民而利用矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531977766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":9,"lineType":1,"content":"作利用","logicSentenceId":"7678931665531994150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"35","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：楊筠松曰：年月要妙少人知，年月無如造","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532239910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"命法。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532239910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"吴景鸞曰：選擇之法，莫如造命。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532256294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"體用之妙，可奪神","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532272678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"工。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532272678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"郭景純曰：天光下臨，地徳上載，藏神合朔，神迎鬼避。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532289062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"此十六字，至精至㣲，即造命體用之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532305446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"葢藏神者，收","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532321830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"藏地中元神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532321830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"其法選成四柱八字，支干純粹，成格成","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532338214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"局，扵以扶補龍氣，則地脉旺盛，而上騰於墳宅之中。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532338214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"所","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532354598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"謂藏神，所謂地德上載，造命之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532354598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"合朔者，取初一日","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532370982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149372980"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽太隂合照之義，舉一以該百也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532370982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"其法取三竒三徳，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532387366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"金水紫白，貴人禄馬，到山到向，自然吉慶，所謂合朔，所","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532387366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"謂天光下臨，造命之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532387366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"然使犯動凶煞，則禍且隨之，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532403750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"亦屬無益。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532403750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"又必先於年月之内，推求山向，吉神相迎，一","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532420134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"切嵗破、三煞、隂府等項，盡行退避，不相干犯，乃為全吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532420134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"則神迎鬼避之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532420134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"此亦體中之最緊者，體用兼全，上","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532436518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532436518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，寧舍用而取體。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532452902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"每年之中有吉神凶神焉，有吉","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532469286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"星凶星焉，二者不同，不可不辨。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532469286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149389364"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"神隸於地，或吉或凶，隨太嵗之所指揮而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532485670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"葢太嵗，君","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532502054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其分最尊，其力最大，共此二十四山，其與太嵗相喜","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532502054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"相合，及為太嵗之所生扶者，即為吉神。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532502054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"故凡嵗德嵗徳","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532518438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"合、嵗貴、嵗禄、嵗馬，以及開字、成字、平字、危字俱吉，除字、","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532518438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"定字次吉，總之與嵗君相得，故吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532518438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"其與太嵗相衝相","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532534822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"鬭，及為太嵗之所尅制者，則為凶神。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532534822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":54,"lineType":1,"content":"故嵗破者，太嵗所","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532551206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"對衝而破也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532551206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞者，太嵗所殺之三方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532567590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府者，太嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532583974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"之化氣尅山化氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532583974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"年尅者，太嵗納音尅坐山本墓納","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532600358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149405748"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"音也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532600358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆受尅於太嵗，而不可犯之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532616742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":58,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官方為天","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532633126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"官符，主官訟；帝旺方為打頭火，主火災。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532633126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"此太嵗有餘之","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532649510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"氣也，故宜三合局尅之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532649510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"死方為六害，為灸退，主退敗。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532665894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":60,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532682278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗不足之氣也，故宜三合局補之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532682278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"又以嵗千起五虎","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532698662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":62,"lineType":1,"content":"遁，遁至戊巳方為戊巳煞，庚辛方為天金神，丙丁方為","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532698662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"獨火。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532698662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"以上神煞總之隨嵗君而轉移，其餘紛紛神煞，不","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532715046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"從太嵗而起者，皆後人之所添設者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532715046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":64,"lineType":1,"content":"内惟嵗破最凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532731430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"例無制法。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532731430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞亦大凶，不可輕犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532747814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘凶煞，俟其休囚","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532764198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149422132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，而以四柱制化之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532764198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"若不知制化之法，則寧避","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532780582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"之，此神迎鬼避之大畧也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532780582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"103","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"星運扵天，七政中之日月金水，四餘中之紫氣月孛，及","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532796966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"八節之三竒、紫白、竅馬，皆吉星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532796966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"内中日最尊，月與三","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532813350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"竒、竅馬、紫白次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532813350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵玉皇鑾駕等星，皆捏造而無據","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532829734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532829734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"月令為權要之官，其所冲者為月破，所尅者為月隂府，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532846118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"為月尅，山家與年家之嵗破、隂府、年尅同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532846118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"月家之土","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532862502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149438516"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"煞為大月建，小兒煞與年家之戊巳煞同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532862502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"惟大月建","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532878886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"更凶，此月家真凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532878886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"本月之旺方為金匱星臨官帝","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532895270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"旺之間為月徳相合之方為月徳合，正丁二坤之類為","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532895270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"天徳相合之方為天徳合，此月家真吉神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532895270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"天星可以降地曜，然天星氣清，地煞力猛，若犯三煞隂","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532911654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"府，及月家之大月建小兒煞，則太陽到亦不能制，況其","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532911654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"他乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532911654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞避之，中煞制之，小煞不必論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532928038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":82,"lineType":1,"content":"但得八字停","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532944422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"當，吉星照臨，自然貞吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532944422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"若揑造之假煞，則削之而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532960806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149454900"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"修凶福猛，不如修吉之穏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532977190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"然修吉如修太嵗方、三徳方、","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"本命貴禄方、食禄方，必取吉方旺相之月，而以四柱扶","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"補之，則吉者愈吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665532993574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"修凶如修三煞方、官符方、金神方，","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533009958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"必俟凶方休囚之月，而以八字尅制之，則凶者亦吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533009958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"修吉要扶得旺，制凶要制得伏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533026342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"如本命禄馬貴人飛到","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"山向最吉，亦可降中下等煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533042726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"136","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四山方無吉凶，聴太嵗以吉凶而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678931665533059110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"不從太嵗起","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985893403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"者，皆偽造也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985893403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"如偽吉神，則曰玉皇、曰紫㣲、曰鑾駕之類；","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985909787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149471284"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"偽凶神，則曰天命煞、飛天火星，及各様火星、官符血刃","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985909787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"之類，不可勝紀。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985909787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"一考其起例，再考其所以然，則乖謬了","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985926171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985926171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"145","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"六十日亦無吉凶，聴月令以吉凶而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985942555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"日統於月，為月","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985958939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"之所合所生者，及與月令同旺者，乃真吉日，如旺日、相","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985958939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"日、月徳日之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985958939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"日支干為月之所尅所衝，及休囚","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985975323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"而不當月令者，乃真凶日，如破日、四廢之類是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985975323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":100,"lineType":1,"content":"其不","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985991707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"從月令起者，皆偽造也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743985991707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"如偽吉日則曰滿徳吉慶之類，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986008091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149487668"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"偽凶日則曰死别滅門之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986008091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"細考起例，真假了然矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986024475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松疑龍經已及造命體用之槩，而千金歌言言名","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986040859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"理，愈翫愈佳，真千古日家之指南車也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986040859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"嗣是曽文辿、陳","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986057243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷、吴景鸞、廖金精以及後來名術，一切𦵏課，皆以扶","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986057243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"龍相主為宗。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986057243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"其修吉方則曲盡扶吉之法，其修凶方則","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986073627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"曲盡制凶之法。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986073627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"取而玩之，無不鑿鑿有理，通書未有及","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986090011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"此者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986090011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"造命之法，一看來龍宜何局以補之；二看山向何煞宜","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986106395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149504052"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"避，何煞可制，以何法制之，取何吉星照之；三看主人本","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986106395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"命宜何如以扶之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986106395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"三者俱得，而後舉事吉，無不利矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986122779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"至","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986139163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"扵修吉方，則擇吉方旺相之月而扶持之，如培植善類","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986139163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986139163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"修凶方，則擇凶方休囚之月而尅制之，如收降盜賊，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986155547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"必我强而彼弱，乃為我用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986155547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"彼選定八字，不問龍山主","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986171931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"命而槩施之，乃假造命也，扵古法天淵矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986171931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"學者當辨别","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986188315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"其是非，以定從違，庻無差悮。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986188315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"一要隂陽不溷雜，二要坐向逢三合。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986499611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"三要明星入向來，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986515995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"四要帝星當六甲。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986515995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"四中失一還無妨，若是平分便非法。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986532379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149553204"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"一論龍之淨隂淨陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986548763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"此龍單指入首結穴一節之脈，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986565147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"非坐山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986565147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"乾甲坤乙、坎癸申辰、離𡈼、寅戌十二來龍","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986581531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"屬陽，宜立陽向，用申子辰寅午戌，陽日期也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986581531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"艮丙、巽","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986597915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"辛、震庚、亥未、兑丁己丑十二來龍屬隂，宜立隂向，用","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986597915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉丑亥夘未，隂日期也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986597915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"反此則為溷雜，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986614299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"然古","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986630683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"人不盡拘此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986630683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":145,"lineType":1,"content":"如艮亥龍用申子辰者，三合補龍法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986647067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"○二論三合。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986663451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合補龍，則補之有力。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986679835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"不言龍而言","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986696219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"坐向者，借坐向以補龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986696219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"如巽龍作己山亥向，用夘","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986712603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149569588"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"未局以補巽木龍，非真補亥向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986712603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"發福全在龍上，即","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986728987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山亦次之，況向有何益乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986728987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"俱以正五行論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986745371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"有四柱","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986761755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"與向三合者，則不可衝山，必減一字。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986761755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"如亥龍則亥山","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986778139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"己向，止用丑酉金局，以生亥龍可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986778139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"如己字，則衝破","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986794523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"亥山矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986794523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986810907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"推○三要七政中之日月到向。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986827291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"明星","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986843675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"即日月也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986843675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"葢到向則照山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986860059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"陳希夷云：太陽到山，惟國","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986876443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"家修宫殿宜之，士庶人不能當也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986876443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"故楊公屢言三合","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986892827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫福禄堅。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986892827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"若太隂金水，則山向皆可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986909211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"或日在向，月","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986925595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149585972"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"在山，前後夾照尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986925595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"○四要尊星帝星到山到向。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986941979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986958363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"甲者，六個甲子。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986958363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"葢尊帝從甲子起，乾次坎故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986974747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"此四","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986991131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"者乃造命之樞，得全為上，失一猶可，若失二得二，則","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986991131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"非法矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743986991131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"況全不合者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987007515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
