{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"山頭，坐山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987056667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，謂年月諸惡曜犯占也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987073051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"必求年命真","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987089435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人同到山方，及山家禄馬貴人同到為美。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987089435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987105819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149602356"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"丁夘年煞在酉，丁貴人亦在酉，多用酉日時修之，乃","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987105819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人制煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987105819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"又如丙午生人，用丁亥年、辛亥月、乙亥日、","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987122203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"丁亥時作亥向，乃一氣貴人壓制太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987122203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒，竒門乙","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987138587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987138587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"或取八節三竒亦驗。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987154971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"諸徳，嵗徳并天月二徳","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987171355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987171355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"如其年方位有年月諸凶煞，若用徳竒制之，則化","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987187739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"煞為權，反能召福。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987187739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"285","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"二位尊星宜值日，一氣堆干為第一。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987204123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄拱貴喜到山，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987220507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"飛馬臨方為愈吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987220507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"三元合格最為上，四柱喜見財官旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987236891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149618740"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"用支不可有損傷，取干最宜逢健旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987253275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"生旺得合喜相逢，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987269659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"須避尅破與刑衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987269659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星有氣小成大，惡曜休囚不作凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987286043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"尊帝二星，喜扵年月到矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987302427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"而日時亦宜取之，更能助","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987318811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987318811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"○一氣堆干，謂四干一様也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987335195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"然必與山向及命主","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987351579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"之干支相合，而無刑尅為美。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987351579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"拱禄者，如甲命禄在寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987367963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱用二丑二夘，則拱出寅禄矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987367963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":181,"lineType":1,"content":"怕衝所拱及填實，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987384347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"亦要與山頭相關為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987384347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"拱貴倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987400731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"喜到山，則指四柱","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987417115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"之禄馬貴人到山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987417115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"修方者宜到方，修向者宜到向，","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987433499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149635124"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"曰山而包方與向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987433499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"○飛馬又包禄貴在内，即活禄、","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987449883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"活馬、活貴人之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987449883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"本命者，以太嵗入中宫遁之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987466267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"本","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987482651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"年者，又以月建入中宫遁之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987482651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"或飛到山，或飛到向，或","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987499035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"飛到方，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987499035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"○八字以干為天元，支為地元，納音為","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987515419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"人元。","logicSentenceId":"7678931743987515419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"如堆干堆支，兩干兩支三合局及四納音，皆以","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074074633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹不雜，而又補龍相主，方為合格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074074633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":190,"lineType":1,"content":"○財官論主","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074091017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"命不論山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074091017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲生人用三四㸃已字為合財，已命人","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074107401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"用三四㸃甲字為合官。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074107401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"以合為妙，不合不佳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074123785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"查楊曽","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074140169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149651508"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"日課，凡用財官者，皆十干合氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074140169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱地支或互相","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074156553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"衝刑，則彼此互傷而大凶，故曰不可有損傷。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074156553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱中","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074172937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"日干甚重，最宜旺相，得令日干休囚，非貧即夭。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074172937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"或三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074189321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"干四干一氣，不則正當月令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074189321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"如比肩既少，又不當月","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074205705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"令，則必年月上有印以生之，再用禄時，亦健旺而有","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074205705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"力矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074205705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":199,"lineType":1,"content":"然支干有力固好，又必與山命相合，補龍、補山","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074222089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"補命，是得衆力之扶持也，何吉如之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074222089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"若尅龍尅山尅","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074238473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"主。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074238473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"刑龍、刑山刑主，衝龍衝山衝主。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074254857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"是受衆力之摶擊","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074271241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149667892"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"也，凶可知矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074271241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰生旺得合喜相逢，須避尅破與刑","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074287625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074287625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"至此而造命之法無遺蘊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074304009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"若八字自相刑衝，則","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074320393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"用支損傷之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074320393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"古八字亦有自相衝者，衝即破也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074336777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"如用辰戌局、丑未局，以補土山之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074353161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓之山不衝","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074369545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"則不開也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074369545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"若衝主命，則㫁㫁不可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074385929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"至扵制煞修方，以","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074402313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":208,"lineType":1,"content":"吉降凶，則全看月令，必凶方休囚之月制神旺相之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074402313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"月則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074402313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"如以一白水制南方打頭火，必申子辰水旺","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074418697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"火衰之月可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074418697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰吉星有氣，惡曜休囚也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074435081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"此指修","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074451465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149684276"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"方而言，若坐山休囚，則不吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074451465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"365","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"山家造命既合局，更有金水來相逐。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074467849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽照處自光輝，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074484233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"周天度數看躔伏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074484233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"六箇太陽三箇緊，中間歴數第一親。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074500617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"前後照臨扶山脈，不可坐下支干缺。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074517001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"更得玉兔照坐處，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074533385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"能使生人沾福澤。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074533385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"既解天機字字金，精㣲選擇可追尋。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074549769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"不然背理庸士術，執著浮文枉用心。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074566153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"字字如金真可誇，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074582537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹使天機錦上花。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074582537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"不得真龍得年月，也應富貴旺人家。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074598921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"此申結上文造命之法，全以補龍為主也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074615305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"因龍山屬","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074631689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149700660"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"何五行，而以四柱補之，則可以奪神功，改天命，此之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074631689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"謂山家造命法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074631689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"葢從山脈而造富貴，非四柱之能","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074648073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"自造也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074648073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"能如上所云，則造命八字已合格局矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074664457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"此造","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074680841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"命之體也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074680841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"有體而後言用，求諸吉星，皆照山向乃用。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074697225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"如金水二星，亦喜到山到向。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074713609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天以五星為經，日月","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074729993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"而外，莫尊於此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074729993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"然火星凶烈，土星、木星又能掩日月","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074746377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"之光，而蔽山向之明，故不可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074746377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"金清水秀二星獨吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074762761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"若與日月同到山向，謂之金水扶日月，大吉之兆也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074762761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149717044"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"此惟臺歴可查，外此有昇元金水、周仙金水，皆終年","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074779145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"守住一方而不運行，不足信也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074779145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽照臨，諸吉之首，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074795529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"必以臺歴日躔宫度為真。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074795529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"外此有昇元太陽、都纂太","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074811913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"陽、烏兔太陽、四利太陽，皆不足信。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074811913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"天無二日，且一太","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074828297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在東，一太陽在西，終年不動，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074828297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"得真太陽","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074844681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"矣，又得真太隂同臨山向，福澤尤厚。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074844681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"然此日月金水、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074861065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"竒徳禄馬貴人，皆助福之星，非發福之根本也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074861065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"福之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074877449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"根本，全在坐下山脈，山脈旺相則發，休囚則不發，此","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074877449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149733428"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"全在吉課，以生扶之，天干地支純全不缺乃可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074877449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"若支","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074893833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"干既缺，補脈不起，雖諸吉併臨，亦無大福。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074893833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"如無為無","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074910217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"用之人，縱得貴人扶持，終不能大有為也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074910217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"故再丁寧","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074926601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：不可坐下支干缺。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074926601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"葢明體之重而用之輕也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074942985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"人悟","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074959369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"得此義，古人之選擇亦可追蹤比美。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074959369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，庸術之士，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074975753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":244,"lineType":1,"content":"背造命之正理，不論年月之生龍尅龍，只曰某山宜","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074975753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"某年，又云某日大造，某日大𦵏，龍山受尅，主命休囚，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074975753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"何益之有？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074975753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"末四句復深自贊美此歌，以啟人之留意","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074992137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149749812"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775074992137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"方方位位煞神臨，避得山過向又侵。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075024905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"只有山家自旺處，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075041289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"天機妙訣好留心。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075041289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"支如不合干中取，迎福消凶旺處尋。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075057673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"任是羅㬋隂府煞，也須藏伏九泉隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075074057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"434","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"二十四方位神煞占犯最多，避得年煞，又有月煞，避","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075090441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"得月煞，又有日煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075090441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"且山利向又不利，向利山又不利，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075106825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"難得全吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075106825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"只取本山來脈自旺處，得令有氣，更四柱","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075123209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149766196"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"干支乘時旺相。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075123209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"如坐山得干，取天干一氣，或堆禄堆","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075139593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"干；坐山得支，取地支一氣，或三合年月日時，無非扵","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075139593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"山家自旺處斟酌調和，使之更旺耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075139593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"此旺則彼衰，凶","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075155977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"煞自伏，是天機妙訣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075155977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡修造與𦵏埋，須将年月星辰排。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075188745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"地吉𦵏凶禍先發，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075205129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰棄屍福不來。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075205129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"此是前賢景純説，景純雖説無年月。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075221513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"後來年月數十家，一半有頭無尾結。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075237897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此文無十全，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075254281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149782580"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"一半都是俗人傳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075254281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"不是青囊起鬼卦，便是三元遁甲銓。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075270665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬雲騰兼氣耀，六𡈼局與通天竅。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075287049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"装成圖局號飛天，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075303433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"飛天名出何人造。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075303433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"云是祖師口訣傳，金盤圖是左仙録。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075319817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"雷霆九刼號昇元，坤鑑黄羅并武曲。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075336201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"催官使者大單于，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075352585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"鼓角喧傳為第一。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075352585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"統例一百二十家，九十六家年月要。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075368969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"問之一一皆通曉，飛度星辰説元妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075385353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"試令選擇作宅墳，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075401737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"福未到時禍先到。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075401737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"不知年月有元機，年月要妙人少知。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075418121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"年月無如造命法，装成好命恣人為。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075434505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"吉人生時得好命，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075450889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149798964"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"一生享福兼富盛。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075450889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"不獨已身富貴髙，奕世雲仍沾餘慶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075467273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"我因厯數考諸天，元象幽㣲萬萬千。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075483657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"星到曉時次第沒，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075500041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"只有陽烏萬古全。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075500041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂因日有盈缺，不比太陽常麗天。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075516425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"請君專用太陽照，三合對宫福禄堅。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075532809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"更看素曜在何處，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075549193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"福力却與太陽兼。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075549193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"金木二星并紫氣，月孛同用又無嫌。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075565577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"周天本是十一曜，只嫌逆伏災炎炎。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075581961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"482","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"右經詳言諸家恍惚，無如造命之妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075598345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"因龍山主命，以","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075614729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"起四柱八字成格成局，扶龍相主，所謂装成好命也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075614729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149815348"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"八字既好，乃取吉星，以照臨之日為最宜，到向上吉，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075631113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫即到向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075631113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"三合亦吉，或與山三合，或與向三合","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075647497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075647497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"月次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075663881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"五星中金水二星吉，土木二星掩蔽光明，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075680265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"火星燥烈，皆凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075680265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"四餘中惟紫氣最吉，月孛柔星遇","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075696649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"吉則吉，故曰同用無嫌，葢與日月金水同用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775075696649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124406281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"土計皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124406281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"七政四餘共十一曜，若遇逆伏，則凶者愈","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124422665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，吉者亦凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124422665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149831732"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"造𦵏二者，乃選擇大端，不可不慎。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124455433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"慎之如何？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124471817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：合造命","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124488201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"之體用而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124488201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"然豎造與𦵏地亦略不同，𦵏以補龍為主，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124504585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"而山向亡命次之；造以山向主命為重，而補龍次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124504585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124520969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏乘生氣，生氣旺而體自煖，雖山向與亡命不甚全利，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124520969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無妨也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124520969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"若修造，則斧斤震動，且曠日持久，倘山向不","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124537353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"空，主命受尅，不敢妄議興舉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124537353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"況八宅禍福，皆論坐山乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124553737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"514","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"五行生旺，各有其時。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124586505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"惟土分三等，有隂有陽，有半隂半","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124602889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149848116"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124602889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"故元經曰三等殊生是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124619273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"艮土屬陽，坤土屬隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124635657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124652041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未隸中宫，辰戌屬半陽，丑未屬半隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124652041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"艮旺立春之先，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124668425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"坤旺立秋之後。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124668425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓扵四季之下，各旺一十八日，此土","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124684809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"之墓也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124684809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"526","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"木山春旺，除土旺一十八日之外，惟七十二日。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124701193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"又以冬","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124717577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"至後一陽生處互論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124717577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"自冬至至立春，為進氣，謂之向令；","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124733961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"自立春至春分，為正氣，謂之得令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124733961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"自春分至清明，為旺","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124750345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，謂之化令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124750345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149864500"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"火山夏旺，自立春至驚蟄，為進氣向令；自驚蟄至立夏，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124766729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"為正氣得令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124766729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"自小滿至夏至，為旺氣化令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124783113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"夏至後火燥","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124799497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"金流，物極則反，不可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124799497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用火山，不宜大暑之後。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124815881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"金山秋旺，自芒種至夏至，為進氣何令？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124832265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"自夏至至立秋，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124848649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":316,"lineType":1,"content":"為正氣得令，自處暑至秋分，為旺氣化令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124848649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"水山冬旺，自立秋至白露，為進氣向令，自秋分至霜降，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124865033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"為正氣得令，自立冬至冬至，為旺氣化令。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124865033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"凡化令，乃他山進氣之時，尅擇之法，務以財禄培根，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124881417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149880884"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"乃為中和。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124881417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"若以官旺加之，則太旺而反危矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124897801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"549","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"用日之法，向令取其生氣，得令用其胎養氣，化令取其","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124914185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"財源，便是妙理。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124914185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"如春月清明前後，作寅山為化令，取甲","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124930569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"日用之，為甲禄在寅財者，四墓并納音土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124930569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"又如得令","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124946953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"向令不同，進氣化令有異。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124946953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"如春震山，甲乙輔之，甲向冬","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124963337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"至而生旺，震向春分而正旺，乙向清明而化旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124963337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"尅擇之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124979721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"法，取其将化者，補以財禄，正旺者培以根元，向旺者益","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124979721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"以胎息，損益得中，乃為貞吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775124979721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"邱平甫曰：先觀風水定其蹤，次看年月要相同。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125012489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"吉凶合","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125028873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"理叅元妙，好向山家覓旺龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125028873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":333,"lineType":2,"content":"此言先擇吉地，次擇吉年月日時以補龍，千古不易","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":334,"lineType":2,"content":"之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"凡入其鄉而星峰竒特，龍神秀拔，富貴無疑；入其鄉而","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125045257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"山岡撩亂，龍神卑弱，貧賤無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125045257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福之本，總屬之龍，擇","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125061641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"日而不補龍，又何必擇？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125061641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"知補龍之説，而此道之元樞得","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125078025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125078025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149913652"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"凡逺龍不論，單以到穴之小脈為主，以正五行論生尅。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125094409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"日時四柱，生扶之則吉，尅洩之則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125110793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"不問陽宅隂地，至結穴處，必有一線小脈，細細察定，即","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125127177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"以羅經格之，屬木，則用亥夘未局，屬水土，則用申子辰","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125127177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"局，屬火，則用寅午戌局，屬金，則用己酉丑局，或印局生","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125127177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"之亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125127177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"龍雄帶煞者，宜用財局。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125143561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"582","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"山谷隂地聳起開窩者，近穴止有圓毬，無小脈，圓毬若","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125159945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"闊，非脈也，宜扵山後蜂腰處審而補之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125159945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149930036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"凡省城府縣，非午向則丙丁向，其午向者，必𡈼子癸龍","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125176329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"也，其丙丁向必亥艮龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125176329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"俱宜申子辰局，但正脈已結","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125192713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"衙署矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125192713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"民居或東或西，皆脈上枝分横來者，不知屬何","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125209097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"五行，只以補坐山為主。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125209097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"自此以外，則皆補脈，而隂地尤","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125225481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"緊，葢𦵏乘一線之生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125225481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"龍氣之衰旺，全看月令，故補龍者，必扵三合月，或臨官","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125241865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"月、墓月，亦作旺月，非衰病死之例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125241865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"葢丑宫有辛金，未","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125258249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"宫有乙木，辰宫有癸水，戌宫有丁火，固知四墓之旺而","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125258249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149946420"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"非衰也，故三合局用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125258249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"凡補龍全在四柱地支，葢天干氣輕，地支力重也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125274633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"有以","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125291017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"地支一氣補者，如夘龍用四夘之類，極妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125291017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"但難取。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125307401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"十餘","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125323785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"年始一遇，而又或月家、日家，山向不空，其可强為乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125323785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125340169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"若三合局之活動易取也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125340169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"三合局只要在三合月内，生","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125356553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"月、旺月、墓月皆可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125356553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"如此三月内凶神占方，則臨官月，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125372937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"可名曰三合，兼臨官地支。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125372937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"一氣局，或四生，或四旺，不用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125389321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"四墓。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125389321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":367,"lineType":1,"content":"三合字不必全，二字亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125405705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149962804"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"十二淨隂龍，宜用隂課。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125422089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"十二淨陽龍，宜用陽課。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125438473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125454857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：一要隂陽不溷雜，正此謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125454857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"但五行龍各有隂有陽，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125471241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"而亥夘未木局，己酉丑金局，則皆隂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125471241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌火局，申","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125487625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰水局，則皆陽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125487625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"故舊課亦不甚拘隂陽之説。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125504009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"古人造𦵏八字，多以地支補龍，以天干補主命，或與命","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125520393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩一氣，或合官，或合財，或合禄馬貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125520393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"又或天干合","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125536777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"命，而禄馬貴人到山到向，而地支又補龍脈，則八字之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125536777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"上上局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125536777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149979188"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"唐一行禪師、宋託長老皆以四柱納音補龍本年之納","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125553161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"音，亦甚應驗，但不如地支之力耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125553161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"又有論納音者，其法","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125569545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"不論本龍之納音，而扵龍之墓上起納音。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125569545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"論生尅，如庚","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125585929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年作戌山戌龍，正五行屬土，水土墓辰，亦用五虎遁","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125585929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"得庚辰金音。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125585929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"八字宜土音金音吉，火音為克，龍墓凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125602313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125618697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"葢本洪範變運而論者，與一行禪師、託長老之㫖有異，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125618697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"亦宜叅看。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125618697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"凡以三合水局補水龍，以木局補木龍者，為旺局，上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125635081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104149995572"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"以金局生水龍，以水局生木龍者，為相局，又為印局，次","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125651465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125651465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"水龍用火局者，為財局。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125667849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"龍雄帶煞者，不必再補，則用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125684233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"財局，不補亦不洩也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775125684233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ype":1,"content":"若四墓字則凶墓，非三合結","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347916827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"局不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347916827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104150175796"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"又有納音以補龍者，一行禪師諄諄尚之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347933211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"託長老為","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"豐城宛岡黄氏𦵏墓，戌龍作辛山乙向，得甲戌火龍入","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"穴也，宜木音生之，火音比助之，正宜立夏乘旺，故用庚","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"木音，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼午月","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"木音，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"戊午日","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"火音，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"己未時","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":496,"lineType":2,"content":"火音","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"下𦵏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347949595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：造𦵏八字，取用全在納音，不可分毫爭差，則福應","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347965979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"如嚮。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347965979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"然以前法叅之，亦相合焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347982363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"戌龍屬土，又與寅午同","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347998747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"三合火局，今託長老用寅午火局以生戌土，則非徒納","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347998747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"音之屬木屬火，能助甲戌火龍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775347998747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"故補龍者，必以前三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348015131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104150192180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"合局或一氣局為主，而叅以納音之説。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348015131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"託不補辛山，而","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348031515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"單補戌龍之納音，因知古人重龍不重山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348031515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"今人不問","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348047899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"838","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"龍而單問山，豈不謬哉？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348047899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"又有一法，謂之占奪一方秀氣，亦甚吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348064283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"如木龍，則四柱","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348080667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"用寅夘辰三字全，謂之占盡東方秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348080667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"火龍，則用己午","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348097051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"未三字全，謂之占盡南方秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348097051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"金龍，則用申酉戌三字","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348113435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"全，謂之占盡西方秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348113435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"水土龍，則用亥子丑三字全，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348129819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"之占盡北方秀氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348129819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"與官旺局同，但多一字耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348146203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"以三字凑","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348162587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355104150208564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"作四柱，擇一字空利者，多用一字，以成四柱也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348162587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"三字外","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348178971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"不可叅一别字，叅一别字則亂格矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348178971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松與人修方，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348195355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"用𡈼寅年、甲辰月、甲辰日、丁夘時，此必寅甲夘乙龍，又","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348195355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"坐寅夘山方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348195355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"寅夘辰全秀，占東方格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348211739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"859","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山不必補，但宜扶起，不宜尅倒，尅倒則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348244507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂扶起？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348260891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山有吉星照之，無大凶煞，占之而又八字相合，不衝","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348277275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"不尅，即扶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348277275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"如坐山與龍同氣，則補龍即以補山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348293659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"如𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348310043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336262184"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"癸龍坐子向午，龍與山皆屬水，用申子辰局可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348310043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"倘龍","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348326427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"與山不同氣，則止以補龍為主，而坐山有吉星無凶煞","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348326427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"即妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775348326427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"870","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂尅倒？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485116443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗衝山則倒，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485132827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":523,"lineType":2,"content":"日月時忌衝山，嵗衝尤忌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞、隂府、年尅","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485132827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"及伏兵大禍占山則倒，此開山之緊要凶神，勿造勿𦵏","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485132827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485132827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"876","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"年家天地官符占山，俟其飛出别卦之月，以吉星照之，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485149211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"或太陽，或紫白，或三竒，此中得一二吉星到，反能發福。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485149211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336278568"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天官乃臨官方，又名歳徳吉方，地官乃顯星方，又為","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"歳位合，皆可吉可凶，非大凶煞也，但要吉星到耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485165595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"忌還","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，忌本月，忌旺月。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485181979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"883","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"占向同此，其餘神煞置之勿論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485198363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"凡太嵗占山，疊戊巳、隂府、年尅、打頭火則大凶，疊金神","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485214747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"次凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485214747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"若不疊此數凶，而以八字比之，或三合之，又八節","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485231131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"之三竒同到上吉，其福最久。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485231131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"888","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"凡日月金水紫白三竒竅馬，得二三件到山大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485247515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"凡八字四柱禄馬貴人到山到向大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485263899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅山多用甲","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485280283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336294952"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"字，甲山多用寅字，名堆禄格，餘倣此推。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485280283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"凡主命之真禄、真馬、真貴人，以太歳入中宫，遁到山向","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485296667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485296667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"895","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"凡嵗貴、嵗禄、嵗馬，以月建入中宫，遁到山向次吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485313051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"凡八字宜扶山合山，或與山比肩一氣，或印綬生山，或","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"禄貴到山，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485329435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌地支衝山，次忌天干尅山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485345819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"惟辰戌","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485362203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未山不甚忌衝，然嵗衝亦凶，日月時内止一字衝之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485362203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"可也，衝多亦破而凶矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485362203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336311336"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱中有納音尅山者，若年尅月尅，忌修造，不能制","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485378587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485378587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏則以月日納音制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485394971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"制者當令，尅者休囚，乃穏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485411355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"凡陽居原有屋而修山者，兼方論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485427739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"忌大将軍、大月建、小","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485444123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"兒煞、破敗五鬼及金神煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485444123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"此五者惟金神可制，而秋月","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485460507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"難制。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485460507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"大将軍飛出别卦無妨，還宫則凶，吉多無妨，此俱","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485476891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485476891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"修方修山不忌𦵏","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485493275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"915","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"年家打頭火，及月家飛宫打頭火、丙丁火。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485509659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"占山占向忌","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485526043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"修造，不忌𦵏","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485526043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
