{"lines":[{"lineId":"926","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"向不必補，但有吉星而無凶煞可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485624347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"何謂凶煞？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485640731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗也，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485657115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳煞也，地支三煞也，浮天空亡也，此造𦵏同忌者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485657115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"内惟太歳戊巳尤凶，蓋太歳可坐不可向，而戊巳在向，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485673499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336344104"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"猛于在山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485673499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞可制，亦宜斟酌，俟其休囚之月，以三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485689883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"合尅之，吉星照之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485689883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"然𦵏可而造險，葢𦵏暫而造久也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485706267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"浮","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485722651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"天空亡略輕，主退財耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485722651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"伏兵大禍，占向次凶，然修造亦","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485739035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"忌，𦵏不忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485739035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"巡山羅㬋，占向，一白到則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485755419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"古人有補向","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485771803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"者，所求補龍扶山也，不然則坐山之財局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485771803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"如艮龍作","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485788187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁向，或用四丙，或用寅午戌火局者，生艮土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485788187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"又如","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485804571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"子山午向，用寅午戌火局者，子山尅火為財也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485804571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"然止用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485820955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"寅戌二字，切忌午字冲山，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485820955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"推","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485837339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"952","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"相主者何？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485870107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"以四柱八字輔相主人之命也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485886491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"從來皆論生","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485902875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"年，不論生日，有論生日者，非古法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485902875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"956","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"修造以宅長一人之命為主，𦵏以亡命為主，祭主止忌","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485919259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"冲壓，餘可勿拘。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485919259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"958","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"古人皆論生年之天干，或合官，或合財，或比肩，或印綬，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485935643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"或四長生，或取禄馬貴人，不衝命尅命，而又補龍扶山，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485935643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"則上上吉課也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485935643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336376872"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"昔楊筠松為俞侍御修陽宅，俞係乙亥生，用庚寅年庚","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485952027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"辰月庚寅日庚辰時，取乙與庚合，合官格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485952027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"乙禄到夘","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485968411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"寅辰拱之，拱禄格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485968411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱又名天干，一氣兩支不雜，上","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485984795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"吉格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775485984795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"課曰：行年七十六嵗，自乙亥至庚寅年，正七十","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486001179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"六歳，此論生年不論生日之證也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486001179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"又一戊午年生人，扵丙子造𦵏，是非不停，皆衝生年也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486017563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"故知生年為重。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486033947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"用合財合禄格者，如曽文辿為𡈼午修主，楊筠松𦵏𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486050331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336393256"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"午亡命，皆取四丁未。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486050331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋丁與壬合，合財格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486066715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"又午與未","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486083099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"合，天地合格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486083099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"四㸃丁禄到午命，聚禄格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486099483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"故其課曰：","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"支干合命愈為竒，上上格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486115867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"今人以支干合命者為晦","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486132251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"氣煞，何其謬歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486132251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"983","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"昔楊筠松為乙巳主命，修艮山坤向屋，取丁丑年、庚戌","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486148635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"月、庚申日、庚辰時，葢取乙與庚合，合官格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486148635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"又庚禄居","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486165019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"申坤向，驛馬到艮寅山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486165019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"故其課曰：三合馬進山，三禄向","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"上頒。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486181403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"又三庚名三台格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486197787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336409640"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"一印綬格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486214171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"宜正印，忌梟印。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486230555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲命宜四癸，乙命宜四𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486246939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486246939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"梟印亦能生我，多見則忌，一二㸃不忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486263323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"若傷官、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486279707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"食神、洩氣，多見則忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486279707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"998","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"一比肩格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486296091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"如己巳亡命，楊筠松取四己巳比肩格也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486312475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"人忌本日，何歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486328859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"比肩上吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486345243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"如己命見三己四己是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486361627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"劫","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486378011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"財凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486378011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"如己命多見戊字是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486394395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"一四長生格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486410779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"如𡈼生人用四申，丙生人用四寅是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486427163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"官","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"不相合，不宜多見，多則尅身，一二㸃可也；合官，則四㸃","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336426024"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"愈妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486443547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":615,"lineType":1,"content":"七煞大能尅命，忌用，或年月利而干係七煞，一㸃可也，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486459931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"得四柱中天干食神制之為妙，若至二㸃必凶，況多乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486459931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":617,"lineType":1,"content":"昔有乙夘生人，造屋用辛丑年、辛夘月，後大不吉，乙以","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486476315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"辛為七煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486476315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"若用庚字，則合官大吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486492699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"合官者，貴格也；","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486509083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"合財者，富格也，不合則無情。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486509083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"財與官俱宜，一㸃二㸃。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486525467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人，宜四柱活動取之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486541851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲以寅為禄，甲命人疊","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486558235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"見寅字，乃自家之現財禄也；寅命人疊見甲字，乃財禄","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486558235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336442408"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"自外而來也，皆聚禄吉格。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486558235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人與馬倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486574619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"命禄與命貴人最吉，馬次之，乃病地也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486591003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"馬有必不可用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486607387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"者，如寅以申為馬，四柱若用申字，則衝寅命，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486607387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"查古人造𦵏課，所云禄馬貴人，皆四柱中之顯然可見","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486623771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"者，如上數課是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486623771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"然難逢難遇，蓋成格成局之難也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486640155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486656539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"有本命飛禄、飛貴、飛馬，取造𦵏之年飛到山向中宫，俱","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486656539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉，此稍易取。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486656539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"一、本命地支，切忌四柱地支衝之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486672923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"若又天干尅命干者，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486689307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336458792"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"名天尅地衝，最凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486689307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太歳衝命最凶，月次之，日又次之，時為輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486705691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰戌丑未命遇衝不吉，但略輕，土衝土也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486722075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"然太嵗衝","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486738459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"之亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775486738459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：東衝西不動，南衝北不移，謂木不能傷金，火不能","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662915635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"尅水也，亦略輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662915635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"如申酉命遇寅夘衝，亥子命遇己午衝","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662932019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662932019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"止主是非。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662948403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"若北衝南命，西衝東命，則凶莫堪矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662964787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662981171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"亦以太嵗為重，月次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662981171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋歳君力大，而月乃司令也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775662997555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336475176"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"凡本命羊刃四柱切忌多見，如甲命忌夘字之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663013939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"本命煞惟天罡四煞最凶，造𦵏皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663030323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"天罡四煞即嵗煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663046707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"修忌宅長，𦵏忌化命及祭主，吉不","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663063091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"能制。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663063091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌生人屬火，忌扵丑年月日時内作甲乙庚辛四","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663079475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"向，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663079475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":646,"lineType":2,"content":"非此四向，則犯丑字，不忌。不犯丑字，則此四向，亦不忌。二者俱犯乃凶，犯　一箇丑字亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"申、子、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663095859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"辰年生人屬水，忌扵未年月日時内作甲、乙、庚、辛四向，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663095859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663095859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"己、酉、丑年生人屬金，忌扵辰年月日時内作丙、丁、𡈼、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663112243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336491560"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"癸四向，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663112243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、夘、未年生人屬木，忌扵戌年月日時内作","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663128627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"丙、丁、𡈼、癸四向，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663128627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"命食禄最吉，能催官禄，乃本命食神之禄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663145011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"八字用三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663161395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"四㸃俱吉，或修食禄方亦妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663161395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":653,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲命以丙為食神，丙禄","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663177779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"在巳，四柱多用巳字是也，或修巳方亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775663177779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":711,"lineType":1,"content":"凡鼎新開居，倒堂豎造，皆謂開山立向，則單論開山立","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837470747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"向吉凶神，至年與月之修方凶神，俱不必論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837470747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"修主原有","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837487131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"住屋，欲扵屋後修造，謂之修山，不名開山，則忌開山凶","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837487131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336606248"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"神，兼忌修方凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837487131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"向上凶神，除太嵗、三煞二者外，其","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837503515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"餘不必論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837503515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"住屋前修造，謂之修向，不名立向，則忌立","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837519899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"向凶神，兼忌修方凶神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837519899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":717,"lineType":1,"content":"坐山凶神，除歳破三然二者","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837536283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"外，其餘不必忌矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837536283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"若所修之處，前後還有屋，則又兼中","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837552667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum {"lines":[{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"修山修向修方，看與修主住房利否。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837585435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":720,"lineType":1,"content":"如與住房不利，又","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837601819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"欲急修，則宜避宅别居，俟工完後，入新宅可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837601819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":721,"lineType":1,"content":"既避宅","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837618203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"而去，則止論山向空利，而方道與中宫神煞皆可不拘。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837618203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336622632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"修方神煞，年家則以三煞、嵗破為最，打頭火、天地官符","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837634587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837634587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":725,"lineType":1,"content":"月家以大月建、小兒煞為最，飛宫官符、獨火次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837650971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"凡修山修向者，必要兼避方煞，惟新開山立向者，不論","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837667355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"方煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837667355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":727,"lineType":1,"content":"修山而忌三煞在向者，蓋三煞在向亦凶，必俟","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837683739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚之月，乃可修山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837683739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"修向而忌三煞、嵗破在山者，蓋","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837700123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":729,"lineType":1,"content":"山既大不利，則向亦不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837700123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":731,"lineType":1,"content":"凡修方先定中宫，扵中宫下羅經格，定所修之方屬何","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837732891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336639016"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":733,"lineType":1,"content":"字，先查此字何年可修，次查何月可修，然後擇吉日與","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837732891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"方生合則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837732891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":735,"lineType":1,"content":"方之必不可修者，曰本年戊巳方也，嵗破方也，太歳到","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837749275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"方而帶戊巳打頭火、金神也，月家則大月建、小兒煞也，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837749275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆必不可犯者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837749275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":737,"lineType":1,"content":"至月家丙丁火，及飛宫之打頭火、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837765659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"天地官符次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837765659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":738,"lineType":1,"content":"有制可修","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837782043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":739,"lineType":1,"content":"方之可修者有三種：一曰空利方，本年無甚大凶煞，占","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837798427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"方亦無甚吉神到方，但擇吉月吉日以修之，亦自平穏。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837798427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336655400"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"二曰修吉神方，或太歳方，而帶吉不帶凶也，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":742,"lineType":2,"content":"必要八節之三竒到，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":743,"lineType":1,"content":"或三德方，如甲年六月，則歳徳、天徳、月徳㑹扵甲方也，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"年天喜方也","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":744,"lineType":2,"content":"子年酉，丑年申，寅年未，夘年午，辰年己、巳年辰，午年夘，未年寅，申年丑，酉年子，戌年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"亥，亥年戌","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"次之，則年月之三台土曲方也","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":745,"lineType":2,"content":"即平字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":745,"lineType":1,"content":"青龍官國方","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"也","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":746,"lineType":2,"content":"即開字，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"極富谷将方也","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":746,"lineType":2,"content":"即危字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡顯星方也","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":746,"lineType":2,"content":"即定字。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"月家","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"之金匱方也，本年之竅馬方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837814811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆年月之吉方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837831195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":747,"lineType":1,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837847579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"或本命之禄馬貴人方也本命食禄方也，又或本命之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837847579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人禄馬飛到此方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837847579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"此三者乃本命之吉方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837863963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":749,"lineType":1,"content":"必年","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837880347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336671784"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":751,"lineType":1,"content":"月之吉方，又合本命之吉方，擇吉日修之，則無不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837880347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"擇吉日之法如何？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837896731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：吉方宜扶不宜尅，扶則福大，尅則","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837913115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"無福。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837913115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":753,"lineType":1,"content":"年家與此方，或三合局，或一氣局，又必此方旺相","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837929499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，則諸吉當權修之，自然發福。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837929499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"然修吉方必不疊𦂳","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837945883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":755,"lineType":1,"content":"要煞乃可，蓋吉不宜尅，而煞又要尅，二者不可並行也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837945883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"若不緊要之煞，則不必論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837962267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"方吉命吉，自然降伏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837978651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837995035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"曰修凶煞方，除戊巳嵗破及太嵗之帶凶者不修外，其","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837995035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆可制而修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775837995035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"其制之之法詳見後","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838011419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"修方亦有分别，不問正向横向，但在後不作住房，而止","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838044187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"作書室下房者，則止論修方，而開山立向之吉凶不必","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838044187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838044187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"若在後欲作住房，則以開山立向為主，而兼修方","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838060571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"論，必山向利，方向又利，乃可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838060571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"此論甚確。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838076955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋雖修方","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838093339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"而欲作正寢，則是其宅以所修之屋為主房，故即同開","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838093339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"山論。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838093339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"今人修方不論後面，是住屋閑屋，一槩論方，不論","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838109723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"山向，大失古人之㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838109723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336704552"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"四圍有屋，則中間之屋皆名中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838126107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳在向，及戊巳煞、","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838142491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞占山占向，則中宫終年不吉，不可修。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838142491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"月家大月建，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838158875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"小兒煞，打頭火占中宫，亦不可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838158875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":773,"lineType":1,"content":"月家飛宫，天地官符入中宫，若年月紫白三竒在中宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838175259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":774,"lineType":1,"content":"或本命禄馬貴人飛入中宫，則可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838175259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"凡修中宫，忌戊巳日，蓋中宫本屬土，又用戊巳土日，則","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838191643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"助起土煞，不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838191643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"若辰戌丑未月，尤忌戊巳日。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838208027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336720936"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1312","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：盤針之法，漢初只用十二支，自唐以來，始添用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838240795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1313","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"四維八干。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838240795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1314","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌云：縫針之法𡈼子中，更論正針子亦中。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838257179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1315","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"又胡舜申隂陽備用云：聞諸前輩言，盤針之用，當以丙","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838273563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1316","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"午𡈼子之中者為正。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838273563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1317","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"狐首經云：陽生扵子，隂生扵午。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838289947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1318","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838306331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1319","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"子至丙，東南司陽；自午至𡈼，西北司隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838306331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1320","lineNum":783,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午𡈼子之間，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838322715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1321","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"為天地之中，南北之正。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838322715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1322","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"其説相合，故㫁然以丙午𡈼子","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838339099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1323","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"中針為是。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838339099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1324","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"按通書以𡈼子之中為縫針，今謂之中針。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838355483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1325","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋中針之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838371867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1326","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336737320"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1327","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"子位，當𡈼子之中，乃子之初，自子至癸，皆子位也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838371867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1328","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"地","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838388251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1329","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"理家格龍用之。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838388251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1330","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"若定方向，則用正針；消砂納水，則用","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838404635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1331","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"縫針。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838404635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"詳見本原，並見後圖。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838421019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336753704"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336770088"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskh0d7/1-SK1619_figure_01449.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=mQiZo3lmrJCo9y4bim2uD%2FuHqEY%3D","pictureHeight":1498,"pictureWidth":1026,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskh0d7/1-SK1619_figure_01449.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=nuq%2BUXLqB0bS5uDm5bDjrskjJDI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskh0d7/1-SK1619_figure_01449.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336786472"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"羅經體製不一，多者至三十餘層，然其用總不離乎三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838437403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"針者近是。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838437403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"今約取十二層，内一層，天池，以受指南針者","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838453787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838453787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"二層，八卦，正方隅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838470171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"三層，二十四山，一卦三山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838486555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838502939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"層，坐山九星變卦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838502939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"五層，淨隂淨陽，配龍向也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838519323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"六層，穿","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838535707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"山七十二龍，正針分金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838535707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"七層，中針二十四山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838552091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"八層，二","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838568475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"十四天星。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838568475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1351","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"九層，六十龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838584859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1352","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"皆屬中針，所以格龍者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838601243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1353","lineNum":801,"lineType":1,"content":"十層，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838617627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1354","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"縫針二十四山。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838617627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"十一層，六十龍。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838634011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"十二層，一百二十分金。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838650395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"皆屬縫針，所以消砂納水者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838666779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘配卦配宿，皆由此","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838683163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336802856"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"推。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838683163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"故約舉之，而其義已偹也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838699547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1363","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：中宫下羅經：中宫定而後方隅定。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838732315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1364","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"如直進","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838748699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1365","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"有幾層者，必自山下第一層之後簷起，量至大門之前","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838748699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1366","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"簷水止，共幾丈，折半為中宫下羅經，以定二十四字，而","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838748699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1367","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"方隅始確。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838748699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1368","lineNum":810,"lineType":1,"content":"通書有論層數者，如只有一層，則以棟柱之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838765083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1369","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"中為中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838765083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1370","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"若有前廊，前深後淺，又以簷下為中宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838781467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1371","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"若前","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838797851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1372","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"有廊，後有披厦，前後相等，則又以棟柱為中宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838797851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1373","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"如有","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838814235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1374","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336819240"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1375","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"二層，則前層之後，後層之前，中間天井為中宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838814235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1376","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"如有","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838830619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1377","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"三層，則以中層為中宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838830619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1378","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"四層則以二層後天井為中","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838847003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1379","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，與二層同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838847003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1380","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"五層則以第三層為中宫，與三層同也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838863387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1381","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"此其説似是而非。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838879771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1382","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋棟數有淺深，而羅經二十四方位","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838896155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1383","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"無伸縮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838896155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1384","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"近時有以祖堂為中宫者，亦非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838912539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1385","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"古並無此","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838928923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1386","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"説。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838928923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1387","lineNum":819,"lineType":1,"content":"羅經二十四字，乃一定之方位，如一居周圍有二十","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838945307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1388","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"四丈，則一字管一丈；有十二丈，則一字管五尺，此定理","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838945307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1389","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838945307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1390","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"如子山午向，則夘酉當腰。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838961691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1391","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"若必以祖堂為中宫，則祖","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838978075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1392","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336835624"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1393","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"堂在山下者，夘酉前長後短；祖堂近大門者，夘酉前短","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838978075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1394","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"後長，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838978075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1395","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"修方忌扵祖堂不利，則合家不利。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775838994459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1396","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"然相離稍逺者，猶之","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839010843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1397","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839010843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1398","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"若扵祖堂利，而扵修主之住屋不利，則修主不利，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839027227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1399","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"而合家亦不得受福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839027227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1400","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵修主之住屋，若與祖堂共","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839043611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1401","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"一棟，則吉凶同論，若異棟，則必兼論，必俱利乃可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839043611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1402","lineNum":828,"lineType":1,"content":"今人","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839059995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1403","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"有單論祖堂利否者，非古人之㫖也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775839059995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1404","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"古人云：祖堂不利，","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883575347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1405","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"則移香火扵吉方。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883575347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1406","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"如修主住房不利，必要遷住吉方，乃","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883591731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1407","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336852008"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1408","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"可修作，其義甚明。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883591731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1409","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"凡移徙而修者，必待修完後，方可擇","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883608115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1410","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"吉入宅，或歳官交承亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883608115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1411","lineNum":833,"lineType":1,"content":"如主命本年利作兑，不利作","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883624499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1412","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"震，則當遷居扵東，使所修之方，昔視之為震者，今則視","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883624499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1413","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"之為兑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883624499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1414","lineNum":835,"lineType":1,"content":"此活變之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883640883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1415","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"按：定中宫之法，論層數固未精，而論丈尺亦未甚確。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883657267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1416","lineNum":837,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋方位皆以目之所見為定，如大門，則以㕔事為中","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883673651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1417","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"可也；如㕔後，則以正寝為中可也；如墳塋，則以祖穴","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883673651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1418","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"為中可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883673651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1419","lineNum":839,"lineType":1,"content":"移步換形，惟變所適，要在相其形勢，取其","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883690035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1420","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336868392"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1421","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"尊者為主，以臨四方，庶義精而理得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883690035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1422","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355150336884776"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1423","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"欽定協紀辨方書卷三十三","logicSentenceId":"7678931775883706419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"20","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：年家吉凶神，起例有八：一曰本年天干，二","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621135872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"曰三合五行，三曰本年十二建星，四曰本年五虎遁，五","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621135872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"曰本年納音，六曰四方，七曰納卦，八曰羊刄。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621135872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"凡吉凶神，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621152256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"從此八者而起，則為真。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621152256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"扵真凶之中，又分輕重，大者避","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621168640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"之，中者制之，小者以吉星照之而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621168640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳歳德合歳，禄馬貴人、山方皆吉，能制諸凶煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621185024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"○歳","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621201408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"干化氣尅坐山化氣，為正隂府，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621201408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"帶卦者為傍隂府，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621217792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520533033"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621217792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"俗術丙辛隂府，用甲巳二干化土制之，乙庚隂府，用","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621234176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"戊癸二干化火制之，切不可信。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621234176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"傍隂府有吉星制，或年","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621250560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"月吉，則不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621250560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松開乾山，用𡈼申𡈼子𡈼辰𡈼寅，又","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621266944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"用𡈼子𡈼子𡈼子庚子合天地一氣格，又取𡈼禄到乾","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621266944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"亥為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621266944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"如祔𦵏及修造，正傍俱不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621283328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"○以上從嵗天","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621299712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"干起例。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621299712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"43","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞大凶，伏兵大禍，夾三煞亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621316096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞止忌單修，先從","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621332480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"吉方起手，連及修之無害，惟嵗煞不可犯，伏兵亦凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621332480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"大","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621348864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520549417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"禍與吉星㑹不為害，與凶煞㑹凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621348864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":37,"lineType":1,"content":"○臨官為天官符，忌","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621365248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"單修，若從吉方起手，連及修之無害。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621365248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"月家飛宫同到小","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621381632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476621381632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"○地官符扵吉方起手，連及修之無害，單修凶，或用","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749783040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽紫白命貴禄馬制之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749783040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"○帝旺為金匱星吉，又為","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749799424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"打頭火，主火燭凶，若疊太歳尤凶。","logicSentenceId":"7 {"lines":[{"lineId":"66","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"建星如子年子上起，建丑為除，丑年丑上起，建寅為除","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749881344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749881344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"建為歳君，為元神，為吉凶衆神之主，可坐不可向。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749897728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"在山在方，疊吉星則大吉，疊凶星則大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749914112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"在方為堆黄","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749930496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"方，亦疊吉則吉，疊凶則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749930496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"除為四利太陽，小吉；滿為土","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"瘟，為四利䘮門，凶，又為天富，小吉；平為三台，又為土曲，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"又為四利太隂。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749946880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉定為歳三合，為顯星吉，又為地官","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749963264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"符，為畜官，次凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749963264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"執為四利死符，又為小耗凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749979648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"破為歳破，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476749996032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355 {"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳天干納在何卦？","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750258176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"其衝破對卦，名曰破敗五鬼，忌修","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750274560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"方吉，多不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750274560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"○以上從納卦起例。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750290944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520614953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"本年禄前一位為羊刃，對衝為飛刃，名李廣箭，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750307328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"然惟","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750323712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"八干山有之，忌坐山，不忌方與向。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750323712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤艮巽山無禄亦","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750340096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"無刄。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750340096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"古人𦵏課犯隂府年尅者甚多，而八干山絶無犯","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750356480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"李廣箭者，其犯箭者，皆四維山原無箭故也○以上從","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750356480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":78,"lineType":1,"content":"羊刄起例。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750356480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"120","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"按年神總論，宗鏡自為一家之言，大體醇正，故備録","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750372864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750372864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"然唯太歳歳破不可犯，三煞猶可制化，況其他乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750389248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府以納甲為正卦，為傍，與通書不合，而亦有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750405632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750422016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520631337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"其義紆逺，輕于年尅山家見義例本篇十二建星，不","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750422016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"足為憑，當兼諸神叅看見義例四利三元條下，天干","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750422016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"臨官為禄，帝旺為刄，刄固不如禄之吉，然其凶亦不","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750422016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"過如大煞止耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750422016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"大扺大煞、羊刄皆不為凶，疊凶星則","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750438400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"凶，猶疊太嵗、月建也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750438400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"且其起例既從年干，又曰乾坤","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750454784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"艮巽四山無刃，則必年與山同。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750454784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲山用夘月日正","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750471168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"為扶山，何凶之有？","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750471168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"故今臺官不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750487552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"然本條内云古人","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750503936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏課犯隂府年尅者甚多，則不為無功也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750503936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"至其中所","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750520320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520647721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"云神煞不忌新宅而忌舊宅，又云年尅山家傷祖父，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750520320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"無祖父則不忌，種種支離，概刪不録。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750520320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"天徳方即天道方，月徳方即三合月，官旺之間大吉，天","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750553088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"徳合、月徳合方次吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750553088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"此四德到方，大能制此方之煞，併","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750569472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":97,"lineType":1,"content":"歳徳、歳徳合，共名六徳，俱走天干，不走地支，不能制地","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750569472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"支方煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750569472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"月天赦方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750635008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"春戊寅，夏甲午，秋戊申，冬甲子，此天赦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750651392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"然原無定在，故以月建入中宫遁之，遁得天赦，落在何","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750667776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"方？","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750667776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"此方宜修造，可制官符等煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750684160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"天月徳三合周轉，已有","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750700544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"飛宫之義，不宜再飛，天赦必飛，乃現","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750700544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"178","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"曾文辿曰：太歳坐山留福徳，却将年月更加臨。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750913536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"還須四","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750929920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"柱無沖尅，共轉天河福愈深。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750929920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松曰：太歳可坐不可","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750946304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"向。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750946304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：吉莫吉扵修太歳，凶莫凶扵犯太歳。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750962688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：太歳","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750979072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"疊吉星則貢福，疊凶星則降禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750979072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"俱言坐太歳之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476750995456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"造","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751011840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏者坐太歳極吉，向太歲極凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751011840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"然坐之有數端焉：一查","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751028224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗不疊戊巳隂府年尅打頭火乃可坐。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751028224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"二要八節三","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"竒照之；三要月日時，或與太嵗一氣，或與太嵗三合，乃","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520713257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751044608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"若支沖之，干尅之，則犯歳君而大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751060992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"四要太陽紫白","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"諸吉同到，則尤妙，福大而乆，非别吉之可比也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751077376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳禄馬貴人，能壓一切凶星，貴人為上，禄馬次之，要","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"與造主本命禄馬同行，乃能致福。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751093760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"用命貴禄馬，而歳貴","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬不至者，命主無管攝；用歳貴禄馬，而命貴禄馬不","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"值者，歳君不依歸。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751110144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"歳命交㑹，方為全美。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751126528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇務令有氣","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"得時，如木向春生，金逢秋旺之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751142912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"飛宫亦有六合之法，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"合貴為上，合禄次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751159296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":135,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲命禄在寅，十二月作艮，以月","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520729641"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":137,"lineType":1,"content":"建丑入中宫，遁得寅字到乾，乾中有亥，合艮中之寅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751175680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":138,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751192064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"212","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"邱平甫曰：諸家年月多差舛，惟有紫白却可憑。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751208448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":139,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751224832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":140,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：禄到山頭主進財，從外壓将來；馬到山頭進官職，要","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751224832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"合三元白貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751224832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"與白同旺相，貴子入朝堂。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751241216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":141,"lineType":1,"content":"六白屬金秋","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751257600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"月旺，紫火春夏强。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751257600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"一八水土旺，三冬立見福禄崇。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751273984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":142,"lineType":1,"content":"此言","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751290368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"紫白之真，且宜與貴人禄馬同到。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751290368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":143,"lineType":1,"content":"又紫白喜旺相則愈","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751306752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"有力，皆不二之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751306752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":144,"lineType":1,"content":"桑道茂及一行禪師皆云：紫白所","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751323136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520746025"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":146,"lineType":1,"content":"到之方，不避太嵗、将軍、官符諸凶，惟不能制大月建而","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751323136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":147,"lineType":1,"content":"已；不避宅長，一切凶年並不能為害，惟不能制天罡四","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751323136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"旺煞而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751323136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"則紫白之吉，古所共宗。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751339520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":148,"lineType":1,"content":"通書有謂飛宫弔替，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751355904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":149,"lineType":1,"content":"多有不合，故紫白難用者，妄也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751355904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"232","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"凡月家吉星弔替飛宫不犯衝伏為美。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751372288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":150,"lineType":1,"content":"如一白到坎，八","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751388672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":151,"lineType":1,"content":"白為艮，為星伏之地；九紫到坎，八白到坤，為星衝之地，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751388672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":152,"lineType":1,"content":"其吉減力。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751388672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
