{"lines":[{"lineId":"236","lineNum":153,"lineType":1,"content":"右論三篇亦出選擇宗鏡，其中飛天赦為今所不用，","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751405056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520762409"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦不背扵理，録之以備一義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678938476751405056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"金匱星今亦不用，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525156904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":156,"lineType":1,"content":"葢金匱即大煞，以其旺為吉，又以其旺為凶，未免自","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525156904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"相矛盾。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525156904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵金匱大煞本無吉凶，疊吉星則吉，疊凶","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525173288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"星則凶，亦猶疊太嵗月建耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525173288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰六徳不能制支煞，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525189672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525189672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"夫支之凶者，正當以干制之，方見制化之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525206056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525222440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉年歳煞在辰，用庚辰月日時，則天干一氣，皆金","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525222440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"與乙作合為嵗徳，而辰亦不以煞論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525222440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"故精扵造命","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525238824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":162,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，則建除與山方猶屬第二義，所謂天光下臨也，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525238824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520778793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"烏有重支而輕干者乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525238824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰大月建吉不能制，亦非。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525255208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"夫月建謂之土煞，自較太嵗為輕，況又不論定位而","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525271592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"論飛宫，㫁無山方中宫無往不忌之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525271592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":166,"lineType":1,"content":"其論坐太歳","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525287976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":167,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，慎重周詳，體用兼備，非惟日者之妙用，實亦君","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525287976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"子之存心。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525287976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":168,"lineType":1,"content":"俗術並不論此，漫曰太嵗可坐，何孟浪也！","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525304360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"其中太嵗不疊，戊巳可坐一語，則又可以明戊巳煞","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525320744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"之誤，兼可以證大小月建之偽，誠破的之論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525320744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"其論禄","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525337128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"馬貴人嵗命同到，與古課脗合，而語義尤備。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525337128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰甲","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525353512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520795177"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"命丑月寅禄到乾，則亦止用地支一字，可與真禄叅","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525353512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"觀。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525353512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"各神制化，諸説不同，詳見後。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525369896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：坐三煞，向太嵗，此不能制者也，不可犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525402664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":177,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞在方在向，及隂府在山，此可制而不易制者也，不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525419048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"可輕也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525419048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘紛紛，神煞中煞制之，小煞不必制，有吉星","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525435432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"同到，自能壓伏。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525435432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"除太歳在山在方，宜合不宜衝，灸退在","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525451816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"山在方，宜補不宜尅，此外則四法而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525451816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"干犯干制，如隂","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525468200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520811561"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"府天金神，皆以干制干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525468200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":182,"lineType":1,"content":"支犯支制，如地官符之類，擇","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525484584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"其死月死日修之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525484584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":183,"lineType":1,"content":"三合犯三合制，如三煞打頭火，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525500968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符以三合局尅之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525500968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":184,"lineType":1,"content":"納音犯納音制，如年尅地","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525517352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"金神，以納音制之可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525517352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":185,"lineType":1,"content":"今通書制三煞等法皆用納音，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525533736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":186,"lineType":1,"content":"不知納音力輕，仍當兼地支三合取用方是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525533736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"289","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"千金曰：煞在山頭更若何，貴人禄馬喜相過。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525550120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":187,"lineType":1,"content":"三竒諸德","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525566504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"能降煞，吉制凶神發福多。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525566504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":188,"lineType":1,"content":"此言山頭之中煞、小煞不用","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525582888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"尅制，而止以諸吉照之者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525582888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":189,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋尅則尅倒坐山矣，山值","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525599272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520827945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":191,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚月亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525599272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：吉星有氣小成大，惡曜休囚不降災。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525615656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":192,"lineType":1,"content":"則尅制修方","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525632040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"法也，勿作一例看。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525632040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"尅制者，尅制得法為主，吉星為用。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525648424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":193,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525664808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":194,"lineType":1,"content":"小煞則不必制，遇吉星自伏。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525664808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":195,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽三竒能降諸煞，紫白竅馬能制地官符、大将軍以","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525681192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":196,"lineType":1,"content":"下諸煞，禄制空亡貴人降諸煞，以本命飛到者最為上，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525681192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":197,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳飛到者次之，同到者尤吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525681192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"306","lineNum":198,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞之法，宜用四柱尅之，而不宜衝，尅之則伏，衝之則","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525697576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520844329"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"起，而反為禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525697576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":200,"lineType":1,"content":"除太歳隂府在坐山不宜尅外，其餘諸煞","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525713960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":201,"lineType":1,"content":"如三煞、官符、大将軍、伏兵大禍等項，在坐則重而難制，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525713960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":202,"lineType":1,"content":"在向在方則輕而可降。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525713960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":203,"lineType":1,"content":"方上有煞可制者，先從吉方起手，連及修作，又從吉方","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525730344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":204,"lineType":1,"content":"住手亦佳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525730344","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":205,"lineType":1,"content":"凶方怕疊太歳，怕太歳對衝，怕太歳三合，其方則皆大","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525746728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525746728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":206,"lineType":1,"content":"次之怕月建相疊相衝相合，則亦為禍，不然不甚為","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525763112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525763112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":207,"lineType":1,"content":"葢嵗君與月建之力極大，吉星必藉其力方能作","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525779496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520860713"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"福，凶星必藉其力方能作禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525779496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":209,"lineType":1,"content":"吉方宜動，不修動決不作","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525795880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"福；凶方宜靜，不修動亦不作禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525795880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":210,"lineType":1,"content":"惟年納音所尅之方，雖","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525812264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":211,"lineType":1,"content":"凶亦無害，已為太嵗所制故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525812264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗君月建衝破吉方則不吉，無力故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525828648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":212,"lineType":1,"content":"若衝破凶方則","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525845032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"又凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525845032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋煞如虎如火，合之固起，衝之亦起，惟浮天空亡","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525861416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"占向，可以八字衝之，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525861416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳可坐不可向，三煞可向不可坐，不易之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525877800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"凡制神煞，先令其星失時無氣，更泊死絶休廢之鄉，得","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525894184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520877097"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人當旺之令，修之化煞為權，較之尅制尤穏，恐","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525894184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"壓伏太過，或遇衝合，反為禍也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525894184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"335","lineNum":220,"lineType":1,"content":"書曰：若要貴，修太歳，若要發，修三煞，要大興修火星，要","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525910568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"小興，修金神，要發富，修官符，救冷退，修灸退。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525910568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":221,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：制煞","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525926952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"修方，反獲吉福。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525926952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"此言修，非言𦵏，言修方，非言修山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525943336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525959720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"煞必須尅，而坐山宜補，尅之則山傷，補之則煞旺，故單","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525959720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"云制煞修方者，以方可尅故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525959720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"惟太嵗或在山，或在方，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525976104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"皆可修。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525976104","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋修太嵗者，可合而不可尅，不尅則不傷山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507525992488","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520893481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府與山分而為二，亦可修，尅隂府不尅坐山也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526008872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526025256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"諸煞皆與山方合而為一，故尅制此方，即所以尅制此","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526025256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，惟方不怕尅也，故皆指修方言。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526025256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆修年家坐宫煞，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526041640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"非修月家飛宫煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526041640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":231,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗必疊吉星，不疊凶星，而後修之，君明臣良，其吉可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526058024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"知，故曰大富大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526058024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞連占一方，其力極大，制之得法，自然發福。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526074408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"然此煞","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526090792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"最凶，制不得法，必至為禍，修主孱弱，亦難駕御，不可輕","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526090792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520909865"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":236,"lineType":1,"content":"試。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526090792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"火星乃三合旺方，即打頭火也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526107176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"尅而修之，旺氣發越，大","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526123560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":238,"lineType":1,"content":"發人丁，故曰大興。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526123560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"363","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"火尅金神則為財，以丙丁竒制之，則旺田産，故曰小興。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526139944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":240,"lineType":1,"content":"地官符為嵗，三合修之得法，亦主旺財，故曰發富。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526156328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"三合死方為灸退，以月日旺相輔之，則無氣而有氣矣，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526172712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":242,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰救冷退。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526172712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":243,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞之法，古云干犯干制，支犯支制，三合犯三合制，納","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526189096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520926249"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"音犯納音制，此確論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526189096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":245,"lineType":1,"content":"又有化氣犯者化氣制，坐宫犯","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526205480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"者坐宫制，飛宫犯者飛宫制。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526205480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":246,"lineType":1,"content":"如隂府甲巳屬土，則以丁","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526221864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":247,"lineType":1,"content":"壬木制之，乙庚屬金，則以戊癸火制之，此化氣制化氣","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526221864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526221864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":248,"lineType":1,"content":"如病符小耗，年家之不飛者，以年月日吉照之，此坐","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526238248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"宫制坐宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526238248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"如月家打頭火，則以月家一白或𡈼癸水","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526254632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"徳制之，此飛宫制飛宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526254632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":250,"lineType":1,"content":"又有以隂府甲乙屬木，戊巳","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526271016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"屬土，三煞打頭火官符等項，在寅夘辰則屬木，己午未","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526271016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"則屬火，本煞又自分五行，尅制者倣此，辨衰旺者亦倣","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526271016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520942633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526271016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"384","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞全看月令，必本煞衰月、制神旺月乃可。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526287400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"惟太嵗灸","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526303784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"退另論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526303784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"若諸煞聚㑹，或與太嵗同宫，則不可制，勿犯可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526320168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526320168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"389","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：太嵗以下，凶煞甚多，難以盡避。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526336552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"其各神所臨之","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526352936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"地，惟奏書愽士宜向之，餘各有所忌，須辨生旺休囚，制","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526352936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"化得宜。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526352936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"如有破壊須修營者，以天徳、嵗徳、月徳、天徳合、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526369320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗徳合、月徳合、天恩、天赦、母倉所㑹之辰，或各神出遊","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526369320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520959017"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"日，併工修之無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526369320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"397","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"凡制凶神，宜酌其輕重，不可用煞之生旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526385704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"如煞屬木者，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526402088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"忌春令，并忌亥夘未日時。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526402088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"如用午字，則木煞死，申字，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526418472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"木煞絶，餘可類推。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526418472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"按宗鏡載制煞之法甚詳，醇多疵少，故節取而録之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526434856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰吉方不動不作福，凶方不動不作禍，即洪範龜","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526451240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"蓍共違，靜吉作凶之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526451240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":269,"lineType":1,"content":"原文有曰戊巳煞不動亦凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526467624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"則悖謬已甚矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526467624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府制法，似是而非，辨見後。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526484008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":270,"lineType":1,"content":"通書二","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526500392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520975401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"則，言畧而意該。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526500392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"時憲書載扵年神之下，制煞之大要","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526516776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526516776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"今為逐條詳具扵左。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526533160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"415","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：太嵗，君也，坐之吉，向之凶，衝破坐山故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526565928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526582312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"八字合之吉，衝之尅之凶，以臣犯君故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526582312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"疊紫白三竒、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526598696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人等吉星，則極吉，得君行道，膏澤及民也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526598696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"疊戊","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526615080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"巳年，尅隂府、大煞等凶星，則又極凶，衆凶有藉，倚勢作","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526615080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"孽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526615080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"故太嵗或在山，或在方，審其疊吉而不疊凶，則以","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526631464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086520991785"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱合之，或一氣，或三合局，造𦵏移徙，其福大而且久，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526631464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"非諸吉星可比也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526631464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"必要八節、三竒、太陽、紫白諸吉同到","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526647848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"本命，貴禄臨之尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526647848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿曰：吉莫吉扵修太嵗，凶莫","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526664232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"凶扵犯太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526664232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳所在，宜造𦵏，宜移徙，宜補葺，皆修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526680616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"不可拆毁，不可穵窖開池，皆犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526697000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"按太嵗為歳君吉星，㑹扵坐山，乘旺固吉，然不得已","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526713384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"而修作及𦵏事則可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526713384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"若興造之事，本屬可緩，行險","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526729768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"儌倖，未必得福，不如其勿犯也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526729768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"content":"通書有用月日納音","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526746152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521008169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"尅太嵗納音之説，益屬無理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526746152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"至可坐不可向，則不易","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526762536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"之論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526762536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋向太歳則坐于歳破矣，雖有吉星，不能解也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507526778920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"又按坐太歳固吉，而亦有不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671957538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"如子午夘酉年，太歳","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671973922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"與大煞同位三，然與歳破同方，則坐之亦不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671973922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671990306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"因飛宫大煞名打頭火，遂謂太歳疊打頭火凶，失其","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671990306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"義矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507671990306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"今改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672006690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：三煞止忌修方，先從吉方起手，連及修之無害。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672039458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521024553"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":299,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年三煞在己午未，若巽坤方有吉星，則從巽方起","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672055842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"工，連及己午未方，至坤方止工亦可，止忌單修己午未","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672055842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"方是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672055842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"456","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：三煞乃極猛之煞，伏兵大禍次之，要制伏得倒，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672072226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"占山造𦵏皆忌，惟占方可制而修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672072226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"制法有三，一要三","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"合局以勝之，二要三合得令之月，三煞休囚之月，三要","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"本命貴人禄馬及八節三竒，或日月以照臨之，小修則","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"或月或日之納音，尅三煞方之納音，得一吉星到方可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521040937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672088610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"三煞在南方己午未則屬火，用申子辰月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672104994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"在東","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672121378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"方寅夘辰則屬木，用己酉丑月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672121378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"在西方申酉戌則","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672137762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金，用寅、午、戌，月日時在北方亥、子、丑，則屬水。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672137762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"三合無","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672154146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"土局，不能制，忌用辰戌丑未相衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672154146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿為𡈼申宅主，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672170530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"修午未三煞方，取甲辰年、戊辰月、𡈼子日、庚子時豎柱","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672170530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"與𡈼申年生，命成申子辰水局，以尅火煞，一吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672170530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":313,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672186914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"庚天干三竒，又辰子兩支不雜，二吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672186914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":314,"lineType":1,"content":"榖雨前太陽在","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"戌，與午方三合，而甲戊庚貴人在未，三吉也；甲年午未","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521057321"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"方為庚午辛未，納音屬土，而戊辰月、𡈼子日納音皆木，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"以木尅土，四吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672203298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":318,"lineType":1,"content":"命馬𡈼寅歳禄、歳馬丙寅俱到離，五","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672219682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672219682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"八白在坎照離，九紫正在未坤，六吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672236066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"古人之妙","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":320,"lineType":1,"content":"用如此。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672252450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"486","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"按：三煞為太歳三合之衝，可向不可坐，故占山則造","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672268834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏皆忌，占方則可制而修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672268834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"然各年不可概論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672285218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":322,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672301602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥年，煞在生我之方，為收開閉之位，又當休氣；辰、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672301602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"戌、丑未年，煞在我生之方，為除滿平之位，又當相氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672301602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521073705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"制化之法，雖輕重亦有不同，而要可制之化之，變凶","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672317986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"而為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672317986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"若子、午、夘、酉年則三，然與歳破同方，對方","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672334370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳又與大煞同位，雖有制伏，亦難以吉論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672334370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"故子、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672350754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"午、夘、酉年，災煞最凶，劫煞、歳煞次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672350754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申、己、亥年，嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672367138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"煞最凶，刼煞、災煞次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672367138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、丑、未年，畧與子、午、夘、酉","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672383522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"等。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672383522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":331,"lineType":1,"content":"若寅、申年之刼煞，夘、酉年之歳煞，與太歳為六合，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672399906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"其凶尤小。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672399906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":332,"lineType":1,"content":"如𡈼寅年用𡈼寅，月日時修亥方，則四禄","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672416290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"聚亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672416290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"乙酉年用庚辰，月日時修辰方，則一氣皆金，並","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672432674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521090089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"不以歳煞論矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672432674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"又寅、午、戌、亥、夘、未年為煞尅歳，己、酉、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672449058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"丑、申、子、辰年為歳尅煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672449058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"煞尅嵗者，俟其休囚之令用","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672465442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672465442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗尅煞者，則惟忌子、午、夘、酉四旺月，餘月皆可用，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672481826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"只取吉神到方，八字成格而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672481826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"又化煞變尅為生，與","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672498210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"制煞之義有别。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672498210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"煞尅嵗者，用煞之子，如金煞尅木，歳","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672514594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"用水局，月日時則洩金以生木矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672514594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"嵗尅煞者，用煞之","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672530978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":341,"lineType":1,"content":"財，如水嵗尅火，煞用金局，月日時則洩火以生水矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672530978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"用子煞休，用財煞囚，具有妙義。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672547362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":342,"lineType":1,"content":"惟木煞無土局，則不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672563746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521106473"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"用化而用制可也；水煞無土局，則不用制而用化可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672563746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672563746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿取用甚精，夫亦舉一隅耳，引而伸之，觸類","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672580130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"而長之，選擇之能事畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672580130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"月三煞倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672596514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"531","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：山家以得氣運為妙，如月分與山運生旺比和，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672629282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"宜用之，月分衰病亦可用，惟忌年月日時尅山運耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672629282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"然","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672645666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"止忌開山，凡新立宅舍，修造動土，逾月安𦵏論之，旬日","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672645666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"之内不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672645666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":351,"lineType":1,"content":"袝𦵏祖塋，倒堂豎造，或現成基址，不動地基，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672662050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521122857"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"亦不忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672662050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":353,"lineType":1,"content":"又本日尅山家者，如甲子年作水土山年，納音","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672678434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"屬金，尅山家，木運當取火，月日時生旺兼作，主火命併","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672678434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬貴人制之吉，月日尅者亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672678434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"542","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"按洪範五行専論山運，自為一家之言。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672694818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"年尅山家，世","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672711202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"俗避之唯謹，雖有月日尅制之説，用者絶少，惟旬日","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672711202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"内不忌，世多用之，深以為便。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672711202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"夫𦵏之吉凶，不因日之","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672727586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"近久，旬日無咎，踰月何傷？","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672727586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"荀悦曰：非吉凶所從生，洵","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672743970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"知言矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672743970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"然以五行生尅之理而論，則以月日尅年納","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672760354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521139241"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"音，不如以年納音生月日化尅為生，於理為順。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672760354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"再","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672776738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"得正五行，補龍扶山，自應吉無不利。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672776738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"月尅較輕，日","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672793122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"時尤輕，八字成局，納音自可勿論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672793122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"俗本又云：年尅","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672809506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":365,"lineType":1,"content":"妨宅長，月尅妨宅母，日尅妨子孫，則無稽已甚，不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672809506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"足道矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672809506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：此煞惟忌山頭，不忌作向修方，惟安𦵏不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672842274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":369,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：正隂府忌修陽宅，安𦵏不忌；傍隂府忌坐山，修造","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672858658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521155625"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672858658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":371,"lineType":1,"content":"用天月徳太陽到山制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672875042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：舊説隂府單占坐山，以正五行之七煞尅之，必","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672891426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":373,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府衰月，七煞旺相得令之月，如甲乙隂府屬木，宜以","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672891426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"庚尅甲，以辛尅乙，然必七月八月金旺木衰，乃可制也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672891426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"又隂府生山者可制，為坐山所尅者可制，若與坐山同","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672907810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"類，則不可制，制則尅倒坐山。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672907810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"如震金山，戊癸年為隂府，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672924194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"癸生震，戊受尅扵震，可制而修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672924194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"若兑木山，乙庚年為","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672940578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"隂府，乙可制也，若以丙尅庚，則兑山傷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672940578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":378,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆指修山","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672956962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521172009"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"而言，若𦵏地決不可犯，且尅隂府，即尅嵗君，嵗君不可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672956962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672956962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"按隂府之義，本屬紆逺，義例甚明，術士不知其義，又","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672973346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"以襲誤傳譌，遂各為臆説而不可解。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672973346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":383,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲山，丁𡈼年","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672989730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂府，以丁𡈼屬木，尅甲巳之土也；丙辛山，甲巳年","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672989730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"為隂府，以甲巳屬土，尅丙辛之水也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507672989730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":385,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡引舊説乃","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673006114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"曰甲隂府屬木，宜以庚尅之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673006114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"将謂丁𡈼年用庚尅甲","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673022498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":387,"lineType":1,"content":"山，則山已受太嵗化氣之尅，何堪又受月日正五行","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673022498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521188393"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"之尅？","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673022498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":389,"lineType":1,"content":"将謂丙辛山用庚尅甲年，無論嵗干不宜尅，而","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673038882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"尅又非其所尅。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673038882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"夫甲年之所以尅丙辛山者，在土不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673055266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"在木，而欲以金尅之，誠不解其何謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673055266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":391,"lineType":1,"content":"若其與坐山","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673071650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"同類不可制之説，則專指尅太嵗而言，而五行亦不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673071650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"合。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673071650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":393,"lineType":1,"content":"如兑山，乙庚年為隂府，乃以兑為屬木，而謂以丙","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673088034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"尅庚，傷兑山，則又以兑為屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673088034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五行各有專屬，理","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673104418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":395,"lineType":1,"content":"之自然，雖諸家取義不同，亦必自成一説，㫁無忽命","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673104418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"為木，忽命為金之理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673104418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":396,"lineType":1,"content":"然曰尅隂府，即尅嵗君，猶知隂","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673120802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521204777"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"府之義，在年不在山。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673120802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"若諸家通書，從年起例，所列隂","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673137186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"府皆山，則所謂制隂府者，皆尅山耳，並未有知尅嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673137186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"君者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673137186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"至其曰正、曰傍，諸説不一，大抵天干畧近，卦","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673153570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"義尤逺。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673153570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":401,"lineType":1,"content":"然觀臺官所傳，及展轉遺誤之故，又似卦係","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673169954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"正文詳見義例本節。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673169954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"究之五行之義，當以正五行為","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673186338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"本。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673186338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"其有取化氣者，必實有合化之義，而後取之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673202722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"兹乃","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673219106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"舍正取化，又非逐年遞變，與五運之義亦不合，良不","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673219106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"可為典要。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673219106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"世人不察，以其名為太嵗也，而即謂不可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673235490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521221161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"犯；以其名為隂府也，而即謂安𦵏凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673235490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"又無確切制化","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673251874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"之法為之解説，多致疑畏誤事。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673251874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡補龍篇載曽文","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673268258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":409,"lineType":1,"content":"辿開乾山，一用丁酉年、己酉月、甲申日、己巳時；一用","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673268258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"己酉年、癸酉月、𡈼申日、丁巳時，謂隂府有金制，甚為","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673268258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"精當。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673268258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋乾納甲申巳化土，丁𡈼為隂府，用申巳酉年","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673284642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"月日時，一氣皆金，則丁𡈼不得化木，非但制之已也，","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673284642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"且安知其非以金局扶乾山乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673284642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"若甲山隂府，則不可","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673301026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"用金制。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673301026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋甲之化土，其理曲，而甲本屬木，其理直。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673317410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"茍","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673333794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521237545"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"以金尅丁𡈼，丁𡈼未必受尅，而甲木已先傷矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673333794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"毋寧","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673350178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"丁年用火局，𡈼年用水局，用水以生甲之本行，用火","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673350178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"以生甲之化氣，而丁𡈼各從旺論，自不能化木而尅","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673350178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"土，乃為得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673350178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"倣此類推，則制之可也，化之亦可也，使","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673366562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"各從其類，而自不尅我，亦無不可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673366562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，以補龍扶","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673382946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"山為主，太嵗而外，各隨其義以為化裁，則不惑扵俗","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673382946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"術之曲説矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673382946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521253929"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：灸退為三合死地，可向而不可坐，取天道、天徳、","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673415714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳、嵗禄、貴人制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673415714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"649","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：凡煞皆强梁有餘，故宜尅，灸退乃休囚不足，故","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673432098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"宜補。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673432098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋二十四方位之氣，皆隨太嵗轉移，灸退乃太歳","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673448482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"死地，山方無氣，冷淡休囚，故宜擇旺相月，或月日時一","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673448482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，或月日時三合補之，則不退而反盛旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673448482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"若再加尅","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673464866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"制，則愈休囚愈退敗矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673464866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"如申子辰年屬水，水死扵夘，夘","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673481250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"為灸退。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673481250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿取丙申年、辛夘月、乙夘日、己夘時修夘","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673497634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521270313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"方，則三夘一氣局也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673497634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"或亥夘未三合亦可，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673514018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"再得","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673530402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"命禄，嵗禄同到，或天干堆禄尤妙。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673530402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"假如修夘方，灸退用","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673546786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"三乙字，乙禄到夘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673546786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"然以一氣局或三合局為主，而禄","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673563170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"不必甚拘。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673563170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"通書有用六合者，有單取堆禄者，非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939507673579554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"已上","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242382848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"補法，雖係修方，然修山亦可","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242382848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"671","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"按補灸退之法，宗鏡得之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242399232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"通書用徳禄，亦是貴人，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242415616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"差輕耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242415616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521286697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：大将軍，方伯之神，其方忌興造，若不㑹諸凶，用","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242448384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"真太陽制之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242448384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂弔客同方嵗后也，其方忌興造，宜","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242464768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽嵗徳三合制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242464768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"680","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：大将軍占方不可修，然有輕重，如己午未年，将","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242481152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"軍在夘，甲巳年則夘乃丁夘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242481152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"再以月建入中宫，順數","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242497536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"九宫，惟乙亥月丁夘仍在夘上，謂之将軍還位修造，犯","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242497536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"之凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242497536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"餘月則丁夘飛出别方夘上，得年家月家之紫白，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242513920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":450,"lineType":1,"content":"或太陽三竒，亦可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242513920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521303081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":453,"lineType":1,"content":"按蓬瀛書曰：嵗在四孟，太隂與大将軍合扵四仲，名","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242530304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"曰羣醜，必須太陽到方。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242530304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"如申年太隂大将軍合扵午，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242546688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":455,"lineType":1,"content":"必六月太陽到午宫，又用午時修之，所謂真太陽到","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242546688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"方也，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242546688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"若寅月太隂與大将軍合扵子，子時太陽","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242563072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"無光，兼取丙丁竒九紫到方為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242563072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":457,"lineType":1,"content":"若不㑹太隂，不疊","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242579456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"凶煞，則有一二吉星，亦可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242579456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"698","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：官符有天官符、地官符，用年月日時納音尅之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242612224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521319465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲子年天官符在亥，遁得乙亥，納音屬火，以水納音","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242628608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242628608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"又用一白水星水徳制之，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242644992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：官符一年","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242661376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"止占一字三竒，紫白禄馬貴人，一吉星到方，即從吉方","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242661376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"起工連及，修之吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242661376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：官符本非大凶，遇竅馬吉，或太陽到，或紫白到，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242677760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"或扵其死月以天赦日解之以修，主命貴人禄馬臨之","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242677760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"反吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242677760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"曽文辿曰：紛紛神煞不須求，但逢尅應便堪修。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242694144","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":468,"lineType":1,"content":"吉","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242710528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"星若照官符位，為官職位顯皇州。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242710528","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":469,"lineType":1,"content":"此言官符之可修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242726912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521335849"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"地官符遇竅馬即吉，遇紫白亦吉，不必尅也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242743296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":471,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松為","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242759680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"人解訟，以命貴解官符。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242759680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"癸亥年地官符在夘，修主乙亥","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242776064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":473,"lineType":1,"content":"生命隂貴人，戊子以太嵗癸亥入中宫，戊子到震夘方","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242776064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"也，用午月，夘木死扵午也，用甲午日，天赦也，訟果解，所","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242776064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"謂支犯支制也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242776064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符乃三合中煞，或倣上制三煞例，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242792448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合局制之，然比三煞則輕矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242792448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"年月納音尅之，亦可","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242808832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"修也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242808832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"己未年天官符在寅，十一月有𦵏寅山申向者，小","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242825216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"雪後太陽到山，平安迪吉，至月家飛宫官符，尤無妨碍，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242825216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521352233"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"謂必不可犯者，謬也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242825216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：天官符以年月納音尅之，或","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242841600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"日納音亦可，再得太陽照之，三竒紫白亦可。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242841600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"若以三合","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242857984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"局尅之，則尤伏矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242857984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"但不喜其還宫月分耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242874368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"734","lineNum":483,"lineType":1,"content":"按官符、白虎、大煞為嵗三合，若疊凶煞，則為太嵗所","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242890752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"弔照，其凶有力，故以為忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242890752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"若疊吉星，則亦吉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242907136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"故當","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242923520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"以吉星照臨為取用之法，納音尅制次之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242923520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":485,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰三合","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242939904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"制之尤伏，似亦以為太過之意。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242939904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":486,"lineType":1,"content":"月家飛宫復臨本位，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242956288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":487,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之還宫，飛伏同到，嫌其過旺，則以三合局尅之可","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242956288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521368617"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242956288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"天官符為歳臨官之方，亦畧與地官符同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242972672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242989056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"疊太嵗則凶，見火星條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508242989056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"749","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"紀嵗歴曰：喪門所理之地，不可興舉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243021824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"弔客所理之地，不","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243038208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"可興造，及問病尋醫，弔孝送喪。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243038208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"752","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"按喪門弔客為嵗破三合小煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243054592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"三合之衝破則凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243070976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"破之三合未為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243070976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"如兩方同修，則與嵗破合局，衝","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243087360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"尅嵗君，大忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243087360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"若單修一方，則止取吉星照，蓋用嵗三","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243103744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521385001"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"合月日，惟忌嵗破三合月日耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243103744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"如子年喪門在寅，弔","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243120128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"客在戌，修寅方宜用子辰月日時合太嵗，忌用寅午","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243120128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"戌月日時合嵗破，亦不用申衝寅方也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243120128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"問病尋醫，弔","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243136512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"孝送喪應不忌，且如太嵗在南方，将終年不向南行","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243136512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243136512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
