{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"乾坤寳典曰：黄幡所理之地，不可取土開門。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243169280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"豹尾所在","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243185664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"之方，不宜嫁娶興造。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243185664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521401385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"按子、午、夘、酉年，黄幡即官符，豹尾即弔客；寅、申、己亥","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243202048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"年，黄幡即白虎，豹尾即喪門。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243202048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、丑、未年，黄幡即太","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243218432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"歳，豹尾即歳破。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243218432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"當從各神以為制化。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243234816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"黄幡為歳三合","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243251200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"墓地，忌取土開門，亦屬有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243251200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"如不得已而用之，則取","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243267584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"天道、天徳、月徳到方可矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243267584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"豹尾尤輕嫁娶，非忌其方，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243283968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"惟上轎下轎忌向之，凡凶煞皆然，豹尾却不足忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243283968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"巡山羅㬋、　病符、　死符、　小耗。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243300352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：巡山羅㬋忌立向，不忌開山。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243316736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"修方通書曰：以一","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243333120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521417769"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"白水星制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243333120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"明原曰：病符主災病，死符小耗同方，忌塜","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243349504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"墓置死喪，及穿掘造作。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243349504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"789","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"按巡山羅㬋為太歳前一位，逼近太嵗，故立向忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243365888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年在甲，巳年在丙，申年在庚，亥年在𡈼，雖近而不","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243382272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243382272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":521,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫雙山之月，有吉星到山到向，坐山乘旺，猶","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243398656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"可擇吉取用。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243398656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":522,"lineType":1,"content":"若子年在癸，丑年在艮，夘年在乙，辰年","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243415040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"在巽，午年在丁，未年在坤，酉年在辛，戌年在乾，則與","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243415040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳同宫，勿犯可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243415040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"通書謂以一白水星制之，則誤","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243431424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521434153"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"作四餘之羅㬋，以為屬火，謬矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243431424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"病符為舊太嵗，故亦","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243447808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"忌立向。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243447808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"死符為舊歳破，故亦忌開山，然皆小煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243464192","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"子、午、","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243480576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"夘、酉年，猶與太歳歳破同行，餘年則性情迥别，各取","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243480576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"山向三合月，吉星蓋照，便自可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243480576","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"但日時勿干犯本","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243496960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"年太嵗歳破耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243496960","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"810","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：歳刑忌修方，六害忌開山，月刑、月害止忌修方，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243529728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"宜取太陽三竒、紫白禄馬貴人制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243529728","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521450537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"按辰、午、酉、亥年，歳刑即太歳，未申年，歳刑即嵗破，開","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243546112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"山立向，修方皆忌，吉不能制也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243546112","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年止忌修方，太陽","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243562496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"六徳可以化之，月刑亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243562496","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":539,"lineType":1,"content":"六害為六合之衝，故忌開","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243578880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"山。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243578880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":540,"lineType":1,"content":"然惟辰戌年疊灸退，己亥年疊刼煞，子午年疊歳","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243595264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，當兼補制之法，而以太陽六徳化之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243595264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年則凡有","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243611648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星到山，三合月、六合六徳日即吉，惟六合月不可","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243611648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"用。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243611648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":543,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋嵗之六合月，則六害為月破，六害之六合月，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243628032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"月又為嵗破，皆不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243628032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"若月害對方，即是太陽，但擇","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243644416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521466921"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"吉日即可修，惟忌刑衝耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243644416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經曰：蠶室所理之方，不可修動。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243677184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"歴例曰：蠶官所理","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243693568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，忌營搆宫室。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243693568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"蠶命所理之地，不可舉動百事，犯之","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243709952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"皆絲繭不收。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243709952","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"835","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"按：蠶室、蠶官、蠶命，為歳方長生之宫，皆無凶義，而堪","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243726336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"輿經歴例以為絲繭之占，亦恐傷生氣耳，非凶煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243726336","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"應忌扵其方修作蠶室，若養蠶則又應為吉方，餘當","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243742720","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"844","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"按力士恒居太歳前，維辰、戌、丑、未年，與巡山羅㬋同","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243808256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"位，太嵗同宫，不惟不宜抵向修造，亦不可犯，餘年不","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243808256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243808256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"飛亷亦小煞，子、丑、寅、午、未、申年，同白虎，夘、辰、巳、","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243824640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"酉、戌、亥年，同喪門，當同各煞制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243824640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"851","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰獨火、打頭火、月逰火，忌修造，不忌安𦵏，然必與","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243857408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"年遁丙丁，或月家丙丁獨火㑹合方忌，不㑹不忌，丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243857408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"獨火不與諸火㑹合，亦不忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243857408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"宜用一白水星水徳制","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243873792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243873792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"又本曰忌用丙丁，寅、午戌月日時並丙丁竒九紫助","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243890176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":569,"lineType":1,"content":"其火氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243890176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"858","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：打頭火即大煞，為太歳三合旺方，又為金匱星","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243906560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"書云人家衰弱修金匱，獨火将星原同位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243906560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋大旺","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243922944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355086521516073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"則亢，亢則屬火，然制化得宜，修動旺方，則發丁旺家惟","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243922944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"子午夘酉年疊歳君不可犯，其餘年分倣上制三煞法，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243922944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"以三合局制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243922944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"通書忌用寅午戌局，非是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243939328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":575,"lineType":1,"content":"若己酉丑年","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243955712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"打頭火在酉，不用寅午戌火局，何以制金之旺氣乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243955712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":576,"lineType":1,"content":"此","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243972096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"煞與天官符俱可吉可凶，不與三煞比三合制矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243972096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"再得","logicSentenceId":"7678939508243988480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"c {"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"按制火星之法，諸説皆同。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439629876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"水徳𡈼癸也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439646260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":585,"lineType":1,"content":"年家用年干","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439662644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"起五虎遁，月家用月建入中宫，順數至𡈼癸是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439662644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"四","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439679028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"柱忌丙丁，不忌寅午戌，宗鏡説是三竒丙丁三元九","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439679028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"892","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"紫雖不忌，亦不取耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439679028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"893","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"月家金匱方，今通書不載，然亦","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439695412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"有理。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439695412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"四仲月會月建亦須避忌，與太歳同。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439711796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"898","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：金神遇天干庚辛者，宜用天干丙丁制之；遇納","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439744564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":593,"lineType":1,"content":"音屬金者，宜用地支己午制之，更宜用丙丁竒，太陽羅","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439744564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":594,"lineType":1,"content":"星九紫及寅午戌火局制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439744564","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"901","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：金神忌修方動土，犯之主目疾。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439760948","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋目屬肝，肝屬","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439777332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"木，金能尅木也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439777332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏事不忌，制之之法，以火尅之而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439793716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"庚","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439810100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"辛干者，為天金神，以丙丁干制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439810100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"納音金者，為地金神，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439826484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"908","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"以納音火制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439826484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"又八節之丙丁竒，或年家之九紫，有氣，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439842868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399570963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"皆能制之，修作無害，非甚𦂳煞也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439842868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"巳月金生，申酉月金","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439859252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"旺，則不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439859252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"金神在申酉方，謂生旺得地，則必扵火旺","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439875636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"之月，以寅午戌三合制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439875636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"若在午未方，則火地尅之，不","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439892020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"917","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"待制而自可修矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439892020","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"919","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：浮天空亡，乃年干、納卦、絶命破軍之位，用天徳、","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439924788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"月徳照之，本命貴人禄馬制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439924788","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"921","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"按浮天空亡，以年干取納甲之卦，又以卦變絶命，兼","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439941172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399587347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"取所納之干，較之隂府太歳，取義更為紆逺。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439941172","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"各本通","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439957556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"書俱用之，然亦年家小煞耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439957556","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"當以六徳照之，非但天","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439973940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"月二徳而已。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439973940","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":611,"lineType":1,"content":"絶命破軍扵九曜屬金，取三竒九紫到","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439990324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"方，扵義為切，貴人禄馬則通例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508439990324","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":612,"lineType":1,"content":"一説用月日刑衝","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440006708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"之，大謬。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440006708","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":613,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以月刑衝之，則其方係月刑月破矣；以日","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440023092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"刑衝之，則其方係日刑日破矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440023092","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"934","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"二者皆選擇 {"lines":[{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399603731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：修造犯之，主虛耗，宜用太陽三竒，嵗月徳合、嵗","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440072244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"命貴人、禄馬制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440072244","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"940","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"按破敗五鬼，為年干納卦之衝，較之浮天空亡，尤為","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440088628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"941","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"小煞，歳月徳合制之，固為親切，然太陽三竒紫白，有","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440088628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"一吉星到方，亦自可修矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440088628","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"944","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭為堪輿宗㫖，董仲舒言之極詳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440121396","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"今時憲書與天道","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440137780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"946","lineNum":625,"lineType":1,"content":"天德並載扵逐月之下，天道天徳用日而兼用方，則月","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440137780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399620115"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"厭當亦兼方論也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440137780","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":627,"lineType":1,"content":"子午、夘、酉月，與建破同方，必不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440154164","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥月次之，寅申辰戌為月三合，丑未月為生氣，太陽","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440170548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"丙丁照之可用。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440170548","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"又按古有歳厭之説，子年起子逆行，與","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440186932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭同義。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440186932","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"五鬼子年起辰逆行，常居歳厭三合前辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440203316","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440219700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"以方位考之，則五鬼乃月厭之白虎厭，所謂前，猶歳所","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440219700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"謂後也，為月厭之後，從隂中之隂，故曰五鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440219700","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦小煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440236084","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":633,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽三竒、紫白禄馬、貴人，蓋照皆可用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440252468","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399636499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳歴曰：月建所理之方，戰鬭攻伐宜背之，不可抵向。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440285236","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"963","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"太白經曰：五帝所在，出軍不可向之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440301620","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"964","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"按月建可坐不可向，月破可向不可坐，與太歳、歳破","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440318004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"同，歳尊而月親也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440318004","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"通書建破論日而不論方，大小月","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440334388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"建論飛宫而不論定位，殊失其㫖。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440334388","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"世俗春不開東門，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440350772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"夏不開南門，秋不開西門，冬不開北門，則太白經五","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440350772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"帝之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440350772","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399652883"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：大月建忌修方動土，小月建即小兒煞，止忌修","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440383540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"方，用禄馬、太陽、三白、九紫制之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440383540","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡曰：月家土煞為大","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440399924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"月建，小兒煞與年家戊巳煞同。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440399924","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"小月建忌修方，不忌安","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440416308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440416308","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"修方占山、占向、占中宫亦凶，大月建尤凶，不可制，造","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440432692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"𦵏皆忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440432692","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"通書遷𦵏不載者，非。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440449076","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"982","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"按小月建，陽年以正月寅建入中宫，隂年以正月戌","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440465460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":651,"lineType":1,"content":"厭入中宫，皆順數至本建，則小月建者，乃月支飛宫","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440465460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440465460","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"大月建，子年正月起艮，逆飛九宫，三年一周，十五","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440481844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399669267"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"年三元，周而復始，則大月建者，乃月干支飛宫，即其","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440481844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"月入中宫一星之本宫耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440481844","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"詳見義例。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440498228","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"以理而論，自較","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440514612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"月建之定位為輕，通書説是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440514612","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡據俗術之妄説，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440530996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"大月建主傷宅長，小月建主傷小兒，占山、占向、占方、","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440530996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"占中宫皆忌，而反詆通書不忌安𦵏為非，實為過當。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440530996","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"且太嵗三煞亦或止忌山，或止忌向，或止忌方，安有","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440547380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"山、方、中宫只占一處，遂無往不忌之理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440547380","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰月家","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440563764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"土煞則是。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440563764","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦惟子、午、夘、酉年正、七月，辰、戌、丑、未年","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440580148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399685651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":663,"lineType":1,"content":"八、九月，寅、申、己亥年十一月，大月建與本月建同宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440580148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之還位，及疊戊巳、五黄，或入中宫，則不可犯。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440580148","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"餘月","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440596532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"則有貴人、禄馬、六徳之竒到方便自可修。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440596532","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"如太嵗疊","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440612916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星則吉是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440612916","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵術士之説，多自相矛盾而不可","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440629300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"通。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440629300","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"如謂月建為吉凶衆神之主，疊吉星則吉，疊凶星","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440645684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"則凶，而又謂大月建凶不可制，其不可從明矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440645684","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"以上","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440662068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"各條，各隨其義，以為制化。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440662068","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"若然，多而大凶，則不可犯，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440678452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"若二三小煞，則叅互取義可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440678452","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱以年為君，月為相，日為有司，時為胥吏。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440711220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":673,"lineType":1,"content":"所貴支干","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440727604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"純粹，成格成局，扶龍相主，如君臣合徳，官吏奉法，而人","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440727604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"民實受其福也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440727604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"年為君，故四柱切忌衝動太嵗。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440743988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"月為相，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440760372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"當旺一時，故扶龍山相主命，必擇龍山主命旺相之月，","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440760372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"而制煞修方，必擇煞神休囚之月。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440760372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"日為有司，君相之徳","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440776756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"賴以承宣，故日之吉凶較年月尤切。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440776756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"用日之法，又以日","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440793140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"干為君，日支為臣，干重而支輕。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440793140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1029","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"日干必要旺相，切忌休","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440809524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1030","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399718419"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1031","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"囚。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440809524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1032","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"總看月令以辨衰旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440825908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"如寅夘月遇甲乙日為旺，丙丁","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440842292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"日為相，皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440842292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚辛日為廢𡈼，癸日為洩，戊巳日為受","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440858676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，皆不吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440858676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":683,"lineType":1,"content":"然此不當令之日干，如四干三干一氣，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440875060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"比助身强。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440875060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"如二月用四辛夘，此大八字也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440891444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"難逢難遇，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440907828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"取小八字。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440907828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"如五月甲日休囚，楊筠松亥年修夘方地官","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440924212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"符用癸亥年、戊午月、甲午日、丙寅時。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440924212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋甲日生在亥，禄","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440940596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅，又有年干癸水、亥宫𡈼水以生之，此古人扶持日","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440940596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"干之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440940596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂小八字，以四柱支干不純，将就取用","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440956980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399734803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440956980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"楊公曰：取干最宜逢健旺，即日干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440973364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"造命書曰：日干","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440989748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"休囚，非貧即夭。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508440989748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"皆名言也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441006132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":691,"lineType":1,"content":"若日干休囚，而又無比肩，無","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441022516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"印綬，立見退敗。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441022516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"用時有二法，或與本日支干一類，或日","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441038900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"干之禄時而已，時神吉凶不必拘也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441038900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"四柱最忌地支相衝，大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441055284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"衝龍、衝山、衝主命，亦大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441071668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"天","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441088052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"干尅龍山，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441088052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"惟辰戌丑未為四庫，自衝，可衝山亦可衝","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441104436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"主命則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441104436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":697,"lineType":1,"content":"凡四柱得天干一氣，或地支一氣，或兩干兩支不雜，或","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441120820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399751187"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"三台，或三竒三徳，謂之成格。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441120820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"三合局謂之成局，皆吉格","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441137204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939508441137204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"然必扶龍山相主命乃吉，如是則體立矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001551872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"再得日月","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001568256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"竒白照臨山向，又四柱之貴人禄馬到山到命，則用行","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001568256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001568256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"體用兼全，上也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001584640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"然有體而後求用，切不可騖用而失","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001601024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"體。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001601024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"按宗鏡四柱法，造𦵏皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001617408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"其上取大八字，其次亦取","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001633792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"小八字，謂用時止有二法，則其義未備。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001633792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"三合六合貴","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001650176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"人皆吉，不專取禄。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001650176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":706,"lineType":1,"content":"如申年月甲日，則禄為破，要在合","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001666560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399767571"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"年月以取用耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001666560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"小修止擇吉日吉時，與山方年命生","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001682944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"合則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001682944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":709,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋選擇所以利民，過拘則廢事，篇中所謂難","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001699328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"逢難遇是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001699328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"日貴旺相，得令。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001732096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"忌休囚無氣，而日干尤重。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001748480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"日之吉凶，全","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001764864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1092","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"看衰旺，日之衰旺，全看月令。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001764864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1093","lineNum":713,"lineType":1,"content":"當令者旺，受生者相，皆大","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001781248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1094","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001781248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"尅月令者囚，受尅扵月令者死，皆凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001797632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"日生月者休，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001814016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"不為吉，故母倉非上吉日。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509001814016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399849491"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1168","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"凡辰、戌、丑、未月修作中宫，決不可用戊巳日。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002551296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1169","lineNum":756,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋中宫與","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002567680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1170","lineNum":757,"lineType":1,"content":"四季月皆屬土，再見土日必不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002567680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1171","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"按宗鏡用日法專取旺相，自為一家之言，而與建、除、","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002584064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1172","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"叢、辰諸家亦不相背，甚為可取。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002584064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1173","lineNum":759,"lineType":1,"content":"然其論戊巳日，則謂","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002600448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1174","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、戌、丑、未月日忌修中宫者是，謂動土最忌者非。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002600448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1175","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"論","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002616832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1176","lineNum":761,"lineType":1,"content":"四廢日，則以正四廢為凶者是，以傍四廢為凶者非；","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002616832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1177","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"荒蕪日即五虚日，以忌百事為謬者是，謂一月止忌","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002616832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1178","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"一字者非。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002616832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1179","lineNum":763,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋古人造𦵏，四柱取全局，故春月忌巳、酉、","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002633216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1180","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399865875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1181","lineNum":765,"lineType":1,"content":"丑及庚、辛、申、酉年、月日時，夘月酉衝，故尤忌，非謂見","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002633216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1182","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"一字之即為荒廢也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002633216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1183","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"且又有此肩相扶之法，亦非概","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002649600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1184","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"以荒廢為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002649600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1185","lineNum":767,"lineType":1,"content":"觀其謂子、午、夘、酉為轉煞，而又載古人","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002665984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"之不忌，以為明徵，其義可見。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002665984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"至其以寅月甲日、夘月","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002682368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":769,"lineType":1,"content":"乙日為得令得禄，則醇乎其醇，勝扵復日之義逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002682368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"總之，日神吉凶，皆以生旺為主，四時五行至為活變，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002698752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"當與宜忌叅看，則輕重取舍甚明。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002698752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":771,"lineType":1,"content":"至以年時合成八","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002715136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"字，則又非宜忌之所能盡，神而明之，存乎其人耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002715136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"時者，日之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002747904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":775,"lineType":1,"content":"全在幇扶日辰，或與日支干比和，或與","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002764288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"日支三合、六合即吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002764288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"時家吉凶神不必盡拘，惟貴人禄","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002780672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"馬為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002780672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":777,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲、戊、庚日，以丑、未時為貴人，甲日禄到寅時，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002797056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1201","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"子辰日馬到寅時是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002797056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1202","lineNum":779,"lineType":1,"content":"時衝月令衝歳君皆凶，大事則忌，小事可勿論。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002813440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1203","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"時破大凶，日支衝時支也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002829824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1204","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"如子日午時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002846208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1205","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"時刑次凶，日支刑時支也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002862592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1206","lineNum":781,"lineType":1,"content":"如子日夘時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002878976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1207","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399898643"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1208","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"五不遇時次凶，時干尅日干也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002895360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1209","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日庚午時之類。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002911744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1210","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002928128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1211","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"元歌曰：縱得三竒與三門，五不遇兮損光明。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002928128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1212","lineNum":785,"lineType":1,"content":"可知其凶，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002944512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1213","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"切忌之。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002944512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"1214","lineNum":787,"lineType":1,"content":"旬中空亡截路空亡忌出行，不忌𦵏事。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002960896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1215","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"時建吉與日比和也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002977280","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1216","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"凡犯五不遇則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509002993664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1217","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"古人多用建時，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003010048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1218","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"決不用破時，用五不遇者亦少。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003010048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1219","lineNum":789,"lineType":1,"content":"楊筠松𦵏丁巳亡命，子","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003026432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1220","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"山午向，用𡈼申戊申、𡈼申戊申建時五不遇，然取兩干","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003026432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1221","lineNum":791,"lineType":1,"content":"不雜，地支一氣，又戊禄到己，申與已合，且戊𡈼同生扵","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003026432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399915027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1223","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"申，故不以不遇為嫌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003026432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1224","lineNum":793,"lineType":1,"content":"凡用時，小修則只取幇扶日主，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003042816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1225","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"大修與埋𦵏則要幇扶四柱，使四柱純粹，以補龍山相","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003042816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1226","lineNum":795,"lineType":1,"content":"主命，乃千古不二之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003042816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1227","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"孟月甲、丙庚𡈼時，仲月艮巽坤乾時，季月乙辛丁癸時，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003059200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1228","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之四大吉時，又為神藏煞沒。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003059200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1229","lineNum":797,"lineType":1,"content":"但學者不明歸垣入局","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003075584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1230","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"之理以取吉耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003075584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1231","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月雨水後亥将用事，用子時上四","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003091968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1232","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"刻作𡈼子山向，則為神藏煞沒。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003091968","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1233","lineNum":799,"lineType":1,"content":"其他甲庚丙山向亦倣","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003108352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1234","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"此推。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003108352","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1235","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"每一日只有一時諸星歸垣入局，如太陽在子，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003124736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1236","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399931411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1237","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子時吉，太陽在午，則丙午時吉，此即歸垣入局之妙","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003124736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1238","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"也，吉莫大焉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003124736","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1239","lineNum":803,"lineType":1,"content":"元經云：善用時者，常令朱雀鎩羽，勾陳登","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003141120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1240","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"陛，白虎焼身，元武折足，螣蛇落水，天空投匭，所謂六神","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003141120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1241","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"悉伏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003141120","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1242","lineNum":805,"lineType":1,"content":"如不得六神悉伏，則得吉将加時亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003157504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1243","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"日干不旺，用禄時則旺。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509003173888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1244","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲日寅時、乙日夘時皆吉時，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538422836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1245","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"能幇日干及幇四柱者，真吉神也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538422836","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1246","lineNum":807,"lineType":1,"content":"時家亦有三竒，紫白","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538439220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1247","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"倣月例推。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538439220","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1248","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"遁甲竒門時乃行兵之用，非為造𦵏也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538455604","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1249","lineNum":809,"lineType":1,"content":"然造𦵏、修方、嫁","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538471988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1250","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399947795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1251","lineNum":811,"lineType":1,"content":"娶、上官、出行等事，用之皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538471988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1252","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"凡選時用竒門之法，先以超接為定，次看禄馬貴人到","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538488372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1253","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"局，與竒相合，斯為上吉，能解一切凶煞，召吉致福。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538488372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1254","lineNum":813,"lineType":1,"content":"如竒","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538504756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1255","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"到而禄不到，為獨脚竒；禄到而竒不到，為空亡禄，不能","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538504756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1256","lineNum":815,"lineType":1,"content":"為制煞之用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538504756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1257","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"按宗鏡用時之法，甚為切當。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538521140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1258","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"惟四大吉時一條，誤以","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538537524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1259","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞沒時為神藏煞沒，辨見義例元經。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538537524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1260","lineNum":817,"lineType":1,"content":"六神悉伏，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538553908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"神藏煞沒之正義也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538553908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰太陽在子，則𡈼子時吉；太","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538570292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399964179"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在午，則丙午時吉，專取太陽，當自為一義。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538570292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"其以𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538586676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"時為子時上四刻，扵義尤精。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538586676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":821,"lineType":1,"content":"見義例貴登天門條下。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538603060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰𡈼時作𡈼子山向，乃取真太陽到山到向之法。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538619444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":823,"lineType":1,"content":"但時刻係天常赤道度，山向係地平方位度，惟北極","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538635828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"之下，赤道與地平合。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538635828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"十二支占時之中四刻，八干四","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538652212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"維占前後時各二刻，合之亦為四刻。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538652212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":825,"lineType":1,"content":"如已正二刻至","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538668596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"午初二刻屬丙方；午初二刻至午正二刻屬午方之","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538668596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"類。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538668596","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"自是以南，則北極漸低，偏度漸多。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538684980","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":827,"lineType":1,"content":"又夏至日行北","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538701364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188399980563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":829,"lineType":1,"content":"陸，距地平逺，則偏度多；冬至日行南陸，距地平近，則","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538701364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"偏度少。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538701364","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"術家不明天學，乃以二十四方位為二十四","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538717748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"時，既與六𡈼之法不合，又不與山向相應。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538717748","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":831,"lineType":1,"content":"今按京師","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538734132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"北極出地，推得各節氣太陽到方時刻，列為表。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538734132","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188400029715"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1290","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"甲為北極，乙為京師天頂甲乙相距五十度五分。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538750516","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1291","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"丙","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538766900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1292","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"丁為赤道，戊為太陽。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538766900","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1293","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戊為夏至。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538783284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1294","lineNum":841,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽去極六十六","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538799668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1295","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"度三十分，即戊巳之餘。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538799668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1296","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"戊庚為髙弧，庚辛為太陽地","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538816052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1297","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"平經度，距午七度三十分，即庚乙辛角。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538816052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1298","lineNum":843,"lineType":1,"content":"用弧三角形","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538832436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1299","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"法，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538832436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1300","lineNum":844,"lineType":2,"content":"法見考成上編。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"求得戊甲乙角二度二十六分，即丙巳弧，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538832436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":845,"lineType":1,"content":"為太陽距午赤道度。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509538 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1332","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"通書云：凡修造，必身命年月方向皆利，則修作吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539061812","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1333","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"如或","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539078196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1334","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"不利，而又不得不作者，則當遷居。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539078196","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1335","lineNum":869,"lineType":1,"content":"自所遷之處，視所作","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539094580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1336","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"之方為吉可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539094580","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1337","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"如年命利作兑，不利作震，則當遷居而","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539110964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1338","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"東。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539110964","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1339","lineNum":871,"lineType":1,"content":"既居扵東，則自其居視所作之方，昔為震者，今為兑","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539127348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1340","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539127348","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1341","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"自此作之，則無不可。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539143732","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1342","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"論作方終始，凡所作止在一宫，選擇固易。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539160116","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1343","lineNum":873,"lineType":1,"content":"如連跨數宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539176500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1344","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"有吉有凶，則當扵吉宫起工，自此連及不利之宫，殊無","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539176500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188400144403"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1346","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"害也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539176500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1347","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"若興造月日利而工作未辦，則畧起造以應日時，","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539192884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1348","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"自此接連以作之，固無不可也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539192884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1349","lineNum":877,"lineType":1,"content":"及其畢工，須歸福徳之","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539209268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1350","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"方吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539209268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1355","lineNum":881,"lineType":1,"content":"論清明前後修墓法：凡已𦵏墓塋，或加土，或種樹，或砌","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539274804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1356","lineNum":882,"lineType":1,"content":"祭臺，或破壊修整，宜扵寒食、清明之間，鳩工修作，不論","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539274804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1357","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"山向、年月日時。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539274804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1358","lineNum":883,"lineType":1,"content":"按荆楚記，寒食係冬至後一百零五日。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539291188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1359","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355188400160787"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1360","lineNum":885,"lineType":1,"content":"以古厯平氣計之，清明在冬至後一百零六日半，寒食","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539307572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1361","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"乃清明前二日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539307572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1362","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"魏時寒食亦是三日。","logicSentenceId":"7678939509539323956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

ogicSentenceId":"7678926371318136878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"其日忌開市納財、立券、交易、裁衣。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318153262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":249,"lineType":1,"content":"○曹震圭曰：長","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318169646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774123555"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"星，金也；短星，火也，謂金火之氣能毁傷萬物也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318169646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":251,"lineType":1,"content":"○考原","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318186030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":252,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：長星者，庚辛也，以月建内所寄之干，用五虎元遁得","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318186030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":253,"lineType":1,"content":"庚辛者，自建辰向前數之，春夏至庚則止，秋冬至辛則","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318186030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":254,"lineType":1,"content":"止，其本節所當之卦，則取其宫數，其餘辰則一辰當一","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318186030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"得數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318186030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月建寅，寅中有甲，以甲遁得庚午，自寅","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318202414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"一震三，辰一，巳一午一，共得七數，故七日為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318202414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":256,"lineType":1,"content":"二","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318218798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"月建夘，夘中有乙，以乙遁得庚辰，自夘之震三，併辰一，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318218798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"共四數，故四日為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318218798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":258,"lineType":1,"content":"二月建辰，辰中寄乙，就乙仍","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318235182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774139939"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"遁得庚辰，止得一數，故一日為長星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318235182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":260,"lineType":1,"content":"四月建巳，用丁","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318251566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"遁得庚戌，自巳之巽四，歴午未申酉戌，共九數也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318251566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"午不","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318267950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"用離九者，以巳用巽四故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318267950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"五月建午，用丙遁得庚寅，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318284334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"為丙火長生之位，故向前得庚子。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318284334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"自離九歴未、申、酉、戌、","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318300718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"亥、子，得一十五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318300718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"333","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"六月建未，就丁遁得庚戌，自未申歴","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318317102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"3 },{"lineId":"361","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"辰當一得數於朔實二十九内減之，餘數是也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318513710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":280,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318530094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"用甲遁得丙寅，寅為艮八，以減二十九，餘二十一日，為","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318530094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"短星也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318530094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"二月用乙遁得丙戌，自夘之震三至戌得十，以","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318546478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"減二十九，餘十九也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318546478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"三月就乙遁得丙子，自辰一歴巽","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318562862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"四至子得十三，以減二十九，餘十六也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318562862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":284,"lineType":1,"content":"四月用丁遁得","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318579246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"丙午，為干支同體，故即用本宫之巽四，以減二十九，餘","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318579246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774189091"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"二十五也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318579246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"五月用丙遁得丙申，自午至申之坤二共四，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371318595630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":288,"lineType":1,"conten 1,"content":"春秋之始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384459273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"故長於初七、初八之上弦，短於二十一、二","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384475657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"十二之下弦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384475657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":308,"lineType":1,"content":"長至於望之十五者，長也；短自十六而","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384492041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"至於二十五者，短不及晦也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384492041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"五月而十五者，物長至五","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384508425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"月而一隂生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384508425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":310,"lineType":1,"content":"九月而十六、十七者，五隂盛而隂將消","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384524809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384524809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"十月而初一日者，陽將長而長之所由始也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384541193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"四月、五","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384557577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"月而二十五者，陽已極而短之所由止也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384557577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":312,"lineType":1,"content":"十五之前，初","logicSentenceId":"7678926371384573961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774238243"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":n {"lines":[{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774320163"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"唐書吕才傳卜宅篇曰：易稱上古穴居而野處，後世聖","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385376777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"人易之以宫室，葢取諸大壯。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385376777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"殷周時有卜擇之文，詩稱","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385393161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"相其陰陽，書卜洛食。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385393161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"近世乃有五姓，謂宫也，商也，角也，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385409545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"徴也，羽也，以為天下萬物悉配屬之，以處吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385409545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":360,"lineType":1,"content":"然言皆","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385425929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"不類，如張王為商，武庚為羽，是以音相諧附。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385425929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"至栁為宫，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385442313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"趙為角，則又不然。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385442313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"其間一姓而兩屬，復姓數字，不得所","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385458697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"content":"歸，是直野人巫師説爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385458697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":363,"lineType":1,"conten
