{"lines":[{"lineId":"566","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"通書曰：年貴人，冬至後用陽貴，夏至後用隂貴。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385786377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":397,"lineType":1,"content":"時貴人，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385802761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"晝用陽貴，夜用隂貴。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385802761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"又一説，子至巳用陽貴，午至亥用","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385819145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":399,"lineType":1,"content":"隂貴。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385819145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"571","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"凡修造，用家主名姓昭告，若家主行年不利，即以子弟","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385835529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774402083"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"行年得利者作修造主，昭告神祗，俟修造完偹入宅，然","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385835529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":403,"lineType":1,"content":"後安謝。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385835529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"凡新立宅舍，或盡行折除舊宅，倒堂豎造，修主人眷既","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385851913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"已出火避宅，其起工只就坐上架馬。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385851913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":405,"lineType":1,"content":"若修主不出火避","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385868297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"宅，或坐宫，或移宫，但就所修之方擇吉方起工架馬，或","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385868297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"别擇吉方架馬，亦利。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385868297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":407,"lineType":1,"content":"若修作在住近空屋，或在一百步","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385884681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"之外起工架馬，並不問吉凶方道。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385884681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"凡立磉，便為立向修方。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385933833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"如月家不利，須與豎造同月。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385950217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385966601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":414,"lineType":1,"content":"豎造既得吉日，則在前定磉難得全吉之日，吉多凶少。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385966601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"亦可用至扇架，則又輕於定磉矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371385982985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"凡新立宅舍，尚未歸火入宅，即於宅内新造牛欄、馬枋、","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386015753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774434851"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"羊棧、猪牢等屋，並不問年月、方道。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386015753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"如在百二十步之外，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386032137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"須看年月方道無凶煞占方宜起手修作。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386032137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"凡方道有三：曰隂方道，曰陽方道，曰交接方道。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386048521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"隂方道","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386064905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"者，即中宫滴水門也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386064905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"陽方道者，地基不與舊宅相接也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371386081289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"交接方道者，或前後左右屋宇與舊宅相連也。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501899785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"如屋上","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501916169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"起樓，及架天井，就簷滴水歸裏，皆屬中宫，名曰隂方，只","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501916169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"取中宫無煞，得吉㑹為大利。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501916169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"如建亭臺，造軒閣，不進中","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501932553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"宫，名曰陽方，只取外方向為利。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501932553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"如就屋比連接架增簷，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501948937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774451235"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"添桁補廊，名曰交接方，要内外俱有吉㑹，方為大利。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501948937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"凡作宅，據方隅而作方隅，則當用作方法。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501965321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"若開新基，立","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501981705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"棟宇，或淨盡拆除舊屋，而創新居，則當用作山法。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501981705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"然造","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501998089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"作之事，以人家居處為本宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371501998089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":432,"lineType":1,"content":"所居在所作百步外，則新","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502014473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"創者始可專用作山法。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502014473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"若所居在所作百步内，則雖新","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502030857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"創，亦當以作方法論之。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502030857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"如所居雖在所作百步之外，但","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502047241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"屋宇舊房門廊俱在，則其宅已定，不過補東而去西，除","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502047241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"舊而換新，尚當用作方法，但不在百步之内，禍福輕耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502047241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355176774467619"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"故凡造作，用作方法者多，用作山法者少。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502063625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"論方道逺近神煞：京城府州縣寸金之地，所作之方，但","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502080009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"隔街路作之不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502080009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"如小修葺，並不問吉凶之方，但要吉","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502096393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"日，餘即不畏。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502096393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":441,"lineType":1,"content":"若是鄉村之地修方道，或隔大溪水，人不","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502112777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"得渡，四時常流，亦不問凶煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502112777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"若隔小水溪澗，常流不絶，","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502129161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"小煞不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502129161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"若居城市，隔一街巷三五尺，非自已地者，亦","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502145545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"不犯方隅神煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502145545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"如欲屋近，作樓臺㕔館，雖是修方，亦取","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502161929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"方道，有吉神無凶煞，作之不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7678926371502161929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽家言，多病迂泥，術士揑造，益屬荒唐，而惑世誣民，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366206504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"則未有如合婚大利月之尤甚者。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366206504","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"夫婦之道，人倫之始，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366222888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"書載釐降，詩咏闗雎，未嘗有合婚之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366222888","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰士如歸","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366239272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"妻，迨冰未泮，禮曰仲春之月，令民㑹男女，未嘗有大利","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366239272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"月之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366239272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"即祿命之法，以人生年月日時去留疏配，推","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366255656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"人壽夭窮通，亦未嘗有以男女年月定妨妻妨夫之説","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366255656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366255656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"為是説者，不知其所自起，而皆托於吕才。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366272040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":53,"lineType":1,"content":"觀唐書吕","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366288424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244246843401"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"才傳，其於隂陽術數，辨駁甚詳 nNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"魁罡之義。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366648872","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"鐵掃帚既取三合，而水局取衰病月，金局","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366665256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"取冠帶與衰月，火局取臨官與死月，木局取帝旺與","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366665256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"胎月，參差不倫，又必傳寫之誤，無端而加以掃破之","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366665256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"名，當亦不能自為之説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366665256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"年月六害，祿命不忌，且年","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366681640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"月非夫婦，何以遂為不和之占？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366681640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"假令年月相衝，又當","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366698024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"作何論斷？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366698024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"此不待辨而知其非也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366714408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"四敗生命，既非本","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366730792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244246908937"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"於五行，又無取於三合，其月分更無例可推，而謂男","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366730792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":92,"lineType" 妻。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366796328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"又如水命女以土為夫，土長","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366812712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"生於申而衰於丑，故七月至十二月生為益財；病於","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366812712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"寅而養於未，故正月至六月生為退財；絶於已，故四","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366812712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"月生為望門。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366812712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"寡死於夘，墓於辰，故二三月生為夫多","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366829096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"厄；而二三四月生，又為死墓絶，妨夫。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366829096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"夫五音之命各","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366845480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"十二年，三月之中計二萬五千九百二十命，六月之","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366845480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244246941705"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"中計五萬一千八百四十命。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366845480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":109,"lineType":1,"content":"無論何日何時，而謂生","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366861864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"此三月之内皆妨妻妨夫，生此六月之内皆退財，固","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366861864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"萬萬無是理也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366861864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"至於男之益財，金命十月，誤起七月；","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366878248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"土命七月，誤起五月；女之益財，火、木、金命皆差早一","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366878248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"月，死墓絶妨夫，誤與男命同，則傳寫之譌，更不足辨。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366878248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"世人不察其所以然之故，惟聽術士之説，一一求其","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366894632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"悉合，多至逾時不得婚嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366894632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"嘻！","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366911016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":115,"lineType":1,"content":"俗術之害人，何至此極","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366927400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"耶！","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366927400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"然合婚之説，北方世俗用之，士大夫及南方皆不","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366943784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244246958089"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":118,"lineType":1,"content":"深信，而行嫁大利月，則舉世用之而不辨其非，而不","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366943784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"知其所謂大利者，固術士之揑造而無理之甚者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366943784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以女命為主，子、寅、辰、午、申、戌六陽年，自本命前","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366960168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"一月向前順數；丑、夘、己、未、酉、亥六隂年，自本命後一","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366960168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"月向後逆數，第一月為大利，第二月妨媒氏首子，第","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366960168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":123,"lineType":1,"content":"三月妨翁姑，第四月妨女父母，第五月妨夫，第六月","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366960168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"妨本身。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366960168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"至第七月又復一轉夫，第十二月為女本命，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366976552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"第六月為本命之衝，雖選擇無忌地支一字之理，而","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366976552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244246974473"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"猶有可言，陽前隂後一月，又何取以為大利耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366976552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"且第","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366992936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":128,"lineType":1,"content":"一月利矣，以次而推，何由而妨媒氏，何由而妨翁姑，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366992936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"何由而妨父母，何由而妨夫壻？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773366992936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"求之隂陽五行、九宫","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367009320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"八卦、堪輿建除叢辰之説，無一可通，此不亦荒誕不","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367009320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"經之至乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367009320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"而世俗懵然信之，一月偶愆，輒逾數歳，摽","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367025704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"梅束楚詩之致慨於失時者，比比皆然，故曰惑世誣","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367025704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"民之尤甚者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367025704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"今已奏准刪除，具錄立成於左，觀者","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367042088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"當自知。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367042088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"辨","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367058472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247089161"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":163,"lineType":1,"content":"右女命已上親屬，若得行嫁大利月，是遇吉期，無","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367271464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"諸禁忌，喜見新人。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367271464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":164,"lineType":1,"content":"餘月各有所忌，如無所忌之人","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367287848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":165,"lineType":1,"content":"則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367287848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusksljv/1-SK1619_figure_01475.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=kCZfiUCcZjLmxCue0n%2FLxoPeo18%3D","pictureHeight":1572,"pictureWidth":711,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusksljv/1-SK1619_figure_01475.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=o%2BBM0NYf6wPgxPCYMhVJZ9bWfug%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusksljv/1-SK1619_figure_01475.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":169,"lineType":1,"content":"玉皇鑾駕、紫㣲帝星、紫㣲鑾駕、北辰帝星、撼龍帝星、","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367320616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"都天寳照、都天轉運行衙帝星。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367320616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":170,"lineType":1,"content":"周仙羅星、星馬貴人，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367337000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"既非實有此星，又且必無此理。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367337000","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":171,"lineType":1,"content":"且于一帝星之中，又","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367353384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":172,"lineType":1,"content":"有金輪、火輪、水輪、天乙、太乙諸名，皆術士揑造選擇。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367353384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":173,"lineType":1,"content":"宗鏡日統而論之，有五六玉皇，終年各守一方，絶不","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367369768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"移易，是六朝之分皇，五代之各帝也，有是理乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367369768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":174,"lineType":1,"content":"且擇","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367386152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":175,"lineType":1,"content":"日而取日月星辰到山向者，喜山向之光輝也，豈謂","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367386152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"日月星辰中有神仙乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367386152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":176,"lineType":1,"content":"彼昏不知，悞以為道家所稱","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367402536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247121929"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":178,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽帝君、太隂帝君、銀河星君，遂各揑一玉皇以壓","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367402536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"之，以致紛紛不一，誣罔極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367402536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":179,"lineType":1,"content":"今皆刪去不用，而各錄","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367418920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":180,"lineType":1,"content":"立成於左。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367418920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"278","lineNum":213,"lineType":1,"content":"年支神煞隨二十四山順行者，從太歳逼近之方起，","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367484456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"以次漸推而逺，還歸于太歳之方。","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367484456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":214,"lineType":1,"content":"假如子年癸，名曰","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":215,"lineType":1,"content":"巡山羅㬋凶；次丑，則曰暗曜凶；又次艮，則曰土宿凶；","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":216,"lineType":1,"content":"又次寅，則曰瘟星凶；又次甲，則曰水星吉；又次夘，則","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":217,"lineType":1,"content":"曰財寳吉；又次乙，則曰金星凶；又次辰，則曰血光凶；","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":218,"lineType":1,"content":"又次巽，則曰太陽吉；又次巳，則曰吉星吉；又次丙，則","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":219,"lineType":1,"content":"曰火星凶；又次午，則曰炎曜凶；又次丁，則曰紫氣吉；","logicSentenceId":"7678947773367500840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskxv6j/1-SK1619_figure_01537.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=fr2QHRXYbks1Y7FDS4%2BvuEoplFQ%3D","pictureHeight":1570,"pictureWidth":142,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskxv6j/1-SK1619_figure_01537.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=Jn0gJ9kokQAm3AIXrbVgt%2BhyNw0%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbuskxv6j/1-SK1619_figure_01537.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247367689"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":222,"lineType":1,"content":"又次未，則曰榮官吉；又次坤，則曰計都凶；又次申，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":223,"lineType":1,"content":"曰刀兵凶；又次庚，則曰木星吉；又次酉，則曰旺田吉；","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":224,"lineType":1,"content":"又次辛，則曰鬼煞凶；又次戌，則曰傷亡凶；又次乾，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":225,"lineType":1,"content":"曰太隂吉；又次亥，則曰吉慶吉；又次𡈼，則曰攝提凶；","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"又次子，為太歳本位，則曰旺蠶吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498782248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":226,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年，則巡山羅㬋","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498798632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":227,"lineType":1,"content":"從艮起，以次順推二十四山，以居二十四煞，十二年","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498798632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"例同之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498798632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":228,"lineType":1,"content":"今觀其名而思其義，考其例而度其情，其為","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498815016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"297","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"術士揑造，已屬曉然。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498815016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":229,"lineType":1,"content":"唯巡山羅㬋逼近太歳，俗所最","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498831400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":230,"lineType":1,"content":"畏，而亦尚近乎理，故臺本取之，餘皆不用，而猶載其","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498831400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247384073"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"例于事類總集中。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498831400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"其起例錯誤，辨見義例。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498847784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":232,"lineType":1,"content":"又以二十","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498864168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"四煞中有計都，遂謂羅㬋屬火，辨見利用。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498864168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":233,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘無庸","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498880552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":234,"lineType":1,"content":"深辨，觀立成當共見矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498880552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"334","lineNum":262,"lineType":1,"content":"按，起例支神退方，子年起已逆行十二支，又謂之流","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498913320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"財。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498913320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"從月起者為月流財，從日起者為日流財。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498929704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋以一","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498946088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":264,"lineType":1,"content":"陽生于子，而至于巳之六陽，一隂生于午，而至于亥","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498946088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"之六隂，乃隂陽順生之序。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498946088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"今子年起巳，至巳年而在","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498962472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":266,"lineType":1,"content":"子，是陽之退也；午年起亥，至亥年而在午，是隂之退","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498962472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498962472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"然師以左次而無咎，壯以觸藩而無攸利，隂陽之","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498978856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":268,"lineType":1,"content":"義正不以進退為吉凶，且又非實有一物起已而逆","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498978856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247613449"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"行，徒曰年各一方，更無取義。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072498995240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"即子年巳方、午年亥方","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499011624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":272,"lineType":1,"content":"為劫煞，丑年辰方、未年戌方為歳煞，乃别從三合起","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499011624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"例，與支退了不相干。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499011624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"特俗情兢進，而好財術士遂詭","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499028008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":274,"lineType":1,"content":"詞以動聽，其與刀砧火血，雅俗雖有不同，而其為揑","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499028008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"造則一也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499028008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"況由是而進焉，以取支之卦位，子年己，丑","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499044392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"年辰，皆巽也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499044392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年夘，則震也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499060776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":276,"lineType":1,"content":"夘年寅，辰年丑，皆艮也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499077160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"巳年子，則坎也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499093544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"午年亥，未年戌，皆乾也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499109928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"申年酉，則兌","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499126312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499126312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"酉年申，戌年未，皆坤也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499142696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"亥年午，則離也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499159080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":278,"lineType":1,"content":"又或兼取","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499175464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"雙山，愈引愈逺，而本義遂不可曉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499175464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"今通書支退唯子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499191848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247629833"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"丑巳午未酉亥年與起例合，流財唯辰午未酉戌年","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499191848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"與起例合，餘年皆誤。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499191848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":282,"lineType":1,"content":"然則今之所謂退者亦非退，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499208232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"流者亦非流也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499208232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"俗術流失，至於此極，故刪而辨之，作","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499224616","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId": {"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"年月神煞，由來舊矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499257384","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":286,"lineType":1,"content":"術士好竒，每事揑造，造之不得，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499273768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":287,"lineType":1,"content":"則猶是神煞，而揑為别名，又略為改竄，以文其陋，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499273768","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p3-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl2s63/1-SK1619_figure_01538.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=9wL9AaLFE8g54EfIo5%2BykxsUijw%3D","pictureHeight":1566,"pictureWidth":253,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl2s63/1-SK1619_figure_01538.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=AN62%2FB2TgWsBGicwCS%2FB%2BC%2B7zTw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl2s63/1-SK1619_figure_01538.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247646217"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"神煞由此日紛。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499290152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":290,"lineType":1,"content":"即如一浮天空亡也，又名之曰頭白","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499306536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡，又名之曰八山空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499306536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"一坐煞、向煞也，又名之曰","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499322920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"翎毛禁向，又名之曰八山刀砧。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499322920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":292,"lineType":1,"content":"而亦自厭其重複也，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499339304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"則於八山刀砧而加之以三合月，于頭白空亡而加","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499339304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":294,"lineType":1,"content":"之以八卦山，而又叅互錯譌，世本遂並列之以為數","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499339304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，而莫之辨。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499339304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"又如六害，則别名之曰隂中太歳、隂中","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499355688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"煞，小耗則别名之曰淨欄煞，而皆隱其本名。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499355688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":296,"lineType":1,"content":"又如黄","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499372072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"道、黒道，則又别立名色，名曰明星、黒星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499372072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"而雷公與天","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499388456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":298,"lineType":1,"content":"岳，吉凶互異，雷公即青龍，本吉星也，天岳即天牢，本","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499388456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247662601"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":300,"lineType":1,"content":"凶星也，因天牢而别名曰天獄，因獄而訛嶽，又因嶽","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499388456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"而訛岳，遂以天岳為吉，而雷公為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499388456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":301,"lineType":1,"content":"曹震圭、邵泰衢","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499404840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"已辨其誤，而未之改正。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499404840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":302,"lineType":1,"content":"又如王官守相民日，則衍之","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499421224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"而至於十二，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499421224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":303,"lineType":2,"content":"説見義例。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"而又别為福厚恩勝等名。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499421224","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":303,"lineType":1,"content":"建除十","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499437608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"二神，已有同位異名，而又别為朱雀貴人等號。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499437608","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":304,"lineType":1,"content":"夫神","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499453992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"煞一也，而名號旁見側出，惑人耳目，深可厭惡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499453992","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":305,"lineType":1,"content":"今查","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499470376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"明概行刪去，而具立成於左。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499470376","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":306,"lineType":1,"content":"此外可以類推，亦不能","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499486760","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410" :null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":323,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈼子、巽巳、辛戌六山屬土，乙辰、庚酉四山屬金，甲夘、坤","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499535912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":324,"lineType":1,"content":"申四山屬水，艮寅、丁未四山屬木，癸丑、丙午、乾亥六山","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499535912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"屬火。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499535912","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"○魏鑑曰：此十干化氣所生也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499552296","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"其法用五子元遁，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499568680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":326,"lineType":1,"content":"視化氣天干所加之支，即為同氣，而同宫之干維隨之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499568680","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲巳化土，依五子元遁，得甲子、己巳、甲戌，故子、巳、戌","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499585064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499585064","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":328,"lineType":1,"content":"而𡈼與子，巽與巳，辛與戌，俱同宫，故六山俱屬土。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499601448","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"乙庚化金，依五子元遁，得庚辰、乙酉，故辰、酉屬金。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499617832","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"而乙","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499634216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"與辰，庚與酉，俱同宫，故四山俱屬金也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499634216","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":330,"lineType":1,"content":"餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499650600","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247793673"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"凡斗首俱以坐山所屬五行為王，為我，為元辰。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499666984","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":333,"lineType":1,"content":"我生者，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499683368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"為亷貞，為子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499683368","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"生我者，為貪狠，為官星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499699752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":334,"lineType":1,"content":"我尅者，為武曲，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499716136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"為妻財。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499716136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":335,"lineType":1,"content":"尅我者，為破軍，為鬼賊。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499732520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"447","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"凡擇日期，以年月為上，為外，為出。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499748904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":336,"lineType":1,"content":"日時為下，為内為入。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499765288","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"元辰宜生旺有氣，宜生出，不宜死絶受尅。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499781672","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":337,"lineType":1,"content":"亷貞子孫，只","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499798056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"喜一位，重見則洩氣，損子孫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499798056","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":338,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼官星，不宜生入尅入，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499814440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"宜休囚。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499814440","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":339,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲妻財，宜生旺有氣，宜生入尅入，不宜生出","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499830824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"尅出。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499830824","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":340,"lineType":1,"content":"破鬼宜休囚尅出，不宜生旺有氣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499847208","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247810057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":343,"lineType":1,"content":"按：斗首五行，不知其所自起，為其説者，皆托之楊筠松。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499863592","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":344,"lineType":1,"content":"及觀筠松所著諸篇，絶無一語論及斗首，其為偽托可","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499879976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"知。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499879976","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":345,"lineType":1,"content":"今臺本亦不載，而四方術士，多挾之以為秘訣，舉世","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499896360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"莫能别其是非。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499896360","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"不知其説，則固支離之甚者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499912744","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":346,"lineType":1,"content":"如因甲","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499929128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":347,"lineType":1,"content":"巳化土，遂以甲巳遁出之甲巳二干所臨之支，及其同","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499929128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"宫干維，皆屬土，而甲巳反不屬土，其大㫖已離其宗。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499929128","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":348,"lineType":1,"content":"而","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499945512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":349,"lineType":1,"content":"亷貞、貪狼諸名，又非卦變本義，由兹而推衍之，别為吉","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499945512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"凶格局，更不可問。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499945512","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":350,"lineType":1,"content":"故撮其大要而辨之，觀者知其無稽，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499961896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247826441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":352,"lineType":1,"content":"自不惑于其説，而好竒以自逞者，其亦可息矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499961896","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"474","lineNum":354,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗鏡曰：凡選擇取用尊帝二星，到山、到向、到方，能","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499994664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"壓一切凶煞，召吉致祥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072499994664","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":355,"lineType":1,"content":"若㑹歳命貴人祿馬同到修造，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500011048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":356,"lineType":1,"content":"遇之發福最快。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500011048","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"478","lineNum":357,"lineType":1,"content":"年起例凡上元下元甲子年，尊星起乾六、乙丑、兌七，丙","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500027432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、艮八，順行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500027432","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"中元甲子年，尊星起坎一，亦順行。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500043816","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"俱不入","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500060200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"中宫，輪六十年，其對宫為帝星。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500060200","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":359,"lineType":1,"content":"如下元甲子年，造乾山","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500076584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247842825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":361,"lineType":1,"content":"巽向，尊星到乾，帝星到巽，大吉。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500076584","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"501","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"按選擇宗鏡，極言尊、帝二星之吉，今考其起例，甚無義","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500191272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"理，宜乎臺本之不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500191272","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":375,"lineType":1,"content":"其曰年例上元、下元甲子起乾","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500207656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"六，中元甲子起坎一者，蓋自上元甲子年起乾六，至己","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500207656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":377,"lineType":1,"content":"未年而七周，庚申年又值乾六，則中元甲子必起坎一","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500207656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247875593"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500207656","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":379,"lineType":1,"content":"又至己未年而七周，庚申年又起坎一，則下元甲子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500224040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"必起乾六也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500224040","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"然下元甲子六十年既盡，而再起上元，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500240424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"不能復至乾六，與三元九宫周而復始之義不合。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500240424","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":381,"lineType":1,"content":"且既","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500256808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"用飛九宫，而不用中五，亦屬非理。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072500256808","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":38 ,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":411,"lineType":1,"content":"其日宜舉","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868077603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"百事。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868077603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"天老為黄帝時人，尚未知其有無。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868093987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"至元女之説，更","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868110371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"為誤謬。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868110371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"元者，天之色也；女者，母萬物者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868126755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":413,"lineType":1,"content":"亥在子前，至","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868143139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247941129"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"于子而天開矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868143139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":415,"lineType":1,"content":"子前為亥，則亥乃生天之本也，故乾在","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868159523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868159523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"宋儒曰：以形體言之，謂之天；以主宰言之，謂之帝；以","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868175907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"性情言之，謂之乾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868175907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"故乾者，天之性情也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868192291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":417,"lineType":1,"content":"性情在形體之","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868208675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"先，故天開於子，而乾在亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868208675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"乾在亥，即是生天者矣，故","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868225059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"又以元女名之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868225059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":419,"lineType":1,"content":"元即天也，女為母義，故六𡈼之術于十","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868241443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"干中配𡈼為名，謂是元女所傳，𡈼即亥云爾。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868241443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"乃以元女","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868257827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"為實有此人，又能與黄帝、文王、周公、孔子同集此三十","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868257827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"七日，流傳人世，亦可嗤矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868257827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"又以董仲舒配成七聖，益為","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868274211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247957513"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"怪謬不倫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868274211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"伏斷日、宻日、裁衣日，皆以值宿起算。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868306979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"查二十八宿選擇","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868323363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，來自西域，伏斷以日配宿，略似旬空、路空，八十四","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868323363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"日而一周。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868323363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以子日起虚，丑值斗，亥值壁，亥、子、丑屬","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868339747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"水，而又值水宫之宿，以水遇水為嫌，是與路空之義相","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868339747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"似也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868339747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"以下按支逆數則進四宿，順數則退四宿。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868356131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋支十","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868372515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":431,"lineType":1,"content":"二而宿二十八，支輪二周，必差四位，故連本位隔四取","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868372515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247973897"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868372515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":433,"lineType":1,"content":"戌值胃，酉值觜，申值鬼，未值張，午值角，已值房，辰值","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868388899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"箕，夘值斗，寅值室。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868388899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"其值日之宿皆在日支後二宫，是與","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868405283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"600","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"旬空之義相似也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868405283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":435,"lineType":1,"content":"然寅夘日在後三宫，則因隔四所致，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868421667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"必不能合，較之旬空、路空之義，亦又疎矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868421667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"且伏斷本選","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868438051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"時之法，兼取亢、牛、婁、鬼四金宿為暗金伏斷時。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868438051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":437,"lineType":1,"content":"其法以","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868454435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"一元甲子日起虚，二元甲子日起奎，三元甲子日起畢，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868454435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":439,"lineType":1,"content":"四元甲子日起鬼，五元甲子日起翼，六元甲子日起氐，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868454435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"七元甲子日起箕。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868454435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"七元既盡，而甲子日又起虚，周而復","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868470819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244247990281"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"始，各從甲子日起子時，歴六十日七百二十時而止，然","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868470819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"其數則亦七日八十四時而一周也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868470819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":443,"lineType":1,"content":"如一元甲子日起","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868487203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"虚宿，即從子時起虚，寅時值室，巳時值婁，酉時值觜，故","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868487203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"一元甲子日子時、寅時、酉時皆為伏斷，已時為暗金。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868487203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":445,"lineType":1,"content":"由","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868503587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"是順數，乙丑日子時起鬼，丙寅日子時起箕，丁夘日子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868503587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":447,"lineType":1,"content":"時起畢，戊辰日子時起氐，己巳日子時起奎，庚午日子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868503587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"時起翼，至辛未日子時又起虚，與甲子日同。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868503587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"二元甲子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868519971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":449,"lineType":1,"content":"日起奎宿，即從子時起奎，丑時值婁，申時值鬼，故二元","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868519971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248006665"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子日丑時、申時皆為暗金，申時又為伏斷。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868519971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":451,"lineType":1,"content":"以次順數，","logicSentenceId":"767895007 {"lineId":"638","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"夫理非自然，數非脗合，皆屬揑造，宜今選時之","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868618275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"不用也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868618275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":461,"lineType":1,"content":"密日者，乃房、虚、星、昴四宿，七政屬日，西語曰密，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868634659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"彼地以為主喜事，而中國遂以其日忌安𦵏啓攢凶事，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868634659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"亦無謂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868634659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":463,"lineType":1,"content":"且西域二十八宿分屬七政，其日各有宜忌，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868651043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"與中國風俗逈然不同。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868651043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"專取密日，更屬無謂。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868667427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"至以角、亢、","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868683811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":465,"lineType":1,"content":"房、斗、牛、虚、壁、奎、婁、鬼、張、翼、軫十三宿為宜裁衣，亦出彼","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868683811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"地俗忌，並不可從。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868683811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"密日裁衣日易明不列立成伏斷日","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868700195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":467,"lineType":1,"content":"時各列立成于後。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868700195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","page {"lines":[{"lineId":"658","lineNum":475,"lineType":1,"content":"宋王明清談錄載：丁顧言宦蜀，至官有期，駐舟江滸，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868749347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"游憩山寺，遇老僧，問何為而至，丁具以告。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868749347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"又問期在","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868765731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"何時，丁又以告。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868765731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":477,"lineType":1,"content":"僧曰：是取為兀日，不可視事，勿避之，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868782115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"君必以事去。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868782115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"丁笑而不應。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868798499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"既至官月餘，以事免歸。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868814883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"是","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868831267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"兀日之説，自宋已有之矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868831267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":479,"lineType":1,"content":"顧詳其取義，不過小六𡈼","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868847651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"之留連赤口日耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868847651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"陽年正月初一日起小吉，隂年正","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868864035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"月初一日起留連，按日順數，毫無深義。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868864035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":481,"lineType":1,"content":"然則宋時老","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868880419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"僧亦偶中耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868880419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"人之以事去官者，豈盡由視事之遇兀","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868896803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248088585"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"日耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868896803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"以兀日視事者，又豈盡去官耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868913187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl5xy3/1-SK1619_figure_01511.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=D1Do0dbC7ouSaswHDbSDMD9RR%2F8%3D","pictureHeight":1565,"pictureWidth":949,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl5xy3/1-SK1619_figure_01511.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=WP4wDbwXdoW0Va27sZajRBRYZAI%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl5xy3/1-SK1619_figure_01511.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"681","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"通書以每月初四、初七、十六、十九、二十八凡五日，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868945955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"之四不祥，忌上官赴任、臨政親民，世俗信之惟謹。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868945955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":489,"lineType":1,"content":"今","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868962339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"按其起例，蓋以隔三為破，對七為衝，乃月朔地支衝","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868962339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl6al7/1-SK1619_figure_01512.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=QltgxoHzqY%2FJS6tb3p%2FQ1p3t1n4%3D","pictureHeight":1551,"pictureWidth":615,"originalUrl":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl6al7/1-SK1619_figure_01512.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=3XBmAzsNwg6NnXOOsrNZK7Forxw%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl6al7/1-SK1619_figure_01512.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248121353"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"破之日，猶建除家之平破日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868978723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":493,"lineType":1,"content":"假如月朔是子日，子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868995107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"破夘而衝午，此五日者，非夘日則午日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072868995107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"月朔是丑","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869011491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"日，丑破辰而衝未，此五日者，非辰日則未日也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869011491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":495,"lineType":1,"content":"自寅","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869027875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"至亥皆倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869027875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋古者以月朔為吉月，故術士遂以衝","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869044259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"破之日為不祥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869044259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":497,"lineType":1,"content":"然日統于月，月建當令氣王，故以衝","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869060643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"破為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869060643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"若月朔，亦月中之一日耳，餘日干支，無與月","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869077027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":499,"lineType":1,"content":"朔衝破之理，則四不祥之名，亦附㑹支離之甚者也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869077027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"今刪去不用。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869093411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"703","lineNum":503,"lineType":1,"content":"轉神歴曰：紅沙者，孟月酉，仲月巳，季月丑，其日忌嫁","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869126179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"娶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869126179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":504,"lineType":1,"content":"○儲泳袪疑説曰：己、酉、丑之所以為煞者，先天數","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869142563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"之四衝也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869142563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"夫子、午之數各九，夘酉各六，總為三十。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869158947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"自","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869175331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"子順行，極三十而見已，是為四仲之正煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869175331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"寅、申各七，","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869191715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"己亥各四，總二十二。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869191715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"自子順行，極二十二而見酉，是","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869208099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"為四孟之正煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869208099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌各五，丑未各八，總二十六，自子","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869224483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"順行，極二十六而見丑，是為四季之正煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869224483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"此申𡈼三","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869240867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"煞之所由起也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869240867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248154121"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"按紅沙即身𡈼煞，儲華谷以為極數，然驛馬亦是極","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869257251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"數，是不得以極為凶也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869257251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":514,"lineType":1,"content":"即謂驛馬為三合，身𡈼為四","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869273635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"衝，然四衝為建、破、平、收，而平收亦不盡以為忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869273635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"況酉","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869290019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"月巳日則是三合，亥月酉日則是生氣，亦未可以其","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869290019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"為四衝之總數而遂謂之衝。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869290019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"非若驛馬實有動象，若","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869306403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"四季月丑日，則真建、破、魁、罡，不待以紅沙而後為忌","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869306403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869306403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"又一本孟月取巳，仲月取酉，皆與季月例同。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869322787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"通書、","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869339171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"萬年書皆不用，故今仍之，不以轉神為據云。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869339171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248170505"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿經以月厭前一辰為章光，後一辰為無翹。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869371939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":523,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋堪","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869388323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"輿家專忌月厭，故前後並忌，然亦是後人附㑹耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869388323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"無","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869404707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"翹即太陽，辨見義例。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869404707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"堪輿家專取不將，乃厭前干配","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869421091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"厭後支，章光已是厭前支，自在不用之内，不須又立","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869421091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"章光名色也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869421091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"且日辰非同，方位比連，無前後並忌之","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869437475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"理。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869437475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"别本又以厭後為金烏，厭前為玉兔，並為歳神吉","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869453859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"方。","logicSentenceId":"7678950072869453859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"然則方且不忌，何況於日？","log
