{"lines":[{"lineId":"947","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"冰消瓦解，又名夭命煞。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409699880","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"以例推之，即年支之平收也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409716264","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"夫平收日已非盡凶，而年煞又輕於月煞，何年之平","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409732648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"收，即至於冰消瓦解而夭命乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409732648","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"陽月平，隂月收，為天","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409749032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"952","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"罡，加本年遁干為滅門。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409749032","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"953","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"陽月收，隂月平，為河魁，加本","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409765416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"年遁干為大禍。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409765416","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"如正月己為平日，亥為收日，甲巳年","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409781800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"五虎遁則為己巳、乙亥也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409781800","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"二月子為收日，午為平日，","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409798184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳年五虎遁則為庚午、丙子也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409798184","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘年月倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409814568","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"夫","logicSentence ull,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"豈知抄之刻之，遂成故","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409929256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"典。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409929256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":619,"lineType":1,"content":"觀諸凶煞，火星與官符血刃獨多，蓋愚民怕官，非","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409945640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355244248334345"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"與火燭，而貧者止以六畜為生計故也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409945640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":621,"lineType":1,"content":"今觀此條，則","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409962024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"充類至義之盡。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409962024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"夫名之可畏，無有過於冰消瓦解、滅","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409978408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"門大禍者，而究其實，則止一平收日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409978408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"嘻！","logicSentenceId":"7678950073409994792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":623,"lineType":1,"content":"術士之揑造","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410011176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"大言，妄談禍福，乃至此極也！","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410011176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl7cij/1-SK1619_figure_01515.we {"lines":[{"lineId":"989","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"世俗多畏楊公忌，通書亦多載之，謂其日不宜出行","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410043944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"舉事，犯之不利，皆因未悉其原委，故為所惑耳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410043944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":629,"lineType":1,"content":"今按","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410060328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"其説，乃是室火猪日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410060328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":630,"lineType":1,"content":"其術元旦起角宿，依二十八宿","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410076712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"次序順數，值室宿之日，即為楊公忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410076712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":631,"lineType":1,"content":"不論月之大小，","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410093096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"二十八日一週，每月遞退二日，故正月十三、二月十","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410093096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135054875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":635,"lineType":1,"content":"一以至七月初一、二十九，而終于十二月十九，凡十","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410109480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"三日。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410109480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"夫以宿值日，亦如用甲子紀日，雖未必始於大","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410125864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"撓，而其來已久。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410125864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":637,"lineType":1,"content":"每日一宿，自然順序，不用安排，以論","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410142248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"趨避，猶可説也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410142248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"然亦未聞室宿值日有所避忌。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410158632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"今並","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":639,"lineType":1,"content":"非值日之宿，而强以角宿起元旦，每年叧起，不能輪","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1007","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"轉，固不通矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410175016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"且若正月小，則二月十一日乃是危宿，","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410191400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":641,"lineType":1,"content":"二月再小，則三月初九日乃是虚宿，又安得强指為","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410191400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"室火猪乎？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410191400","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"晉志曰：營室為元宫，又名清廟，必非凶曜。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410207784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"詩曰：定之方中，作於楚宫。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410224168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"爾雅曰：營室謂之定。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410240552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":643,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋古","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410256936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135071259"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"者視營室中而興土功，未當以為忌也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410256936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":645,"lineType":1,"content":"將以其為火","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410273320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1019","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"尾、室、觜、翼皆火宿也，何獨忌於室耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410289704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1020","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"將以其為猪","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410306088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1021","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"歟？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410306088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1022","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"星係宫像，不係肖形，顧可實指為猪耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410322472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1023","lineNum":647,"lineType":1,"content":"邪説誣民，","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410338856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1024","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"莫此為甚。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410338856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1025","lineNum":648,"lineType":1,"content":"彼楊公者，不知為何許人，其説殆與宻日","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410355240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1026","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"同出西域。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410355240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1027","lineNum":649,"lineType":1,"content":"彼俗惡猪，聞聲輒厭，故併忌之，然豈可用","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410371624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1028","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"之中國耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410371624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1033","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"嫁娶最忌月厭。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410420776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1034","lineNum":655,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭正月從戌起，戌為狗，術士遂以","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410437160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1035","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"天狗命之。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410437160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1036","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"夘戌酉申者，春季之月厭也，折其中而取","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410453544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1037","lineNum":657,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，謂之春季月厭正位，命為天狗頭，犯之者小姑無","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410453544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1038","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410453544","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1039","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"夏午、秋夘、冬子，同此例也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410469928","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1040","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"反之即為厭，對正位而","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410486312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1041","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之天狗尾，犯之者妨夫主。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410486312","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1042","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"月厭前一位為章光，正","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410502696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1043","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"月在酉，春季酉申未，折其中而取申，謂之天狗口，忌","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410502696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1044","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"行嫁。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410502696","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1045","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"天喜之説，有以春戌、夏丑、秋辰、冬未論者，有以","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410519080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1046","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"三合成日論者，又有以春季未午巳，夏季辰夘寅，秋","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410519080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1047","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135104027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1048","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"季丑子亥，冬季戌酉申論者。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410519080","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1049","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"今取此隨月將三合逆","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410535464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1050","lineNum":665,"lineType":1,"content":"行之天喜，而亦折其中而取春午、夏夘、秋子、冬酉，謂","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410535464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1051","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"之天喜正位，而命之為天狗腹，主當年無子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410535464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1052","lineNum":666,"lineType":1,"content":"春夏之","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410551848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1053","lineNum":667,"lineType":1,"content":"天喜，即秋冬之紅鸞，乃又取紅鸞十二位，折其中，而","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410551848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1054","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"取春子、夏酉、秋午、冬夘，謂之紅鸞正位命之天狗背，","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410551848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1055","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"主三年有子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410551848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1056","lineNum":669,"lineType":1,"content":"春季，月將，亥、戌、酉；夏季，申、未、午；秋季，巳、","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410568232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1057","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"辰、夘；冬季，寅、丑、子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950073410568232","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1058","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"亦折其中，而取春戌、夏未、秋辰、冬","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017120256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1059","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，為六合正位而謂之天狗足，主六年生子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017120256","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1060","lineNum":671,"lineType":1,"content":"春季，月","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017136640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1061","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"害，巳、辰、夘；夏季，寅、丑、子；秋季，亥、戌、酉；冬季，申、未、午。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017136640","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1062","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017153024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1063","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135120411"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1064","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"折其中，而取春辰、夏丑、秋戌、冬未，謂之月害。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017153024","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1065","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"正位而","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017169408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1066","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"謂之天狗後足，主九年生子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017169408","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1067","lineNum":675,"lineType":1,"content":"夫月厭寅，月起戌，戌則","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017185792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1068","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"屬狗。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017185792","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1069","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"若夘月，即居酉位，而為雞，以此遂以天狗名之，","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017202176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1070","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"已屬可笑。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017202176","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1071","lineNum":677,"lineType":1,"content":"又諸神與十二辰相為叅伍，乃有月厭、厭","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017218560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1072","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"對、天喜、紅鸞等名，非獨重二、五、八、十一四箇月也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017218560","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1073","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"乃","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017234944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1074","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"截住兩頭，中間取一位起例，益屬支離不通。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017234944","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1075","lineNum":679,"lineType":1,"content":"以此硬","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017251328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1076","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"配頭、尾、口、腹、背、足，成一天狗，而定生子之年分，妨夫、","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017251328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1077","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"妨小姑之占斷，謬悠極矣。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017251328","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1078","lineNum":681,"lineType":1,"content":"且小姑無子，與新婦何涉？","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017267712","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1079","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"而天喜正位，定必大吉，而斷為當年無子。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017284096","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1080","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋里巷小","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017300480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1081","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135136795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1082","lineNum":684,"lineType":1,"content":"民之情，小姑者，老婦之所鍾愛，而春月行嫁，臘月生","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017300480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1083","lineNum":685,"lineType":1,"content":"子，新婦有越禮之疑，故以小姑無子為凶，而以當年","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017300480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1084","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"無子為吉也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017300480","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1085","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"術士苦心，侮弄鄉愚，良可悲歎。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017316864","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1086","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"選擇宗","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017333248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1087","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"鏡不加辨駁，轉編載其説，吁可怪也。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017333248","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1088","lineNum":687,"lineType":1,"content":"又以春夘、夏午、","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017349632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1089","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"秋酉、冬子四正位，謂之天狗方，益屬不經。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017349632","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1090","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"何天狗之","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017366016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1091","lineNum":689,"lineType":1,"content":"彌綸宇宙如此耶？","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017366016","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1095","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"天、地兵、人、鬼、死六道四吉二凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017398784","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1096","lineNum":693,"lineType":1,"content":"天、地、兵、人，吉，鬼、死，凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017415168","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1097","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"以十二歳分為兩週，自子至已，自午至亥，輪轉六道。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017431552","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1098","lineNum":695,"lineType":1,"content":"子年艮坤，天道；甲庚，地道；乙辛，兵道；巽乾，人道；丙𡈼，","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017447936","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1099","lineNum":0,"lineType":5,"content":"","figure":{"head":"","descriptions":[],"tplvUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl8efv/1-SK1619_figure_01517.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-rsize-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN:1200:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=wCGBRyQ5CZvO%2Fjr46i7%2FRQ3BUjw%3D","pictureHeight":1552,"pictureWidth":595,"originalUrl":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl8efv/1-SK1619_figure_01517.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-wm-png:6K-G5YW45Y-k57GN.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=vbhltkuE4%2BM3s6ssXfKmXLsbu4k%3D","uri":"read/SK1619/10/ref/1l9lmbusl8efv/1-SK1619_figure_01517.webp"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1100","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527355353135169563"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1101","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼道；丁癸，死道。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017464320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1102","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"丑年則從甲庚起天道，而艮坤轉為","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017480704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1103","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"死道。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017480704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1104","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"寅年則從乙辛起天道，而甲庚轉為死道。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017497088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1105","lineNum":699,"lineType":1,"content":"六歳","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017513472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1106","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"既週，午年即同子年之例，以達於亥。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017513472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1107","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"其為謬妄，不足","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017529856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1108","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"深辨。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017529856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1109","lineNum":701,"lineType":1,"content":"又黄帝龍首經有占歳月利道吉凶法，陽歳以","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017546240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1110","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"大吉臨太歳，隂歳以小吉臨太歳。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017546240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1111","lineNum":702,"lineType":1,"content":"視天上甲庚所臨","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017562624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1112","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"為天道，丙𡈼所臨為人道，魁罡所臨為拘檢。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017562624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1113","lineNum":703,"lineType":1,"content":"天道、人","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017579008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1114","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"道吉，拘檢凶。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017579008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1115","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"假令今年太歳在寅，大吉臨寅，視天上","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017595392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1116","lineNum":705,"lineType":1,"content":"甲庚臨地，乙辛為天道，天上丙𡈼臨地，丁癸為人道，","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017595392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

"神煞起例天、地、兵、人、鬼、死六道，蓋即龍首經","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017726464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1131","lineNum":715,"lineType":1,"content":"之法，而又推廣之，愈鑿愈陋。","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017726464","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1132","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"年支子、丑、寅、夘、辰、已、午、未、申、酉、戍、亥","logicSentenceId":"7678950074017742848","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
